tei:div.tei:p: gu ru rgyal mtshan gyi gter sgrung deb phreng / byejijici tsho — — jigli/tshoX sa'adza ṭwāṃXci ra ga 'a la ga tsāko/3 tre gyi jirghaṃ )/ richo ciri —pyi ༄ sgo sgo — —dzi nga ma sa las// riṇḍaṃ‘rtsa ci 4 / rgo tsho / —cinyi/tsho ski ci spro 1 4 ske3ri —sta ri rge ḍo rte ‘ dzha //sto wardo sto rimi chogyu/ pyiXci ‘/ / dzi ṭwāṃ — / —chocibyeci/dro/rwasgyutsho rshasduspe pe shī ṣṭharme ci ci — rnyirīX ci rdatshosnyiwasnyernyi rsha ༈ pre co ci rsha sdoolha / hūṃ — ci —4 sgo tsho 2ṭwāṃ nyeXru)pebye

'dzam gling skyes mchog seḍi chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi rnam par thar ba mu tag phreng mdzes las:sbyozhi7sbyoje|khyod7ljang/ljang 〈sna/7rjerjetholjang:༄byu gu ru rgyal mawo gyis phab:mgo log khul mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang ge sar rtsom zhib khang gis bsgrigs/kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

nge ( sderka liju snarī /potrepo rdzo dnghadnghardzerdzo4 nee dā97 tsuriri bye9 tsho sde rdzo lko lgo tsho lngedze mo/ nghruci 49— tre༅ rke 7 tshi 3 rsha —rkewa — ༅ tsho /kyi) ṭwāṃrkiwatho—31 rdoga~XdrotshaXwaXpha sheltatsho ༷ tshostu /tre tsho—rdze dkunya — dnghaskyi khu 4shwekhaṃ zijiXkta—༷ji ge de — rdzo tshakāshā /hphu mi ༷ / trītse sdo — sna sdushaju rte sna7 ju shaṃ / kṣ-i paṃtrī rdzo rme ni 9 byu bhe ༷sna ༄shā (tre1 po chi rke ṇḍaṃ rī〉 —dngha rngo dkupyo dzotho borin bhe rsā rdo rlo rka tre pa~Xtho8— sgro kṣiṃ / 5 mo — /rī /dzolkonghrudhe 3rdzo7 rsha tre tswa wake —wurngo7lha(rdzo7 ci dzā sko tsho —— gresherdzezhe dzedze— sna bhe tre
'dzam gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi rnam par thar ba mu tig phreng mdzes las:byang mi min dngul gyi rdzong chen phab pa me rlung 'tshub ma'i lang tsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

wā rtsom pa po mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus/ 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khyon na‘‘bris na zad mtha' med pa'i sgrung gteramimizhes rlung ltar grags pa'i ngag rig sgyu rtsal gyi dbang phyug dam pa gu ru chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog ni bod rab rgyal me lug(spyi lo1967)lor yab rong le'i 'dzam gling dang /coyum dur bud bza' lha 'dzoms gnyis kyi sras su mgo log 'bum pa khag gsum gyi nang tshan a skyong gong ma'i dur bud tsho bar sku 'khrungs/ dur bud bla ma mthu stobs dbang drag gis tshe dbang dang 'brel mtshan gu ru chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dur bud bla ma bde dpal dang / nam sprul 'jigs med phun tshogs/ mkha' 'gro tā re lha mo sogs skyes chen dam pa mang pos mgrin gcig gis dur bud gter ston shes rab rgyal mtshan nam mtshan gzhan dur bud ras pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi yang srid 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin dang 'brel bsngags brjod dang bkur snyi rgya cher mdzad/dur bud gter ston shes rab rgyal mtshan ni sngon dpal o rgyan chen po'i zhal slob zag med 'od lus grub pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mchog gyur nyang ting 'dzin bzang po 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i thugs rje yas sprul du byon pa'i o rgyan las 'phro gling pa'am rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po dang 1

sngags 'chang hūṃ nag me 'bar zhes sku gcig la mtshan gsum du grags pa'i gter chen de nyid kyi rnam rol yin la/ gling dus su 'bru sras nam mkha' thog 'gyur gyi skye ba bzung zhes grags/ mdor na nyang ban gyi skye phreng nyer brgyad pa gter chen shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / nyer dgu ba sgrung gter gu ru chos kyi rgyal mtshan yin tshul sngon gyi gter chen mang po'i lung gis zin zhes rgyal yum tā re lha mos zhal bzhes mdzad myong /gu ru chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog nyid chung dus nas skyes thob kyi shes rab rno zhing / dam pa'i rang bzhin gsal la/ grub pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs kyang ma nges par ston pa zhig yin/ khong gis snga phyir dur bud bla ma mthu stobs dbang drag dang / dur bud bla ma bde dpal/ gtug rgya bla ma tshe ldan/gtug rgya bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ o rgyan sku gsum gling ba/ gces sprul 'jigs med sor rtog rdo rje/ ho thog bla ma rig 'dzin 'jigs med/rtogs ldan blo gros rgya mtsho/ nam sprul 'jigs med phun tshogs/ rgyal yum tā re lha mo/ mkhan chen 'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas/ a kya bla ma dkar chos/ bya bral chos dbyings/ dur bud bla ma nam mkha'/ dpal yul karma chags med/ bla ma mthu ldan rig pa'i rdo rje sogs mkhas grub skyes chen dam pa bcu phrag du ma'i zhabs la gtug nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gnas la thos bsam rgya cher mdzad pas/ thun mong rig 2

gnas lha ris kyi thig rtsa dang / tshon gyi sbyor sde/ thang ka brkos ris sogs sku gsung thugs rten gyi bzo bkod/ gzab gshar mdzes rtsal gyi yig gzugs sna tshogs/ bca' 'bud rdung gsum/ gar dbyangs thig gsum/'don phyag len/ rnam thar zlos gar sna tshogs kyi bstan bcos spyi dang /yul dus mi sna'i bzo bkod rgyan chas sogs bye brag gi bzo rtsal/ rtsa chu'i brtag pa sogs sman rtsis kyi shes bya dang lag len gyi man ngag skye bo'i dpyad pa/ rta dpyad sogs brtag thabs sna tshogs/ sum rtags dag gsum/snyan ngag mngon brjod/ rtsom rig glu gar rol mo sogs shes par bya ba'i gnas mang po thugs su chud par ma zad lag len gyi gnad la mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ thun mong ma yin pa rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang /khyad par du snga 'gyur ka dpal rdzogs gsum las brgyud pa'i smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung rgya mtsho lta bu mnos pa las/ thos bsam sgom pa'i mdzad pa rlabs che la/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol zhing / thugs rjes gzhan don nus pa'i tshad du son pas/ mkhan chen 'a jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas dang / rgyal yum tā re lha mo sogs skyes chen dam pa mang pos bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa/ 'brel tshad don ldan padma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i tshad ldan gyi gter ston du yang yang bsngags shing / khong gi mdzad 'phrin spyi dang / khyad par du zab mo 3

gter gyi chos skor la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po mdzad myong / khong gi gter chos las ge sar skor gyi gter sgrung thams cad la rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig pa'i dpa' bo thams cad kyis dpyad bsdur dang mthong chen mdzad mus yin la/ rgyal khab kyi 'brel ldan sde khag krung go spyi tshogs tshan rig khang dang / rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang / rgyal khab rig gnas pu'u/ krung go rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs bcas thun mong gis‘‘rgyal khab rim pa'i sgrung mkhan mkhas pa'i’migo ming gsol myong la/zhing chen dang / khul rim pa'i bya dga' thengs bcu phrag gnyis thob myong /khong gi gter sgrung gi kha byang la sgrung khag brgya dang nyi shu bri nus la/ da lta phab zin pa'i sgrung yig che chung bsdoms pa'i pod nyer brgyad yod/ khong da lta mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang gi ge sar zhib 'jug khang du phyag las gnang bzhin yod/ khong nyid sgrung mkhan du gyur pa'i go rim dang / khong gis sgrung phab pa'i skabs kyi khyad chos/ phab zin pa'i sgrung yig so so'i tshig don gnyis kyi dmigs bsal gyi che ba sogs rgyal khab phyi nang gi dus deb dang brnyan 'phrin khang mang po las bstan yod pas 'dir ma spros la/ khong la gter sgrung las gzhan pa'i brtsam chos dang / gter chos mang du bzhugs kyang re zhig ngo sprod kyi dgos pa ma mchis pas rgyas par bris med/ mdor na khong nyid kyis sgrung 4

gter gyi mdzad pa skyong tshul la/ khrag 'thung su kha badzra yis gter nas bton pa'i gter chos〈'jam dbyangs wer ma dkar po'i lung byang mun sel sgron me:〉las/ dus kyi rab byung 'dzum pa'i tshe: nam mkha'i thog zer 'od snang 'bar: shel dkar lhun po'i mgul ba ru: rgyal mtshan dkar po wer mas 'degs: dam tshig 'jam pa'i rdo rjer bsre: mtshan snyan dbyangs can sngon mos sgrogs: phrin las ārya tā res spel: ngo mtshar sa gzhi'i rgyan du che: zhes bstan yod pas tshul gnas kyi dpyod ldan rnams kyis thugs yul du 'jags par 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba 'di yang mgo log khul ge sar zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi 'gan 'dzin pa rmongs rtul nor sde yis spyi rtsis2005lo'i zla10bar bris pa dge legs 'phel/ 5

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1)me'u dang po/gur nag dpon gyi blo thabs kyis/ /the'u ring bla mar mthu bcol byas/ /lung bstan byung nas khro rgyal gyis/ /ngan sngags sgrub pa'i las la gzhol/ / (3)le'u gnyis pa/gtor zor me dpung mthu chen 'gran/ /bdud kyis khro thung zor kha bsgyur/ /mi min rdzong la gtor brlag thebs/ /khrag ral khros nas dmag rgod phab/ / (29)le'u gsum pa/shar gling dmag sna byang la gtad/ /byang gling dpa' bo'i ngar 'thab byas/ /me yi me ru dmar po dang / /

rtsal ldan seng ge thog rgod bsgral/ / (50)me'u bzhi ba/dgra lhas dmag bkod legs po mdzad/ /rten 'brel rgya mtsho'i skyel ma bzang / /mi min bdud kyi bla gnas btul/ /spyi dpon blo gros sgo mo 'byed/ / (74)me'u lnga ba/stong bdud dang ni shan pa 'thab/ /thog lhas mi nyag mchong zhags dgrong / /g.yul 'khrug nag po'i gnam sa sgrib/ / khe tshes gyad mi me ru bcom/ / (102)le'u drug pa/g.yu lhas bka' bzhin nub rdzong skor/ /gyad mi gza' rgod phyir bros brgyab/ /rtsal ldan dpa' bo mang du shor/ /dpa' 'thab lha min gnas ltar bzos/ / (132)le'u bdun pa/glog dmar drag rgod g.yu lhas bsgral/ /2

bho sras khros te rtsal bde bsad/ /'dan gyi chos bzang zhing khams brjes/ /nub rdzong khra mo gling la thob (165)le'u brgyad pa/mi min sras mo gling gis bzung / /byang rgyal rmi gab klong la 'khyan/ /lha yis lung dang dbang bskur te/ /sras mo'i blo rtse gling la gtad/ / (184)le'u dgu ba/gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gtsos/ /'brug rgod rtsal ldan 'khor bcas kyis/ /dung skyong dpon gyi sgar la gtugs/ /ri lung khrag bi/ kha mdog bsgyur/ / (217)le'u bcu ba/stong bdud la sogs dmag la chas/ /bal sras dpa' bos sha lan blangs/ /shan pa 'khor bcas dpa' rtul dang / /stong bdud la sogs byang la 'thab (237)3

le'u bcu gcig pa/a stag dmag gis byang rdzong skor/ /rkang ring ha ri rnam gnyis bsgral/ /chos 'grub dang ni stobs chen gyis/ /rtsal ldan dpung gi gral ra gtor/ / (259)me'u bcu gnyis pa/nyi grags mda' yis nor 'dzin phigs/ /lha blon mtshon la stobs rgyal drangs/ /smug gus rtsal ldan lha dbang bsad/ /bdud 'dul blon gyis dngul khrab bsgral/ / (278)le'u bcu gsum pa/khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po khos/ /blon rgan mkhas pa mtha' la sgyugs/ /bla bya khrung khrung dkar mo yi/ /ming sring rnams kyi 'phrin pa khyer/ / (294)le'u bcu bzhi ba/gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dang / /rgyal sras mched dang 'khrug pa'i mthar/ /4

ge sar dpon gyis bdud blon bsgral/ /lha yi dus babs lung bstan byung / / (320)le'u bco lnga ba/dug smyon nag po phyi mar bskyal/ /gling gis dgra blar dpung bstod mdzad/ /bdud 'dul gyad ma'i lag la shor/ /byang gling shi bsad na thang bzos (340)me'u bcu drug pa/dgyes tshogs bkra shis chang gis brngan//byang rgyal pho brang dmag gis skor/ /gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang dang / /glog dmar drag rgod la sogs pham/ / (370)le'u bcu bdun pa/dpa' mos rtsal ldan grags pa bcom/ /sgyu ma mngon shas khro lus bsgral/ /seng chen rgyal pos byang rgyal btul/ /dgra lhas gyad mi gza' rgod phab/ / (398)le'u bco brgyad pa/5

rgyal sras ming sring 'khor bcas bzung / /sngon smon dag pa sad par byas/ /lha yi lung bzhin dngul rdzong gi /g.yang sgo 'byed pa'i las la gzhol/ / (421)le'u bcu dgu ba/rin chen shel dkar nor bu'i gter/ /'gro ba yongs kyi dpalari du spel/ /rten 'brel smon lam dkar po'i rgya/ /dbu nag bde dgas brgyan du gyur/ / (446)6

mchod brjod/( na mo gu ru si bha ye: sh-ibaṃbaṃrnyaglobaitharīmachod sbyin brgya ba rig byed snying bo dang:mi yi seng ge grong gsum mthar byed pa:snang bdag cha gter la sogs lha brgya'i mgor:zhabs sen 'god mdzad zas gtsang sras la 'dud:lho nub dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du:rgyal kun gsang gsum sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur:gangs can bod la lhag par brtse ba yi:mtsho skyes bla ma'i zhabs zung spyi bor mchod:rigs gsum sems dpa' bsam bzhin gdul bya'i ngor:ngur smrig gar bsgyur mdo sngags bstan pa'i srog:blo bzang grags pa sgrol ba'i mgon po sogs:dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la dad phyag 'tshal:dmar ser 'od stong 'bar ba'i brtse dga' yis:

blo ldan yid kyi khang bzang mdzes mdzad pa:dran pa tsam gyis shes rab mchog stsol pas:rgyal sras zur phud lnga bas bdag skyongs shig:bcu drug cha rdzogs dga' ba'i mdza' na mo:mtsho byung ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can ma:bdag mgrin 'o ma'i mtsho la rtsen dang lhan:legs bshad gtam gyi dga' ston myur tu stsol:'di na rigs gsum sems dpa'i 'phrul:skyes mchog seng chen rgyal po yi:thun mong thun mong ma yin pas:rnam thar chu gter chen po las:bdag la 'chad pa'i skal ba mchog:yongs thos cha shas tsam gyi gtam:sgro skur phyogs lhung nyer spangs nas:'chad do 'gro kun rna ba blogs:2

le'u dang po/gur nag dpon gyi blo thabs kyis/ /the'u ring bla mar mthu bcol byas/ /lung bstan byung nas khro rgyal gyis/ /ngan sngags sgrub pa'i las la gzhol/ /na mo seng ha ra dza ye:de yang 'dir 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i rnam par thar ba mu tig phreng mdzes las: byang mi min dngul gyi rdzong chen phab pa me rlung 'tshub ma'i lang tsho zhes pas skor brjod pa la: de yang hor gnam lha gur dkar rgyal pos las dmag 'bum tsho bcu gnyis gling la drangs nas lha thang dkar bo khrag gis bkang: rgya tsha zhal dkar sku srog 'phrog: snang ngu me tog sad kyis bcom: rong tsha dmar leb khrag la bsgyuroḥ stag rong gzig 'phen chu la bskur: ma tshad dpa' rtul mang bo'i dbu 'phang smad de: gnam sa steng 'og bsgyur ba ltar a lcam 'brug mo hor du khrid cing: gling ja mkhar ring mo rtse bshig dang smad bshig gis gtor te g.yul las pham pa'i a thang chad nges pa zhig gling ba rnams kyi mgo la byung nas sa 'thor 3

lung 'thor du re zhig 'gro dgos thug par gda': khong hor sde 'bum dmag khra mo: pho brang dkar mo brtsegs stong du phyir log nas skyid pa'i dga' ston rgya che ba: spro ba'i bro gar grangs mang ba 'khrab cing: dpa' bo'i snyan grags srid pa gsum gyi khams na grags nges pa zhig byas nas bsdad mod: gtam gyi dpe la: 'dzam gling las kyi sa cha: bya snga dro byas na phyi dro smin zer ba bzhin du sku skyes mchog seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul khong gis nag po bdud kyi bstan pa dung la bsnubs: bdud sde chos la bsgyur:nor g.yang g.yang du blangs: bdud mo grogs su bkug ste lo mang song bas rjes su lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan dang: bla bya khrung khrung gis 'phrin pa byas pa ltar du ser bo hor du thon nas: sgo srung rim pa bcu gsum btul: yang srung 'gag sgo'i mi dgu bsad: 'dzoms par sprul nas 'dzoms zas bslangs: mo mar sprul nas mo log btab: nya bar sprul nas bla nya bzung: tshong bar sprul nas phyag rtags phul: mkha' 'gror sprul nas sems gso mdzad: bla mar sprul nas dmu gab phabs: gyad chen sprul nas glang smyon btul ba ma zad pā thul mi lnga bsgral: bla rir sprul nas mchong lha gcur: snang srid dbang sdud padma drag po'i nga rgyal bskyed de the'u ring thams cad dam la btags: gong sman lha yi gnam mdas stobs chen lnga ba'i lam du drangs: bdud sde'i hor la 'jab rgol byas: pā thul mang po 4

dgra la shor: gling ba'i dpa' rtul dpung gshib thon nas hor sde khrag gi mtsho la bsgyur: shi bsad sdig pa'i na bun 'thibs shing mtho hor mkhar yod tshad rtse nas bshigs: dpung hor dmag rgod tshad cham la phab: dus mtha' ma rgyal srid 'chor la nye skabs hor gyi gur nag rgyal po'i sems la:dang po gur dkar la sems dkar byas tshad stong log tu gyur te sdang mig lta sa nga dang shan pa gnyis po byas mod: da lta nged gnyis kyi bshad pa'i steng la babs zin yod pas: su yin yang shi lam las 'gro sa mi 'dug pa: 'chi bdag thog tu byung ba dang gnyis su ma mchis: da nga rang gi las dmag mnga' 'og tu yod pa rnams la gsang brda zhig sprad de phyogs ga la ba zhig tu bros pa las mi 'ongs cing: phyi nas dgra lan re 'phrod shas che bsam ste yang rgod pā thul bco lnga dang: rang 'og gi las dmag 'bum phrag gcig khrid de rta zla ba'i tshes pa gsum gyi mtshan mor 'gro ba mi thams cad gnyid du yur ba na rang rang gi rta la bcibs te nor rin thang che ba 'ga' re khyer nas nub phyogs khyung po'i yul du song ba dang: stobs chen tshe dbang bstan pa la mgo btags skyabs 'jug zhus: hor gling gi g.yul 'khrugs kyi lo rgyus thams cad snyan zhu phul zhing rjes sor shar khra mo gling la dgra men zhig sprod rogs byed par bskul na yang: khyung po'i tshe dbang bstan pa'i sems la don med mi sha bsgos na chag sgo rang la 'khor: sdug 5

med g.yang la lceb na rang srog 'dre yis 'khyer zer ba ltar yin pas: kho tsho la gtam drangs mor bshad dgos bsam nas na re: khyed cag nga khyung po'i rgyal po la gtad nas 'ong ba yin pas bdag thob kyi sa dang rdzong re ngas bkod bsgrigs byed chog mod: shar khra mo gling la 'gran ya byed rgyu dka' khag shin tu che bas nga tsho'i thabs brgya jus stong byed: re zhig dmag ngal gsos la pha yul gyi lo rgyus la zhib rtogs kyis zer zhing stod brag dmar srin mo lung brgyad kyi sa thams cad phul nas 'tsho gzhes la 'go 'don mdzad de khyung po'i spyi'i nom mdzod las gser dngul dar zab 'phrug sogs dang: nas sogs 'bru rigs khal stong gsum bcas gnang sbyin yod pas ma gzhi gyis zer ba la: kho tsho spro dga' dang bcas gnas der song nas mkhar brtsigs pa dang: gro nas kyi so nams sogs la 'bad pa byas nas lo mang bsdad kyang dmag gi yo lang gi gtam cha gcig ma byung nas gur nag rgyal po sems mi bde lung nge yod pas tshe: shar mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas lha rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas poḥ lho dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams nas lha rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor dang bcas pa: nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas lha 'od dpag med pa 'khor dang bcas pa: byang las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas lha don yod grub pa 'khor dang bcas pa: dbus stug po bkod pa'i 6

zhing khams nas lha kun bzang yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa: ma zad gnas chu shel grub pa'i pho brang mi 'jigs gnam gyi ka ba nas lha rma chen sbom ra 'khor dang bcas pas bdud 'dre gur nag rgyal po'i blo kha lhag par bsgyur nas nga rgyal me ri 'bar 'bar: zhe sdang dud sprin 'khrigs 'khrigs: phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshub 'tshub tu gyur nas gling dkar po shul med e thub bsam: mgon ge sar gyi sha la zos na bsam: blon 'dan ma'i khrag la 'thung na bsam: 'brug mo rang bdag byas na bsam nas nyin dkar gsum la blo ma bde: mtshan mo gsum la gnyid ma khug par yod pa la: dgra sha rtsod pas blo sgo zhig rnyed de cung mi ring ba'i sa na sgrub gnas dgra rtse brag phug zer ba zhig na lha the'u ring gi bla ma rab 'bar zer ba'i snyan grags rgyang la khyab che ba: mthu nus pa grub rtags la mnga' brnyes pa: mi sems rlung skyal du 'gugs pa: mi sha me yis gzhob pa: mi khrag bdud la mchod pa zhig 'dug pa thos nas zhal ma mjal gong la dad pa skyes: phyag ma 'tshal gong la mos pa thob ste khyung po'i tshe dbang bstan pa'i mi thos pa byas nas pā thul dug ri me 'bar dang: mchan khebs rang 'dra dpa' bo brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams kyis dar zab gser dngul gos 'phrug gi 'bul ba 'jig rten sgyu ma'i longs spyod khyad du 'phags pa yid du 'ong ba 'dra min drel la bkal nas sgrub gnas chen po 7

de yi phyogs su nyin zhag lnga yis chod par gda': de nas yul gyi mi rnams la gtam dris pas sgrub phug yod pa'i sa gsal bor bstan byung ba na:khong rnams lhag par dga' spro 'phel zhing sgrub phug gi 'og nas rta drel gyi khal rnams phab 'dug pa the'u ring gi bla mas mthong nas sems la: 'di dag ci zhig yin: nga bla ma la glags 'tshol ba zhig srid dam: kho mtha' 'dre gling gi g.yo bskor 'dra ma yin nam bsam nas mi spags dmar po'i sgrub gos sne ring rgyab la gyon zhing sbrul rigs lnga'i sku chings khra bo bsdams:sgrub zhwa zur gsum gnam lcags phur ba'i rtse 'dra ba dbu la gsol zhing dug ra nag po'i gdung rgyan sprad: srog chags bya rigs mang po'i sgro yis sgrub zhwa'i gdong zur gsum po'i steng du bstar brgyab pa: dmar nag dug gi rang bzhin gru gsum hom khung 'bar ba'i nang du steng lha khams bco brgyad brlag byed kyi gtor ma: bar gnyan khams yongs rdzogs thal ba'i rdul du 'joms nus pa'i srog dmar gyi khrag khol ba: 'og klu rigs 'joms byed kyi lang ro gan rkyal du mnan pa: mthu nus pa rang 'grub du byung ba'i rtags la gtor ma'i rtse nas me lhab lhab du 'bar ba: khrag lhog lhog tu khol ba: snang srid che dgu yongs kyi mnga' thang dang mthu stobs lhag med du 'joms par byas te sgrub phug gi sgo la thon nas skad cha 'dri smed dang yin lugs lo rgyus kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:8

glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: gnam the'u sa the'u bar the'u gsum: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sgrub la bar cad mi 'dod rkyen: thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du bzlog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: brag nag mdung rtse zeng 'dra 'di'i: gnam sa'i bar nas bdud srin 'dul: 'dre dang ma mo rgyu ba'i phug: sgrub gnas dgra rtse brag nag zer: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: yul skyid nyi ma lha thang na: btsan bdud lha thung rgyal po bzhugs: mchod gnas the'u ring rab 'bar yin: de nas gson dang 'dra ma yod: gtam dang skad cha mi bshad par: sa 'dir jag sgar 'debs lugs la: 'gag tsha jo ru yin shas che: ngan 'phrul ci yod a phos shes: de min stong gsum 'jig rten na: nga la nyes bcos byed mi med: nyes na bla ma rab 'bar ngas: sbyang ba bsgrub pa dag la sbyangs: ma rung dgra srog chod nges yin: ci yin lo rgyus zhib du gsung:tshe gcig bsgrub cing brtson pa nga'i: bstan la bar chad dgos don med:lug chung 'chi la ma 'tsher nas: spyang tshang sgo la thon zer na: lhu tshigs phyogs bzhir mtshams brgyad gtor: zhim sha spyang thong rting mar dbang:de 'dra khyod cag mgo la 'ongasoḥ gangs dkar rtse nas seng chung 'gying:g.yu ral dgra bzhi'i steng la ngom: wa skyes 'gran 'dod snang ba 'khrul:rang mal gad khung 'grim dang dga': rdza ri'i gseb nas 'brong phrug 9

'gying: ru thur rnon po kun la ngom: glang rog 'gran 'dod snang ba 'khrul: phyugs rwa'i gzan rtswa tshol dang dga': sgrub gnas 'di nas bla ma ngas: drag sngags nus pa dgra la ngom: tshur 'gebs 'gran rtsod mi 'os bsam: rang khyim phyir la snyeg na dga': dal na mi khom sgrub pa'i rkyen:brel mos las mtha' dpyad pa gal: drag po'i mthu ldan rab 'bar ngas:the'u ring kha mgon sgrub sgrub nasoḥ gtor ma me dmar 'bar nas byung:khrag zor dgra la 'phang 'phang gis: grub pa rang dbang thob nas yod:ci 'dod gang dga' 'dang rgyag med: rdzun med gtam gyi glu lan remoḥdon med tshig la nyan don med: bden rdzun dbye ba bkar rgyu yin: de nas ci dgos lab gleng byed: e red tshur yong skya mi tsho: 'thad na don 'bras ci yin shod: de min rang snang ma 'khrul bar: sdod shes kyis dang bzang le gda': yin gcig min gnyis thon nges na: sgrub pa'i gtor zor mi 'phen na: snying khrag sa la mi 'pho ri: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la:ma go glu la yang len med: khyed cag yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: gur nag rgyal blon thams cad kyis glu de thos nas shin tu skrag na yang: gur nag rgyal pos rig pa sor chud par byas te dad phyag dgu sprugs su 'tshal bar: bla ma cung zad yid chas nas lhod tsam mdzad par kho tshos dgu tshan gser dngul drwa ma rnams mdun du 10

spungs zhing lus dad pa'i thal mo sbyar: yid dad pa'i mos gus 'khrungs:mig dad pa'i mchi ma shor gyin ya lags bla ma rin po che: mthu nus pa'i bdag nyid rin po che: blo bkod pa'i 'phrul 'khor rin po che: 'di phyi gnyis la phan pa'i rin po che: nga tsho ser bo hor nas yin: rgyab pha yul shor ba'i sdug rgan yin: blo mdun pa lha la dris na bsam: da lta khyung po'i yul du 'khyams: tshe dbang bstan pa'i skyong bzhin mchis: mtha' 'dre gling sdug zer ba la: dgra lan thengs gcig sprod pa'i phyir: nam yar lang bsam blo de la btang: mun mar rub mos pa de la bzhag: sdug a thang chad nas yod pa'i dus: khyed bla ma'i snyan grags rgyang nas thos:sku'i zhal la mjal 'phrad e thub bsamoḥ byams snying rje'i chu rgyun ring mo des: nga gur nag yid sems gcong bo'i sa: zhing chu mar glan du e bsgyur bsam: mthu gnam lcags thog gi ngar shugs kyis: mtha' gling sdug ltad mor e ston zhu zer nas pus mo gnyis kyi lha nga sa la btsugs te blo phyi nang kha khog med pa: gtam sba gsang ci yang med pa: yi mug re sdug gi skad cha thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par zhu 'dod dang bcas yid ha cang skyo bas glu 'di 'dra blangs so:glu tha la mi len ka med red: glu a la mi 'gug tshod yod red: lha the'u ring dkar nag khra gsum dang: sgos shan pa'i lcog lha mtshal rtse 11

sogs: ngas rang yul hor gyi lha la 'bod: mthu byin rlabs dngos grub ma g.yel 455: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas sgrub phug dgra rtse brag nag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang a chen hor gyi sa cha nas: sde 'bum tsho dmag gi dpon po la:mtho rgyal po gur dkar gur ser dang:nga gur nag min pa su yang med: dus deng sang bshad na yi re mug:skyabs kun gyi mchog gyur bla ma lags: snyan dar lung ma g.yeng tshur la gson: yul pha jus shor ba'i gur nag nga: khyed thugs rjes ma dor rab 'bar rje: mchog bla ma 'dzam gling nyi ma la: byin thugs rje nye ring mi mnga' mkhyen: sdug du:kha'i mnar ba'i gur nag ngas: nor dgu tshan longs spyod gter gyi mdzod: yid gang 'dod nom gyi 'bul ba 'di:gcig zhus na sku khams bde 'dri dang: gnyis bshad na sdug rgan gur nag gi: mgon skyabs dang gdong grogs e byed bsam: mtho a sngon mthing gi g.yu 'brug dang: dpal grub pa mnga' brnyes rab 'bar gnyis:snyan grags pa rgyas lugs 'dra 'dra la: mthu byin rlabs thugs rje bla ma che:stobs sgyu 'phrul thengs gcig ngom rogs zhu: kho gling sdug dpa' rgod che drags nas: sa hor yul ngam thang sdug la bsgyur: bu 'dra 'dra'i rting ma ma lon thal: khyed mthu rgyal bla ma rin po che: gtor khrag zor kha lo gar bsgyur red: dgra gling sdug 'go dpon 'bangs dang bcas: lo gcig 12

sgrub gtor mas ha la 'phongs: ngas bskul lo bla ma rin chen bskul:snying khog nad ma bzhu gdug pa'i sbran: khyed mthu nus gcig gis mtha' la skrod: sngon srid pa mi yi gtam dpe la: drin pha ma'i bu phrug gces pas bskyangs: bu ngan pas pha ma mi dran mod: gal thug dus pha ma 'bod srid de: drin pha ma'i byams sems chung le min: dpe de dang khyad par ci zhig yod: khyed the'u ring lha mchog sgrub pa yi: lha bla ma hor dang chos mthun pas: ngas de sngon ma shes gti mug gis: khyed zhabs phyi sgrub pa med na yang: byams brtse ba'i yon bdag mi 'dor ba: mchog rin po che yi khyad chos mdzod: byang na dmar gzhung gi rkyang chung ngas: bang rgyugs rogs bsil ma'i rlung zhig bsam: nags rgya rdzong dkyil gyi stag mo ngas: rtsal rtsed ya gangs kyi seng chung bsam: chab gtsang bo'i rgyud kyi gser mig ngas: lus sgyur grogs rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng bsam: yul pha jus shor ba'i gur nag ngas: mgon nus ldan drag po'i rang bzhin bsam: las bzang po lam la 'gro ba 'dra: lha bla ma khyed dang 'phrad lugs la: dgra lan po sprod pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs: da mkhyen no bla ma bka' drin can:byams thugs rjes gzigs par gsol ba 'debs: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:ces glu zhus de ltar phul ba dang: the'u ring bla ma rab 'bar gyi yid 13

la skye ma myong snying rje lan gcig skyes shing kho tsho sgrub phug tu bos nas phun sum tshogs pa'i zas sna mang po drangs te thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad cing gsungs gleng mang du byas mthar the'u ring gi bla ma rab 'bar gyis mtha' dgra gling sdug la mthu zor 'phangs nas shul med dgra 'phung zhig byed rgyu khas blangs te gur nag dpon blon la srung mdud dang rdzas sogs gnang ba thob nas phyir khyung po'i yul du song ngo:der the'u ring bla ma rab 'bar gyis gru gsum dgu ldan gyi gtor ma:me ri me dpung gi mar rgyan: the'u mo rkang gcig gi zhal 'bag: hom khung dmar nag gi khrag snod: dug rdzas dgu yi cha lag bcas rim pa dgu yi sa 'og tu the'u ring gi srog gtor: sa sna dgu 'dus kyi rdzas rnams bsags shing ra ma nag po dgu yi gsob sogs bkod pa dang: the'u ring bla ma rab 'bar gyis blta log bon nag gis dmod zor gyi sgrub pa la thun bzhi las bzhi 'bad pa rtsol med byas par grags so:des skabs su 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba: rma yul g.yang gi rwa ba: bde skyid kun 'dzoms kyi zhing khams: lhang lhang g.yu 'brug grags sa: snyan snyan khu byug smon sa: pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse: lha klu gnyan gyi 'phrul mkhar: 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gdengs khang: dri bzang dud pas khyab sa de na sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras: dbu nag bod kyi skyabs mgon: rigs 14

gsum mgon po'i rnam rol: padma ka ra'i thugs sprul: dbu rmog dar gdugs rgyal mtshan: nor bu rgod sgro la sogs: brgyan brgyan 'od stong lham me: zhi ma khro ba'i nyams can: dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags:sku la go mtshon sna dgu: sra btsan rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi go gyon pa de nyid kyis smug gu'i drel rdzong phab zhing dbu nag la drel 'gyed gnang mthar 'gro ba'i don du 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi sku mtshams la bzhugs te thugs chos sku'i btsan sa zin pa: ngag 'dzab dbyangs rang sgra sgrogs pa:lus rdo rje'i skyil krung sogs cog bzhag bzhi ldan gyi gnad dang ldan par gnas tshe: mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong nas ma cig gong sman rgyal mos sku lus 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pas 'od thig gi ri mo lam meoḥ gsung snyan 'gyur sgrogs pas lung bstan mgur ma seng nge: thugs mi g.yo lta sgom spyod pa khyab brdal ka nas dag pa'i dpa' gdengs sad pa:yon tan lo 'dabs rgyas pas chos kyi dri bsung thil ba: 'phrin las glog zhags 'khyugs pas 'gro don re 'bras bskang ba: chu dar rlung gis skyod kyin mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde rnams kyis mtsho la gza' skar bkra ba bzhin du mtha' bskor zhing byon nas 'dzam gling skyes bu chen po seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul la lung bstan gyi glu 'di snyan 'jebs bung ba'i mgur dbyangs la drangs nas blangs so:15

na mo gu ru dhe wa ye: glu a la byang chub rgyud nas 'dren: glu tha la thams cad sgrol ba'i glu: bla ma padma 'byung gnas mkhyen: rang gzhan gdul bya'i re ba skongs: yi dam khros pa yongs 'dus mkhyen: rkyen ngan bar chad dbyings su sol: mkha' 'gro marnya ra ba mkhyen: thabs shes zung du 'jug par shog: chos skyong ma gza' dam gsum mkhyen: log rtog dgra dpung chom la phobs: srung ma ye shes spyan ldan mkhyen: pha rol mi mthun 'jigs las skyobs: gnas 'di sprin dkar rgyu ba'i klong: stong nyid nam mkha'i dbyings rol red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: shes rab mdzes rgyan gong sman sgron: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo yin: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing de: drag po g.yul rgyal mi yi nor: skyes mchog ge sar rin po che:snyan gson glu yis mchod pa 'bul:da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la:mi min byang gi sa cha na: bdud pho shang ri khrag mig la: ltas ngan bdud kyi bla bu 'khrungs: pho lo bcu gsum sum cu red: 'dul ba'i dus la babs nas yod: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po la: smon lam thebs pa'i sras chung gnyis: sangs rgyas bstan la phan pa che: thabs dang dpung gi zin nges dgos: ya med thog 'brug glog gsum dang: me chu dug gi dpa' bo yod: lan med gyad chen mi bzhi dang: rtsal ldan dpa' bo sum cu srid: 'bum dmag phyed lnga'i kha grangs yod: rin chen dngul gyi gter 16

rdzong 'di: sgang ba bod la bzhag pa che: rten 'brel las kyis grub nges yin: lha dang mi gnyis mnyam chas la: dpa' dang go mtshon dus gcig 'dzoms: lha yi byin rlabs glog las myur: dpa' rtul rgod hrag thog las btsan: mi min byang gi ga la brten: med thabs med pa'i dngul rdzong 'di: phab dgos dus la babs nas byung: gyod mgo rtsod gzhi'i snying bo la: hor rje gur nag rgyal po kho: bros bros pha yul rgyab la dor: khyung po'i tshe dbang brtan pa la: skyabs zhu mgo 'bul byas nas yod: khyad par the'u ring bla ma la: mthu dang ngan sngags drag po bcol: da lta the'u ring nag po des: drag sngags nus pa sgrib kyin yod: the'u ring bdud kyi dug zor de: gling dkar stod la 'phen nges gda': stobs dang nus pa che na yang: khro rgyal mthu la mi 'gran pas: skrag nga 'jigs skrag dgos pa med:skyes bu mi yi nyi ma yis: srung ba'i ra gur gling la btsugasoḥ stag rong dpon po khro thung gis: zor kha bsgyur pa'i las la brtson: mi min byang gi yul gru la: —mi shi rta chag thub pa gyis: gna' mi rgan po'i ngag rgyun la:gser 'od snang pa'i klung yangs mdzes: khya 'khyil dgon gyi 'du ra na:ban chung mkhas 'dod snang bas brgyag: dam tshig gser thig ma zhib na:rtsod tshig rang 'dod mos blo red: bkod yag grong dang grong khyer na: mi 'gyur shel gyi gdengs khang nang: rgyan legs gos bzang dbang chen 17

dpon: nyam chung sems kyis ma bskyangs na: yin mdog zhe blo khrel ba'i rgyu: kha yag bshad dang ma bshad med: rma khams g.yang gi ra ba noḥ pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse'i nang: ge sar bdud kyi gshed ma che: smon log zil gyis ma mnan na: lha phrug yin dang ma yin med: sku mtshams rang don zhor sgrub 'dra: a kyang mi zhu ku re yin: drin chen pha ma las lhag pas: byams brtse chen po'i 'gro ba bskyangs:lha dang bla ma bzang po khyod:gdams ngag gser gyi phye ma brdal: yang dag rgyal po rin po che: chos khrims zhal lce rdul ltar zhib: rgyu 'bras drang mo'i lam du bsrings: btsan po'i gnya' la ldog pas non: nyams chung bde ba'i lam la khrid: mi 'gyur seng chen dgra 'dul gyi: rnam thar mu tig dkar po'i phreng: zad med dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhinoḥ mtha' med kun tu dar gyur cig: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:ces gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to:des skabs su chu gnyis chab ma sgrogs 'dra: brag gnyis mda' sgro gshibs 'dra: mkhar btsan pho rog snying rdzong: stong nyid sgom khang phyug mo: g.yang chags nor bu'i gdengs khang: stag gdan dmar po'i yang steng: che btsan ldong gi rgyal rgyud: gzig gi thig le rang 'dzoms: dpa' stag rong dpon po khro thung: 'dzam gling gter gyi lde'u mig: nag po 18

bdud kyi kha gnon: rab khros 'jigs rung 'bar ba: rdzogs chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor de nyid byang lha rta mgrin dmar po'i sgrub pa la 'bad de:'dan bza' ma gtogs mdun la mi tshud pa zhig byas nas bzhugs yod skabs su skad cig la 'dzam gling skyes mchog ge sar gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis shar gyi rab gsal khar 'od dmar pos thig le zhig byung nas 'od dpag tu med pa 'tsher zhing mkha' las sprin thon pa bzhin du gong gi thig le de trī yig cig tu gyur: de yongs su gyur ba las byang lha rta mgrin dmar po dbu skra dmar ser gyen la gzengs bas nang du rta mgo ljang gu phyogs bcur 'tsher ba: sku mdog dmar la dur khrod kyi chas bcu yis brgyan pa pad nyi bam ro brdzis pa'i khar: ma ṭwāṃ ru ṭa gan rkyal du mnan pa drag po rghaṃ bhyo phaṭa kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir bzhin lung bstan gyi mgur glu 'di ltar gsungs so:glu a la len pa rten 'brel bzang: glu tha la thar ba'i rgyud nas len:gnas rang snang 'og min chos dbyings zhing: 'ja' 'od dang thig le'i gdengs khang nas: gzhi gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang pho rog snying rdzong gi: shar mi 'gyur shel gyi rab gsal khar: lha nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gnas dur khrod 'jigs rung 'bar ba nas: lha khro bo'i 19

rgyal po rta mgrin zhes: bdud ma rung log pa'i tshogs kyi gshed: gnas khams gsum bdud bgegs dbang du bsdus: don de 'dra rang gi che ba tsam: da man chad glu yi don 'bras ni: dar dmar gsal gdugs kyi 'og rol nas: gdan stag gzig khri yi yang steng nas: sde stag rong dug gi tsho dkyil nas: khyed stag rgyal dug gi lo 'dab rgyas: ya stag rong dpon po khro rgyal gson: shar gling dkar lha yi bstan dgra de: byang mi min dngul rdzong phab ran pas: khyed stag rong dpon pos 'go 'don mdzod: dpa' rting ma'i ngo so dgung las mtho: sngon gna' mi bod kyi dpe bzhin loḥ 'dab sgro gshog ldan pa'i khyung chen bya: dgung nam 'phang bcad nas la rgya 'dzin: rtsal 'dzum drug ldan pa'i stag mo yis: gcan srog chags btul nas la rgya 'dzin: 'gyur 'khyugs gshog ldan pa'i gser mig nyas: mtha' rgya mtshor gshegs nas la rgya 'dzin: mthu dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i stag rong dpon: bdud dgra dpung bcom nas la rgya 'dzin: de zer bas dpe dang don mthun gda': las drag sngags mthu yis gtor zor sgrub: sde hor nas bor pas gur nag gis: yul khyung bo'i rgyal la skyabs 'jug zhus: lha the'u ring bla ma grogs su rnyed: mthu'i gtor ma gling la 'phen srid pas: stobs rdzu 'phrul me yis gzhob la thongs: dpal 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po dang: dpon stag rong stag mo 20

ri bkra gnyis: kho bdud dgra 'dul grangs 'dra 'dra la: da bsod nams khyed kyi che ba 'dra: byang mi min dngul gyi sa cha na: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po la: mdzes sras mo tshe 'dzin lha mo zhes: lo bcu drug na tshod lang tsho rdzogs: sman mdzangs ma'i yon tan lnga dang ldan: dpal 'dzam gling bu mo'i rgyan gcig yin: khrom chen po'i mjes thag chod le red:khyed stag rong dpon dang dam tshig gcig: de a khus rting ma lon shas che:mthu ngan sngags lcog brdongs dug gzer can: gtad zer na brag dkar yul la gtod: kho the'u ring rab 'bar nag po des: yid re smon gcig kyang 'grub med kyis: red e bsam stag rong dpon po lags: las rang don 'bras bzang ljang sgyug la: yang gzhan don lo 'dab rgyas par nges:da de bas dga' gcig ga na yod: sang nyi bzang nyi ma rtse shar la: khong ge sar dpon gyi snyan du zhus: glu ma go gtam la med pa byos: dpon khro thung yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsungs pa dang mnyam du 'od dmar gyi thig le zhig tu gyur nas mi snang bar gyur to:nyi ma de yi phyir nyin stag rong dpon po khro thung gis dgu tshan dar gyi 'bul ba cha tshang ba zhig bzung ste: 'do ba 'phar ba rnga nag la bcibs nas sku seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi mdun du 'gro khar sems la: da 21

res kyi lung bstan 'di 'khrul ba mi 'dug: ge sar gyi rdzu 'phrul 'dra yin na khong gi mdun du zhu dgos zer mi srid: byang mi min dngul gyi rdzong chen phab dgos pa'i lo rgyus dang: the'u ring bla ma'i mthu kha bzlog rgyu sogs chad lus med par zhus na rjes sor rting ma dang dpa' dar bzang bstod bcas thob pas dga': de min sras mo tshe 'dzin lha mo'i phyogs nas skad cha zhu mi 'os ma gtogs: nga khro thung gi lag tu mi 'ong ba thag gis chod 'dug bsam zhor la pho brang seng 'brug stag rtser thon: mdun 'dug rnams kyis bsu ba byas: gsol dpon dag gis bza' btung yid tshim pa zhig drangs tshar ba dang mnyam du rgyal po ge sar bzhugs sa'i gzim khang du gdan drangs ba na: khong dga' dga' spro spro dang: gus gus zhum zhum gyi rnam 'gyur ston gyin na re: ya mi dbang lha yi rgyal po ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul lags: tshur gson dang zhu rgyu 'di 'dra yod zer zhing ha ra hur thung gi rta la drangs te lung bstan gyi don 'bras zhu ba'i glu 'di ltar phul lo:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: byang lha rta mgrin dmar bo mkhyen: rnam gsum 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'bul: sgo gsum sgrib sbyang dngos grub stsol: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: rma yul g.yang gi ra ba nas: lha klu gnyan gyi 'phrul 22

mkhar la: sku mkhar seng 'brug stag rtse zer: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: pho brang pho rog snying rdzong gi: nang bcud stag rong dpon po yin: gling dkar lha yi ldong rgyud red: de nas dar gdugs 'phan gyi 'og: gser khri zil gnon brjid pa'i steng: mi smug dung gi so sgo can: yang smug byu ru'i mig rtsa dmar: ge sar dgra 'dul rin po che: dar lung snyan gyis ma g.yeng gson: da lo gnam lo tshes tshun la: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: mi ma yin pa'i bdud chen la: mi min khrag ral khyung gshog zer: mi 'gyang 'dul ba'i dus la babs: sdug tshod kho yis ma zin nas: dkar phyogs bstan pa gnod chen bskyal: 'dzam gling skyes bu seng chen khyed: phyogs bzhi bdud kyi kha gnon dang: sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sprul red: 'gran bral 'chi bdag dngos las lhag: mi min tsam la 'tsher mi srid: ngo bstod che bkyag skad cha min: de nas tsha bu rin po che: kha sang yar tshes dang po la: byang lha rta mgrin dmar bo yis: lung bstan mgur ma snyan du brgyud: gur nag wa mo khung 'dzul khos: khyung bo'i rgyal por mgo 'bul byas: brag dkar yul gyi the'u ring ste: bla ma rab 'bar zer ba la: drag sngags mthu yi las shig bcol: sgyu ma'i rtsal chen ngom nges pas: dug dang khrag gi gtor zor te: 'phen nges gling la the tshom med: bsgyur ba khro thung rang la dbang: zor 'phen nus pa a khu la: brgya 'gyur stong gi 23

'gran mi zod: e chog ge sar g.yul rgyal dpon: rgyal mchog thugs dang mthun srid na: mi rgan rgas kyi thub don med: rta rgan gshis sha ngan dogs med: bdud yul stobs rtsal 'dzoms kyang rung: rgan po'i srog la gces med byed: skyes bu'i jus don shi nus na: mi rgan bsam pa rdzogs pa yin: kha bshad don dang mthun min rtogs: rgan po'i 'chol gtam ga la yin: yang dag gtam gyi 'dab ma la: skyes mchog dbang sngon nam mkha' gsal: khro rgyal khri gdugs nyi ma shar: dgra lha dung zla dkar po tshes: dpa' rtul skar tshogs mtha' nas rgyas: bdud yul mun pa 'od kyis bcom: bde skyid nyi zer bod la 'dren: longs spyod dgu tshan dgu yi grangs: bla ma ge sar khyed la 'bul: thugs rjes ma dor dbyings nas gzigs: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la 'brel ba med: skyes bu'i thugs la de ltar zhog:ces zer nas glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du 'dzam gling mi yi brgyan gcig: dpal lhun chags brjid ldan rgyal po de: gzi bajid 'od stong lam me: rngams brjid 'ja' tshon gyi le: mdzes sdug lta ba'i chog mi shes pa de nyid 'dzum pa'i zhal dang bcas: dar kha dog sna lngas btums yod pa'i nor bu chu shel zla ba dwangs gsal zhes pa zhig yod pa de stag rong dpon la gnang nas: ya kho re stag rong dpon po lags: skyes bu 24

mchog gi smon lam zab: thabs dang bkod pa rgya mtsho 'khyil: rtsal dang rting ma khyed la che: dpa' rtul grub chen brgyad cu'i nang: grub pa khyed las lhag pa med: khyed ni rta mgrin dmar po dngos: ma 'ong da lta dus gsum gyi: bya ba lag mthil bzhin du rtogs: bden no gsung la 'khrul ba med gsung nas glu 'di 'gags med rdo rje'i rang sgra la drangs nas blangs so: glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: gnas dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling nas: mgon grub brgya'i cod paṇa padma 'byung: 'khor rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: byin 'thibs se bdag blo chos la bsgyur: gnas dur khrod khrag mtsho 'bar ba nas: lha yi dam khros pa yongs 'dus la: rje khro tshogs bye ba 'bum phrag bcas: rkyen nad gdon mi 'dod 'tshe ba bzlog: gnas rnyu ma tha la'i grong khyer nas: ma mkha' 'gro rgod lcam dkar mo la: mdzes 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: yid bde stong dga' bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: gnas ma nges gangs khrod ri rgyal lhun: grogs chos skyong srung ma dge bsnyen bcas:gnas gangs can dkar skyong pho mo'i tshogs: mchog bstan 'dzin la 'tshe bgegs dpung bzlog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas rma yul lha yi g.yang ra nas: dpal bde skyid nyi gling phyug mo ste: mkhar pho brang seng 25

'brug stag rtse zer: steng lha klu gnyan gyi 'phrul mkhar dang: 'og 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i g.yang ra la: don dgos 'dod chos kyi gter rdzong red:pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes noḥ bdud ru bzhi bdud phran 'bum gyi gshed: nga rgyal mchog mi yi nyi ma yinoḥ ya de nas ldong gi khu bo lags: dpon stag rong khro rgyal rin po che: tshur gson dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod: dus da lo mi min dngul rdzong 'di: spyir 'dzam gling bod la bzhag pa bzang: yang sgos su gling gi snyan grags red: dpe dug sprul mgo yi nor bu 'dra:thabs mkhas na len rgyu mi dka' yang: thabs ma mkhas srog la nyen kha che:gtor tshur 'phen phyir la bzlog pa sogs: mthu ngan sngags drag po'i 'phrin las rnams: bya ci dgos a khu'i thugs dang brtun: dmag dpung rgod nam dgos thon pas chog: sngar gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la:mtho a sngon mthing gi skya rengs des: rmag mun pa bcom pas mi tshad pasoḥskyid nyi ma shar ba'i pho nya byas: shing rgya lcang rtse yi khu byug des: chab 'chag rom bcom pa'i mi tshad pasoḥ dpyid dpal yon bsu ba'i pho nya byas: gtam kha dpe don 'dir bkod pa 'dra: khyed stag rong dpon po khro rgyal gyis: bdud nag po 'dul ba'i mi tshad pas: phyogs gter rdzong 'gugs pa'i pho nya byas: gling ge sar dmag gi ru dar bsgrengs: dpa' rting ma'i ngo so ma mtho med: ya de nas khu bo dmar yag stag: khyed ma 26

bzhugs e go myur du byon: mthu drag sngags ting 'dzin la mo ngoms: kho mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal: dpa' rgod 'dod snang ba che le de:shar khri gdugs nyi mas 'od lam nas: 'bu me khyer che sa e 'dug blta: sra gnam lcags thog gi ngar lam nas: kho rdo rje'i brag ri e brtan blta:gtsang dag pa rdza chu'i babs lam nas: kho sa phung phye ma e brtan blta:lcags rgya khra hor ba'i bcum lam nas: kho byi'u chung gshog 'gyur e mkhas blta: khyed stag rong dpa' bo'i ngar lam nas: byang the'u blar skyid khom e 'dug blta: nga dgra 'dul dpa' bo'i kha sngon nas: kho khrag ral dpung hrag e ldan blta: rgod dpa' rtul stag gzig khros lam nas: byang bdud phrug thar sa e yod blta: de e red khu bo rin po che: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: dpon khro thung yid la de ltar zhogoḥces glu mjug rdzogs pa na: a khu rang dga' spro dang bcas bka' dang du blangs nas phyir phebs so: de nas pho brang pho rog snying rdzong gi byang phyogs bon gyi sgrub phug tu phyin nas rta mgrin dmar po'i sgrub pa la: stag lha me 'bar gyi cha lag cha tshang ba can zhig gi zhal phyes te bsnan nas:gong gtor cha bdun dang: smad le lcags kyi hom khung nag la gting zab pa'i nang du the'u ring gi ling gzugs lcags sgrogs kyis bsdams pa zhig 27

bzhag: de'i steng du dmar gtor che ba rtse bco brgyad yod pa rtse re la me ru dmar bo ljang gu ser po dmar skya rnams kyis brgyan pa: rtsib gsum la bā ling dgu brtsegs re'i steng du rul bu re bzhag: mtha' skor du gtso bo'i phrag la slebs pa'i gtor zor bcu gsum dang: de'i mtha' skor gyi bka' nyan: bran g.yog: las byed: pho nya: dbang phyug: bstan ma sogs la gtor chung brgya dang brgyad kyis bskor ba: steng na gtor gdugs nag po dang: phyi na rtsang dang mu ran gyis bskor ba bzhag: de'i mtha' la bzlog gtor bcu dang: chad tho: bskul gtor sogs bca' ba cha tshang ba byas: ma tshad thun bzhi las bzhi la 'bad pa lhod med byas shing dar nag gi bzlog pa: dar dmar gyi bsad pa: dar khra bos bskul ba sogs kyi phyag rgya gar stabs kyi ngang du stag rong bla ma mched bzhi gtso'i dar dmar can gyi bla rgyud: dar nag can gyi sngags rgyud sogs 'dus te rnga sgra 'brug stong grags grags: se cha gnam sa ldab ldab: mi rkang gi gling bu bus: dung chen sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams nas zhi drag dbang gi 'phrin las la 'jug par gda' 'o:28

le'u gnyis pa/gtor zor me dpung mthu chen 'gran/ /bdud kyis khro thung zor kha bsgyur/ /mi min rdzong la gtor brlag thebs/ /khrag ral khros nas dmag rgod phab/ /de'i skabs su the'u ring gi bla ma rab 'bar gyis kyang drag sngags zhag bdun la sgrub pa'i gtor ma las me 'bar: gtor rgyan las dud pa 'khrigs nas las la bskul ba'i dus la babs pa sogs kyi rtags dang cho 'phrul byung ba dang: mthu zhwa dang sgrub gos thams cad gyon zhing 'brug zla ba'i tshes pa dgu yi nub mo nag phyogs la ra mda' sbran pā dang sgrub gtor la lam bstan dgos pa sogs kyis: 'jigs pa'i stangs stabs kyi drag po'i bro dang bcas mig gnyis dmar gor gor dgung la gzigs shing:phyag gnyis kyi gar dang bcas dmod sngags mthu yi 'phrul 'khor kha phyes pa dang mnyam du: gnam the'u dkar nag khra gsum dang srid pa nag phyogs thams cad la dmod bcol gyi glu 'di drag po zor gyi lam phye 'am the'u ring khros pa'i gshe sgra la drangs nas blangs so:29

glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: nam mkha' mthing gi gzhal yas na: gnam the'u dkar po ra dkar skya: the'u ring bye ba 'bum dang bcas: drag po zor lam dgra la phyes: bar snang stong ba'i gur khang na: bar the'u khra bo ra khra skyoḥ the'u ring bye ba'i dpung dang bcas: drag po zor lam dgra la phyes/ sa gzhi g.yang gi ra ba na: sa the'u nag po ra nag skya: the'u ring bye ba sa ya bcas: drag po'i zor lam dgra la phyes: ri rgyal bum pa'i mkhar nang na: the'u mo rkang gcig dgra yi gshed: the'u ring bye ba'i tshogs dang bcasoḥ drag po'i zor lam dgra la phyes: mi ma yin dang bdud kyi tshogs: 'gong po ma mo 'phrog ma bcas:de ring zor 'di dgra la rbad: mtha' dmag gling la ho ma ya: khyad par 'gag mo'i jo ru kho: a bar rig la snying re rjeoḥ drag po mthu yi gtor zor 'di: gnam la 'phang na sprin sgo phye: sa la 'phang na ri dgu snyil:brag la 'phang na thal bar gtor: bskal ba dus kyi me yang gsod:mtha' yas rgya mtsho gting nas skems: zor lha gnam the'u dkar po yin:zor srung bar the'u khra bo yin: zor bdag sa the'u nag po yin: zor 'dren the'u mo rkang gcig yin: gzugs can dgra bo smros ci dgos:gzugs med dgra 'dre thal bar brlag: gnam lcags thog dang gtor chen zor: sra ba brag gi ci la rten: 'chi bdag bdud dang gtor chen 30

zor: btsan phyug 'phan gsum kun la 'byung: ki ki ki la bswo bswo bswo:ki bswo lha yi bskul ma yin: the'u ring dkar nag khra gsum dang: the'u mo rkang gcig la sogs 'bod: rbad pa'i dgra la rtsal ma zhan: ma g.yel ma g.yel the'u ring lha: mthu rtsal dpung gi grogs mdzod la: rting ma sdang ba'i dgra la ngoms: spyo ya rgyo ya pha rol gyi: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du bzlog: go na rna ba'i dkyil du zungs: ma go glu la yang len med: the'u ring 'khor tshogs thugs la zhog:ces zer ba dang dmod zor drag po de 'ur sgra dang khob sgras ri lung thams cad gang ba zhig byas te shar khra mo gling gi phyogs su me stag khrom khrom byed kyin 'phur song ngo:des skabs su stag rong dpon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgrub gtor gyi rtse nas dpa' bo rta mgrin gyis sku stod 'gying stabs su bstan te 'di skad: ha ha he ho ya: nga sgrub na gzhan phan sems kyis 'grub: nga sgrub na log rtog 'joms pas 'grub: nga sgrub na yang dag las kyis 'grub: nga sgrub na gnas lugs nges pas 'grub: phyi snang snod bcud nga yi zhing: lha srin sde brgyad nga yi bran: tshangs pa brgya byin nga yi g.yog: nga las che btsan su yang med: 'bod bskul gyi don dag ci zhig yod: mthu ngan sngags lcog bsdongs gang la byed zer ba dang lhan tu bon sras stag lha me 31

'bar gyis kyang zhal gzigs nas rghaṃ rghaṃ: snang srid sems su ma gyur med:mnyam bzhag gcig gi cho 'phrul las: sems kyi rba rlabs rlung ltar rgyu:chos sku thig le nyag gcig la: gzhom gzhig 'pho 'gyur ga la mchis:'khrul snang sgyu ma'i bdud dgra la: ye shes drag char ga 'dra 'bebs zer byung ba dang: stag rong dpon po khro thung dga' drag nas gdong 'dzum shigs shigs: sgrub zhwa srin po'i khros zhal dgu brtsegs can la dmar nag ca la'i bstar phreng sgrigs: sgrub gos drag chas ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'phrul ris can la sbrul nag dgu yi ska regs bcings: sgrub lham rdo rje'i gser sham sum brtsegs kyi steng du dbang sdud dmar po'i lha chab sgrogs: 'jigs byed khros pa kun 'dus kyi chas bcu bo sku la tshang ba zhig byas: drag po gnam lcags zhun ma'i khro phur zur gsum dbal las me 'bar ba: rtse nas dug rlangs 'thul ba zhig phyag g.yas pas bzung:g.yon pas sngags kyi bsgrangs phreng dang dar nag gi bzlog dar bsnams shing myur mor pho brang gi steng du byon nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gar 'khrab: stong gsum zil gnon gyi dpa' gdeng la gnas par byas te mkha' la sdig mdzub mdzad pa tsam gyis: dpal rta mgrin dang stag lha me 'bar gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis grogs sbran zhing the'u ring gi gtor zor de bar snang nas me la bsregs pa las dgra la gnod ci yang ma thub: der 32

stag rong dpon po khro thung gis gsal dag brtan gsum gyi ngang nas mi g.yo zhing bdud srin thal bar brlag pa la: lha la mi dang mi bzhin du gleng mo chog pas spro ba dang bcas glu 'di drag sngags bdud kyi dpung 'joms la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la skye ba med pa'i glu: glu tha la thar ba'i lam ston glu: gnas o rgyan lho nub 'o ma'i mtshor: 'dab stong ldan padma'i sbubs brgya las:dpal gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal: sku zhi drag rgyas pa'i nyams dang ldan: blo ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams: da yang dag ye shes ngang du sgrol:zor gtor chen sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: sdang dgra dpung ma rung bdud bgegs tshogs: rtswa 'jag skya me la bsregs pa bzhin: mthu drag po'i rting ma dgung la bstod: mchog byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar phob: gnas dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i tshal: dgra ru ṭa bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng: lha yi dam rta mgrin dmar po la: rtsal ye shes me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar: bdud log rtog ru ṭa'i nus mthu choms: gzhi stong gsal rig sku'i ngo bo las: mthu gtor zor sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: mtha' dgra yul ma rung gdug pa'i tshogs: thang bye phung chu yis gtor ba bzhin:mthu ngan sngags drag po bzla bzhin rbad: stobs nus shugs ldan pa'i dngos grub stsol: gnas dhu ma tha la'i grong khyer na: ma ye shes mkha' 'gro 33

mkhar chen bza': 'khor 'bum phrag yangs ba'i tshogs dang bcas:byams snying rje'i byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs: rkyen chags sdang dgra gnyen mdud pa grol: thabs shes rab zung gi phyag rgya bcas: zor 'di nyid sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: dgra dpung drag ming med rlung la bskur:lho sprin nag rlung gis gtor ba bzhin: dam nyams pa'i mu stegs bdud kyi tshogs: mthu nus pa chom la thugs rjes sgrol: gnas dbang drag srin po'i 'du ra na: stobs log 'dren bgegs kyi gshed ma mchog: sgos yang mgon stag lha me 'bar la: bon gto chog mthu yi me dpung 'bar: mthu be bum me yi 'phrul 'khor bskor: phyi bdud sde'i thal ba rlung la phul:nang gnyis 'dzin mdud brgya dus gcig gzhig: lam bde chen go 'phang thob la rem: yul gnas dang zhing dang nye ba'i gnas: dpal chos skyong srung ma las la bzhengs: chos bstan bshig bdud kyi bla srog bskums:kun 'phung ba'i dgra snying zhal du bzhes: zor drag po'i kha lo da bsgyur bas: mtho lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs bskums shig: bar gnyan tshogs rnams kyi sku zur cig: 'og klu rigs rnams kyi dbu bsgur cig: da zor lam phyes la dgra yul ston: lha'i dpung tshogs bye ba dkar po'i tshogs:mtho nam mkha'i khu 'phang babs babs kyis: gnyan ser bo'i dpung rgod bye ba 'bum: shar rta bdun zer mdangs ngom ngom gyis: 'og sngon po klu 34

yi sde tshogs 'bum: mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs rdol rdol gyis: steng dkar po lha yi mthu la bsten: kho gnam the'u dkar po ha la 'phen: yid nyon mongs shes bya'i rgyud las grol: bar ser bo gnyan gyi mthu la bsten: kho bar the'u khra bo ma ra ya: yid zhe sdang drag po'i mdud brgya grol: 'og sngon po klu yi mthu la bstenoḥ bdud sa the'u nag po dam la thog: sems gti mug rmong ba bsal du gsol: yul snang srid dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs:mthu stobs chen nus pa me ltar sbor: bdud the'u mo rkang gcig chom la phob: yid 'dod chags ser sna'i rgya las grol: dpung bskul lo chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs: bdud dam nyams rnams kyi bla srog chod: sems rnam shes 'khrul med sa la spor: rgyud rnam rtog sgyu ma'i snang zhen kun: gzhi rnam dag chos sku'i dbyings la grol: mthar gdod ma'i mgon dang dbyer med ngangoḥ rtsal sgyu 'phrul rgyal ba zhi khro rnams: zor 'phen pa'i grogs la ma g.yel cigoḥ glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:ces lha yi thugs dam bskul zhing yi dam la 'phrin las bcol:mkha' 'gro grogs su sbran te dmod pa drag po dang bcas rbad mnan bsad gsum gyi las gzhung thams cad tshar nas drag po'i gtor ma rdzu 'phrul gyi rang bzhin gnam sa bla 'og sgyur nus pa de'i kha lo brag dkar ba dan mdung rdzong gi phyogs su bskor ba na: sgrub gtor te rang shugs kyis 35

'phur zhing me stag zi ra 'tshub 'tshub byed kyin 'ur sgra dang ldir sgras ri lung tho sprad pa ltar song bar gda' 'o: sgrub gtor dmar khrom khrom byung ba the'u ring bla mas mthong nas sa the'u nag po'i rten dar byin rlabs can zhig yod pa de gnam la lan gsum g.yug g.yug mdzad de ngan sngags gtor zor bzlog byed kyi las la gzhol ba don yod du gyur te zor kha 'gyur nas byang mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po'i pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi steng la phog nas rten dar nag po dgu mdzes bsregs: mi 'gyur bdud kyi rgyal mtshan bcad: thog khang srid pa'i g.yang khang me la 'bar bas dud sprin gyis gnam sa bsgribs: rtsal ldan thog rgod lha dar gtso'i khas len dpa' bo bco brgyad rgyang so ba byas pa rnams bsgral: rtseg bar ma zhig me yis zin la nye skabs der yul bdag srin po lcags ral can gyis dzu 'phrul chu yi 'khor lo bskor nas me rang mal du bsad do: de'i rkyen gyis byang gi rgyal po glo bur du khros shing tshigs pa gting nas zos:khrag gis ngo mdangs bsgyur: mig rtsa khrag gis gang: skyems po'i chang la rngams 'thung zhig byas te bsam blo mang du btang nas phyogs kun la dpyad kyang rgya gar dang: bal bo: lho mon: sog po: a drag: zhang zhung:'jang hor bdud sogs la rtsod rgyu dul tsam yang med pas zor kha skor don med: des na 'di nag po bdud kyi kha gnon: rdzong chen bco brgyad 36

kyi spyi dgra: rdzong phran brgyad cu'i sger dgra: nag phyogs yongs kyi dgra ru nges pa shar khra mo gling zer ba zhig yod pas sa na: mthu med rnga bo rdung mi:dpa' med go mtshon 'dzin mi: gtam med glu chung len mi: stag rong dpon po khro thung zhes don med chom la phab mkhan: nyes med chad pas mnar mkhan zhig 'dug pa des: nga byang la don med brnyas bcos sha stag gi gtor zor 'phangs pa 'dra bsam nas: mdun blon pho nya rnams la dmag bsdu rgyu'i bka' dung zla bkra shis dang: dran pa zla gsal gnyis la babs nas de ma thag khrims rnga rdung: khrims dar 'phyar: khrims dung bus pa dang chabs cig gis pho nya rnams kyis cha dang 'phrin 'phrod pa byas:der byang ba rnams kyis ri rta ri nas bzung: sga stan smed skor dus gcig byas te rta gang mgyogs kyi bang kha gshib pa ltar khrag ral rgyal po'i pho brang du thon nas rgyal po'i rta ra gong 'og du rta thams cad btags: 'du ra padma stong thang la 'tshogs shing: rgyal po'i pho brang gi rtse mo me yis gzhob pa mthong nas yid mi bde long long gi ngang du yod tshe: rgyal po'i gdong dmar po khrag gi g.yor bzhin shin tu khros pa'i tshul gyis dran tshor gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so: glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: nam mkha'i sprin gyi gdengs khang na: srog bdag srin po lcags ral bzhugs: de ring glu 37

la len grogs mdzod: mtha' 'dre dgra yi dmag dpung choms: bar snang stong ba'i 'ja' gur klong: yul lha bdud btsan me 'bar bzhugs:gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: tshul 'gebs dgra yi snying khrag 'thung: sa gzhi g.yang gi ra ba na: srung ma sman mo rkang 'jibs bzhugs:'bod pa'i dus su rtsal ma zhan: tshur 'gebs mthu de lan po sprod:gter brag nor bu spung yag na: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral bzhugs:khrel med mtha' 'dre'i dpung tshogs kyi: srog rtsa chod la snying khrag bzhes:sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: dgu brtsegs khri yi yang gong nas: mthing mdog gdugs kyi 'og rol red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi rgyal po nga: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po yin: de nas 'dir tshogs blon po rnams: yang sgos mdun gral gong ba nas: dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar nyon: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig nyon: thog lha gshin rje nag po nyon: g.yas gral gzig gdan gong ba nas: rgyal sras zla gsal 'bum lu nyon: sras po rin chen dpal bzang nyon: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod nyon:gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang nyon: g.yon gral dom gdan gong ba nas: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa nyon: me yi me ru dmar po nyon: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring nyon: dug gi dug smyon nag po nyon: rgyab gdan dar zab gong 38

ba nas: gyad mi me ri rtse rgyal nyon: glog dmar drag rgod ya med nyon:mdun gral g.yas kyi bzhugs gdan steng: rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa'i gtsos: rtsal ldan dpa' bo bco lngas nyon: mdun gral g.yon gyi bzhugs gdan las: rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod gtsos: rtsal ldan dpa' bo bcu bzhis nyon: dpa' bo'i dpung dang dmag gis nyon: nyon dang 'dra ma 'di ltar yod: rang re byang gi sa cha na: dpa' rgod rting ma'i grags pa cheoḥ stag shar rgod po sha stag la: 'do ba mgyogs pa'i gyi ling rigs: ya med 'gran bral byang yul 'dir: don med mthu kha dug gzer can: me stag khrom se mkhar steng lhung: ngo mtshar lha yi rten dar bsregs: lcags kyi rgyal mtshan thang la 'gyel: thog khang dang po me la shor: rtsal ldan thog rgod lha dar gtsos: dpa' chen mi pho bco brgyad dgrong: yag nyes gnyis kyi so mtshams la: lcags ral srin pos rdzu 'phrul gyis: me dpung da mar po bcom pa red: kho re mi min byang gi sde: dpyod dang bsam blo ci 'dra gda': byang sde zho bzhin chags na yang: don med mthu yis khrag bzhin dkrugs: brtag na mi shes rgyu de med: sa mtha'i gling sdug ge sar la: khu bo khro thung sdar lu zhes: mthu dang drag sngags shes mkhan yin: mi byed dgu byed de yis byed: 'ja' tshon spar gyis e zin blta: chu bo thu bas e khog blta: phyi dgra nang la e khrid blta: nang mi dgra yis e gsod blta:39

legs pa'i bya ba gcig mi shes: mi legs bya ngan sna dgu byed: bsam na kho yis bzos pa 'dra: ma zad gling sdug 'bum dmag rnams: rgod 'dod snang ba dgung las mtho: khyad par bdud rigs spyi yi dgra: yang sgos mi min sger dgra red: mi thub ltegs bdud lus mi nyan: gling yul dbang du bsdu ba la: 'bum dmag ma 'dug 'gro rgyu byed: mtha' dgra gling gi pha jus de: mi 'gyang lag tu tshud par byed: de nas ci dgos rim gyis blta:e red blon tshogs dpyod ldan tsho: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: 'dir tshogs yid la de ltar zhog:ces zer ba na: mdun gral gral gyi gral mgo na bzhugs pa'i blon shes chen shes rab lha dar gyi sems la: a tse rgyal po 'dis ci 'dra gsung 'dug: gtor zor te gling khro thung gis 'phang ba yin don med deoḥ byang gling gnyis kyi bar na rgyal khag mang po yod pas su yin ga la shes: dang po dpyad pa nan gyis byas na su yin gang yin shes yong la: de nas dpa' dang rting ma blangs na los chog: de min bsam blo ma btang gi skad cha:dmigs pa ma bzung gi phaṭa sgra ga la 'os: sde don med la mi sha dang: ri lam med la lam gtod: chu zam med la zam pa ci rung bsam nas shugs kyis yar bzhengs te rin po che nor bu chu yi dpal 'dzin dga' ba g.yas 'khyil te gong rgyal po'i mdun du phul nas na re: ya rgyal po rin po che 40

lags: sku bzhugs pa rgyal sras mched gnyis dang: de min rtsal ldan dpa' blon 'bum dmag dpung dang bcas: nga rgan po'i bsam tshul 'di 'dra 'dug zer nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: byang mi min bdud kyi srung ma rnams: ngas 'bod do kha mgon bsdong grogs kyis: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min g.yang gi sa cha nas: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog pho brang ste: mtho sha ri gnam rdzong phyug mo yi: skyid 'du ra padma stong thang zer: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: blo dpyod chen dgu thigs skya mo rtogs: chags che ba nam mkha'i go 'byed mkhan: nga dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar yin: ya de nas rgyal po rin po che: brjid byin chags rmog gi mar 'og gi: sra khebs chen khrab kyi yang steng na: snyan dar lung padma'i gseng lam phyes: nyon zer ba 'chol gtam ma yin pas: don chen po'i zhu ba 'ga' re yod: dus da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha la: dgra sus 'phang med pa'i gtor zor byung: gyong chen po byang la byung ba bden: yid 'gyod pa'i mun pa 'thibs na yang: gling khro thung smyos sam gzhan zhig yin: don gnas lugs dngos su shes pa gal: don med pa'i mi sha bgo don med: shar khra mo gling gi sa cha na:dpon chen po ge sar dgra 'dul dang: blon dpa' rgod grub chen sum cu 41

bcas: dpung grangs mang phyogs bzhi'i rgyal khag yod: rtsal kun ldan dpa' po sha stag red: nged mi min byang la dpung rgod mod: 'gran zer ba pha jus 'chor rtags red: bya de 'dra dgos pa lar nas med: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: shar skya rengs gnam mtha' gsal ba de:lag spar mos khebs mkhan ga la sridoḥ phyi 'jig rten bskal ba'i chags 'jig de: de 'dod mkhan med kyang su yis bzlog: dpa' lan med ge sar kun la grags: nged mi min byang gis ga la thub: las de 'dra dgos pa lar nas med: dpa' rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa gcig: lho spyang ba'i mi dar stag chung gnyis: blo bkra gsal nam mkha'i dpal bzang gsum: da ma 'dug so dang nyul ma song: dgra su yin mtha' de dpyad na 'grig: don med par mi sha bsgo mi rung: de e red rgyal po chen po lags: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: gal che ba'i bya ba sgrub shes dgos: sgrub ma shes 'gyod pa'i gzhi ma yin: bsags bsags pa'i rgyu nor bkol shes dgos: bkol ma shes srog gi gshed yang sridoḥ de zer yang zer la bden yang bden: jus chen po 'thab na spyang grung dgos:blun che na 'thab sar srog dmar shor: tshod bstun na mi 'grub gang yang med: bya dal gyis sgrub dang yun gyis 'grub: yang sde gnyis mthu rtsal 'gran zhor la: stabs ma legs zor kha ma 'gyur ram: don 'di la 42

dpyad pa phra zhib dgos: khyed khrag ral blo sgo mkha' las yangs: sras mchog gnyis nyi zla'i 'od re bzang: gong blon tshogs skar phran mdangs re bkra: 'bangs ru sde kha rgya shin tu che: skyid nyi ma'i 'od khyim shes pa gal:sdug mun pa lag g.yug ga la rung: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:ces glu de ltar blangs bar: byang 'bum sde khra mo'i snying bcudoḥ mtho rgyal sras mched kyi a ce: mdzes sdug lha yi lang tsho can ma steoḥ byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo'i sems la: blon shes rab lha dar zer ba 'dis sems dkar gyi bden tshig sha stag bshad nas: jus chen por e phan e 'grigs blta ba ma gtogs: don med kyi skad cha gcig kyang med pas:bzang po'i bya la dmigs gtad: mkhas pa'i tshig la skyar bzlos shig byas na dga' bsam nas g.yu mchog dgos 'dod 'byung ba zhig yab rgyal po'i mdun la bzhag nas 'o lags so: rgan lha dar gyi gsung la 'khrul ba med:gtam tshig gcig bshad na spyi don red: las bya gcig sgrub na spyi don red: khong blon po yid sems dkar ba shes: ya rgyal blon stag gzig thang gang tsho: mi mkhas pa'i tshig la yi rangs kyis: dmag chen po yo lang dal cig bshol: khyed mngags pa'i mi rnams la mo song: go chod dang don yod gnyis ka gyis zer nas ngag rta byang glu ngang dkar ldem drug la 43

drangs te glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: rang snang nges pa lnga ldan gyi: shar lho nub byang steng 'og la: 'bum phrag yangs ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'bod: thugs rje'i byin rlabs snying la phobs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong zer: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: shar phyogs dung gi gzhal yas su: me long ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: gar stabs phyag rgya shigs se shigs: rgyan dang dril g.yer si li li: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: 'bum phrag dpa' mo'i gtso mo mdzad: skye ba 'di la zin nas bzung: mi min khrag ral khyung gshog gi: che ba rigs kyi gdong rgyud nas: byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo yinoḥ gzugs mdzes lha yi rjes 'gro yin: de nas byang gi rgyal blon tsho:nyon dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod: mi 'dod rkyen ngan gtor zor te: khra mo gling gis 'phen don med: don med mi sha mi bgo rgyu: chos rgyal las kyi che ba red: mi min byang dang khra mo gling: sa thag dpag tshad mang po'i bcad:sog po stod smad bar gsum dang: rgya dang 'a sha 'bru yul sogs: sde re'i rgyab na sde re yod: sngags nag mthu ba kun la yod: btsal gcod dpyad pa gtong rgyu gal: mun nag mda' 'phen ga la rung: glen pa'i glen gtam rga yis nyan: smyos na las bya su yis zin: yab chen dgung gi nyi ma 44

lags: mi chen zhal gyi gtam chung 'di: bden pa yin rgyu ga la srid: mi bden nyams tshod glu zhig 'dra: shar gling lha yi zhing khams na: ge sar stobs bcu'i nyi ma shar: dbu nag bde legs lam la drangs: snyan grags g.yu 'brug ldir ba 'dra: ci ma yin la 'gran rgyu med: med don rtsa ba 'di 'dra ste: de sngon thos pa'i skad cha la: gdug rtsub che ba nag po bdud: kha grangs mang ba ser bo hor: dpa' rtsal che ba smug po 'jangoḥ ya med ku ne mon gyi dpung: thams cad byang dang dpa' rgod mnyam: kha grangs byang gi mang re red: dpa' rtsal nus pa'i ma phan par: yod tshad gling gis dbang du bsdus: pha jus rgyal srid gling la shor: mos pas phul ba ga la yin: ma thub dgra 'og shor ba red: dpa' dang dpung dmag kun 'dzoms pas: stag gzig me thang gling gis gshags: bal bo'i 'gag 'phrang gling gis gtor: lcags mo'i gser 'phru gling gis bcad: li khri'i be thul gling gis btul: 'gag yul bu rta gling gis bsad: 'dan shog khra mo gling gis phabs: sum pa'i mdzo g.yang gling gis blangs: byu ru'i stag rtse gling gis bsad: a drag mi rgod gling gis bsgral: smug gu'i drel rdzong gling gis 'phrog: thams cad pham pa e go lags: ma thos bu mos gsal zhig 'debs: da rung de yi mi tshad par: rdzong phran mang po cham la phabs: bsags pa'i rgyu nor dpung gis 'phrog: brtsigs pa'i gyang khang 45

stong log byas: de tshor ci yong rang la yong: ma 'thab rang tshod zungs dang dga': tha ma tha ma'i bzhag rting la: gtor zor gling gis 'phang zer noḥ shi yang 'gyod pa byed rgyu med: de min phar 'gro ga la nyan: byur gyis ded dam gdon gyis ded: rgyal ngan snying la ma zhugs sam: de 'dra gtan nas mi phod lags: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: yab chen thugs la de ltar zhog:ces blangs pa na: byang mi min bdud kyi rje bo khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po'i mtshang la phog ste ma dga' nas gdong rab tu gnag pa'i mnyam dang bcas sems la: blon rgan shi mig gson blta 'dis wa mo'i sdar skad lhang lhang bsgragasoḥ shes med bu mos don med ku co 'don pa la yid gtad cig byed rgyu gang na yod: sras mo ngan lang ma 'dis nga la gtam gang byung gi 'cha' smod 'dra zhig byas song ba la lan zhig babs yod:byang mi min bdud kyi rgyal khab 'di na rgod thag chod thog 'brug glog gsum gtsos pa'i me chu dug gsum dang: yang rgod gyad chen mi bzhi: ya med rtsal ldan nyer dgu: las dmag rgod hrag ldan pa 'bum phrag phyed lnga yod pasoḥ sdug gling ba 'dra zhig phar zhog dang: 'chi bdag yin kyang byed thabs med pa zhig bzo nges yin bsam nas na re: 'o nga rgyal pos bshad pa lan gcig yin: de bas mang na 'chal gtam 'dra: 'dus blon 46

po'i mdun gros lan gcig yin: de bas mang na gros mthun dkon zer zhing bshol med dgra la jag gcig byed rgyu la thag gcod kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: mtho gnam gyi srin po lcags ral mkhyen: mtha' 'dre yul gling gi pha jus 'phrog: bar gnas pa'i bdud btsan me 'bar mkhyen: byang mi min bdud kyi bu rta skyongs: sa dog mo'i sman mo rkang 'jibs mkhyen: ltas ngan pa mi 'dod dgra la sgyur: gnas rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral mkhyen: sde 'bum dmag myur du 'dren rogs mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang mi min stobs kyi rgyal po nga: mtho a sngon mthing gi nyi ma dang: sa dog mo'i rgyan du ri rab lhun: rno sder chags rgyal po seng dkar mo: bya 'dab chags nang gi ga ru ṭa: nga yin nges khyung gshog rgyal po yin: stobs mnga' thang longs spyod klu la 'gran: bdud shing ri rgyal po'i bla bu yin: chos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo yin: ya de nas 'dir tshogs blon po rnams: tshur gson dang 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: kho lha dar rgas pos 'chol gtam smras: der bsam med bu mos tho co bsgrags: byang mi min shog kha'i rna bar sdugoḥ bya rgyal pos nam 'phang gcod lam nas: byi'u chung chung 'phur lhab ngo re tsha:47

nags rgya stag ngar ma'i mchong lam nas: wa ga ma 'dur na ngo re tsha:'brong ri dmar sgang la 'grim lam nas: glang rog pos rā bsdar ngo re tsha:byang mi min rgyal po khyung gshog ngas: sdug shes med stong gtam nyan 'dod med: blo rig pa nam mkha' lang ba 'dra: tshod zin pa srid pa'i gangs rgan 'dra: bya gang brtsam thams cad rang grub yin: mtha' dgra bo gling sdug mi thub zer: nga'i sgra 'dzin rna la 'gro lugs med: byang mi min khrag ral khyung gshog nga: phyi gnam sa rub kyang 'gran ya med: dpa' lan med 'chi bdag nag po 'dra: des mi tshad thog 'brug glog gsum dang: kho ya med me chu dug gsum dang: gyad chen po'i dpa' bo mi bzhi dang: rtsal ldan pa'i dpa' bo nyer dgu dang: dmag 'bum phrag phyed lnga ser ltar 'bebs: kho gling sgar me tog bcom 'dra byed: bsags bsags pa'i rgyu nor dpung gis 'phrogs: da de dus e thub khyod tshos ltos: blon rgan pa shes rab lha dar 'di: dus da lo 'chol bas 'chol gtam gleng: sman ngan lang tshe 'dzin lha mo la: gtam kha mtshar mang yang nyan don med: da g.yul gyi 'thab lugs 'di ltar byed: yang dpa' bo me chu dug gsum la: rtsal ldan gyi dpa' bo bcu yis skor: dpung 'bum dmag hrag bsdus gcig dang bcas: sang nyi shar tshes pa bcu bzhi la:shar khra mo gling gi yul la song: dpa' rting ma dgung la grags pa longs:48

kho mi ngan ge sar rgyang grags can: skabs ldan na byang du bzung nas shog:skabs ma ldan srog dmar chod la shog: dpa' tshur 'ong rting ma gzengs bstod yod: dpung 'bum dmag re re'i dpon la 'jog: nga rgyal po'i bka' dang ri gzar rbab: yar bzlog rgyu med pa gtam gyi dpe: gtam ma go zer mkhan med pa gyis: phyi mardzas pa'i rmog dang sra ba'i khrab: 'og mgyogs pa'i rta dang rno ba'i mtshon: da la mo lab tse brgyan ltar gyis: lha srung ma bstod dang rlung rta tshugs: mi rang dang lha gnyis 'bral med dgos: las bya ba lam du 'gro nges yin: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la:glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed 'dir tshogs yid la de ltar zhog:ces smras pa dang: ya med me chu dug gsum dang hrag bsdus las dmag khra mos rgyal po'i bka' la mngon par bstod cing de nub rang rang gi sgar la log: phyi nyin shar skya rengs dang po'i dus su ru dmag thams cad kyis dpa' chas bca' lag ma tshang ba med le zhig byas te shar gling gi phyogs su chas so:49

le'u gsum pa/shar gling dmag sna byang la gtad/ /byang gling dpa' bo'i ngar 'thab byas/ /me yi me ru dmar po dang / /rtsal ldan seng ge thog rgod bsgral/ /des skabs su rma yul lha yi bdag nyid: sku mchog lhun po'i nyams ldan: 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal po: lhun chags 'dod dgu'i g.yang nor: dmar ser 'jam dpal gzhon nu: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba: dbang chen padma'i thugs sprul: g.yul 'gyed nyon mongs dpung 'joms: gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje: dgra bla'i go mtshon 'tshub pa:dkar phyogs lha yi pho nya: smug po ldong gi rgyal rgyud: sngon po klu yi tsha bu:sku rje 'dzam gling skyes bu don grub de nyid pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse'i sgom khang nang du gser khrir 'khod nas: dwangs sman mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo la: 'gro don dus la babs nas mi min byang gi sa la dmag sna gtod ran pa'i lo rgyus gleng pas dgyes 'dzum dang bcas:rgyal pos tshe glu 'gyur med kyi ngag rta la drangs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:50

glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: zangs mdog dpal gyi zhing khams su: padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: rdzus skyes khye'u pad 'byung la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: rkyen ngan mi 'dod 'tshe ba bzlog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: 'gag mo'i lha sras ge sar yin:de nas seng lcam 'brug mo lags: gson dang 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la: mi min byang gi dngul rdzong 'di'i: gter sgo mi 'gyang 'gyed rgyu ni: ge sar rgyal po'i las don red: mi sdod byang la 'gro shoms byed: nag phyogs bdud rigs 'dul du 'gro: bdud sde yan por mngags nyan med: mngags na skyes bu'i dam tshig nyams: e tshor a lcam 'brug mo lags: gsol dpon mi chung kha bde dang: thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal la: cha dang bang chen dgos tshul dang: rgyags chas cha lag sgrig lugs sogs: ma 'gyang la mo shod la thongs: mi min khrag ral rgyal po des: 'bum dmag gling la mngags nas thal: gdong len rting ma len par rem: dpyid gsum skyid kyi sna 'dren la: khu byug gzhon nu rang chas srid: gsung snyan 'gyur khug ldem glu len: bod yul skyid kyi gzhi ma la:rdzong khag g.yang nor sgo skyes srid: dpa' rtags rting ma ri las mthooḥdus babs gdul bya ma yin nam: ma 'ongs gangs ljongs yangs ba ru:bsod nams rlung rta ma rgyas sam: de tsho 'brug mo'i los mkhyen te: 'on 51

kyang yin lugs 'dra ma tsam: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: 'brug mo'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung ba dang: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo: mdzes sdug zla gsal dwangs ma: gsung snyan pi waṃ dbyangs ldan: dgongs pa nam mkha'i sgo 'byed: chos sku'i don la blta ba: sku lus dpag bsam ljon pa:gar bsgyur ldem 'gros shigs se: spyan rangs zur mig mda' 'phen:mdzes ldan padma'i mchu sgros: smin legs 'o 'dzin rab rgyas: gnyen lcug bum pa'i sked mgul: rgyan bzang dar sna mang po: zim zim rlung gis skyod pa: 'khyugs 'khyugs ri mo bkra ba: rgyan rabs bco brgyad tshang ba:sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo de nyid kyis phyag zung pad dkar gyi rtsa ba ltar bskyangs te gsol dkar khyung gshog bcud 'dzoms kyi nang la gsol ja dang: rin chen dngul gyi bum pa'i nang la ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe chang dang tshe rul rnams blugs pa gser gzhongs rin chen rgyan mdzes kyi nang du bsgrigs nas yar btegs te bkra shis smon lam dkar po dgu seng drug 'gyur gyi ngag rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: gnas spyi bo bde chen dag pa'i zhing: yid 'ong ba nyams dga'i 'ja' gur klong: ma chos sku kun tu bzang mo bzhugs: phyi bag chags 'khrul ba'i la yog khrol:52

gnas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na: ngag snyan 'jebs dri za'i phang 'gro'i klong: ma longs sku mkha' spyod dbang mo bzhugs: nang 'gro drug 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: gnas snying kha chos dbyings zhing khams na:'od mi 'gyur gdod ma brdal khyab klong:ma sprul sku maddha ra ba bzhugs:don mi rtag rgyu ma'i 'khrul ba gzhom: sgos lhag lha ārya tā re dang: ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: da de ring bu mo'i glu sna drongs:glu 'gag pa'i rkyen te bsal du gsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: yul bde skyid g.yang gi lhas ra nas: mtho pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse zer: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang nya chags phu drug mda' dang bdun: lam skya ring gad pa'i rngams dang brgyad: g.yang dung mtsho phyug mo'i 'dzum dang dgu: skyid pho brang stag rtse'i zil dang bcu: bcu 'dzoms pa g.yang gi ra ba nas: ma dwangs sman gtso mo 'brug mo yin: glu 'di yi glu ngo ma shes na:'di 'brug mo'i dgu seng drug 'gyur yin: ya de nas seng chen mi yi nor:dpa' skyes mchog dgra 'dul rin po che: khyed gson dang 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: dus da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la: sde mi min byang gi dngul rdzong gi: nom chen po bod la 'dren pa bzang: yang bde skyid gling bzhi khyab par nges: de rten 'brel mi che su zhig che: byin rlabs chen stsol bas bla ma dang: yid dad pa che ba'i slob bu mchog: skyid thar ba'i lam 'dren dam 53

tshig rnams: dus gcig tu 'dzoms na 'di phyi bde: sku bka' drin che ba'i pha ma dang: rus rigs rgyud gcig pa'i phu nu mchogoḥ las ya rabs brtson pa'i phyi thag rnams: dus gcig tu 'dzoms na gzhi khyim bde: mthu drag rtsal che ba'i ge sar dang: dpa' grub pa mnga' brnyes dpa' rtul mchog: phyug nor g.yang rdzong gi sgo mo rnamasoḥ dus gcig tu 'dzoms na gangs ljongs bde: rten 'brel 'byung mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rgya: ja 'di bzhes sku khams shin tu bde: spyir 'gro ba'i don kun lhun gyis grub:g.yon dngul dkar bum pa'i nang shed na: lha ma cig grub pa'i tshe chang dang: yang 'chi med dang ma'i tshe rul yod: sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin brtan pa la: rkyen ngan pa'i dgra bgegs mi 'byung zhing: tshe chu rgyun bzhin du ring bar shog: gsung 'gag med glu yi rang bzhin la: don zab mang legs bshad char 'bebs shogoḥ thugs g.yo med gdod nas ye dag la:don 'khrul bral chos sku'i dpal 'bar shog: lam yon tan gter gyi mdzod chen rdol: dpal yang dag phyogs las rnam rgyal shog: 'khrul 'khor ba dung sprugs phrin las 'bar: phyogs ris med gdul bya don ldan shog: yul chos nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin la: yang chos can 'dzin pa bral bar shog: gzhi chos sku'i klong la grol bar shog: lam longs sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog: 'bras sprul sku'i gdul bya thob par shog: dpal 54

sangs rgyas stong gi phrin las mchog: mgon rigs gsum padma'i rol gar bzhengs: bdud dgra 'dul g.yul las rnam rgyal ba: sku seng chen khros pa dmar nag rtsal: khyed phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis shog: sgos mi min byang gi bdud sde 'joms: gdon ma rung 'gong bo thams cad btul:mthu drag po'i dpung gi zi ra 'tshub: gling dpa' rtul grub chen dam pa rnams: sku 'das 'khrungs med pa'i smon lam 'debs: ma rigs byed mkha' 'gro'i bden mthu dang: nga 'brug mo'i smon lam bzang po yis:don brjod pa ma lus 'grub par shog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: gling seng chen dgra 'dul yid la zhog:ces gsung ba dang: 'dzam gling mi yi nyi ma: dgra 'dul g.yul las rnam rgyal de nyid kyis gsol ja bzhes tshe: gsol dpon mi chung kha bde dang thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal gnyis la sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mos lo rgyus gnas tshul rnams gsal bor brjod pa dang: kho gnyis pho brang gi yang thog tu 'dzegs nas khrim sa rnga gsal ba'i 'brug grags lan gsum rdung: khrims dar dar khra phyug mo gnam la phyar: khrims dung dkar mo rgyang grags lan gsum bus te kun la brda 'phrod pa byas nas gling dkar phu mda' bar gsum gyi 'bum dmag rnams mtsho la gza' skar bkra 'dra:kha ba bu yug 'tshub 'tshub: 'du ra stag thang khra mo la mi 'dzoms rta 55

'dzoms kyis khra mer re sgar brgyab pa na: de ma thag mi chung ga ma gzig mgo dang: thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal gnyis kyi gtsos pa'i gsol dpon mi pho bco brgyad kyis lha gur mthong ba don ldan: phyi la chon thag mi dgos: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i chon thag: nang la ka ba mi dgos: padma stong ldan gyi ka ba can: mjal na ngan song med le: sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrul gur te rma del yag stag thang khra mor phubs nas gser khri khams gsum zil gnon dang dar gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phan yab: mdun cog gdan sogs pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse nas spyan drangs ba dang: 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal pos dbu rmog gser 'od lam me: dar 'phru 'ja' 'od gsal le: sku khrab rdo rje'i srog rdzong: 'khor gsum dug tsher rgyas yag: sku'i go mtshon dgra dar thams cad tshang ba zhig byas nas: 'do chen rkyang bu kha dkar: phyi byol song rta mchog 'phur shes: nang rta lha'i rgyal po dngos su bzhugs pa de la: gser dngul gyi srab smed glo len sogs cha tshang bar byas nas khra dpung nge bcibs te rma de yag stag thang khra mo la slebs pa dang: dpa' rtul rnams kyis mdun bsus te rta las babs shing lha gur chen mo'i nang la byon tshar ba dang: gsol dpon rnams kyis sha mar thud gsum gyi bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa mchod pa dang: der sku rje rin po ches byang mi min dngul rdzong 'bebs ran tshul gyi lo rgyus gleng bas glu 56

'di ltar blangs so: glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: lho nub o rgyan padma'i mtshor: snang mtha'i thugs las trī:dmar 'phros: 'od zer snang ba'i sku mchog ste: padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal: dbang drag rol ba gshin rje'i gnas: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod na: ma rung ru ṭa'i gshed ma la: gtum chen drag por gsol ba 'debs: rnyu ma tha la'i grong khyer nas: bsil 'byin padma'i pho brang nas: shel dkar tshe sgron gus pas 'bod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: 'du ra stag thang khra mo nas: lha gur 'phrul gyi lding khang nang: bde skyid 'od kyi gzhal yas red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: 'gag mo'i lha sras ge sar yin: de nas 'dir tshogs gling gi sde: snyan gsan bsrings thag tshur la gtod: da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la:mi min byang gi dngul gyi rdzong: gling dkar dpung gis len ran pas:rten 'brel dus la babs nas 'dug: bkra shis thog ma'i nyi ma loḥ blon chen 'dan ma bsam 'grub dngoḥ gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag gnyis:stag rong dpon po khro rgyal gsum: rong sras lha rgod 'bum lu bzhi: spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan lnga: 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me drug: sga bde mi chen ser bo bdun: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po brgyad: mi brgyad dpa' rtsal 'dra mnyam red: rta brgyad bang kha rlung la 'granoḥ dpa' grogs 57
