'bum dmag dpung dang bcas: ma bzhugs la mo byon shoms kyis: mi min khrag ral rgyal po desoḥ 'bum dmag gling la mngags yod pas:gdong len rting ma ci dga' longs: mi chung gtam gyi sgo mo gcig: thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal gnyis: rgya phrug sro ma badzra gsumoḥ mgyogs pa'i rtsal thob gru gu bzhi: rin chen nor bu sprin bcibs lnga: dung phrug dgra 'dul thang ri drug: gser tsha nyi ma shar yag bdun: skya lo'i khyung ne bstan pa brgyad: dad dga' bstan pa dar rgyas rnams: phyogs kyi rdzong chen dgu la song: cha dang lo rgyus ma lus zhus: 'di zla'i tshes pa nyer brgyad la: del yag thang la thon ni gyisoḥ rgya yi shes rab dpa' bzang gcig: hor gyi gru ba sangs rgyas gnyis: mon gyi blon chung tshe brtan gsum: nyi shar dung zla dkar po bzhi: phyogs bzhi'i bdud chen ru bzhi nas: ru 'dren che mthor 'phrin pa zhus: 'dir zla'i tshes pa nyer brgyad la: del yag thang la 'dus nas shog: rdzong khag so sor zhu 'phrin phul:rgyal po ge sar nga dang gcigoḥ 'bum pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal gnyis: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod gsum: nyi zla skar gsum dpung sdebs byed: gling dmag phyogs bzhi'i dgu thigs kyis: mi min mun pa'i dpung tshogs 'joms: e red 'dir tshogs blon po rnams: a sngon nam mkha'i rgyang lam na: khri gdugs nyi ma 'od re che: sgra gcan kha la mi shor dgos: shor 58

na 'od stong ngo re tsha: gtsang chab sngon mo'i chu nang na: gser mig nya mo 'khyugs 'gros byed: lcags kyus ngar la mi shor dgos: shor na gshog drug ngo re tsha: khra mo gling gi sa cha na: dpa' rtul rgyal blon dpung re drags: mtha' dgra'i kha la mi shor dgos: shor na dpa' rtul ngo re tsha:tsho chen lha sde dkar po lagasoḥ nged rang dpa' rtul dpung rgod kyis:rting ma phyi rabs bod la 'jog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len medoḥ lha sde'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung ba la: gling sde stod smad bar gsum gyis 'o legs so zhes mngon par bstod do:de nas gong mngags blon po rnams bdud hor mon 'jang stag gzig bal bo sog yul sogs la chasoḥ yang 'dan ma dpon blon rnams kyis gra bsgrigs legs par byas rjes de nub rang rang gi sgar la logs:nyi ma de yi phyir nyin: shar skya rengs kyi skya mda' ma shar: sngo rengs kyi 'dab ma ma gsal: bya rog gis zar chu ma 'thung gong la 'dan ma dang: spyi dpon: khro thung: sga bdeoḥ nyi 'bum: lha rgod: 'dan sras:'bru sras bcas ru dar 'tshubs se byang dgra bo'i tshur 'gebs byas pa la dgra lan rtsod du chas pa dang: gangs la'i lha lam ring mo nas byang gling gnyis kyi dmag gis phan tshun rgyang nas mthong byung pas: thog mar me yi 59

me ru'i sems la: ge sar la mkhyen pa yod pas 'di phal cher gling dmag yin nges red: thabs bkod gcig ma byas na: jus la nyen kha che bsam nas: myur bar mdung dar de dgung la 'phyar ba tsam gyis 'bum dmag gi dpung hrag rnams 'tshub 'khyil le bsdad pa dang: me yi me ru dmar pos zangs rmog khyung gtor rtse lnga'i rmog 'dab ra phabs: zangs khrab a long dgu bsgrigs kyi steng nas 'khor gsum dug gi so ngar bsdams: 'do chen me ru 'tshub shes kyis kha ru g.yas la bsgyur nas: zangs gzhu'i steng la zangs mda' zhig bzhag te rdzun gtam mgo g.yog gi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: ngas rang yul lha la gsol ba 'debs: phyi'i mtha' dmag kha lo dgra la sgyur: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang gangs la'i lha lam ring mo zer: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nub kha che'i khri bstan rgyal po des: nga nang blon rdo rgod me 'bar yin: ya de nas tshur yong 'bum dmag dpung: dpon su dang gang gi 'bum dmag yin: lam 'di nas ma 'gog gzur na dga': de ma gzur chag sgo nyo nges yin: dus na ning lo yi yar tshes la: nub kha che rgyal gyi tshong mgron zhig: shar rgya nag yul la song ba yin: de phyir la da rung ma slebs pas: rjes ra mda' rtsad gcod 'gro ba yin: dal mi khoms rgyal 60

po'i gtam la skrag: nub kha che'i khrims kha me las tsha: dpung rda ra'i dmag tshogs dpa' ngar che: pho su yin 'gran rtsod nus pa min: dgung mthing gsal a sngon nam mkha' nas: bya khyung chen gshog rtsal ngom pa 'di: mtho nam 'phang rtsal gyis gcod la dga': kho ne'u les 'phur rtsal 'gran rgyu med: rdza brag ri 'thab pa'i 'grim lam nas: bya rgya khra hor bas spyang grung ngom: mtshams bar snang gshog 'gyur gcig gis gcod: kho byi'u chung 'phur rtsal 'gran rgyu med: byang gangs la'i lha lam ring mo nas:nub kha che'i dpa' bo dpung rgod che: shar rgya nag yul la g.yul ngo sgyur:khyod mtha' mi'i lam 'gog snang ba 'khrul: dpa' rting ma len na kha che'i bu: rno li gri'i so kha su yis 'gran: lam ma 'gog rang lam snyog dang dga': sde don med mi sha bgo don med: yin gcig dang min gnyis thon zer na: mda' nyag phran mtheb kyis mi 'phen na: mdung kha ring 'dom la mi mjal na: rno ngar chen so kha mi 'gran na: de ci dga' rang cag bsam blo thongs: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod mtha' mi'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: 'bum dmag gling gi dpung dkyil nas: tsha zhang 'dan ma bsam 'grub des glu de thos pas: ngar rgod gting nas 'khrugs shing rmog dkar gyi 'dab ra phab: khrab dkar gyi rgyun 61

thag bsdams: 'khor gsum la dug gi kha rlangs 'khrigs bzhin bdud 'chi bdag yin kyang ya nga ba zhig byas nas: mda' rgyang gang gi tshad tsam sngon la brgyug te: gzhu chung dkar mo mtheb skyen gyi steng la lha mda' khra sgro ma zhig bzhag cing rdzun glu gzhan mgo skor ba 'di glu rta tha la drug 'gyur la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: dkar po lha dang ser bo'i gnyan: sngon po klu dang khra bo gza': dmar po btsan gyi sde tshogs rnams: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes noḥ byang gi gangs la ring mo red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rgya nag khrims kyi rgyal po de'ioḥ bka' blon dpa' rung rgod po yin: nag po rgya yi sa cha na: rgod 'dod 'chol gtam bshad sa med: gzhon nu'i snang ba rtsod sa med: med don rtsa ba bshad rgyu na: khrims rgyal khrims kyi rgyal po khos: khrims kha dmar bo me las tsha: khrims gzhung sngon mo chu las ring:khrims med chad pa gcod la khad: nang mi phyi la 'gro sa med: phyi mi nang la yong sa med: nged cag tshur yong 'bum dmag dpung: ge sar rgyal po mjal du 'gro: dgra lha dpon la 'tshams zhu byed: da rung de yi ga la tshad: 'dzam gling bod kyi sa cha rnams: skyid skyid ltad mortsobalta 'dod yod:gangs la byang gi rgya lam nas: ma 'gro zer na kha blon 'khrul: ma tshad rgya 62

nag rgyal po la: mi 'dod tshong rkus btsugs nas byung: snang ba de ltar ci 'dra mtho: dngos gnas yin nam rtsed mtshar yin: rtsed mtshar yin na bshags pas 'dags: dgu tshan nom gyis mjal rten dang: rin chen nor gyi grangs ka rnams: ma bzhag kha grangs khyer la shog: mi bshags dpa' tshod 'gran 'dod na: gson la mngags na dpa' bo min: 'jig rten mi yi bshad srol la: sngags nag rang tshod bzung bas dus: jag rkun khram pas tshur 'geb byas: 'byung bzhi'i g.yar mtshams bzhag dang lhan: las ngan sems dang bral le bzo: zer ba 'jig rten mi yis gleng:de nas kha blon rang snang can: lugs min gtam gyi nyes pa bzos: de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la: mda' gcig 'phen pa thog gi mda': thog mda' ngar ma'i rgyang lam na: brag dkar mtho yang thal bar brlag: 'on kyang mtha' dmag dpa' med tsho: dmyal bar mi mngags khas len byed:ma skrag ma skrag pha yi bu: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: kha blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung ba dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs pas 'ur sgra dang bcas te me yi me ru dmar po'i snying dkar nag gi mtshams la phog nas sngon las dus la babs pa chu srin dung gis thags pa bzhin mda' 'phen long ma byung bar bsad: der gling gi dpa' bo rnams kyis ki sgra 'brug 63

stong grags grags: mda' mo ser ba babs babs: ral gri glog 'od 'chad 'chad: mdung mo skar mda' rgyugs rgyugs byas nas 'thab pa'i mod la: mi min gyi dpung dkyil nas chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring nga rgyal gting nas 'khrugs: dran pa skor log brgyab cing rmog gi 'dab ra phab:khrab kyi rgyun thag bsdams: 'khor gsum ri mo bskor: 'do ba'i glo len 'then tshar ba dang dmag gi sngon la thon nas ya kho re sdar ma wa skyes tsho:mi gcig thub dpa' bor grags pa min: mda' gcig skyen nyag phran thogs pa min: rta gcig mgyogs cang shes thogs pa min: brel brel ma byed ngo re tsha: sdar ma'i dpung gshibs ki sgra des: dpa' bor zhe sdang slong bas rgyu zer zhing dpa' ngar ngar yin lugs dang 'dra ma brjod pa'i glu'i ngag rta byang glu ldem 'gyur la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: lha srin po lcags ral mthu stobs can: dus de ring dgra srog chod la shog: khyed bdud btsan me 'bar myur mgyogs can: dus de ring dgra srog chod la shog:sa'i sman mo rkang 'jibs bla len ma: rdzong gter bdag ri bo brag ral can: dus de ring dgra srog chod la shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na:byang gangs la'i lha lam ring mo red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: yin thag chod rting ma len mi la: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha na: khong khrag 64

ral khyung gshog rgyal po bzhugs: blon rgod po stag gzig gral ra nas:nga ya med dgra yi tho ba ste: dpa' chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring yin: yang dpa' rgod stag gi kha ya yin: lan med pa khrag 'thung bdud kyi bu: lho 'dzam gling 'di na nga rang btsan: sdug rang bstod min te gnas lugs yin: da de nas 'bum dmag khra mo'i dpung: sdug gling ba'i dmag la nor ba med: kho 'gag mo'i ab sha dmar zan des: byang mi min yul la mthu zor 'phangs: sde zho bzhin chags pa khrag bzhin dkrugs: las ma byas pa la gcig kyang med: de byas pa'i ya lan sprod 'dod yin: sgos sngon ma'i mi sngon rta sngon can: dpa' med kyang rgod mdog byed mi red:gling 'dan ma bu de e yin bsam: de yin na a pho'i bsam pa 'grub:gson mi yul 'grim kha 'jug rgyu min: shi 'chi bdag sngon la slebs pa soms: gtsang chu bo'i gzhung la lcags kyu drangs: nya gser mig shor sa e 'dug blta: nags rgya rdzong stag mo'i mche ba bsgrad: gla rog por bros sa e 'dug blta: byang thang chen dkyil nas chu 'dren thon: sde gling sdug thar sa e 'dug blta: gtam 'dra ma'i skad cha da rung yod: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po khong: rgya gar nag gnyis la 'brug ltar grags: stobs che ba dpung gi ya bdag red: spyir dmag dang g.yul gyi las la mkhas:sde gling sdug tshur 'gebs phar la zhog: dgra 'chi bdag byung yang 'jigs 65

pa med: khyod gling sdug da lo pha jus 'chor: rgyu tshe gsogs mkhar rdzong gyong la bskyal: shi dmyal khams nag po ya re nga: yang da rung de yi ga la tshad: dgung mthing gsal khrag ral rgyal po la: brgyan rgyal sras nyi zla rnam gnyis 'khrungs: blon skar tshogs khra mos mtha' nas bskor: khyed gling sdug mun pas tshur 'gebs 'di: 'od dung zla'i kha nas shul med byed: de e bden stos la mi bden nyon: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdung gang la: mda' nyag phran kha lo bsgyur ba 'disoḥ khyod sngon po skya la ho ma ya:glu go na rna ba'i bu ram yin: glu ma go ba la 'grel rgyu med: khyod gling sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag mda' 'phangs bas: 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod g.yas 'gyur sa la babs 'dra zhig byas pas mda' ma thebs: rgyab phyogs kyi mi rgod dpa' bo bco lnga g.yas bsgril g.yon bsgril gyi mda' gcig gis rtse la drangs nas so sor rta las lhung: tsha zhang 'dan ma bsam 'grub kyis bya de mthong nas ngar chen gting nas 'khrugs shing gzhu steng la mda' bzhag longs ma sbyin par 'bru sras byang rong btsan pos ral gri shubs nas bton te chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring dang ja yun tsam gyi ring la gri kha 'gran kyang phan tshun pham rgyal ma byung: skabs der phyogs gnyis kyi ru dmag rnams kyis phan tshun stong lug ma bu 'dres pa ltar 66

mda' gri mdung gsum gyis ci chod byas te g.yul 'thab nas shi bsad khrag gi 'khor lo skor 'go brtsams pa na: rong sras lha rgod 'bum lu dang 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me gnyis kyis re re bzhin ral gri shubs nas bton te dpung gshib kyis mchong bas: dug gi dug smyon nag po dang phan tshun ja yun tsam la gri kha 'gran kyang pham rgyal cher ma byung bas: der dug gi dug smyon nag pos rta kha g.yon du bsgyur nas skad cig tsam la dmag dkyil du shor yong ste: ya med chos skyong dar thod gtso'i gling dmag nyis brgya khrag la bsgyur nas na thang ro yis bkang: khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyiloḥ rlangs pas ri lung bkang nas sha zan ri khyi sha la zhen kha log pa gcig byas tshe: dpa' rtul rnams kyang re re bzhin brgyugs nas mi min gyi dmag mang du bcom pa'i mod la: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gis ral gri khregs gcod leb dkar shubs nas bton te dmag khrod du mchong zhing gling dmag 'phru khra can dang 'phru sngon can gang mang zhig khrag la bsgyur ba dang: ki bswo ha gsum gyis ri lung bkang bar byas: yang rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa dang: rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug thog rgod gnyis kyis mda' dung ba bkang bo re re bzhin du gling dmag gi nang du 'phangs nas dmag mi bdun cu khrag la bsgyur song: de'i tshe sga bde mi chen ser bo dang: rtsal ldan seng ge thog rgod gnyis thug song ba na: dang po mi min byang gi blon 67

po rtsal ldan seng ge thog rgod kyis yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: nam mkha' sprin gyi gdengs khang nas: srin po lcags ral 'bar ba 'bod: dgra srog chod la rang dpung 'tshos: bar snang stong ba'i 'ja' gur klong: bdud btsan me 'bar khrag gi gdong: yag nyes dus la ma g.yel cig: sa gzhi g.yang gi ra ba nas: sman mo rkang 'jibs nag mo 'bod: mtha' 'dre gling ba'i dgra sna bzlog: rdzong btsan g.yang gi ri bo nas: gter srung ri bo brag ral 'bod: mi min byang gi bstan pa skyongs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:gangs la byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral khyung gshog bka' blon la: rting ma'i dpa' rtsal rgyas pa'i bu: rtsal ldan seng ge rgod po yin: ma thub dgra yi kha gnon yin: 'o na gling phrug chas nag can: mthong myong med pa'i mtshar lugs la: mthing nag gos kyi thil ba de: sgom chen sngags kyi cha lugs red: mtshon bzung dmag la chas lugs la: skyes pa pho yi ngang tshul red: lha la mi the sdig la dga': bdud la ma the sgom chen tshul: ra min lug min kha ser khyod: skya min ser min dmag chas can: de ring gson la mngag bsam med: bla ma shes na gsol ba thob: yi dam yod na bskyed rim sgom: mkha' 'gro dad na grogs la bos:chos skyong srid na las la bskul: srung ma yod na dus la babs: babs 68

nas mi tshad 'phyi zhan 'dra: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs pas: lha gur gyi mgon po'i rnam sprul: 'bru sga bde chos skyong ber nag gi snying kar phogs na yang: mda' de bya sgro me dang 'phrad pa bzhin du bya grub ye shes kyi mes shul med du bsregs: khos dpal gur gyi mgon po'i rnam sprul 'bru sga bde la mda' brgyab pas nyes pas kho yi srog gi 'phen pa bcu gsum rdzogs nas bla nyams tshe nyams la song skad: der sga bde mi chen ser po na re: ya kho re dpa' med rang snang can: bdud phrug kha ser a bar rigs: 'chi la brel brel mi dgos dang: 'chi bdag sga bde slebs nas yod gsung nas mda' gri mdung sogs ci yang ma bzung bar phyag g.yas pas 'gram pa skyor: g.yon pas sog gur phubs nas dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: dpal 'phags pa gur gyi mgon po la: 'khor mgon po pho rgyud lha yi tshogs: dgung gan nas 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa 'dra: ngas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: rkyen bar chad bral nas bgegs sol cig: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang gangs la'i lha lam ring mo zer: mi nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:69

gling ge sar rgyal po'i bka' blon yin: stobs chen po'i dpung sha dkrugs mi yin: 'bru sga bde chos skyong beer nag zer: gangs mthon po'i seng dkar ge sar rgyal: 'dzum g.yu ral thig le sga bde yin: mtsho gting zab gser mig ge sar rgyal: 'khyugs rtsal gshog mi chen sga bde yin:shar gling ba'i skyes mchog ge sar rgyal: de'i bka' blon ya med sga bde yin: nga ma rung bdud kyi gshed ma yin: mthu drag sngags rgyu shi phaṭa 'gyel 'grub: nga yin na a pho de 'dra yin: ya de nas tshe zad mi min blon: wa ga ma stag brdzu stong gtam can: khyod lag len stong ba'i 'ja' la dpe: drin pha ma'i byams skyong bu la byas: bu ngan pas khrel gyis pha mar smad: dgra nag po'i gdong la bud pa'i dus: bros gad khung nyul ba ngang tshul red: pha bla ma'i gdams ngag bu la bstsal: bu dam med mngon lkog g.yo rgyu che: shi dmyal ba'i yul la thon pas dus: yid 'gyod pa drag po rtas mi shongs: byang mi min bdud rgyal rkyen gyis bslus: nang blon tshogs skyag lab stong gtam nyan: da dpa' rtul mdun la thon pas dus: bros 'dod kyi yob sdebs tha ra ra: mi khyod kyis bshad pa bden nas gda':ngas mthing gos gyon pa sngags kyis tshul: mthu stobs chen 'gran zla yod pa min: mi su yin grub pa thob rgyu dka': pho nga la grub rtags shugs kyis 'grub: der mthing gos rang la babs yod bsam: rgyan rus pa'i chas 70

sogs khrigs se khrigs: phyi 'khor pa'i chos nyid sgyu mar rtogs: don rang rig kun bzang rgyal sa rnyed: nga rnal 'byor don gyi rnal 'byor yin:rgyan rus chas lugs dang mthun no bsam: nga drag po dmag gi ru 'dren babs: dpal sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sprul ste: mgon 'dzam gling seng chen bka' blon babs: mtshon dug tsher bzung ba don yod bsam: phyi mu stegs bdud kyi kha gnon dang: sgos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma la:steng gong ma lha nas smon lam thebs: khyod dga' na bdud kyi ltegs bdud yin: dzong ma dga' bdud kyi 'gran pas chog: khong ge sar g.yu 'brug sngon mo la: nged dpa' rtul thog rgod glog 'dra yod: dpa' 'bum dmag ser rgod kha grangs mang: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la: mtho pho brang mkhar rdzong rtse nas bshig: dgra byang gi pho rigs chom la 'bebs:yang mo rigs mdzes ma grogs la 'gugs: rdzong bca' lag nom pa rting mar len: nga'i shugs chen stobs kyi che ba ngom: mtshon rnon po'i lag cha ngo so chungoḥ khyod khyi phrug rda lur seng ming btags: shugs khu tshur gcig gis ha la 'phen: sked 'khor gsum 'do ba a phos len: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len medoḥ khyod bdud phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du myur bar rta kha dkrugs te nye 71

sar slebs pa na: rtsal ldan seng ge thog rgod des am tshigs bsdams nas dpung 'dzings 'thab res byed shom byas tshe: sga bde skyogs kyi lde'u mig gis shugs chen gyis khu tshur gcig rgyab pas kho dran pa 'thor nas phyi mar bskyal: 'khor gsum 'do ba rgyan la blangs: ki sgra dang bcas g.yul ngor brgyugs nas byang dmag mang po bsgral: des skabs su rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug thog rgod kyis ral gri shubs nas byangs te mchong zhing: 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me dang g.yul bkyes pas: khos 'dan sras kyi gri ngo ma lon par phyir bros brgyab pa'i lam kha nas gling dmag mang po khrag la bsgyur rjes ral gri'i so kha la khrag gis g.yog yod pa rta'i rngog mar phyi phyi lan 'ga' byas pa dang mnyam du rta kha g.yas la bsgyur nas phyir shor yongs ba: 'bru sras byang rong btsan pos mthong ste dpa' the tshom med par mchong nas phan tshun gri kha 'gran yang pham rgyal ma byung bar gnas tshe:gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag 'bru sras kyi dpung rogs la thon byung b.roḥrtsal ldan des khong gnyis kyis rub na dpa' rtags mi zhog bsam nas rta kha phyir bskor te bya 'phur ba ltar bros song: yang stag rong dpon po dang rtsal ldan dom tsha thog rgod gnyis thug nas gri kha 'gran par: stag rong dpon po khro rgyal gyis srin gris btab thengs gcig gis rtsal ldan dom tsha'i khrab kyi rgyun thag breg nas sa la 'phangs: rtsal ldan dom tsha'i 'thab 72

pa'i spobs pa zhi nas lam gang thob kyis phyir bros: a khu lhag par khros te ki sgra dang bcas yar ded dang mar ded mang du byas: ldong khu bo spyi dpon dang rtsal ldan me lha grags pa gnyis thug pa na: rtsal ldan des sems la mtshar snang zhig skyes te khrel bgod shor zhor du rgas po 'di bsad dang ma bsad med: 'dis byang gi mi zhig phar zhog rta zhig kyang sod rgyu ma red bsam nas rta kha g.yas la bsgyur te dmag nang du shor grabs byas pa na:spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyis myur bar mda' gcig 'phangs pa kho la ma gnod: der rtsal ldan me lha grags pa glo bur du tshigs pa zos nas ral gri shubs nas byangs te gdong la mchong pa dang: khong gnyis kyis ja yun tsam la gri kha 'gran kyang pham rgyal ci yang ma byung: de ltar 'khrugs 'khrugs long long byas nas mun rub cing g.yul 'gyed byed mtshams bzhag nas rang rang gi sa la gyes:73

le'u bzhi ba/dgra lhas dmag bkod legs po mdzad/ /rten 'brel rgya mtsho'i skyel ma bzang / /mi min bdud kyi bla gnas btul/ /spyi dpon blo gros sgo mo 'byed/ /des skabs su gling gi pho nya rnams kyis so sor rang rang gi las 'gan dang du blangs te song zhing brda btang pa ltar du bdud yul nas ma dpa' mo a stag klu mo la: mchan khebs ga dar phying sngon dang: pho rgod dpa' bo gang mang dang las dmag nyis khri'i dpung dang bcas nyin mtshan ltos med du gling la byon yong ba dngoḥ hor yul nas sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po la: mchan khebs shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan dang: dpa' rgod rta dmag 'bum tsho lnga bcas gong ltar gling la byon no: 'jang yul nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur la: mchan khebs mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug dang: 'bum dmag gnyis bcas gling la byon: mon yul nas dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar la: mchan khebs mon phrug zla ba khra btsan dang:'bum dmag gnyis bcas gling la 'byor: de bzhin du rdzong chen dgu yi 74

pha dmag dang: rdzong phran bcu bdun gyi dpung hrag bsdus rnams mun pa 'khrigs 'khrigs: bu yug 'tshub 'tshuboḥ sprin smug rgyas rgyas byas te 'du ra stag thang gong mar byon nas dgra dar 'tshubs se sa gzhi mi yis bkang:nam mkha' dar gyis brgyan nas yod pas tshe na: rgyal sras dgra lha rtse rgyal gyis: dngul rmog nor bu rtse brgyad la: dar 'phru rgod 'phru cha 'grig dang:nor bu sogs kyis legs par brgyan: dngul khrab zla ba'i 'od rdzong la:'khor gsum sngo bsangs sdebs brtsegs bkra: ral gri ya zi skar phran la:kha dog mdzes ldan dpa' lung brgyan: stag ral 'dzum chen ri mo'i nangoḥlha gzhu dngul mo mchog yag bcugs: gzig ral ri mo spungs yag nang:lha mda' 'phur shes dgu bcus bkang: go dgu lus la tshang pa: mdzes sdug yid du 'ong pa zhig byas nas 'do ba bya rta khyung gshog gi steng la bcibs te phyogs kyi rgyal khag 'bum dmag khra mo la dmag bkod kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la redoḥ bla ma padma 'byung gnas mkhyen: ma rig 'khrul ba'i gnyis 'dzin khroloḥ yi dam phur bu'i lha tshogs mkhyen6ོ ma rung ru ṭa'i bstan pa snubs: mkha' 'gro rgod lcam dkar mo mkhyen: dam nyams dgra la bka' chad phobs: chos skyong drag pa kun 'dus mkhyen: bod khams phung rnams srog rtsa chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma 75

shes na: 'du ra stag thang khra mo red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: pho brang dngul chu khro rdzong nas: 'bum pa'i zhal dkar 'das po'i bu: dgra lha dgra yi tho ba yin: kho re 'dir tshogs gling gi sde: mtho ba ri rgyal rtse nas gson: dma' ba gtsang bo'i 'gram nas nyon: da lo dus kyi bzhag so la:shar gling lha yi zhing khams 'dir: mi min byang gis tshur 'gebs byas:ma byas las la tshod med red: mi 'thab kha med gling la byung: thabs dang bkod pa 'di ltar yod: phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren che bzhi la: dpa' rogs bkod pa 'di ltar yod: yang yang ngos bshad mi dgos mod: da thengs gsal 'debs 'di ltar byed: bdud sde dug gi tsho chen nas: dpa' mo a stag klu mo la: mchan khebs dpa' bo mi bdun te: lha blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal gcig: sog blon stobs chen stag dmar gnyis: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub gsum: a drag nyi ma grags pa bzhi: gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen stag lnga: smug gu'i stong bdud lag ring drug: a bse'i lha 'bum rgyal sras bdun: phyogs kyi rdzong khag shams mthud ni: sog stod sog smad byu ru dang: a drag gangs ri smug gu'i dmag: a bse'i dmag bcas rdzong khag bdun: a stag lha mo'i dpung grogs yinoḥ rting ma dgung la grags pa dgos: sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po la: mchan khebs dpa' bo mi bdun te: bal sras thog rgod ya med gcig: dga' ldan sprin tsha me 76

'bar gnyis: li yi khro mi dpa' brtan gsum: mi nyag mchong zhags dug chu bzhi: stobs ldan grags pa thog rgod lnga: lu yi me ru ngo nag drugarmilcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur bdun: phyogs kyi rjong khag shams mthud ni: bal bo dga' ldan li yi sde: mi nyag stobs ldan li yul dmag:lcags mo dang bcas rdzong khag bdun: dpa' bzang shan pa'i dpung grogs kyis: rting ma dgung la grags pa gyisoḥ 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur la: mchan khebs dpa' bo mi bdun de: li khri'i g.yung drung 'chi med gcig: zhang zhung stag mo khri bstan gnyis: sog gi me ru khrag 'thung gsum: 'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po bzhi: sum pa'i stag rgod btsan po lnga: sgye ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang drug: gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dga' bdun: phyogs bzhi rdzong khag shams mthud ni: li khri zhang zhung sog gi sde: 'dan sde sum pa bhe ra'i dpung: gnam lcags dpung bcas rgyal khag bdun: 'jang phrug g.yu lha'i dpung grogs kyis: rting ma dgung la grags pa dgos: dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar la: mchan khebs dpa' bo mi drug yod: mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang gcig: mnga' ri'i zla bzang rgyal po gnyis: 'ol kha'i ya lang nag po gsum: stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa bzhi: g.yu bse'i stobs ldan nag po lnga: mu stegs a bu kha bde drug: phyogs bzhi'i rdzong khag shams mthud ni: mtha' btsan mnga' 77

ri 'ol kha dang: stag gzig g.yu bse mu stegs bcas: dung skyong dpa' bo'i dpung grogs kyis: rting ma dgung la grags pa longs: phyogs bzhi rdzong btsan ru 'dren bzhi: ma bzhugs la mo byon shom mdzod: spyi khyab rgyal po ge sar dang: gling sde khra mo yongs rdzogs 'gro: mi min byang gi sdar ma tsho'i: wa srog gcod rgyu mi dka' lags: e red tsho chen gling gi sde:dkar po rgyal ba yang rgyal byed: nag po pham pa lag pa'i mthil: sang nyin nyi ma rtse shar la: rnga bo'i skad chen grags pa'i dus: bza' btung gur bsdu la mo gyis: dung chen skad de byung ba'i dus: rta bzung sga bstad hrig ge mdzod: rgya gling drug 'gyur byung ba'i dus: char sna rlung gis 'dren 'dra gyis: mi min 'khrugs thag ma chod par: mi brgya kha sems mthun le dgos: rta brgya srab mda' gcig le dgos: spo tho gcig la ldog pa gtod: jus srid gcig la blo sems sgrims: 'di dag dmag gi bkod pa yin: phyi dgra mi thub nang dme dang: wa bros jus btsong chog pa min: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling dkar lha sde'i yid la zhog:ces glu de ltar gsung pa na: dpa' rtul kun gyis mngon par bstod nas thams cad yi rang bar byas so:nyi ma de yi phyi nyin rnga chen skad brda byung nas bza' btung phun sum 78

tshogs pa dang bcas gur rnams bsdus te gra sgrigs legs por byas: dung chen rgyang skad byung nas rta la sga stad cing khal rnams bkal te 'tshubs 'khyil ler mdzad: der 'dzam gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rin po che de nyid las la chas par brtsams pa dang: dwangs sman seng lcam 'brug mo gtso'i na chung bu mo bco lngas mgrin gcig gis byon chang smon lam gyi glu 'di 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i mgur dbyangs kyi ngag rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnas chos dbyings khyab brdal zhing khams nas: dpal chos sku kun tu bzang po bzhugs: yum kun bzang mo dang gnyis med 'khriloḥ khyed mkhyen no byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: gnas nges pa lnga ldan zhing khams nas: lha longs sku rdo sems yab yum dang: dpal rigs lnga'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: khyed mkhyen no byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: gnas padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: dpal sprul ba'i sku mchog padma 'byung: 'khor 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: khyed mkhyen no byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: shar khra mo gling gi sa cha nas:gnas bde skyid pad mo'i lhas ra ste: skyid 'du ra stag thang khra mo red: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: phyi 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo la: ma dwangs 79

sman na chung bco lnga yin: gling skyes mchog nor bu dgra 'dul lags:dpal byin rlabs chen po phyogs bcur rgyas: lam ma rig mun 'thibs bdud khams bcom: las mdzad 'phrin 'od gsal nyi ma shar: sku mchog legs nyon mong sgrib pa med: ma 'gro ba'i dpal du rtag brtan shog:gsung tshangs dbyangs zab chos dam pa'i glu: ma 'gro ba'i snyan tu rtag thos shog: thugs 'od gsal chos sku'i dgongs pa mnga': ma 'gro ba'i yid du rtag mnga' shog: chos yon tan rgya mtshor byang chub pa: ma 'gro ba'i don tu rtag rtsen shog: 'bras phrin las drag po'i me char 'tshub: ma 'gro ba'i log rtog rtag 'joms shog: dbu rmog dkar 'jigs brgyad bral ba 'di: bod dbu nag bde la bkod pa'i rtags: dpal 'jigs bral sangs rgyas ye yin brda: lam bde chen mchog gi bkra shis shog:steng dar 'phru kha mdog bzhi dang ldan: dpal las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa'i brda: phyogs dgra bzhi 'dul ba'i bkra shis shog: gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs mdzes cha bkod: lha rigs lnga sku la rdzogs pa dang: yum lnga dang 'bral ba med pa'i brda: dpal rgyal kun 'phrin las bkra shis shog: 'dab chu dar sngon po rlung gis bskyod: gnas srid pa gsum na mkha' ltar yangs: chos rgyal bstan bskal ba ma stong bar: yul 'jig rten brgyan tu bzhugs pa'i brda: yid smon pa ci bzhin bkra shis shog:80

rgyab khrab dkar sra brtan rdo rjer grub: sked 'khor gsum dgra dar 'tshub la rngams: sra go btsan mtshon cha dug tsher rgyas: sdang dgra dpung zil gyi gnon pa'i brda: phyogs g.yul rgyal rting ma'i bkra shis shog: 'og 'do ba rlung gshog gser sga'i mjesoḥ mtho 'ja' 'od klong na gshegs bzhud mdzad: mthu dzu 'phrul stobs dbang 'byor ba'i brda: las kun nus 'grub brtson bkra shis shog: nang gong blon gdong gral rngams brjid che:phyi bka' blon dpung gi zi ra 'tshub: phyogs bdud kyi srog rtsa gcod pa'i phyir: dmag chen po g.yul ngo bsgyur ba'i dus: sra sa gzhi steng 'og bsgyur ba 'dra: dpa' rting ma dgung la grags pa'i brda: don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par shog: sku'i tshe la bar chad med par shog: 'og rta la chag 'gril med par shog: pho rang rang bsam don 'grub par shog:yang da rung de yi ga la tshad: lha ma cig grub pa'i tshe chang dang: dpa' grub chen brgyad cu'i tshe rul rnams: khyed skyes mchog rgyal blon kun gyis bzhes: don 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob: gnas dag pa lha yi zhing khams nas: lha tshangs pa dkar po'i sde tshogs la: yang lha dmag bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: dus de ring gling dmag mgon la byon: gling skyes bu'i 'gro don 'grub par shog: yang bar ma gnyan gyi zhing khams nas: dpal dgra bla gnyan stag dmar po dang: gnyan dmag rgod bye ba 'bum dang 81

bcas: dus de ring gling dmag mgon la byon: dmag bu rta g.yul las rgyal bar shog: 'og ma dros klu yi zhing khams nas: klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen la: 'khor klu dmag bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: dus de ring gling dmag mgon la byon: sdang dgra khams 'joms la tshags med shog:gnas gangs dkar shel gyi mchod rten nas: khong yul lha rma rgyal sbom ra dang: yul rma bdag bye ba sa ya bcas: dus de ring gling dmag mgon la byon: rdzong dngos grub g.yang du len par shog: snyan grags pa'i sa steng khyab par shogoḥ dpal g.yul rgyal rting ma mtho par shog: skyabs bslu med mchog gsum bden pa dang: ma dwangs sman mkha' 'gro'i smon lam gyis:rten 'brel 'byung bslu ba med pa'i ngang: yid smon pa ci bzhin 'grub par shog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:gling rgyal blon thugs la de ltar zhog:ces mgrin gcig gis blangs ba dang: 'dzam gling skyes mchog chen po gtso'i dpa' rtul gzhon nu bco lngas glu la ngo so bstod kyang rab tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas mgrin gcig gis glu lan 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: ki bswo lha klu gnyan rnams bswo: dgra 'gegs log rtog rtsad nas 'joms: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: gling sa mthong ba kun smon nas: bkra shis g.yang gi ra ba 82

red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpa' bo grub chen bco lnga yin: de nas dwangs sman mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dar lung ma g.yeng snyan gson dang: de ring rten 'brel kun nas 'dzoms: gnam la nyi zla skar gsum shar: bde skyid rgyun chad med pa'i rtags: sa la bkra shis g.yang zhag chags: thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i rtags: bar la bkra shis byin rlabs 'khrigasoḥ ngo mtshar snyan grags thob pa'i rtags: 'o na 'dir tshogs bu mo rnams:dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags ma: 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos ba:'dam gyi padma bzhin du mjes: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog:dbu skra gnag snum lcang lo can: 'od zer 'ja' tshon lhang nge ba: dpa' bo'i yid kyi dbang po 'gugs: mthong grol lha mo'i bkra shis shogoḥ rgya byur dkar dmar skra gnon dang: rab mdzes rgyan rabs ma lus tshang:'jig rten mdzes sdug gcig bsdus bzhin: mthong smon byed po'i bkra shis shog: rin chen g.yu yi rgyan cha dang: mu tig do shal mdangs 'od 'phro: na chung mdza' ba'i lang tsho 'bar: 'dod ldan yid 'dzin bkra shis shog: padma nor bu rin chen dang: mdangs ldan dar gyi brgyan gos klubs: lha yi bu mo zil gyis gnon: bde stong dga' bzhi'i bkra shis shog: gzi zhags mgul gyi phreng ba dang: lham chung me tog ri mo bkra:stong skud sna tshogs nywa chabs can: 'o 'dzin nu 'bur rab tu rgyas: sked 83

phra lus ldem padma bzhin: dgyes zhal 'dzum dkar 'bum dang bcas:dga' ba'i brtse glu snyan 'gyur ldan: dkyus rengs utpal zir mda' rtsen:dpa' bo dgyes pas rang bzhin ma: khyed cag dwangs sman bu mo'i tshogs:nad med tshe thag ring bas phyir: tshe lha sgrol ma'i bkra shis shog: gsung la 'gag pa med bas phyir: sgra dbyangs lha mo'i bkra shis shog: thugs la 'khrul ba med bas phyir: kun tu bzang mo'i bkra shis shog: yon tan 'bras bzang rigs rgyud dar: gzhan phan nus pa'i bkra shis shog: phrin las dga' bzhi'i 'od brgya 'byed: sems can re skongs bkra shis shog:mdor na bkra shis smon lam 'dis: mos pa ci bzhin 'grub par shogoḥgo na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: dwangs sman thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung nas phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i ngang la: rgya gling gi skad dang bsgrags khra 'tshub se rang rang gis rta la bcibs nas chibs kha mi min yul gyi phyogs la gtad do: de nas nyin zhag lnga drug 'gor ba'i rjes la byang gangs la'i lha lam ring mor 'bum dmag dgra dar 'tshub se thon pa dang: gling ba'i dmag gi dpung chu sna rdol ba ltar byung ba mi min gyi dmag gis mthong nas zhe sdang me ru ltar 'bar ba las ci bya gtol med lus: byang gling gnyis kyis phar dgra tshur rgyugs med par nyin 'ga' la 84

dmag ngal gsos skad: de'i skabs su chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gi sems la: mtha' dmag gling gi dpung rgod hrag che la kha grangs 'di ltar mang bas nged mi min gyi dmag 'bum tsho tsam gyis rdzong med sa stong 'di nas 'gran ya mi thub ngo ma red: jus nyes pham kha ma gtogs 'ongs rgyu ci yod: de bas phar rang rdzong la log nas rting ma re e lon blta: dpa' rgod hrag ldan pa phal cher shul du yod pas dgra mi thub pa ga la srid bsam nas gros dbang rnams la gsang gros byas mthar kho na re: ya 'dir tshogs rtsal ldan blon po rnams: yang sgos su dug smyon nag po lags: mtha' gling gi las dmag 'di la go btsan pa gnam lcags brag rdzong: dpung mang ba sa kha'i rtsi thog yin pas thang stong padma'i lhas ra 'di nas nga tsho dpung nyung 'bum tsho tsam gyis rting ma len pa phar zhog: jus nyes pham kha gnam nag lang 'dra zhig mgo la yongs ba lag pa'i mthil yin 'dug: da mi 'dug rang yul du song nas rdzong btsan po la dpa' gcar zhing rting ma ci lon re byed pa las ci: khyed cag gi sems na ci yod ces smras pa dang: de yod thams cad kyi yid la 'thad nas nyi ma de yi nub mor mi min gyi 'bum dmag de 'jam jag ger phyir log: nyin 'ga' 'gor bas rjes su mi minarsha byang gi rgyal po'i pho brang du thon pa dang:khyad par du chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gis rgyal po la gus phyag dang bcas 85

glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: byang mi min bdud kyi lha rnams 'bod: glu len pa'i gdangs tshod zin par shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min rgyal po'i pho brang ste: mtho sha ri gnam rdzong phyug mo red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rgod me chu dug gi dpung gral nas: nga chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring yin: ya de nas rgyal po rin po che: gson zer nas zhu rgyu mi legs te: da mi zhu ka med thug nas byung:nged gong mngags blon po'i tshogs dang bcas: yang nyin mtshan bar med gling la song: gyod byung gzhi rtags khom ma byung gong: byang gangs la'i lha lam ring mo nas: kho gling dmag g.yul sa bzung nas gda': dpa' 'thab 'khrug me ru 'bar 'dra byas: khong me yi me ru dmar po de: dgra 'dan ma chu yis dbang du shor: ngas phar bsad mi rta rgod hrag can:bsad che nas khrag gis yur chu drangs: byang thang chen mi ros na thang bzos: yang de rjes nyi ma'i bzhag so la: shar khra mo gling gis dpung rgyab la: dpung 'phru dkar ser ba babs babs red: 'phru nag po grub so bkug bkug red: 'phru sngon po rgya mtsho lud lud red: 'phru ser bo gser ri nyi shar 'dra: yang 'phru ljang 'bras zhing snye ma 'dra: dpung 'phru khra dgung gi skar tshogs bzhin: dmag lta ba mig gi mi bzod do: yang 86

bsam pa sems la mi shong ngo: der mang sna nyung gis ma rten nasoḥ 'dug ma phod byang la log pa yin: byang mi min khrag ral rin po che: nged phar song rting ma ma che bas: yid 'gyod pa che yang thabs med byung: gong rgyal po'i bka' bkyon chung bar zhu: thang me tog mgo lcog ldem na yang: sad ser bas sngon la ma mjes byung: nags rgya rdzong shug lo rgyas na yang: me dmar bo'i sngon la ma mdzes lags: brag dkar rdzong dbu 'phang mtho na yang: thog gnam lcags sngon la ma rten thal: mgyogs gyi ling bang rtsal 'dzoms na yang: stag ngar ma'i sngon nas ma 'tsham lags: nya gser mig 'khyugs la mkhas na yang: mgyogs chu srin mdun nas shor ma thub: nged byang ba dpa' rtsal rgod na yang: dgra gling dmag sngon nas pham kha nyos:dpung mang sna nyung gis ga la rten: mtha' gling ba'i 'bum dmag khra mo de:pho yang rgod stag mo mchong mchong red: mtshon shubs khra 'dzum drug rgyas rgyas red: dpa' 'bum dmag 'od stong 'phro 'phro red: rtsal ldem myur thog mda' 'phen 'phen red: steng pho rgod stag mo sha stag la: 'og 'do ba bya rta rlung gshog ldan: pho gzhan ma'i mi dang mi 'dra lags: da gra sgrigs a long lta bu byos: rdzong btsan po'i gsang gnad dam 'dzin dgos: bya gang brtsams dpyad pa zhib mo thongs: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed rgyal blon thugs la de ltar zhog:87

ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mi min bdud kyi rje bo: ya med khrag ral rgyal po de nyid nga rgyal gting nas 'khrugs te na re: ya 'dir tshogs blon po rnams gson dang: mtha' 'dre 'gag mo'i jo ru khos: ma byas las la tshod med ma red dam: don med par byang la zor sna gtad: rtsal ldan gyi dpa' bo dang mi pho rgod hrag ldan pa bco brgyad dgrong ba'i mi tshad par da rung dpa' yod 'dod kyi byang la tshur 'gebs byas pa ha cang mi mos pas: g.yul 'thab pa stag gzig 'phrad 'dra zhig byas na gling sdug 'gag mo'i jo ru'i dbang thang da lor rdzogs pa yin pas:pha jus byang la lon nges yin: blo ma pham: snying rtsa ma 'dar zer nas dmag bkod 'khrugs lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral can: srin dmag bye ba sa yas bskor: gling sdug rnams la rting ma longs: rang jus srung la mthu ma chung: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar la: bdud rigs bye ba sa yas bskor: mtha' dmag gling la rting ma longs: rang jus srung la mthu ma chung: sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs ma: 'gong po sha zan bye bas bskor: mtha' dmag gling la rting ma longs:rang jus srung la mthu ma chung: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral la: sde brgyad gzhi bdag bye bas bskor: mtha' dmag gling la rting ma longs: rang jus 88

srung la mthu ma chung: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas:pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po yin: ma khros zla ba'i zhal bzang nga: khros na 'chi bdag nag po yin: 'dzam bu gling na snyan grags khyab: de 'dra yin lugs skad cha tsam: yang dag gtam gyi ldog kha la: drag po'i gtor zor dmar po de:sus 'phang mi shes rgyu de med: 'jig rten gna' mi'i zer tshul la:gnong can khro la rgyab chad 'drog: sdug can ngu la 'dre can lceb: zer ba'i dpe dang mi mthun nam: chu bo 'gog pas lcags ri de: phu na chu dgra che chung rtags: de min lcags ri bzo srol med: las dmag dpung gi gra sgrigs te: nyes pa rang gi bzos pas rtags: de min g.yul ngo bsgyur don med: ma byas gling gis tshod med la: de lan mi sprod ga la 'dug: me yi me ru dmar po khong: rdzong khag dgu yi 'dems ya dang: las dmag dpung la chag nyes sogs: de lan rnga dang rnga lcag byed: dpa' rtsal rting ma ngom lugs dang: btsan rdzong 'thab ra 'dzin lugs rnams: bshad na 'dra ma 'di ltar dgos: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag nas: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dang: thog lha gshin rje nag po la: mchan khebs rtsal ldan dpa' bo bdun: 'bum dmag gcig bcas btsan rdzong zungs:phar 'bud stag mo mchong mchong gyis: gling sdug 'do khyu gtor gtor 89

mdzod: tshur 'bud rting ma ma zhan lags: shi bsad 'khor lo dgra la skor: lho rdzong dkar mo dkris yag nas: gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang dang: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod la: mchan khebs rtsal ldan dpa' bo bdun: 'bum dmag gcig gis kha lo sgyur: rdzong btsan sgo mo bsdams bsdams kyis: phar 'bud spyang mo 'dur 'dur gyis: gling sdug lug khyu gtor gtor mdzod: tshur 'bud mda' mtshon bsu ba gyis: mi rta chag nyes thub le dgos: nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag nas: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa dngoḥ glog dmar drag rgod ya med la: mchan khebs rtsal ldan dpa' bo bdun: 'bum dmag gcig gis dpung dang bcas:lcags sgo zwa yis zlum 'dra gyis: phar 'bud rgya khras bcims bcims kyis: gling sdug byi'u khyu gtor gtor mdzod: tshur 'bud yan bor ma shor cig: dgra yul yi thang chad le gyis: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag nas:gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal dngoḥ chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring la: mchan khebs dpa' bo bdun dang bcas: 'bum dmag gcig gis dpung rgod bsgrigs: phar 'bud thog ser babs babs kyis: gling sdug me tog bcom bcom gyis: tshur 'bud mda' rtsal sus che ltos: mi ro'i na thang gang le gyis: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong nas: mi min khrag ral rgyal po nga:rgyas sras nyi zla gral sdebs yod: dug gi dug smyon nag po dngoḥ khri dmag 90

lnga yis dpung btsan 'dzin: so ba ring thung brje ris dang: go mtshon dgra dar 'tshubs se 'dug: 'do ba chas kyis sos le gyis: byang gling 'khrugs mtha' ma chod bar: nang mi phyi la 'gro sa med: phyi mi nang la yong don med: phyi dgra mi thub nang dme dang: dgra la mgo 'bul skyabs zhu sogs: sus byed gces srog 'been la 'jog: ma go gtam zhig med pa gyis: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: 'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang thams cad kyis yid la 'thad nas bka' dang du blangs so:de'i skabs su mi min byang gi mkha' 'gro: rdo rje rigs kyi rnam sprul:na chung tshe 'dzin lha mooḥ mdzangs ma'i yon tan kun ldan: rgyan rabs mig gi mdangs 'phrog: mdzes sdug yid kyi bu lon ma des rgya gar yul gyi 'bras chang dang: rgya nag yul gyi dgun chang gi gtsos chang mi gcig chang sna kun 'dus shig gsol gar shing lo g.yas 'khyil gyi nang du blug cing yab rgyal po'i mdun la phebs nas: zhal dkar gsal zla ba 'dzum dmul dang bcas glu 'di snyan gsang bung ba'i 'gyur khug gi ngag rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la lenoḥ ma rje btsun 91

'phags ma sgrol ma dang: lha nyer gcig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'bod:nga nyams chung bu mor spyan gyis gzigs: glu 'gag pa'i rkyen te bsal du gsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red:ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpon khrag ral rgyal po'i sras mo dang: ma byang bza' chu lha'i gces phrug la: shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:'das ma 'ongs thugs la gsal mi yin: ya de nas yab chen rin po che:snyan gsan dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re gda': dus da lo gnam lo tshur tshes 'dir: sde byang gling g.yul 'khrugs byed zer na: yid pham 'gyod byang la yong bar nges: de yong don rtsa ba bshad pas na: dpon ge sar mi yi nyi ma khong: dpal sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sprul redoḥ bdud ma rung 'joms pa'i gshed ma red: sgos nag phyogs yongs kyi kha gnon red: lha srung ma lus dang 'bral ba med: kho dngos yod dngos med gnyis ka red:mthu rdzu 'phrul stobs la mnga' dbang bsgyur: don skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur ye nas med: ma na chung bu mo'i shes tshul rnams: 'gal che bas srog la babs na yang: gsang mi 'os yab chen snyan la zhu: kho gling gi lha thang gong ma na: yang mkhas pa gtam gyi yang rtul la: khong spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan yod: thabs shes chen 'phrul gyi yang rtul la: dpon khro thung 'phrul gyi lde'u mig yod: mda' nyag phran 'phen pa'i yang rtul la: blon 'dan ma 92

g.yul rgyal thog rgod yod: stobs shugs chen skyogs kyi yang rtul la: 'bru sga bde mi chen ser bo yod: rno btab chod mtshon gyi yang rtul la: khong dpa' bla mi spyang dkar bo yod: dpa' ngar chen stag gzig kha sprod de:yang ru 'dren dpa' bo che bzhi yod: phyogs rdzong chen dgu yi pha dmag dang: yang rdzong phran bcu bdun dpung rgyab yod: grangs mang ba thang chen rtsi thog 'dra: stobs rtsal chen thog 'brug glog dang mtshungs: kho shes chen blon po myur du thongs: sde byang gling mdun ma gtam rgyu gal: ri lan na mtsho la gus phyag 'tshol: mtsho lan na ri la zhal chab phul: da ri chu nga bde khyod bde byos: da de bas dga' gcig ga na yod: red e bsam yab chen mi yi nor: sgos 'dir tshogs dmar nag khrom gyi dpung: chang bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'di bzhes la: gros 'du ra'i don chen yang gcig mdzod: pho mkhas pa'i don gtam re re shod: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: dbyar drug gsum me tog rgyas zhan 'dra: sad ser ba'i dgra la dogs zon gal: de ma byas 'dab ma sa la 'thor: ston zla gsum chu ma'i zhing rnams rgyas: dgra 'bu srin phyogs la dogs zon gal: de ma byas 'bras bu don med byed: gtam zer bas bden la cha 'jog mdzod:gling ge sar dpung la 'thab dgos na: lus 'chi med lcags srog thob pa dgos: yang de sngon nyi ma'i 'khor lo la: bdud chen po bzhi yi dpa' 93

rtsal rnams: gnyid ma khug rmi lam bzhin du bzos: stobs kho che zer bas rdzong chen dgu: la mthon po'i na bun bzhin du yal: rdzong chung chung mang po dpung gis bcom: blo sngon la khel na mkhas pa yin: thag sngon nas bcad na dpyod ldan yin: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed 'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa na: gling lha'i kyang mi min khrag ral rgyal po'i blo kha bsgyur yod pas rkyen gyis bu mo'i snying gtam rnams la cha 'jog ma byas pas ma tshad bu mo 'dis bshad tshul la nyan na shar khra mo gling nas yongs bas gling nang mi zhig gis bshad bshad byed 'dug pas gsal cha 'di bden nam: 'ol tshod kyi skad cha de 'dra yod don med bsam nas yid the tshoms kyi rgya ru tshud la khad cig byas te ya 'o na tshe 'dzin lha mo lagasoḥ khyod gling yul la gsal cha de 'dra zhig yod pa cis phyiroḥ khyod kyis phyi nang 'thab pas bya ngan zhig srid dam: kho ge sar ram de dpa' ci 'dra zhig 'dug nged byang bas blta dgos la: da thengs kyi g.yul chen po'i yo lang la sems khur mi dgos: khyod kyi skad cha 'di 'dra rjes sor bshad mi chogoḥ 'jig rten gtam gyi dper: lha bla ma'i chos gral gong ma la: stag shar ba'i pho tshod bshad sa med: gong dpon po'i khrims ra gong ma la: ma bu mo'i lab gtam sgrogs sa med zer ba ma thos sam: skya lam 94

ser lam kha kha: 'brong bre lo'i rdza lam so so yin pas ma bu mo la dbang ba'i las ka: stag sha ra la thob pa'i dmag jag zer ba zhig srid pas mgo mi thar sar lus ma 'tshang zer nas mig dmar po las khrag char 'tshub se 'dug go: der byang bza' chu yi lha mos sras mo la bka' bkyon phab zhor du rgyal blon kun la tsho ba'i sha yi sder 'dren dang: zhim pa'i gsol ja mang 'dren: bdud rtsi chang de skor 'dren byas pa'i mthar 'du ba'i tshogs grol nas thams cad rang rang gi gnas la log go:nyi ma de yi phyi nyin gyad chen bzhi dang bskos bzhag gi blon po rnams kyis rdzong btsan bzung nas hrig ger bsdad: de'i dus su khra mo gling gi 'bum dmag gis phyi nyin byang dmag rnams med pa mthong nas rim bzhin byang mi min gyi sa sne gnam thang padma stong brgyad kyi yar mtha': byi ri brag dkar mdung rtse'i la zur du sgar rgyab ste der zhag sa byas nas bzhugs:mtshan mor der rdzong chen phab pa'i gter bdag: dpa' bo 'bum gyi gtso bo: don 'grub wer ma dkar po: smug po ldong gi rgyal rgyud: seng blon rgyal sras bzang bo: 'gag bza' lha mo'i gces phrug: 'dzam gling skyes bu dgra 'dul de nyid mal la gzim pa'i tho rengs kyi dus su byang shasta la yi gnas nas 'od zer sna tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phros pa'i dkyil na mkha' 'gro ma chu dar ser bos brgyan pa rus pa'i gos can zhig phebs 95

nas dga' ba'i mdangs dang bcas mkha' 'gro'i brda glu 'jig rten mi yi skad la bsgyur nas ngag rta thang dkar gshog 'gyur la drangs te glu 'di ltar blangs so:na mo gu ru so bha wa: sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ: a la skye med don gyi glu: tha la thabs shes zung 'jug brda: ye gzhi gdod ma'i mgon po dang: kun tu bzang mor gsol ba 'debs: rtog grol rig rtsal rol ba yis: khams gsum 'khor ba dung nas sprugs: gnas 'di dbang sngon baiḍūrya: skye med dag pa dbyings kyi klong: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mdzad ma: ḍā ki 'od 'chang lha mo yin: 'ja' 'od gur gyi nang shed nas: dgu brtsegs gdan gyi yang steng na: skyes mchog dgra 'dul rgyal po bzhugs: gson dang 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: sang nyin nyi ma rtse shar la: 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod gcig: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gnyis: skyes bu dgra 'dul khyed dang gsum: ma bzhugs phar gyi brag rtsar song: brag snying dkyil la mda' mo rgyob: mi min rgyal gyi bla gnas la: shang shang brag zan nag po yod: ge sar khyed kyi 'dul skal yin: shang phrug te pho khrag mig de: 'bru sras kho yi 'dul skal yin: shang ma chu ru ske ring de: 'dan ma blon gyi 'dul skal yin: ma brjed sems kyi dkyil du zungs: de byas mi min khrag ral kho'i: bla tshe nyams shing dran pa 96

'thor: dmag jus blo 'don thub pa min: bla gnas 'dul bar blo ma lhod: dbu nag skyabs gcig 'gro ba'i mgon: thugs rje phyogs ris mi mnga' bas: 'gran bral lha bu rin po che: bdud khams chos la 'god par shog: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: spyang thong rgyugs la ma 'tsher na: g.yang dkar khyu sne gar gtor red: rgya stag mchong la ma 'tsher na:gla rog nags ri'i gseb la 'chi: zer ba'i gtam la bden lugs yod:ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul la: lha klu gnyan gsum 'khor gyis bskor:mtha' dmag bdud kyi sde tshan rnams: drag pos dpung dang mthu yis bcom: rting ma dgung la grags pa yin: ma g.yel ma g.yel ge sar dpon: lung bstan glu la 'khrul ba med: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: ge sar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces snyan 'gyur lung bstan tshigs su bcad pa de glu la drangs nas ka dag chos sku'i klong la 'ja' yal ba ltar tu gyur to:phyi nyin skyes mchog nyid kyis gling dmag sa der ngal gso ru bcug:'dan ma dang 'bru sras gnyis la lung bstan gyi don 'bras thams cad zhib par gsung nas khong gsum po go bkrag nyi ma shar 'dra: mtshon bkrag lab tse brgyan 'dra zhig byas te rang rang gi rta la bcibs shing mi ring ba'i sa na brag ri zhig yod pa de'i rtsar song nas zhib par bltas tshe 97

brag gi dkyil na 'brong bre ser gyi snying la nor 'gro la khad kyi brag zhig yod pa la: 'dan mas mda' shar gcig rgyab pas brag sgo thal bar bzos pa dang sbrags sgra 'brug grags pa lta bu'i sgra zhig gis sa gzhi 'dar khrob khrob byas pa na: bya shang shang pho mo bu gsum gnyid las sad de nam mkhar rgyang rgyang gis 'phur ba'i tshe: rang rang gi las skal bsgos tshar yod stabs mda' rgyab ste so so bsad: sgro gshog rnams blangs: bya'i lus po sa 'og tu mnan nas steng la rdo yi mchod rten brtsigs: de'i phyi nyin mi min ar brag la chen gyi phyogs nas gling dmag 'tshub 'khyil le thon nas gzigs tshe: mi min byang gi yul khams thams cad lag mthil ltar mthong 'dug pa na: dpa' rtul dpon blon rnams kyis re zhig dmag dpung la ngal gso ru bcugs: der spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyis lag g.yas kyis nyi zer g.yor zhor du yun tsam la rgyang lta byas rjes dmag bkod 'thab lugs sogs kyi glu 'di dal ba ring mo'i ngag rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: skyabs dam pa dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen: nga'i blo sna chos la sgyur bar shog: chos de la bar chad med par shog: yang rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog:sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha red: ngas nye mo mig gis ma mthong mod: rgyang ring bo rna bas thos tshul la: byang mi min 98

ar brag la chen red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: yul khra stod gnam rdzong phyug mo nas: nga chags chen blo yi rdzi bo la: gling spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan yin: rgan bdun cu'i 'bod pa thon nas thal: skra smra ra dung la 'gyur nas yod: yang da rung blo sgo ma nyams lags: phar gzigs dang ltad mo 'ga' re gda': mtho brjid rngams ldan pa'i mkhar chen gan:byang mi min rgyal po 'dug pa'i gnas: ming btags na sha ri gnam rdzong zer: dpa' rting ma'i dpung ba 'gran sa red: gling pho rgod dpung gi gnam lcags thog: thog dmar bo 'phen sa nor med red: de'i shar gyi rdzong btsan ind+ra'i mdog: mtho ri dar dgung la zug pa gan: dpa' bka' blon shan pa'i dpung gis gtugs: snyan grags pa dgung la khyab pa gyis: kho bdud nag bstan pa dung la snubs: mgon thub pa'i rang lugs rgyas par shog: lho rdzong chen gangs ri dkar po'i mdog: mon dung skyong dpon gyi dpung gis gtugs: ram nag po ser bas bcom ltar gyis: lha gong ma'i ngo so dgung la bstod: bdud sdar ma'i rtsa ba phud le gyis: yang nub rdzong rin chen bdun gyi mdog: khyed 'jang phrug g.yu lha'i dpung gis gtugs: spyang smyon pas lug khyu gtor 'dra gyis: gling dgra bla'i dpa' mkhar dgung la bstod: chos bstan par 'tshe ba'i mtha' dmag bzlog:byang rdzong chen rā ga dmar bo'i mdog: ma a stag dpon gyi dpung gis 99

gtugs: tshoms me tog sad kyis bcom 'dra byos: gling ge sar bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: bdud log rtog ru ṭa rtsad rdzogs shog: pho yang rgod thams cad rting ma longs: rta gyi ling rnams kyis mgyogs dar rtsod: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po la: stobs 'byor ba dpa' rtsal ci 'dug lta:gong blon po thog 'brug glog gsum la: dpa' snying khams rtsal drug e rgyas ltoḥ kho dug chu blon dang rtsal ldan rnams: bdud dngos kyi bla bu e yin lta: sngon 'jig rten gna' mi'i gtam dpe la: ban sdom pa shor kha snang ba mtho: chos 'jig rten mi shes blun mtshang ston: sman gnas mgo 'khyar kha mug snang che: yag khog shes med pa'i rtags te ston: de zer ba mi bden ga la srid: dpa' yod mdog byang ba mi min sde: sde don med yul la dmag rgod phab: las bya ba tshod med rting ma la: lan e nus ltad mo mthong nas yongs: dus tha ma rdzong shor jus brlag na: dpon shes med u tshugs a bar rig: de e red tsho chen gling gi sde: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed 'dir tshogs yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung bas thams cad kyis mngon par bstod dooḥde nas 'bum dmag des chu sna rdol ba bzhin du nyin gcig gi ring la byang gi sa cha mang po brgal mthar ri ba'i lha lung dgu 'dus kyi thang 100

chen la thon nas de nub de ru zhag sa byas: nyi ma de yi phyi nyin gling ba rnams kyis rang rang gi las bskos ji bzhin so sor dmag gi ru khag re bsgos nas chas pa dang: byang gi rdzong khag so so'i thad la sgar re rgyab nas 'dug: der byang ba'i dmag rnams yid mi bde sems kha 'tshub se:'jigs dngangs se: skrag lhang nger gnas par gda':101

le'u lnga ba/ stong bdud dang ni shan pa 'thab/ /thog lhas mi nyag mchong zhags dgrong / /g.yul 'khrug nag po'i gnam sa sgrib/ /khe tshes gyad mi me ru bcom/ /de'i phyi nyin nam lang ba dang mnyam du byang gi shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag nas gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dang: ya med thog lha gshin rje gnyis kyis rtsal ldan blon po gsum dang dpa' 'dzoms khri dmag lnga dang bcas pa go bkrag mtshon bkrag 'tshub se shan pa'i sgar la shor nas byung ba na: gling gis so ba rnams kyis mthong nas brda sprad pas hor dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal po dang: bal sras thog rgod ya med: dga' ldan sprin tsha me 'bar: li yi khro mi dpa' brtan: mi nyag mchong zhags dug chu: stobs ldan grags pa thog rgod: li yi me ru ngo nag: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan: pā thul sprin tsha gdong dmar: mgar ba'i ya med nag po: ri ba'i 'bum thub grags pa bcas sgar zur du bud nas 'tshub 'khyil ler go btsan bzung nas bsdad 102

pa dang: phan tshun skad brda thos pa'i sa de nas gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis lcags rmog nag po rtse dgu'i 'dab ra phab: lcags khrab mun pa rang 'thibs kyi rgyun thag bsdams: 'do chen rlung 'dzin 'phur shes kyi kha ru bkag: lcags gzhu 'bar ba dgu bsgrigs kyi steng du lcags mda' khrag 'thung 'phur shes bzhag nas yin lugs dang bcas dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral bdud btsan sman mo dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral bcas: de ring a pho'i grogs la byon: dgra srog gcod pa'i dngos grub stsol: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: me tog padma'i lhas ra bgod: shar rdzong nor bu spongs yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min khrag ral rgyal po yi: blon brgya'i nang gi yang rgod de: ya med gyad chen mi bzhi las: stong bdud mig gcig dgra yi gshed: khrag ral g.yu 'brug sngon mo des: stong bdud thog dmar dgra la 'phen: khrag ral seng ge dkar mo des: stong bdud g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas: khrag ral gshin rje'i pho nya des: stong bdud gshin rje'i zhags pa 'dra: gling sdug wa mo phar la zhog:gnam sa rub kyang do zla med: de nas wa khyu'i yang dkyil nasoḥ mi rgod rta dmar zhon le khyod: gling phrug su dang gang zhig yin: de ring tshe zad nga la 103

thug: gson por mngags bsam snang ba 'khrul: stong bdud mig gcig dpa' bo nga'i: mgo la gyon pa'i rmog nag 'di: lcags rmog nag po rtse dgu zer: rang lugs lcags kyi 'phru nag gsum: g.yul rgyal dpa' bo'i khyad chos yin: shergyab la gyon pa'i khrab nag 'di: lcags khrab mun pa rang 'thib zer: 'khor gsum dug gi so kha can: lan med chu sprin dgu ris zer: g.yon na btags pa'i stag ral 'di: lcags gzhu 'gugs chen bzhugs gnas zer: g.yas la btags pa'i gzig ral 'di: lcags mda' drug cu'i rtsed ra red: sked la btags pa'i ral gri 'di: kun chod ya zi skya rengs zer: rgyab la khur ba'i phub mo 'di: li smug phub mo gling bzhi red: lcags mdung nag po rtse gsum 'di: rno chen khra zi ring mo red: gru la bskon pa'i sbrul zhags 'di: bya 'dzin rlung shugs a long red: dpa' chas go btsan rin thang che: bdud pho 'bum gyi dpa' snying yod: byang gi na dmar gzhung drug nas: rkyang chung rgyugs tshod ma zin na:sug bzhi rdo la thug nyen yod: spen ma'i gseb kyi tshang tshang nas: byi'u chung 'phur tshod ma zin na: rgya khris gces srog gcod nyen yod: dal 'gro'i rma klung dwangs ma nas: gser mig 'khyugs tshod ma zin na: sram nag kha la 'chor nyen yod: rma yul gling gi sa cha na: gling phrug skyag lang dpa' 'dod kyis: don med bcom tshod ma zin na: mtha' ma byang gis 104

srog dmar 'phrog: gling yul jo ru'i dmag gi tshogs: dpa' rtul wa mo khyu gcig gi: rting ma e lon de dus shes: dpa' med gzhan la 'gro 'gro de: ya med byang la yong bsam 'khrul: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs dkar 'og: rting ma stong bdud bu la babs: babs don rtsa ba bshad pas na:mtha' gling nag pos byed stangs la: dang po gtor zor byang la 'phangs:mi shi rta chag mgo nas brtsams: rang 'dug mi de 'dug ma bcug: don med khrag gi 'khor lo bskoroḥ da rung las dmag byang la phab: mi byed rgyu de med lugs la: da lo dbang thang rdzogs pa shes: 'gag mo'i ab 'chan jo ru kho: ab khung nag po'i nang la sbasoḥ de min dpa' 'dod pho gsar rnams: nyag phran mda' yi rtsed mo byed: gtam rgyud phyi rabs mi la 'jog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs nas sems la: dang po glu lan 'dra 'dug na su yin shes pas dga': de nas mda' gcig gi 'gro sgo byas na chog bsam nas go btsan bzung nas bsdad pa la: de yang dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rnam spruloḥ khrag 'thung ya med nag po: mi dmar khrag gi ral ba can: rta dmar rlung gi gshog pa can: drag po khros pa'i stangs stabs dang bcas zangs gzhu dmar po'i steng du zangs mda' dgra gshed 'bar 105

ba bzhag nas: ya kho re mi pho stong gtam can: mal nyal rmi lam ci ltar byung: gtam ku re yin nam ngo ma yin zer nas glu 'di 'bras thung dgra srog dmar len la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: lha the'u ring dkar nag khra gsum dang: nga shan pa'i lcog lha mtshal rtse sogs: dus de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: dgra dam nyams bdud kyi srog rtsa chod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: shar rdzong chen nor bu spongs yag 'dab: byang mi min wa mo'i phru gu rnams: mug srog skyob gad la byed sa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpal o rgyan gnyis pa'i phrin las gar: gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi: bka'i blon po shan pa dgra yi gshedoḥ dpung 'bum dmag hor gyi ru 'dren yin: dus de ring nyi ma'i yar sngon la:dpa' stobs rtsal 'dzoms pa'i rdzong chen dgu: gzhan rdzong phran bcu bdun la sogs pa: shar khra mo gling gis cham la phaboḥ pho rang 'dod mgo 'bul ga la yin: stobs ma 'dra bran du bkod pa red: ma bu mo 'phang bzung stong bdud khyod: sdar wa mo stag ming ngo re tsha: pha ngan pa'i bu de rang snang che: dpa' stong gtam g.yu 'brug grags grags byed: gzhan brnyas pa'i brnyas tshod ma zin na: bu dpa' bos klad khrag dgung la gtoroḥ dus de tshe sdar ma wa mo des: drin pha ma'i ming nas ngu 'bod 106

byed: sdug snang ba pho tshod gar song med: ma ngan ma'i bu mo rang rtsis che:mo yag mdog bzang khul bsgyur du med: ma bsod zad 'khyam tshod ma zin noḥ pho blo gtad med pa'i byi pho des: gdong mchi ma sha re phyir khyim snyogs: kha stong lab rang yu gar song med: byang bdud phrug wa mo dpa' 'dod de: dpa' g.yul 'khrug las la ma zhugs rkyen: gling stag mo khros pa'i ngar lam nas: wa ga ma'i phyir rjes snyegs la ltos: khyod stong bdud stong ming gang la song: ban mkhas 'dod chos bshad stong gtam te:gnad ma khel sdom pa yug mor shor: dpa' rgod 'dod pho gzhon snang ba de: gnad ma khel wa bros rnga brgyangs byas: ma mdzes 'dod snang ba mthon po de: gnad ma khel khrag snag dri ma'i slad: hor sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po nga: dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rnam sprul yinoḥ bdud ma rung 'dul ba'i ltegs bdud yin: chos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yin:bod dbu nag skyid kyi sna 'dren yin: bdud btul la dka' ba mi dgos te: lag sdig pa 'di la rgas po dogasoḥ khyod stong bdud klad pa nang la khug: gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul dang: gling dpa' rtul 'gran na mi dga' bas: gtam mdun ma'i mgo lung sgrigs na bsam: sde byang gling g.yul 'khrug zhi na bzang: da de min g.yul 'thab byed zer na: byang mi min shul la rtswa skya'i bkang: rtswa 'jag ma'i shug glu rna la gzan: de e 107

dga' bsam blo zhib du thongs: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod stong bdud yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gi shan pa'i skad cha la nyan 'dod med par khrel bgod dang bcas mda' gcig 'ur gyis 'phangs pas: shan pas phub kyis bkag nas ma gnod: phar mda' gcig thog lhung pa ltar sgra dang bcas 'phangs pas stong bdud kyis phub kyis bkag long ma byung mod: go btsan pas ci yang ma thub: de nas gri kha thung tsam 'gran pa'i mthar: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis shan pa'i gri ngo mi lon pa shes nas rta kha dmag khrod du bsgyur zhing 'khrug 'khrug long long gi skabs der: dga' ldan sprin tsha me 'bar gyis myur bar mda' dgu 'phangs ba kho'i dpung ba g.yas g.yon brang sogs la thebs kyang ma phigs: de'i tshe khos ral gri klad la bskor nas btab thengs gcig gis dgrong: yang bal sras thog rgod ya med dang: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur gnyis rgyugs nas dpung rub rgyab cing pham rgyal ma byungoḥ bdud blon khos gling dmag 'phru dmar can brgyad cu rtsa nang zhig mtshon la drangs nas bya 'phur ba ltar rang rdzong du songoḥ thog lha gshin rje nag po dang: rtsal ldan dpa' bo mi gsum sogs kyi gdong la:mi nyag mchong zhags dug chu: stobs ldan grags pa thog rgod gnyis kyis 108

go btsan bzung nas mchong zhing phan tshun glu len sogs ci yang med par gri kha 'gran pa'i tshe: rtsal ldan dom tsha thog rgod dang stobs ldan grags pa thog rgod gnyis thug song bas: phan tshun ral kha 'gran nas dpa'aho'adra mnyam gyi skabs su rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa dpa' rogs su thon zhing ral gri shubs nas bton byung ba dang: kho gnyis kyi dpa' ngo mi lon pa shes nas phyir bkyed do: thog lha gshin rje nag po dang: mi nyag mchong zhags dug chu gnyis thug pas dang po mi nyag gi dpa' bo des glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: rong btsan kha ba dkar po dang: rong lha a mye rdo rje sogs: mkhyen gzigs dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: mi min byang la rting ma longs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min sprang sgar 'debs sa de: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ge sar dpon gyi lha blon bskos: mi nyag mchong zhags dug chu yin: rmog dkar steng gi dar 'phru yin: 'do ba'i steng gi khebs gdan yin: mi nyag phyogs kyi shog dpogayin: grub chen brgyad cu'i gdan gral na: bos na ming don gnyis dang mtshungs: dpa' rtsal snying khams tshad la 'jog: rno mtshon gri la mnga' dbang bsgyur: de nas byang phrug dpa' med tsho: de ring thar med kha la brgyab: thar med las kyi 109

bskos thang red: mchong zhags khros pa'i ngar lam na: ri brag 'dar nas tha ra ra: gangs dkar skrag nas bzhud la khad: rgya mtsho dngangs nas skam la nye: e bden ltad mo mthong nas yongasoḥ mi min byang gi sdar ma tsho: gad phug byi khung 'tshol dang dga': yang sgos mi sngon rta sngon can:rnon po mtshon gyi so la 'dren: go khrab 'khor gsum 'do ba rta: mchong zhags dpon gyi rting ma len: ge sar rgyal po'i srung ma rnams: rno gcod mtshon gyi so kha 'tshos: dam nyams bdud phrug srog rtsa chod: mgo bo yungs ldog breg pa bzhin: bem po sdong dum sa la bsgril: snying khrag dron mo sa la 'pho: rnam shes bya sgro rlung khyer de: dag pa lha yi zhing la 'dren:go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: bdud phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa na: thog lha gshin rje nag po na re: ya kho re gling phrug dkar po skya: mi nyag mchong zhags dug chu khyod: shi la brel brel mi dgos dang: 'chi bdag a pho slebs nas yod: dang po glu la gsal bor nyon: de nas dpung ba 'gran na chog zer nas glu 'di sha zan stag mo'i ngar sgra la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lha lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs ma: byang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs: da 110

gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: kho ma thub dgra bo chom la phob: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas: rdzong shar stod nor bu spungs yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po la: dpa' che ba'i gyad chen mi bzhi yod: yang ya med thog 'brug glog gsum yod: btsan thag chod me chu dug gsum yod: dpa' de gral me chu ma dbang yang: kho dug gi dpa' bo sku khams bde: rgod yang dag thog 'brug glog gsum nas: nga thog lha gshin rje nag po yin: thog dmar po 'dra ba'i dpa' rtsal yod: ya kho re mi nyag dug chu lags: khyod khrab rmog gyon pa ngo re tshoḥ yang 'khor gsum bskor ba yi re mug: skye pho brgya'i gral na nyams re chung: lag skor ru bzung na tshad tshad red: lho mi nyag rgyal po man chad nasoḥ dpung 'bum dmag rtsa mi shing mi yan: gling dkar pos rtsa med ma byas sam: khyod mi sha zhe sdang med lugs la: byams snying rje'i 'ja' lus ma btang ngam: sdug zhabs phyi sgrub nas rgyugs pa las: shi dmyal bar 'grim na mi dga' 'am: rgas skye 'chi mgo nag yongs la yod: las de la skrag kyang pham pa med: gling 'gag mo'i jo ru nag btsog kho: dpon khrag ral rgyal po'i ha la 'phen: mgo dar 'phru sku rgyal bod la ngom: byang mi min zer nas grags le gcig: mtha' gling sdug zer nas sdug le gnyis: byed ma thub bzhag na shi ba'i rtags: khyod 111

wa rtul dpung rgod che bsam kyang: nga rtsal ldan dpa' la 'gran lugs med: rgod yang dag rting ma mthong nas yongs: ya de nas gling ba wa mo'i sde: bu 'dra gnyis las rlung sus che lta: dpa' snying khams pho bzo sus bzang lta: gri rno gcod so kha sus rno lta: nga ya med thog lha gshin rje dang:khyod sdar ma mi nyag dug chu gnyis: dpa' stag g.yag la rtsod brgyag pa bzhin: gling sdug shi mi ro sa mtha' bskyal: dpa' byang rgyal rting ma sgo skyel byung: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag tu phan tshun stag g.yag 'phrad pa ltar gri kha 'gran pas: mi nyag mchong zhags dug chus ral gris lan gsum btab kyang go btsan pas ci yang ma gnod: thog lha gshin rje nag pos ral gri klad la bskor nas lan gcig btabs nas lus stod smad khag gnyis la bsgos nas dgrong: de dang mnyam du ki sgra dang bcas dmag khrod du mchong nas 'phru sna tshogs can gyi dmag mi mang du bsad byung ba na: li yi khro mi dpa' brtan dang: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan gnyis kyis mthong nas kho'i gdong bkag ste 'thab par mtshon ma song: khos dpa' rtul gnyis mi thub pa shes nas rta kha g.yon du bsgyur te dmag 'phru dkar can mang du bcom: rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa dang: rtsal ldan dom tsha thog 112

rgod: rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod gsum po so sor rang rang gi thad kyi dmag khrod du mchong byung ba dang: gling sgar nas bal sras thog rgod ya med kyis shing gzhu dkar mo mchog yag gi steng du dung mda' a mo leb chen zhig bzhag nas yin lugs dang 'dra ma brjod pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang: bslu ba med pa'i chos la 'dud: ge sar bstan pa'i srung ma rnams: ma rung bdud kyi bla srog chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khra mo gling gi dmag dpon dang: ge sar lha yi chos blon te: bal sras thog rgod ya med yin: de nas byang gi blon po tsho: ma g.yeng bdag la tshur gson dang: rgya stag rang mal 'dzin pa'i dus: wa mos tshur 'gebs a bar rigs: khyung chen nam 'phang gcod pa'i dus: ne les 'phur 'gran a bar rigs: nyi ma'i gling bzhi bskor ba'i dus: me khyer 'od 'gran a bar rig: dam nyams mi byed dgu byed la: rnam shes steng la sa spungs te:'gran med lha yi yang lha ste: sangs rgyas mi yi sha tshugs can: ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul khong: sku mdog dung ri brjid cing mdzes: ya mtshan mdzes sdug 'od du 'baroḥ zab chos ka la piṅga'i glu: 'gro drug byams dang snying 113

rje'i bdag: yon tan mtha' med mkha' dang mnyam: byin rlabs nyi zer kun tu 'phro: phrin las drag po'i thog char gyis: dam nyams 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol: shes sam byang ba klad med tsho: blun po u thug ci byed med: de ring bal sras thog rgod ngas: 'gugs chen gzhu yi yang steng nas: nyag phran sgro bzhi dgra la 'phen: tshur chas wa sdar byang ba rnams:phyi yi rus mkhar thal bar gtor: g.yar ma'i lus phung gyong la skyel:rnam shes stong gzugs nyam re ngoḥ las kyi rlung gis 'ded srid pas:dpa' rtul nga yi phaṭa shar gyis: las rabs rdzogs sam bde ba can:dpal ldan zhing sogs gang 'dems sar: dka' tshags med par 'phangs bas chog: thar ba'i lam gyi dgra bo ste: shul gyi khyim mi bu phrug yin: zhen chags spongs shig byang gi blon: 'chi ba chos nyid zur med yin: mi min khrag ral rgyal po kho: mi 'dod gdon 'dre khog la zhugs:mi sha dmar po'i rtsod gzhi de: mi bsam sa nas btsal nas byung: mi 'gyang byang gi pha jus rnams: mi ngan dpon gyis lag nas nyams: mi sdug las shig mthong nas yongs: mi min pa tsho a bar rig: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: bdud phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: byang mi min gyi blon po gsum gyi nang nas rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod des glu de thos rjes ya kho re gling phrug 114

dpa' 'dod can: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: bre ser 'brong gi tsho sha de: tshos khom 'khyags khom gnyis ka yod: dpa' 'dra gnyis rting ma 'gran pa'i dus: bshad khom 'thab khom gnyis ka yod zer ba'i dpa' rtags ston chog chog yin pas nyon ang zer nas gzhu steng la mda' gcig bzhag nas yin mdog rdzig nyams dang bcas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: srin lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: byang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:'bod zer na dgra srog dmar bo chod: dpa' rting ma lon par thugs rjes gzigs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang mi min dpa' bo'i sa cha nas:dpa' rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod yin: khyod gling sdug mtha' yi 'dre dmag gis: sde don med byang la zor chen 'phangs: dpa' rtsal ldan blon 'ga'i srog la bsgol: skyid zho bzhin chags pa khrag ltar dkrugs: yang mi 'thab ka med byang la byung: khyod gling sdug wa mos kha nang nas: 'bag phar g.yar 'jigs rngams tshur la bstan: ngo tsha rgyu med pa ci go red:'gag 'di 'drar thug pa'i lam so nas: dgra jag lan mi sprod 'dug thabs med: dpung tshur 'gebs yan por mi gtong rgyu: nged ya med byang 115

gi che rtags yin: dpon khrag ral thog mda' ngar ma yis: dgra jo ru brag dkar rtse nas gtoroḥ rigs rgyal sras nyi zla 'od gsal gyis: dpung dpa' rtul mun pa mtha' nas bsal: sgos rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod ngas: rang dgra skal shi lam nag por mngags: rta 'do ba dpa' chas nom la len: yang de nas rma khams gling la 'gro: nom bsags pa'i rgyu rnams byang la len: pho skyes mdog thams cad mda' la 'dren: sman 'brug mo zer ba'i rgyang grags can: lo rgas yang byang la g.yog mor khrid:yid dga' 'am sdug gam gling ba tsho: ngas de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la:dpa' rting ma nyag phran mda' la babs: mtho nam mkha' mi 'gyur dbyings rol nas: mgon srin po lcags ral 'bar ba lags: gzhu mchog dkar yar mchog dkar bo srungs: sa mi 'gyur g.yang gi ra ba nas: lha sman mo rkang 'jibs dmar mo 'bod: gzhu mar mchog 'gugs pa'i rting gnon mdzod: mtshams bar snang 'ja' yi klong dkyil nas:bdud btsan po me 'bar drag po rtsal: gzhu 'chang kha srung la ma g.yel cig: gnas sa gzhi bum pa'i mkhar nang nas: byang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral lags: mda' nyag phran mdel sne 'tsho rogs kyis: da ma thub gling sdug chom la phob: dpa' rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod ngas: mtshan snyan pa kun la khyab par shog: ya kho re bu pho rgod mdog can: khyod 'u 116

gnyis dpa' rtsal 'gran pas dus: rlung bsil ma ma gtogs bar 'bud med: dgung a sngon ma gtogs lta mkhan med: sa dog mo ma gtogs khrag 'thung med: de e bden ltos la mi bden dpyod: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mda' de 'ur sgra thag ger 'phangs pas:bal sras thog rgod ya med kyi dpung g.yas pa'i steng la phogs pa srung ba btsan pas brag la mtheb rdul phog pa ltar ci yang ma gnod: bal sras kyis mda' gcig 'phangs ba de khos phub kyis bkag pas skyon ma byung:gri kha 'gran bzhin pa'i skabs la: bal sras kyi dpung rogs la pā thul sprin tsha gdong dmar dang: mgar ba'i ya med nag po: ri ba'i 'bum thub grags pa: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan: li yi khro mi dpa' bstan rnams thon nas phan tshun ki sgra dang bcas 'khrugs 'khrugs long long gi gnas la gyur ba na: rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod kyis ral gri ngar chen pos klad la bskor nas btab thengs gcig gis li yi khro mi dpa' bstan gyi dpung g.yas nas bla g.yon pa'i bar du gshags nas dgrong: pā thul sprin tsha gdong dmar dang: rtsal ldan dom tsha thog rgod gnyis thug nas gri kha 'gran nas yod par: phar gyi shing gseb nas shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs 117

ldan gyis mda' gcig 'phangs byung ba de: rtsal ldan dom tsha thog rgod kyi ya thod dpral ba'i bzhi mdo la phogs nas bsad: der rtsal ldan shes rab grags pas mthong ba tsam gyis snying la tsher ma zug pa ltar 'chi ba srog la mi 'dzems par shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan gyi gdong la mchong nas khro nyams dang bcas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: mi min byang gi lha tshogs rnams: yod na de ring grogs la byon: rting ma dgra la mi shor dgos: dbyings nas spyan gyis e gzigs lags: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral stobs kyi rgyal po la: rtsal ldan blon po stag gzig yod: grags pa thog pa'i mi gsum yod: rtsal ldan me lha grags pa gcig: rtsal ldan rdo rje grags pa gnyis: rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa gsum: khrag ral mthing mdog nam mkha' la: rtsal ldan nyi zla skar mas bskor: 'dzam gling bod na 'gran ya med: yang rgod dgra snying za mi nga: rtsal ldan shes rab grags pa yin: de nas yang dag don 'bras la: bu mo khrab gyon gling sdug gis:sdar ma'i lag snga byas nas byung: rtsal ldan dom tsha thog rgod khong: rdzong khag dgu las dga' nges yin: mal nyal rmi lam bzhin du dgrong: sha lan sha dmar ma zos na: pho shi yug sa bas kyang sdug: da rung de yi ga la 118

tshad: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod kho: stong bdud sngon nas e shor ltos:'bum pa'i dgra lha rgyang grags can: gyad mi khrag 'thung dgra skal byed:spyi dpon blo med rgas khog kho: gyad mi me rus tshe rnga gcod: khro thung bya mang byi'u snying kho: gyad mi gza' rgod mdung rtser skyon: 'dan ma wa sdar 'jab yu kho: thog lha gshin rje nag pos sgrol: gzhan yang dpa' rtul khyi phrug rnams: re re bzhin du byang bas gsod: mi min byang gi dpa' bo tshos: dpa' gtam sngon la bshad ma myong: lag len rjes nas lus rabs med: mi min byang gi srung ma rnams: de ring rgod po'i ral kha 'tshos: rno gcod mtshon gyi rting ma la: bsdong grogs ma zhan byang gi lha: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan gyis ral gri shubs nas byangs te dgung la 'phyar yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: mthoskudam mkha' yangs ba'i gzhal yas nas: lha gnam the'u dkar bo ra dkar skya: dus de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: mtha' dmag dpung bdud kyi skye rgyud chod: yang bar snang sprin gyi gzhal yas nas: lha bar the'u khra bo ra khra skya:dus de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: mtha' dmag dpung bdud kyi skye 119

rgyud chod: g.yang sa gzhi mi 'gyur rdzong drug nas: lha sa the'u nag po ra nag skya: dus de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: mtha' dmag dpung bdud kyi skye rgyud chod: gnas lhun chags nor bu'i dkyil 'khor nas:shan lcog lha mtshal rtse khros pa rtsal: dus de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon:mtha' dmag dpung bdud kyi skye rgyud chod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na:byang mtha' bdud sprang po'i pha yul de: gnas shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sde hor yul dug gi mtsho mo nas:dpa' dug gi sdong po shan pa dpon: blon dug gi lo 'dab shan tsha 'khrungs: byang mtha' dmag dug gi ngar gyis gsod: nga shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan yin: khong ge sar rgyal po'i spyi blon dang: sgos shan pa rgyal po'i sger blon yin: nga'i rting ma lus la tshang nas gda': rtsal drug gi 'dab ma kun gyis smon: mtho a sngon gnam na nyi zla skar: nga shan tsha byung na 'dar ra ra: sa dog mo'i zur na ri brag mtsho: nga shan tsha byung na sa la snyil: mtshams bar snang khams na g.yu yi 'brug: nga shan tsha byung na gsung skad 'gag: thang bde mo'i dkyil na ma thub dgra: nga shan tsha byung na dran pa 'bor: ya de nas rtsal ldan shes rab grags: khyod a bar rig la snying re rje: 'bu tshe zad 'gro tshod ma zin nas: dgra grog tshang sgo nas sug bzhi 'thor: nang snum zad mar me 'bar zhan 'dra: yun mi ring 120

'od snang dgung la yal: tshe zad kha'i byang phrug dpa' nyams che: nga shan tsha'i sngon nas gces srog shor: da de min byung rgyu ci yang med: dpa' shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan ngas: yang de sngon nyi ma yan chad la: dpa' ma 'thab pa la gcig kyang med: dgra ma sod shor ba ga la yod: dpe bzhag na 'dra things 'ga' re gda': me dmar bo 'bar ba'i ngar lam nas: shing sdong rgan thar sa e 'dug shes: mda' thog dmar 'phen pa'i ngar lam nas: mtho brag dmar brtan sa e 'dug shes: char ser rgod 'beebs pa'i ngar lam nas: mdzes me tog 'khrungs sa e 'dug shes: de zer ba'i gtam la bden lugs gda': nga ya med shan tsha'i ngar lam nas: dgra byang phrug thar sa e 'dug shes: khyod thod pa'i ri mo de ltar babs: yid skyo 'am byang phrug kha ser lags: sems ma rig 'khrul ba'i bdud phrug khyod: drin ma gyur 'gro la gdug rtsub che: las ma dag rang sdug 'khor bar 'khyam: yid rmongs ba'i ngang du mi tshe 'das: rten dal 'byor stong log byed pa sdug: khyod mi lus thengs gcig snyed pa 'di:rten chud zos byas pa tshod med red: sku seng chen bla mar dgra ru bzung:gling dpa' rtul rnams la zhe sdang tshad: dpa' rting ma mi lon sdig bsags 'di: lam thar ba'i sgo kheg ma rtogs med: khyod g.yang gzar brag la ma lceb par: lam bde mo'i thang la phebs rogs zhu: sdug don 121

med dmyal ba mi bsags par: lam yang dag mchog la brtson par zhu:gling ge sar zhabs zhu byed nus na: mthar rigs ldan shan pa la ru 'gro:tshe 'di nas dal 'byor don yod gyur: de'i zhu sna shan tshas byed dang chog:de e dga' bsam blo zhib kyis thongs: yang blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga khod: blo sngon la khed na mkhas pa yin: yid rjes nas 'gyod na a dgos chung: de shes na kha ta pha ma'i tshig: snying dmar bo'i bcud kyi snying gtam yin: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog: ces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag rtsal ldan shes rab grags pas ral gri bton nas khro nyams dang bcas mchong byung bas: phan tshun gri kha 'gran 'go brtsams pa'i tshe: rtsal ldan gyis gri gcig btab pas shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan gyi dpung g.yon pa'i sha 'gyang la gri rmas cung zad byung: de nas shan tsha khros nas phar gri lan mang btab pa'i rjes ma zhig gis rtse sag kho yi brang dkyil du zug nas khrag rlangs 'thibs se bsad: der byang gling gnyis kyis sod sod dang: rgyob rgyob kyi ki bswo ho gsum gyi sgra bcas 'thab nas phan tshun bar la mda' mo ser ra 'bab 'bab: mdung ring skar mda' chad chad: ral gri glog lce 'khyug 'khyug: mi ro bam thang bzo bzo: mi khrag yur chu 'dren 'dren byas pa'i mthar byang dmag rnams kyis 122
