mang sna nyung gis ma rten nas 'ur rdir re phyir bros rgyab pa dang: gling dmag gis kyang dpa' tshod bzung nas phyir cung zad bkyed de bsdad:der byang dmag rnams kyis gling sdug la ci 'dra'i dpung rgod hrag ldan pa 'dug: mi min byang la jus nyes byung nges red ci bya zer nas wa skad shor bar gda' 'o: de'i skabs su shan pa me ru rtse dang: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan bcas kyis chag nyes shor ba'i mi min byang la dmag nyung yang dpa' rtsal rgod tsam 'dug zer zhor la las dmag rnams kyi ro thams cad la la chu la bskur: la la bya khyi'i gzan tu bskyur: la la me la bsregs pa bcas byas nas de nub rang rang gi sgar la log nas dmag ngal gsos par gda':de yang byang sgar nas sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal gyis rgyan babs med cing rang nyid kyis dpa' khas len byas teoḥ go mtshon dgra dar 'tshubs se dpa' chas lus la rdzogs pa zhig byas shing gyi ling rag dkar la chibs nas byang rdzong la gtad nas chas: nyi shar gyi dus su byang mi min brag dmar leb dgu nas skya mi zhig byung ba byang gi so ba rnams kyis mthong nas brda sprad par gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal dang: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gnyis ka gang myur myur ngang rang rang gi rta la chibs nas shar brgyag gis gdong len du chas pa dang: byang gi ar ru g.yu mtsho'i yar mtha': na dmar 123

gong ba zer ba'i sa nas khong rnams thug song bas: dang po gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal gyis yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes noḥ mtsho chung me long 'dra ba'i zur: gling phrug kher 'khyar shi sa red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min khrag ral rgyal gyi blon:gyad chen bzhi yi gdong gral nas: gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal yin: dpa' rgod 'gran bral yongs la grags: pho lo nyi shu rtsa lnga yin: rtsal drug glog la snying khams bdud: sdang dgra'i steng la thog las rgod: nye 'bangs steng la dar las 'jam: yin na a pho de 'dra yin: kho re mi pho rta rag can: mi gcig kher rgod mug snang de: rang srog 'dre yis khyer bar nges: rta gcig rgyugs la byang 'dod de: bang kha rdo la thug par nges: gnam sa'i bar na grags chen bas: ya med gyad mi me ru rtse: go mtshon glog dmar 'tshub la rngams: rting ma dgra la ngoms pa'i dus: gsal byed nyi zla'i gzi mdangs nyams: ri rgyal lhun po 'dar zhing zhig: 'chi bdag nag po phyir bros byed: nga 'dra 'jig rten khams na med: dpa' 'dod snang mtho'i dgra bo rnams: rkang lham yan la mngags ma myong: gling sdug yan por ga la mngags: yang dag gtam gyi 'dra ma la: ngo mtshar glu yi phreng ba 124

las: bshad na lo rgyus mu tig bstar: 'dzam gling yangs ba'i rgyal khams na: mi min byang rje khrag ral rgyal: dgung nas shar ba'i nyi ma 'dra: sa gzhi'i mchogagyur ri dbang lhun: bar snang g.yu 'brug sngon po 'dra: rgya gar stod kyi sa cha na: rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po grags: stong khun tsi na'i yul gru na: rgya nag khrims kyi rgyal po grags: sku rgyal bod kyi sa cha na:bod kyi mes dpon rnam gsum grags: mi min byang gi sa cha na: ya med khrag ral rgyal po grags: de rnams yan la grags chen med: de nas gling sdug tshe zad khyod: rang snang dgung las mtho na yang: byang gi dpa' bor 'gran 'dod 'khrul: srog dmar skyel du yongs ba red: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: ljang mdzes ri rgyal mthon po'i ngor: lug chung zas la gram gram nas: tha ma ri spyang kha la shor: zhim sha skyel du yongs pa 'dra:zer ba'i dpe de bden par nges: sprang sgar mtha' 'dre gling dpung nas:tshe zad mi pho rta rag can: ya med byang gi dmag sngon thon: lus ngag yid gsum phul 'dod dang: skyabs 'jug zhu ba e yin lags: dpa' grogs bdud kyi snying khams can: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring zer: dom nag khrag gi bzi ba 'dra: lan po med pa kun gyis shes: gling sdug srog gi bdag po red: dga' do bsam mam gling sdug blon: gom gang phar la ma bros dang:mi min byang blon dpa' bo gnyis: bros zer skad cha than la brtsi: go na 125

rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling sdug zhe la de ltar zhog: ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du glu lan ci 'dug bsgug pa na:sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal na re: 'o na byang blon dpa' bo gnyis: blun phrug kha che sngo gdong khyod: kha gtam mang la don snying med: pho nga la thug pa ma bzang thal: nga o ral rgyal gyi nang blon la: dpa' 'gran med khe tshe 'brug rgyal grags: dpa' rting ma dgra la ngoms mi yin zer zhing dpa' gtam dang bcas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: dpal g.yung drung bon gyi lha tshogs dang: mchog stag lha me 'bar khros ri bcas: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: dgra ma rung bdud kyi bla srog chod:sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas: mtsho me long 'dra ba'i yar mtha' ste: spang ser bo dar gdan khug pa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sde sog smad mun pa'i gling bran nas: sog o ral rgyal po'i bka' blon la: dpa' 'gran med rgya bod kun la grags: nga sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal yin: ya kho re skyag phrug stong gtam can: gtam de 'dra bshad pa ngo re tsha: khyod stong gtam stong ba'i 'ja' tshon 'dra:dpa' lag len med pa'i snga ltas red: mi sprang por gser khal btsong rgyu 126

med: pho sdar mas dpa' rtags bzhag ni med: byang 'dre rgyal khyi mo skyag thum la: dpa' che brjod bong bu'i gzig spags 'dra: byang mi min bdud rgyal wa mo kho: gling ge sar dpon gyis bsgral 'dren byed: rdzong dngul dkar gter kha gling gis len: rdzong btsan po sa mkhar dpung gis bshig: kho rgyal sras spun gnyis khyi bzhin khrid: gling rta rdzi khyi bskor e lo lta: de ma nyan nyag phran 'ben la 'jog: byang khyi phrug blon po thang gang 'di: ram nag po ser bas brtsem 'dra bzo: sngon gna' mi'i dpe la 'di ltar grags: khyi skyag zan lam nas rgyugs pa de: rdo gor mo phog pa'i sna 'dren 'dra: sprang 'khyar bo'i mug snang mtho ba de: gtam dma' 'bebs 'phya dmod rna la 'ong: dpe de bas bden zhig ga na yod: khyod byang bas tshur 'gebs gling la byas: yang da rung de yi ga la tshad: nged byang gling g.yul 'khrug byung ba 'di: bshad mi dgos blta ba thad shar te:dgra byang ba pham pa'i snga ltas tshang: chab gtsang bo'i rgyud kyi gser mig nga:khyod sbal rgan 'gran pa dgod re spro: shing rgya lcang rtse yi khu byug nga: khyod khā tas 'gran na zhe re khrel: sa spang dkar stod kyi sha pho nga: khyod ra rgan 'gran na yid re rmongs: shar gling dkar yul gyi dpa' rtul la: khyod byang sdug 'gran na gces srog shor: khyod skyid na mgo 'phang yar la bstod: yang min na sdug gtam bshad na chog: dus de ring nyi ma'i 127

gdugs khang la: phyi gzugs gzhi bya khyi'i gzan la 'phen: nang rus pa'i bse mkhar khag bzhi gtor: yul pha ma'i brang khog rnga ltar rdung: de ma byas 'brug rgyal min rtags yin: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' gcig 'phangs pas:gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal gyi snying dkar nag mtshams su thebs shing chu srin dung gis thags pa ltar mi rtag lnga ba'i lam la brdzangs: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gis mthong nas snying la tsher ma zug pa ltar gyur stabs 'chi ba srog la thug na 'gyod pa med pa'i ngang du bstud mar mda' gsum 'phangs pasoḥmada' dang po 'brug rgyal gyi rmog gi pho byang gi steng la phogs kyang mtshon ma song: gnyis pa ring nas ma phog par phar gyi ri rtsib du sa la zug: gsum pa phub kyis bkag pas ci yang ma gnod: de'i tshe sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal gyis myur bar mda' gcig 'phangs pas: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gis myur stabs kyis phub kyis bkag pa chag rtse sil le gtor: de nas so sos ral gri bton nas mchong de gri kha 'gran par byang blon gyi gri ngo ma lon nas rta kha phyir bsgyur nas bros: gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal gyi go khrab rta la bkal nas phyir gling la phebs pa dpa' mo sogs kyis bsus te bzang bstod dpa' dar gnang ngo: der dkyil sgar ge sar gyi 'bum dmag gis 128

mi min byang gi rgyal po'i rtswa ra stong shong gzhung drug gi nang du sgar brgyab cing phan tshun dmag 'khrug med par nyin 'ga' 'das: nyi ma de yi phyir nyin mi min byang gi 'bum dpon shor ba'i 'gyod pa dang bcas blon tshogs rnams kyis chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring 'bum dpon du 'dems byung ba na: khos 'gan mi khur thabs med byung nas rgyal por yar zhu byed du song ba pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong du thon nas rgyal po la gus phyag phul zhing yid skyo bas nyams dang bcas g.yul 'thab dmag nyes shor zhing rting ma ma thob pa'i lo rgyus zhu 'dod kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: mi min byang gi lha rnams 'bod: yag nyes jus la mi gzigs sam: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring yin: gson dang rgyal po rin po che: skyid po'i glu len ma yin te: sdug gi zhu rgyu 'di ltar yod: kha sang nyi ma rtse shar la: gling sdug wa mo'i dpung gral nas: bu mo khrab gyon lte 'u ste: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal khos: byang rdzong rmog gi lcags 'phru bcad: khrab dkar steng gi rgyab dar nogs: gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal khong: ma dbang gling sdug sprin gyis sgrib:blon tshogs sems pa sdug gis mnar: mi dar las kyi mtha' ma ru: seng ge dkar mo'i 'gying 'tshab la: glang rgan las kyis bskos song zer: khra 129

yag gzig gi 'dzum 'tshab la: khyi rgan mi bsdod thabs med zer: khu byug sngon mo'i gsung 'tshab la: khā ta mi grags ka med zer: blon tshogs gros kyi thag bcad de: gnas lugs babs dang mi brtun bsam: ma bsdad rgyal po'i mdun la 'ong: rgyal dbang mi yi nor bu lags: bka' chab dam pa rtsal du gsol: jag dang g.yul gyi 'khrug lugs sogs: ci 'dra byas na bzang rgyu red: rma khams gling gi pha dmag 'di: gzhan pa'i dpung dang mi 'dra lags: dpa' rgod che ba smos ci dgos: rnon po mtshon yang mi 'gro bas: g.yul nyes gnam nag lang lang red: ci byed blo de mi khed do: mda' mtshon dug gi so kha de: brag la dbyug pa rgyab 'dra red: mgyogs pa rlung gi 'khor lo de: g.yag chad la la phud 'dra red: go btsan srung ba'i gur khang de: da lo slog shul ral ral red:mkhas pa gtam gyi tshig mtshon de: mi khrol lce sne dig gis bzung: yul bdag srung ma'i zi ra de: da lo a med lan med red: rting ma lon thabs dka' na yang: srog dmar nyag phran 'phen la 'jog: pha jus mnyam la ma phan cing: 'gyod pa phyi nas med pa byed: e red rgyal po rin po cheoḥgo na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: rgyal po'i thugs la de ltar zhog: ces zhus pa na: mi min khrag ral rgyal pos gtam de thos nas nga 130

rgyal bzod mi thub pa zhig byung zhing phar 'gro tshur 'ong 'ga' byas mthar:chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring khyod bden yang byed thabs gzhan med: 'bum dpon gyi 'gan khyod kyis lon thag chod yin pas nga rgyal po'i yid la 'thad nges yin: khyed cag rnams kyis rdzong btsan bzung la gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal la sha lan re e lon ltos shig gsung nas ja chang gi ston mo rol tshar rjes phyir rdzong btsan du mngags par nyin gsum gyi ring la byang gling gnyis phar dgra tshur 'bud med par dmag ngal gsos:131

le'u drug pa/g.yu lhas bka' bzhin nub rdzong skor/ /gyad mi gza' rgod phyir bros brgyab/ /rtsal ldan dpa' bo mang du shor/ /dpa' 'thab lha min gnas ltar bzos/ /de yang ma mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas ma cig rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: bcu drug rdzogs pa'i sgeg nyams: dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs bzang: sku la mdzes pa'i rgyan cha btags: lag tu rin po che'i gzhong pa dar sna tshogs kyis bkang ba zhig bsnams te 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur 'od gsal ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar phebs nas lung bstan gyi mgur ma 'di gsungs so:na mo mahā ḍākki ye: skyabs dkon mchog gsum por snying nas 'dud:blo legs nyes shan te 'byed rogs zhu: sgos rgyud sde bzhi dang srung ma rnams: yang kha mgon sdong grogs ma g.yel cig: gnas 'di 'dra mi 'gyur sprin gyi klong: 'od 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gdengs khang red: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpal bsam gtan rdo rje g.yu sgron moḥ nga ma rgyud 132

mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo yin: ma 'gro drug sems can thams cad kun: lam 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'gro ba sgrol: sngon dam bca' gnyan po yid la brtan: snyan seng seng len pa ḍā ki'i glu: brda gsang tshig dkar dmar mkha' las 'phyur: ya kho re 'jang phrug g.yu lha bu: thugs ma g.yel snyan gyi dbang po gtod: don chen po'i zhu ba lan gcig gda': khyod g.yu lha'i dgra skal nag po de: sngon las rlung drag po'i lcags kyus drangs:sang nyi mar 'dul ba'i dus la babs: dgung khri gdugs nyi ma shar dang lhanoḥ dmag khra mo'i kha lo g.yul la bsgyur: dpa' rting ma rang lag yod pa soms: nged dkar phyogs lha dang ser bo gnyan: yang sngon po klu dang smug po dmu: dpung 'phru dmar btsan dang khra bo gza': sman ma mo bstan skyong la sogs dang: yul lha chen rma rgyal 'khor dang bcas: khyed kha mgon sdong grogs 'bral med yod: chags bzhag na 'dra ma 'di ltar dgos: ban btsun pa byed la 'dra zhig dgos: byams snying rje med na gos bsgyur tsam: dpon chen po byed la 'dra zhig dgos: blo shes rgya med na stong ming tsam: blon chags chen byed la 'dra zhig dgos: jus gzhung sems med na khog rul red: stag shar ba'i pho bzo mtho zhan 'dra: dgra thad byung ma thub ga ma wa: sman bu mo mdzes sdug ldan zhan 'dra: khog shes rgya med na khrel med bdud: ya de nas 'jang sras mi yi nor: byang mi min 133

bdud kyi grong khyer na: kho ma rung khrag ral mnga' thang che: dpung blon tshogs kha grangs mang zhan 'dra: da ma 'gyang dpa' 'gran rting ma longs: gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'phrin las 'grub: spyir dbu nag bod la gtam rgyud sgrogs: glu de tsho g.yu lha'i thugs la zhog:ces gsung nas ka dag stong ba chen pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar yal lo: nyi ma de yi phyir nyin 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis mdun blon rnams 'du dgos pa'i brda sprod gsung pa na: 'jang phrug rin chen rgyas dpal dang: shel dpal rdo rje gnyis kyis mkhar rnga sing sing rdung pas:mnga' 'og gi dpon mgo thams cad 'dzom byung ba dang: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis zhal 'dzum shigs se dpa' rtul rnams la gzigs nas mi min byang gi nub rdzong 'bebs ran pa sogs lung bstan dus la babs pa gleng 'dod kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: ge sar skyes bu'i lha tshogs rnams: de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: gling dmag 'du ra 'du sa red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ru 'dren dpon po g.yu lha yin: de nas dpa' rtul dpung tshogs rnams: gson dang 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: mi min byang 134

gi nub rdzong de: dpa' rtul dpung gis 'bebs ran gda': rdzong bdag wa blon sdar ma tsho: dmar gsod khrag la sgyur shoms kyis: nged rang gling ba'i las dmag 'dioḥ dpung tsho bzhi ru bsgos nas ni: 'gro lugs bkod sgrig 'di ltar yod: li khri'i g.yung drung 'chi med dang: gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dga' gnyis: 'bum dmag 'phru dkar can gyis bskor:ma 'dug shar nas rting ma longs: zhang zhung stag mo khri brtan dang: sog blon me ru khrag 'thung gnyis: 'bum dmag 'phru ljang dpung gis bskor:mi min lho yi rdzong la gtug: 'dan gyi chos bzang rgyal po dang: sum pa'i stag rgod btsan po gnyis: 'bum dmag 'phru sngon 'bum gyis bskor: ma 'dug nub kyi dgra la gtug: bhe ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang dang: 'jang gi g.yu lha thog 'gyur ngas: 'bum dmag 'phru nag shog dang bcas: mi min byang gi rdzong la gtug: mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug gcig: ya med g.yu 'brug thog rgod gnyis: dpa' lang stong bdud khri brtan gsum:'jang blon kun bzang brtan pa bzhi: phyogs bzhi'i dmag gi rgyab dpung 'tshos: mtha' dmag mi min sprang rdzong 'di: ram nag ser bas bcom ltar bzo: bsags pa'i rgyu nor dpung gis 'phrog: skyes pa'i mi rta khrag la sgyur: rting ma phyi rabs bod la 'jog: e red dpa' rtul dpung gi tshogs: de ring gza' skar dus tshod bzang: rting ma gling la thob par 135

nges: tshe zad byang phrug sdar ma tshos: tshul rgol gling la dgra sna gtad: pha jus shor ba'i snga ltas tshang: da 'dug mi khoms da lta 'gro: mi tshe byang la gzad don med: rdzong drug myur bar dpung gis len: bdud phrug mgo ske breg nas yongs: dkar bo lha yi tshogs dang bcas: gling dkar lha sde'i bu rta skyongs: ser bo gnyan gyi lha tshogs 'bod: mi min byang gi dgra mtha' chod: sngon po klu yi tshogs la 'bod: mi 'dod 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: dmar po btsan gyi lha tshogs 'bod: log rtog ru ṭa'i skye rgyud chod: drang srong lha yi dpung tshogs 'bum: bu rta dar ba'i gling dkar 'tshos: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang thams cad kyis mgrin gcig gis mngon par bstod cing gling gi ru dpon gaums kyis gra sgrigs tshar ba dang dmag tsho bzhi ru bsgos nas nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi phyogs bzhi nas bskor bar brtsams so:der byang dmag rnams kyi dpa' bo khag bzhi la bsgos nas gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa dang: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub gnyis kyis shar sgo bkag: rtsal ldan lcags tsha gdong nag dang: rtsal ldan 'brug rgod 'phru ring gnyis kyis lho sgo bkag: rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung dang:136

rtsal ldan ri tri me 'bar gnyis kyi nub sgo bkag: glog dmar drag rgod ya med dang: rtsal ldan lu chung rtsal bde gnyis kyis byang sgo bkag nas rdzong btsan bzung zhing mda' mtshon gyi so kha phyir bstan nas 'tshub se yod pa dang: de'i tshe nub sgo nas 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' po dang: sum pa'i stag rgod btsan po gnyis kyis 'bum dmag rgya mtsho lud pa ltar du byung bas mda' rgyang gang gi sngon la dpa' bo gnyis thon pa na: byang rdzong nas rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung dang: rtsal ldan ri rmi me 'bar gnyis tshur sngon la bud cing: rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung gis gzhu steng du mda' gcig bzhag nas ya kho re gling sdug ham pa can: srog dmar skyel du 'ong lugs la: ra bzi yin nam smyos pa red zer zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: glu smra brjod tshig sne ma 'grub noḥ ngag snyan 'gyur 'gugs stangs mi 'ong lags: sa gom gsum gom pa ma spos na: khyim sgo them la mo mi brgal to: gtam tshig gsum 'dra dpe ma bkod na: pho thos pa che yang mi go zer: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: thang chen po dzam pa'i thang smad nas: skyid nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas: mtho pho brang stong rdzong g.yu dkris yod: dpa' rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung yin: ya de nas gling phrug sdar ma gnyis: srog dmar po rin 137

thang chung lugs la: sdug chen po'i mnar ba lag pa'i mthil: rdzong chung chung gzhan la 'gro 'gro de: ngan lob pa'i ge sar 'khrul lugs la:dpa' ya med byang gi dngul rdzong 'di: rgya gar nag gnyis la mi dbang ba:sdug mtha' dmag gling la gang nas dbang: dpon khrag ral g.yu 'brug sngon mo la: gong blon po sprin gyi dpung re 'thug: dpung 'bum dmag ser rgod dgra la 'bebs: rtsal thog dmar kha lo gar bsgyur yin: gling nyams chung gdum ra'i ra ba de: char ser than gcig las dgos don med: dpa' bu rta dar ba'i byang yul nas: bu rtsal drug ldan pa'i spyang mo ngas: dpung rtsal chen gling la 'gran pa'i dus: khyod dpa' med gdong 'bud khyi yi bu: srog rta rnga tsam de breg nas 'jog: yang da rung de yi mi tshad pas: dpung 'bum dmag gla ba khrab gyon rnams: gcig mi 'jog rtsad nas phud rgyu yin: kho jo ru btsan po'i btson la 'dzin: dbyar zla gsum mdog ldan me tog de: phyugs rkang bzhi'i ma bos bsod nams red: lho chu 'dzin gseb kyi sbrang char de: bya khu lo'i ma bos bsod nams red: dgra gling gi pha jus gser ral de: nged byang gi ma sgrub bsod nams red: gling dpa' med shi ran thog la babs: byang mnga' thang che nas che bar rgyas: nga rtsal ldan khros pa gshin rje yin: rno dug gri g.yug pa bzlog med yin: don bden min ltad mo 'gram nas gzigs: glu go na 138

rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang mnyam du mda' de me stag 'tshub se 'phangs pa na: 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bos phub kyis bkag nas ci yang ma gnod: yang gcig 'phang ba thung nas sa khug gcig tu lhung song:der 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bo na re: ya byang phrug sdar ma rnga rgyangs can: mda' de 'dra 'phen pa ngo re tsha: jus pha bla btsong ba'i las la ltos: khyod ro rna ro yi ma 'dan na: nyan bsam na chos bzang glu la nyon:khyod ro mig khrag gis ma gab na: lta phod na dpa' bo'i gdong la gzigs zer zhing gzhu steng du mda' gcig bzhag nas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: dkar po lha yi tshogs la 'bod: rmog dkar lha dang 'bral med mdzod: ser bo gnyan gyi tshogs la 'bod: khrab dkar srung ma lha yis mdzod: sngon po klu yi tshogs la 'bod: 'do ba rta yi bang kha 'tshos: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha la: dzam pa'i thang smad ming du grub: rdzong la khu byug mgrin yag zer: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ge sar lha yi bka' blon la: 'dan yul stod kyi sa cha nas: pho brang thog gdugs 'bar ba'i nang: 'dan gyi 139

chos bzang dpa' bo yin: kho re rtsal ldan spyang mo bu: dpa' bo'i glu la tshur gson dang: 'bum dmag dkyil gyi chos bzang ngas: dpa' snying rting ma dgra la ngoms: khyi phrug byang ba phar la zhog: pho rgod zer tshad srog dang bral: e bden da lta gsal nas yongs: yang dag gtam gyi 'dra ma la: bshad na lo rgyus 'di ltar gda': shes med u thug blun po'i dpon:khrag ral rda li rnga rgyangs can: dpa' ngoms zer ba dgod re spro: de sngon nyi ma'i gdong gang la: rting ma gcig kyang blangs ba med: dgra ngo mig gis ma rig pas: ma mthong phag gi stong gtam la: nyan na rna ba tsha rogs red: stag gzig kha sprod dpa' rtul la: wa skyes byang gi do zla dben:rtsal med wa blon khyu gcig nang: yang sdar dpa' med spyang mo khyod: stong gtam rdzun gyi 'khor lo bskor: sha re tsha la snying re rje: mi thub dgra bor tshod nyams te: pham kha rang gi nyo bas rgyu: mi zin 'ja' la lag snyob te:byis blo 'khrul snang ma sad rtags: khyung dkar mdzo yi shed ya la: gtol rgan rog po rmi lam 'khrul: 'do chen rta yi bang ya la: bong tshe ga ma a bar rig: rin chen gser gyi mdog ya la: ra gan bzhag na than la brtsi:ge sar stobs kyi bdag po la: khrag ral 'gran na mug srog shor: sku rje mi yi nyi ma khong: rgyal kun 'dus pa'i 'phrin las ste: bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong: 'das dang ma byon da lta la: bzhugs kun skyes bu'i cho 140

'phrul las: don la dbyer med ngang gis grub: mos pas 'khor ba mtha' la nye: gus pas thar ba rang la dbang: dran pas rigs drug dung nas sprugs: bsam pas log rtog mun pa sel: bsgom pas sku gsum klong du grol: mthong bas ma rig mun pa sel: skyabs su mos na 'di phyi dge: de min dpa' 'thab sdug 'thab na: sngon ma mi ser rta ser can: mar me rlung gis bsad pa bzhin: gces srog mda' yi 'ben la 'jog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs nas mda' de 'phangs pas: rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung gis phub kyis mda' bkag nas ma gnod: der phan tshun bar gri kha ja yun tsam la 'gran kyang pham rgyal ma byung: sum pa'i stag rgod btsan po dang: rtsal ldan ri tri me 'bar gnyis thug nas mdung 'gran pa na: rtsal ldan ri tri me 'bar gyi lcags mdung ring bas stabs kyis phul thengs gsum pa sum pa'i stag rgod btsan po'i khrab kyi shams nas bla g.yas pa'i sha 'gying la phog nas rmas skyon chen po bzos stabs phyir bkyed: 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bo dang: rtsal ldan ri tri me 'bar gnyis thug nas gri kha 'gran par: 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bos ngar chen gyis ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar te lan gnyis g.yug pa'i rjes ma des 141

byang blon gyi sog phrag kha phyes nas bsad: rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung gis gnas tshul de mthong ba tsam gyis 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bo'i mdun la mchong ste khong gnyis ja yun tsam la 'thab 'khrug drag ru byas kyang phan tshun dpa' ngar che bas pham rgyal ma byung ba na: gling dmag gi dkyil nas 'jang phrug thog rgod dpa' lang dang: 'dan gyi rgyal rgod grags pa gnyis kyis mthong nas ral gri shubs nas bton te re re bzhin mchong byung bas: rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung des gri btab nas 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bo'i phub sing sgra dang bcas gtor: yang mda' 'phangs te 'jang phrug thog rgod dpa' lang gi ya thod dpral ba'i gzhi mdor phog nas dgrong: yang skyar mda' gcig 'phangs pas dmag 'phru sngon can mang po g.yas sgril g.yon sgril byas: 'dan gyi rgyal rgod grags pas mthong ste zhe sdang gting nas 'khrugs te myur bar mda' gnyis 'phangs ba kho'i brang dang nu ma'i steng la phog kyang mda' ma song: de'i tshe 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bos mda' lcags ltong ma zhig 'phangs ba rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung gi rta bra nag stong 'khyams kyi gdong lcags la phog pa rgyab nas thon te mi rta gnyis sa la 'gyel: rtsal ldan spyang mo khrag 'thung rkang thang la bros par brtsams kyang: 'dan gyi dpa' bo rnam gnyis kyis rjes bsnyegs nas dang po 'dan gyi rgyal rgod grags pas mda' 'phangs pa 142

kho'i rkang pa g.yas pa'i sha 'gying la phog nas rmas: 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bo sngon la thon nas ral gri shubs nas bton te gsod grab byas pa la: khos skyabs zhu byas nas srog thar la btang de dmag mi gnyis la phyir gling sgar la khrid nas rma bcos byed du bcug: 'dan gyi chos bzang dpa' bos dmag dar bsgrengs te 'bum dmag rgya mtsho kha lud pa ltar shor byung nas g.yul gyi me lce dgung la 'bar skad:der li khri'i g.yung drung 'chi med dang: gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dga' gnyis dmag sngon du mda' rgyang gi thon pa dang: dmag rnams ser ba babs pa ltar du rim bzhin gshar byung ngo:de'i tshe mi min byang gi rdzong nas gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa dang:rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub gnyis gdong la bud par: khong tsho gdung phrad la nye ba'i skabs su: li khri'i g.yung drung 'chi med kyi rta kha 'then zhing yob lang zhig byas nas gzhu steng la mda' bzhag te glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: bon g.yung drung lha tshogs bye ba dang: sde mu stegs ston pa sde tshan dgu: dus de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: yul ma rung bdud dgra 'dul bar shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sde sog yul mun pa'i thang chen nas: dpon stag ral rgyal gyi 143

blon po de: dpung bee thul dmag gi gral ra nas: nga rgod po g.yung drung 'chi med yin: gling ge sar dmag gi rgyal po la: dpa' med nas mgo 'bulam yin de: yid dad pa'i sa bon rgyud la 'khrungs: sems gus pa'i 'bras bu rab tu smin: glu de yan yin lugs 'dra ma la: don yang dag skad cha 'ga' re yod: byang mi min bdud phrug blun rgan khyod:dpa' rgod 'dod stong snang sha re tsha: spang ljang shog g.yu mo'i gzhung drug na: bya rgya khris gshog rtse rlung la 'gran: kho tshe zad byi'u chung dbang med de: 'bod ma dgos mgron po mtshar dga' che: sha zhim po rgya khra'i bsod nams la: sgro spu chung bsil ma rlung la skur: mtho bar snang yangs ba'i zhing khams nas: glag nag po stobs ldan gzan la bcums: tshe yang zad thang gi ri bong de: kho ma bos mgron po mtshar dga' che: sha dmar po glag mo'i kham gang la: lhu drug po go bo'i gzan la bzhag: gling dkar po'i 'bum dpung phyug mo na: nga be thul g.yung drung g.yul ngor slebs: tshe yang zad mtha' 'dre mi min dmag: khyod ma bos mgron po mtshar dga' che: dngul rdzong chen a phos rting mar len: khyod bdud phrug tshe srog rtsad nas gcod: dpa' nga rgod bsam pa'i rgyal khag mngoḥ rgod thag chod gling dkar lha sde red: dpa' rgyal 'dod mi min snying re rje: rtsal gdong gtug byed nyin e rgod shes: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: tshe 144

zad pa'i byang phrug skya gdong khyod: tshe snum zad mar me bzhin du bzo:gson mi yul 'grim 'dod 'khrul ba dngos: ngas gzhu gcig 'gugs pa gnam sa'i khyon: 'phrul mda' gcig 'phen pa gnam lcags thog: yul sa gnam bar na 'gran ya med: mda' 'bum thub glag gi sgro gshog 'dzoms: mtho gnam la 'phangs na sprin sgo phye: dma' sa la 'phangs na ri brag gtor: klung chu la 'phangs na sked nas gcod: sra brag la 'phangs na rmang nas bshig: gling ge sar skyes bu don 'grub kyis: brag dkar po nor bu stong rdzong nas: skus gter nas bton pas mda' mo yin: gling dpa' rtul re la brgyad re gnang: dgra ma thub srog gi gshedam yin: dus de ring khyod la skyes dar 'bul: phyi rus pa'i bse mkhar lhu drug gtor: nang khrag dmar sa la shud se 'phooḥ sems rnam shes bya sgro rlung gis khyer: sdug dmyal bar mi mngags ka med red: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas nyan rjes khrel bgod dang bcas na re: ya kho re li khri'i 'chi med bu: rgod 'dod dpa' gtam 'brug sgra de: pho nga yis nyan na gad mo 'chor: stag zhal mi zan dmar po des: pha sha jo ru'i lag la bzhag: be thul stag mo'i dpung 145

gral de: gcig med rtsa ba gling gis phud: 'bum dmag rgod hrag 'dzom pa de: mal nyal mi lam bzhin du bzos: khyod smyon pa'i kha pho de la stos zer nas yin lugs kyi glu 'di dpa' gtam chu bo drag 'bebs kyi ngag rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral can: gsol ba 'debs so dgra dpung choms: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar 'bod: ma thub gling la ho ma ya: sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs 'bod: rang dpung 'tshos la bu rta skyongs: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: jus dang rting ma'i mgon skyabs mdzod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: thang chen 'o mtsho bar ma red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral rgyal gyi bka' blon de: nub rdzong dpung gi ya bdag la: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa yin: rma bya'i sgro mdongs bum pa'i brgyan: stong skud ca la zhwa yi brgyan: thel smug 'phrug bzang gos kyi brgyan: gyad mi gza' rgod byang gi brgyan: khrag ral dred mong sog dkar gyi: sder bzhi'i rno rtse gza' rgod yin: khrag ral rgya stag dmar po yi: 'dzum drug gra rgyas gza' rgod yin: khrag ral g.yu 'brug sngon mo yi: thog mda' ngar ma gza' rgod yin: brag dmar mtho yang brtan pa med: e bden ltos la mi bden nyon: be thul g.yung drung 'chi med khyod: a bar rig la snying re 146

rje: sog rgyal nam mkha' stag zhal de: khyod rang las kyi rgyal po red:dgra sha jo ru'i lag la bzhag: yang thul drag lha dgu rgyal de: 'dzam gling dpa' bo'i gral gyi rgyan: snying khrag gling sdug dpung gis 'phos: bee thul ngar rgod stag gzig gral: mar me rlung gis bsad 'dra byas: 'bum dmag thang gi rtsi thog de: dmar mo me yis bsregs 'dra byas: sdar ma be thul g.yung drung khyod: dpa' gtam tshig btsan ngo re tsha: pha jus dgra la sbyin pa'i mi: rting ma che tshul yi re mug: pha bla dgra la btsong ba khyod: pho rgod yin mdog ngo re tsha: nag ge khyi dang bee thul gnyis: bdag po su yin pho la 'ju:gra yag wa dang be thul gnyis:dgra med sa nas ki co rgyag:bu mo khrab gyon 'chi med khyod: rmog dkar mi mdzes rna cha mdzes: khrab dkar mi mdzes lwa ring mdzes:'khor gsum mi mdzes 'phang thur mdzes:rno gcod mi mdzes 'o zom mdzes: pho brgya'i sngon nas da rung 'gro: khrel med nag mo las kyang thu: rkang 'dren sog phrug wa skyes khyod: bsam blo sems la ci 'dra yod: ser bo gser dang gza' rgod gnyis: rin thang che ste ngom na chog: 'chi bdag bdud dang gza' rgod gnyis: dpa' rgod che ste bstod na babs: bsil ma rlung dang 'do chen rta: 'gro'i mgyogs tshad de ldan nas gda': de ring rting ma mda' la babs: mda' mo khrag 'thung lcags rtse 'di'i: 'byung g.yar sgyu lus rlung la bskur: rnam shes 147

las 'bras rjes su 'khyam: bsam pa bzhin du 'ong thabs med: e bden ltad mo mthong nas yongs: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs ba dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs ba bee thul g.yung drung 'chi med kyi brang nu ma gnyis kyi mtshams la phog kyang go btsan pas ci yang ma gnod: be thul g.yung drung 'chi med kyis kyang mda' de 'phangs bsoḥ gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas phub kyis bkag: slar yang khong gnyis kyis ja yun tsam la mdung kha 'gran pas pham rgyal ci yang ma byung: mthar gri kha 'gran pa na: bee thul g.yung drung 'chi med kyis ral gri ngar chen pos klad la bskor te lan gsum btab pa'i rjes ma gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa'i rta yi ske la thebs nas bsad pas kho rkang thang la phyir rdzong du bros: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub dang: gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dga' gnyis thug pas: dang po rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub kyis dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lha lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: nor rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:dus de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: sde gling sdug srog rtsa dmar po chod:sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: thang 148

chen po 'o mtsho bar ma red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po yi: blon pho brgya'i nang gi gtso bo de: nga rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub yin: khyod gling sdug tshe zad rta khra can: mgyogs sgas khra'i bang kha rlung la 'gran: pho khyod la dpa' ming ji skad zer: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: bu nga la thug pa ma bzang thal: mtho gangs dkar rtse yi seng chung nga: dgra bu yug 'tshub kyang skrag ma myong:rdzong btsan po'i nang gi dpa' bo nga: dpung g.yul 'khrug las la spag don med: khyod dpa' med gling sdug dpung mang yang: nged byang ba lag sdig ma gtogs med: ngas gri gcig mi g.yug lag tshod 'dzin: khyod sdar ma'i re ba mda' la che: gri thung g.yug mi min byang gi lugs: mda' rgyang 'phen sdar ma gling gi dpe: ngas de ring khyod la 'dems tshod sbyin:mda' khyod kyis 'phong dang ngas kyang 'phen: khyod don lnga snod drug gting nas gtibs: snying dmar po'i khang bzang rtse nas bshig: sha mchin pa'i rdzo ri sked nas gtor: mgo rmog dkar dar 'phru sha le gcig: rgyab khrab dkar a long shigs se gnyis: rta 'do ba sga srab nyi le gsum: bu dpa' po'i rting ma'i rgyan la len: byang mi min zer nas smon pa gcig: mtha' gling sdug zer nas 'phung le gnyis: dpa' g.yul 'thab zer nas grags le gsum: de mi nus 'jog srol ga la yod: dpa' 'gran 'dod tshur 149

yong rta khra can: tshe zad nas bros sa med pa khyod: dgra 'chi bdag zhags pas bkug pa red: khyod a bar rig la sha re tsha: g.yul ma bkyes sngon la brgyal la khad: g.yul bkyes na rta yang mi thub nges: dus de ring btang snyoms byed rgyu med: lus sgyu ma'i phung po rin thang can: byang ri khyi dgyes pa'i gzan la 'phen: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces smras nas mda' de 'phangs byung bas: gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dgas phub kyis bkag kyang mda' skyen stabs sing sgra tha re gtor nas lag g.yon pa'i mchan bar nas phyir bud song: der gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dga' na re: kho re mi min byang gi bu: mda' de 'dra bu mo'i 'phang thur 'dra: dpa' sdang ba'i dgra la 'gro ba min zer zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: ge sar skyes bu'i lha tshogs rnams: ma g.yel dpa' bo'i kha mgon mdzod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: shar phyogs 'o mtsho bar ma red:nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ge sar skyes bu'i bka' blon te: gnam lcags 'gyur med chos dga' yin: mgo la gyon pa'i rmog dkar 'di: li rmog smug po gling brgyad zer: dar 'phru khra bo bsgron yag 'di: shar gling 150

dmag gi cha lugs yin: rgyab la gyon pa'i khrab dkar 'di: li khrab rdo rje dgu bsgrigs zer: rgyab dar khra bo rlung gis bskyod: dpa' bo rang gi cha lugs yin: g.yas la btags pa'i mda' mo'i dung: gzig shubs thig le rang 'phro zer: g.yon la btags pa'i gzhu mo'i dung: stag shubs 'dzum chen dmar ser zer: sked la btags pa'i ral gri 'di: btab chod gshin rje so nag zer: mdung mo dar gyis rgyan pa 'di: rno gcod ba dan rtse dgu zer: g.yon la btags pa'i phub mo 'di: rno lcags stag gdong khros yag zer: gru la bskon pa'i sbrul zhags dang: 'khor gsum dgra dar 'tshub la rngams: la mo lab tse brgyan 'dra byas: su ma yin gyis 'gran 'dod 'khrul: de nas byang phrug rang snang can: gnam lcags thog mda' grags che yang: 'chi med rlung la 'gro ba min: bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba de: 'byung ba chu la 'gro ba min: btsan dug ha la'i nus pa de: sgro mdongs rma byar 'gro ba min: byang phrug stong snang che na yang: ya med gling la 'gro ba min: da rung de yi ga la tshad: gling dkar skyid la gnas pa'i dus: mi min byang gis tshur 'gebs byas: ma byas tshod med byang sdug tshos: bsam blo ma btang las shig 'dra: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: ban btsun snang ba mtho na yang: ma bzod sdom dang dam tshig nyams: rta rgod chas kyis gsos na yang: byang mtha' gcod dus thang 151

la 'gyel: snying brtse grogs la che ba yang: g.yo rgyu'i mun pa 'thub nas byung: zer ba'i gtam de 'dra re chags: byang sdug gling la brnyas che ba:mtha' ma pha jus 'chor nges yin: gling dmag byang la yong ba 'di: khrag ral chom la 'bebs 'dod gcig: gong blon mgo ske 'breg shom gnyis:'bum dmag shul med gting brlag gsum: dngul rdzong bdag tu thob pa bzhi: ma byas phyir lam snyeg bsam med: lha chen tshangs pa dkar po'i sde:lha dmag bu yug 'tshub 'tshub kyis: dam nyams dgra srog dmar po chod:rting ma a phor che bar shog: gnyan chen sku lha ser po'i rgyal: gnyan dmag rlung dmar g.yug g.yug gyis: ma thub dgra la ho ma ya: klu rgyal gtsug na sngon po'i sde: klu dmag glog zhags mched mched kyis: log rtog ri ṭa'i skye rgyud chod: lha klu gnyan gyi mthu stobs dang: chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthu yis: sdang dgra phye mar brlag nas kyang: rting ma dgung las mtho bar shog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces smras pa dang: gzhu steng gi mda' gcig po 'phangs ba: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub kyi go btsan pas ci yang ma gnod: de nas ral kha ja yun la 'gran par pham rgyal ma khor: gling dmag rnams kyis ki sgra dang bcas te dpa' 'thab byas: khos gri 'phyar nas the tshom ci yang 152

med par gling dmag gi nang du shor te 'phar bas ra khyu dkrugs pa bzhin du 'phru dkar can brgya phrag shi rmas btang: rin chen stong lha 'od dkar dang: ya med nyi shar rgod po gnyis kyis gdong bkags te gri kha 'gran par: khos gri g.yug nas rin chen stong lha 'od dkar dgrong: ya med nyi shar rgod pos myur du mda' gzhu blangs nas snga zhugs su mda' mang du 'phangs ba kho yi dpung g.yas g.yon brang sogs la thebs kyang mtshon ma song: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub shin tu khros nas ral gri klad la 'phyar te mchong byung ba dang: ya med nyi shar rgod pos 'gran ya mi pher pa shes nas bros: khos gri btab nas dmag mi mang du khrag la bsgyur 'dug pas gdong la mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug thon nas mda' ltong sprad de yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu pha rgyud nam mkha' stong ba'i glu: ngas stong ba'i glu zhig mi len te: mtho nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral ba'i glu: yang ma rgyud chu bo gzhung 'byams gluoḥ de 'byams pa'i glu zhig mi len te: chab chu bo rgyun chad med pa'i glu: yang rang rgyud rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor glu: rtsa 'phrul ba'i glu zhig mi len te: lus rtsa la 'gag pa med pas glu: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: gnas shar phyogs 'o mtsho bar ma red: pho nga 'dra nga 153

ngo ma shes noḥ sras g.yu lha thog 'gyur sger blon nga: 'jang mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug yin: dpa' stag snying stag mo rang la 'dzoms: lha bla ma dkor 'dod che grags na: shi dmyal ba skye ba'i snga ltas tshang: pho dpa' med mug snang che grags na: dpa' rting ma dgra la shor ltas red: dbyar zla gsum ljon shing lo ma de: dgun 'chag rom klong na nyam re nga: dpyid gsar ba'i ug chos me tog te: dbyar nyi bzang shar dus dgung la yal:byang mi min yul gyi dpa' bo rnams: g.yul gnam nag 'khrug dus bag la zha: rdzong gad pa skya bor srog dmar 'gebs: jag so ba mo sman g.yog po mngags: kha zas zhim dro ba med do zer: a shi re byang ba snying re rje:khyod gsang tshig khog la mi sbas par: kha srog skyobs byas na mi dga' 'am:'jang mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug ngas: go sngon po gsum gyi gral zhig bsgrigs: brgyan dmar po gsum gyi spes shig dag: mdog ser bo gsum gyi dpal zhig tshang: mdzes ljang gu gsum gyi mthu zhig ldan: mtha' nag po gsum gyi dpa' zhig bskyed: don dkar po gsum gyi lhun zhig gruboḥbargyan khra khra gsum gyi las zhig 'dzoms: 'dzoms zer na smon lam dus su smin: ya de nas bdud phrug kha ser khyod: mda' nyag phran gcig gi ngar la 'dren: brang rus pa'i rgya sgo har se phye: sha rus pa'i khang chung tshub se gtor: snying dmar po'i khrag rgyun sa la 'pho: ngas ma thub bzhag na 154

dpa' bo min: mgo rmog dkar khrab dang 'khor gsum bcas: rta 'do ba sga srab cha tshang rnams: nga dpa' rgod rting ma'i brgyan la len: gling dkar po zer nas grags ni zhig: byang mi min zer nas skyo ba zhig:dpon ge sar zer nas smon pa zhig: byang khrag ral zer nas 'phya ba zhig:dpung dpa' rtul zer nas skrag ni zhig: sde byang blon zer na khrel ni zhig:byed nges pas dpa' bo thon nas yod: 'dra bsam na ma 'dug gdong la gcor: rtsal spyang grung thengs gcig 'gran na bsam: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung zhing dang po su yin gyi glu lan zhig 'dug na nyan: de nas mda' gcig gis sne la 'dren par sla bsam de rta kha cung tsam 'then zhing bsgug nas bsdad: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub kyis ya kho re gling ba rta sngon can: kha stong gtam de 'dra ngo re tsha: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po dang: 'gag mo'i ab 'chan jo ru gnyis: 'dra do zer ba dgra la bsgyur: gtam de 'dra bshad pa'i chad pa la: srog dmar po shi lam sdug la 'dren zer nas dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: nam mkha' stong ba'i gur khang nas: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral 'bod: bar snang sprin 155

gyi gdengs khang nas: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar 'bod: sa gzhi g.yang gi ra ba nas: gnas bdag sman mo rkang 'jibs 'bod: rdzong btsan gter gyi ri bo nas: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:byang yul po ti sham yag zhes: thang chen brtsegs rim gong ma ru: pho brang nyi shar stong rdzong nas: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub yin: khrag ral rgyal gyi bka' yi blon: rtsal ldan dpung gi gral 'dzin yin: kho re mi pho dpa' gtam can: mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug gam: khyi phrug skyag lang khrab gyon khyod: stong gtam skyag lab sha re tsha: 'jang yul mtshal ra sgrug po nas: sa dam stobs kyi rgyal po des: 'bangs sde bu sdug bzhin du bskyangs: dgra la rting ma mang du blangs: dpon sems blon la che na yang:blon ngan mi nyag dbang phyug gis: dgra sha jo rus lag la bzhag: pha jus btsong nas blon la thon: dgra la zhabs phyi sgrub le de: yin mdog kha pho che rgyu med: dpa' med bu mo khrab gyon de: g.yul ngor zhugs na rta las lhung:shes med blun po'i mkhas mdog de: gal la thug na skug pa 'dra: khebs rgya che ba a sngon gnam: nam mkha'i gdugs dkar mu mtha' bral: rgya khyon che ba dog mo sa: dog mo sa la pha mtha' med: dpa' rtsal che ba mi min byang: mi min byang la 'gran ya med: ri rgyal 'bum gyi rtse mo na:156

gangs dkar lhun po brjid re che: g.yang gzar 'gag gi ra ba na: sra brtan brag dmar dbu 'phang mtho: bdud dmag dpung gi gzhi dkyil na:mi min byang gi dpa' rtsal dar: mi dar las kyi mtha' ma la: gling sdar wa mos g.yo rgyu yis: khrab gyon dpa' bo 'ga' re dgrong: mi khro ka med byang la byung: khrag ral khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'od: jo ru ba mo'i gnya' la phyi:sras gnyis zla gsal snang bas gter: gling phrug nyi dga'i snying la gzen:thog 'brug glog gi me chen 'bar: gling sdug brag ri khag bzhir 'thor:dug chu stag gzig kha sprod rgod: dpa' rtul wa mo'i rnga ma rgyangs: rtsal ldan dpung gi rlung nag 'tshub: mtha' dmag shog skya rang dbang med:'bum dmag ser rgod drag char babs: gling sdug ram nag sha re tsha:dpa' tshod ma zin mtha' ma 'gyod: rgod mtha' rlung la bskur ro zer:de nas gling phrug sngon po skya: tshur 'gebs thab chags khyod la med:mda' gcig 'phen pa'i ngar la 'dren: ge sar ram te bsgug nas 'dug: dpa' rtul ra mda' e yongs lta: shi gson dar gyi yol ba la:mngon lkog e thub shes nas yongs: ma bros ma bros pha yi bu: rlung gshog rgyugs pa'i rta pho 'dis: bsil ma rlung la bros dbang med: rtsal ldan dpa' rung stag mo ngas: gling phrug 'do ba'i sug bzhi breg: dpa' bo da mchong rtsal ldan bu: 'chi bdag las la chas pa 'dra: mgyogs pa da 157

rgyugs rlung gshog rta: byang stod dgun rlung rgyu rgyu gyis: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyamatwa mda' 'phangs ba shud sgra dang bcas: mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug gi brang la thebs kyang mda' ma song:de'i tshe mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug shin tu khros nas myur du mda' gcig 'phangs ba de: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub kyis nam mkha' nas spar 'dzin byas de bcag: mi nyag chos kyi dbang rgyug gis mda' gser ldong ma zhig 'phangs mod kho rtsal chen g.yas la 'gyur nas ma phogs kyang rgyab phyogs kyi dmag 'phru dkar can brgyad dgu zhig bsad: ral kha 'gran par pham rgyal ma byung: gling ba rnams kyis mda' gri mdung sogs ci phogs ci nus byas rung go btsan pas brag la mtheb rdul phogs pa bzhin ci yang ma gnod kyang mthar mang sna nyung gis ma rten nas phyir rdzong la bros song ngo:gling dmag rnams chu sna rdol ba ltar rdzong la gcar nas thon par gda': de'i tshe zhang zhung stag mo khri brtan dang: sog blon me ru khrag 'thung gnyis kyis dmag sna drangs nas mda' rgyang gi sngon la thon par:mi min gyi rdzong btsan nas rtsal ldan lcags tsha gdong nag dang: rtsal ldan 'brug rgod 'phru ring gnyis go gyon mtshon thog gis dmag sngon la brgyugs 158

yong nas sngon bkag pas: gling dmag gi ru 'dren gnyis kyi nang nas zhang zhung stag mo khri brtan gyis khong mthong ste rta kha 'then nas gzhu steng la mda' gcig bzhag te yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: g.yang g.yung drung bon gyi lha tshogs dang: gling ge sar skyes bu'i srung ma rnams: dus de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: nga'i 'thab pa'i dgra bo'i mgo ske chod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: nga'i nye mo mig gis ma mthong de: thag ring bo rna bas thos skad la: byang 'o mtsho dga' ba'i mda' ra red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang zhang zhung rgyal gyi mdun blon nga: dpa' stag mo khri bstan ming du 'bod: chos sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mi yin: sde nag phyogs rtsad nas gcod mi yin: ya de nas byang blon wa mo gnyis: yang sgos su mi pho rta ser can: khyod nyon dang gnas lugs 'dra ma yod: dus da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrug 'di: dgung gnam nag rmag gis bzung ba 'dra: mjug rting ma zer ba'i don chen te:yin nges pas gtam la rtsod rgyu med: gling ge sar mthing sngon nam mkha' loḥ bu rtse rgod nyi ma 'od re che: sras dgra lha dung lha'i zer mdangs gsal: blon nyi 'bum skar chen mtha' nas rgyas: rgod dpa' rtul skar tshogs dpung re bkrag: byang mun pa'i dpung 'di a bar rig: skya sa le 159

nam mtha' gsal rgyu red: dpon ge sar lho sprin dpung re 'thug: bu rtse rgod g.yu 'brug skad grags che: khong dgra lha thog mda' ngar ma la:g.yu'i ral ba nyi 'bum ljang se gsal: blon dpa' rtul ser rgod dpung bkrag gis: byang brag dkar dpung 'di a bar rig: mtho rtse bshig chag hrul bzo rgyu red: khyi skyag zan mche ba rno na yang: mdzes gra yag gzig la 'gran rgyu med: byang mi min wa mo u thug rnams: nged gling la 'gran pa ma bzang thal: skyid pha jus gser gyi me tog te: da ma dbang dgra la shor rtags red: steng lha la 'dres na bka' chad 'bebs: gong dpon la 'gal na khrims la sbyor: sdug 'dre la gnod na god kha lang: de khyod rang bshad pa los re bden: dpa' med pa'i mi min skyag phrug tsho: don med par gling la dmag rgod phab: dpon ge sar mi khro ka med byung: bdud khrag ral srog rtsa rtsad nas gcod: nged dpa' rtul mchong shog mi dgos te: byang mi min wa srog mda' la 'dren: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: ban chung chung dgon du ma bzhugs na: grong srang la 'khyam na sdom pa shor: bu chung chung rdzong du ma bzhugs na: jag g.yul la chas na srog dang bral: sman chung chung khyim du ma bzhugs na: gtam mi kha'i mda' mo phog nyen che: de zer ba'i gtam la nor ba med: khyod byang phrug sdug tshod ma zin na: lus lhu drug mda' yi 'ben la 'jog: dpon khrag 160

ral blun po u thug la: gong blon po dpa' med rang snang mtho: 'og sde ba don med dmag la bskul: de'i tha ma pha jus gling gis 'phrog: bya rjes nas 'gyod kyang phan pa med: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang rtsal ldan lcags tsha gdong nag gi skad cha rnams thos pas tshig pa gting nas zos te dug sbrul la tsher lcag brabs pa bzhin shin tu khros shing sdang mig bsgrad: so sgra gro yos brngo brngo byas te gzhu steng la mda' gcig bzhag nas glu 'di ngar chen khro chu'i 'ur chen la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:mkhyen gzigs dpa' bo'i gdong grogs mdzod: bsam pa thams cad 'grub par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: lho phyogs 'o mtsho'i yar thang red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khra glag spyang gsum lus la tshang: snying khams rting ma dus gcig 'dzoms: rtsal ldan lcags tsha gdong nag yin: 'dzam gling bod kyi sa cha na: lcags tsha thog pa gcig las med: stong 'cham rta pho de las gang: rno gcod hub pa leb chen tsam: dpa' rtags g.yu 'brug skad bzhin ldir: rtsal ldan 161

lcags tsha gdong nag nga: 'dab gshog ldan pa'i khyung chen yin: ru thur rgyas pa'i 'brong mo yin: 'dzum drug rgyas pa'i stag mo yin: dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i byang blon yin: gser mig rgyas pa'i nya mo khyod: mtsho mtha' skor tshod ma zin na: sram chung lcags tsha slebs nas yod: 'dab gshog thogs pa'i byi'u chung khyod: bar snang 'phur tshod ma zin na: rgya khra lcags tsha slebs nas yod: rma yul gling gi sdar ma khyod: rgyal khams dkrugs tshod ma zin na: 'chi bdag lcags tsha slebs nas yod: a sngon gnam gyi lho sprin de: lcags tsha byung na dgung la yal: dog mo sa gzhi ri brag de:lcags tsha byung na 'dar nas zhig: g.yang gzar brag gi babs chu de:lcags tsha byung na sked nas chad: yin na dpa' bo de 'dra yin: ci ma yin la 'gran 'dod 'khrul: byang gling gnyis na 'brug ltar grags: gnam sa'i bar na nga 'dra dkon: snying khams stobs dang rtsal la dbang: thabs dang bkod pa nga la bzang: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: khrag ral rgyal po man chad dang: rta rdzi rgan gzhon yan chad kyi: ma shes blo 'dri byed sa yin: ma thub dgra bo byung ba'i dus: dpa' dang rting ma rang dbang mnga': rang bstod ras ma'i bu bstod min:da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la:gdon 'dre snying zhugs gling ba tshos:don med byang la tshur 'gebs 'di:mi min byang gi dpa' bo tshos: lag sdig ma gtogs ci yang med: de nas 162

dpa' med sdar ma gson: zhang blon stag mo khri bstan khyod: a bar rig la snying re rje: zhang zhung lhun grub grags pa de: gsod mi byang gi dpa' bo min: ya med brag ra rgod ldem de: mi min byang gis bsgral ba min: pha jus 'phrog mi byang ba min: byang la rtsod don ci zhig yin: dgra sha gling la mi rtsod par: byang la dmag rgol ci zhig bsamoḥ wa mo ri rtsib 'grim pa khyod: stag ming btags na yi re mug: de ring gson la mngags bsam med: sprin dkar rlung gis gtor ba bzhin: snying gi dkyil la ho ma ya:mchin pa'i zur nas bud le byed: rnam shes bya sgro rlung khyer te: gar 'gro cha med yul du gtong: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: zhang blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de ngar gyis 'phangs pas: zhang zhung stag mo khri bstan gyis phub kyis bkag nas ci yang ma gnod: der zhang zhung stag mo khri bstan gyis mda' de byang blon gyi ya thod dpral ba'i bzhi mdo la phog nas bsad: rtsal ldan 'brug rgod 'phru ring dang: sog blon me ru khrag 'thung gnyis thug nas glu len ngag 'gugs ci yang med par dang po rang rang gis mda' re 'phangs pa phan tshun la phog na yang so sor mda' ma song: gri kha 'gran nas dpa' 'dra mnyam du gnas tshe: zhang zhung stag mo khri bstan gyis mthong nas mchong byung bas:163

rtsal ldan 'brug rgod 'phru ring gi sems la: gling sdug mi pho gcig la'ang ci 'dra skyon chen po 'dug: mang po'i dpung rub brgyab na rting ma mi lon bsam zhing rta kha bsgyur nas dmag khrod du shor grab byas pas: sog blon me ru khrag 'thung gis myur bar mthong zhing zhags pa gcig 'phangs ba kho yi ske la bskon nas rta las lhung: kho myur stabs kyis yar lang nas zhags pa la gri mang du btab pa ma chod: dpa' rtul gnyis kyis kho phyi bkyigs a long bskor 'dra: nang bkyigs gru gu 'dra ba zhig byas nas bzung: de nas gling ba rnams ki sgra ldir re rdzong la shor bar brtsams so:164

le'u bdun pa/glog dmar drag rgod g.yu lhas bsgral/ /sgye sras khros te rtsal bde bsad/ /'dan gyi chos bzang zhing khams brjes/ / nub rdzong khra mo gling la thob/ /der byang phyogs nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur dang: sgye ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang gnyis 'bum dmag gi sngon du thon par: mi min gyi byang rdzong nas glog dmar drag rgod ya med dang: rtsal ldan lu chung rtsal bde gnyis kyis rmog gi 'dab ra phab: khrab kyi rgyun thag bsdams: 'do ba'i glo len 'then zhing rdzong sgo la tshur bud de phan tshun skad cha thos pas sa mtshams nas yin lugs dang dpa' gtam brjod pa'i glu 'di srin po khros pa'i gad rgyangs la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: sde byang gi lha mchog lcags ral can: rmog dkar po'i rtse dang 'bral med mdzod: lha bdud btsan me 'bar nag por 'bod: khrab dkar po'i rgyun thag sra bar shog: sa'i sman mo rkang 'jibs mthu mo che: rta 'do ba'i bang kha rlung la 165

bcol:dzogayang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: byang rang dpung bu rta'i kha 'dzin mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mthing nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: byang sgo chen padma lha thang red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:rje ya med khrag ral rgyal po la: gong blon po thog 'brug glog gsum srid:bu thog lha gshin rje nag po dang: dpa' 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod gnyis: nga glog dmar drag rgod ya med gsum: dpa' pho rgod gzhon nu mtshar gsum grags: rta mgyogs pa'i bang kha tshad gcig 'jog: yin nges pa'i bu zhig yin no bsam: byang rgyal po'i jus la blo rtse dkar: pho dpyod chen bu la nga 'dra med: nga lo brgyad lon pa'i dus tshod la: byang mi min mthing dang lan gcig 'khrug: kho drag rtsal zla ba gdong sngon gyis:mda' 'phangs na 'gran ya med pa'i zer: mtheb skyen po'i mda' rtsal thengs cig 'gran: mda' nyag phran mthing gi yul la 'phangs: mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i bla ri de: gtor zer na sa nag thang la bsgyur: mthing rgyal blon skrag nas dpa' rtsal 'khum: g.yul drag po 'thab pa'i spobs pa zhu: nga yin na dpa' bo de 'dra yin: gtam bden pa rdo thog yi ge yin:khyod sdar ma sdar chu blud pa min: sra rdo rje'i brag la 'pho 'gyur med: nga dpa' bo'i gtan gzhi brag dang 'dra: mtho nam mkha'i glog zhags 'tshub la rngams: nga dpa' bo'i rtsal drug glog dang 'dra: gcan stag mo'i 'dzum 166

drug dgra la ngoms: nga dpa' bo'i snying khams stag dang 'dra: byang mi min rgyal po'i thugs rtsis che: dpung 'bum dmag nang gi snyan grags 'bar: bu dpa' bo'i nang gi yang rgod yin: khyod 'chi bas bkug pas rta sngon can: tshe sngon las nag po bsgyur thabs med: khyod mun nag phyi mar 'grim pas dus: lha bla ma ge sar gar song med: mgon yi dam khro bo'i ga la skyobs: ma mkha' 'gro zer ba rang 'dod red: shi dmyal ba tsha grang khyod kyis myong: sdig rang gis bsags pa rang la gnod: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yan len med: khyod gling sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces smras nas mda' de 'phangs pas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis bar snang nas spar gyis bzung ba mda' sked nas bcags shing sar 'phangs: rta 'do ba'i gong nas g.yas 'gyur cig byas te yob snga sor rgyangs nas na re: 'o na byang phrug rta dmar can: glog dmar drag rgod ya med lags: bshad bshad gtam gtam skad cha rnams: mi bden khā ta'i ag 'gyur 'dra zer zhing mda' ltong sprad de dpa' gtam brjod pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: lan gsum lha la ma bos na: nam sgos dus la e gzigs bsam: de ring dpa' bo'i 167

grogs la byon: rting ma ri las mtho bar shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:nye mo mig gis ma rig de: ring po rna bas thos tshod la: byang sdug wa mo'i gab ra ste: nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: byang sgo padma lha thang red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: 'jang yul mtshar ra smug po nas: 'bum tsho dmag gi dpon po ste: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur yin: ru bzhi'i dmag gi ru gtso yin: kho re ma rung bdud kyi bu: gson dang 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: ge sar mi yi nyi ma de: sangs rgyas stong gi sgyu 'phrul dang:rigs gsum mgon gyi rnam sprul red: bdud dgra 'dul bar lha nas bskos: smon log bstan bshig phung sri'i tshogs: rtsad med ming stong bsgyur bas phyir: chibs kha mi min byang la bskor: g.yul 'gyed dmag gi bca' lag 'dzoms: khyad par sku rje bla ma khong: mi mthun 'gal rkyen g.yul las rgyal: sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba: nyag gcig sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs: gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' ba: zab don chos kyi sgra chen sgrogs: thugs la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba: kun tu bzang dang dbyer ba med: rgyal po yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa: gser khrir bajid kyang rngams par bzhugs: drag pos 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis: dgra 'dul las kyi rting ma che: 'dzam gling bod la 'brug ltar grags: de 'dra dpon gyi bka' blon nga: dpa' bo g.yu lha thog 'gyur zhes: sdang ba'i dgra sde cham 168

la 'bebs: phyogs kyi nor g.yang bod la len: phyag rdzogs bstan pa 'gro la spel: ma rig 'khrul ba'i lam ston yin: dag pa mkha' 'gro'i sa mkhan yin: bde chen zhing gi bsu ma yin: ma skrag ma 'jigs byang gi blon: khyod kyis bshad pa de ring bden: de snga tshe tshad ma rdzogs nas:mda' 'phen gzhu 'gugs gang byas kyang: de la nga rgyal byed rgyu med:'chi bdag g.yu lha'i kha sngon nas: 'gran med glog dmar drag rgod khyod:de ring thar ba thob pa min: kha chems yod na la mo zhog: re zhu yod na slod pas chog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:byang blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs ba na: khos rtsal chen spar 'dzin ma thub pas khar: dkar phyogs skyong bas lha klu sde brgyad pos rbad mnan bsad gsum gyi las byed pa dus dang 'phrad de:bdud phrug kho 'dul ba'i dus la babs te snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phog pa chu srin dung gis thags pa ltar srog dang bral: rnam shes btsan thabs kyis lho dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing la spar ro: rtsal ldan lu chung rtsal bde dang: ste ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang gnyis thug par: dang po rtsal ldan lu chung rtsal bdes gzhu steng du mda' gcig bzhag nas yin lugs sogs dpa' gtam dang bcas glu 'di ltar blangs so:169

glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu yi/ la la mo a la len: byang mi min bdud kyi srung ma rnams: dus de ring dpa' bo'i gdong grogs mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: nub rdzong chen khu byug mgrin yag gi: byang padma lha thang ya gong red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpa' rtsal ldan lu chung rtsal bde yin: nga phra men bdud kyi bla bu yin: skyen zer na mtheb rtsal mda' la mkhas: sra brag la 'phangs na thar se gtor: dgung gnam lcags thog mda' babs pa 'dra: nags stug por 'phangs na 'ur se 'bar: rdzas zhun mar me dang 'phrad pa 'dra: sdang dgra la 'phangs na srog dang bral: dgra 'chi bdag kha la shor ba 'dra: ya de nas gling phrug sdar lu khyod: sems snang ba a sngon dgung las mtho: kha tshig btsan dug gi tsher ma 'dra: don lag la bzhag na dka' bar nges: kho ge sar zer ba'i rgyang grags can: 'gram gcar na gad nag khung la gab: gling dpa' rtul zer ba'i pho bzo can: dpa' gdong gtug rgyab na spyang 'thab byed:sde sge ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang khyod: ngo tsha rgyu med pa'i khyi rgan bzhin:gdong dred spags gyon nas dmag la thon: skye pho brgya'i nang gi blud la babs: sman mo brgya'i nang gi yos la bsngo: khyod mi bsdod brag las lceb na dga': sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: drin pha mar gsod pa'i dgra bo la: dpa' snying med sdar mas yid sems gtod: grogs na zla 170

gtor ba'i gte bo la: drin mi shes khrel mas blo rtse gtod: nad bzhi brgya bskyed pa'i chang rag la: blo klad chung blun pos phug mdun gtod: de zer yang zer la bden yang bden: khyod bhe ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang zhes: mi ngan pa'i byed las nag po de: stong rgya sde'i kha na 'u ru ru: gong dpon lu gser gyi nyi ma de: sde gling sdug 'dre yi kha la brdzangs: sha phu nu mig rtsa gang dmar dang: grogs na zla spyang grung gang ldan rnams: sdang dgra bo'i lag la bzhag bzhag nas: srog ma shor wa mo 'tshams nas thon:drin pha ma'i re ba stong zad btang: grogs bzang po'i blo gtad don med bzos: bza' tshe rogs yid nas khrel le byas: khyod rgod mdog bstan kyang a bar rig: nga'i rkang 'og 'bu la mi rtsi lags: dus da lo byang la dmag 'dren 'di: mi khyod la babs thengs ci zhig yod: don med par rang sdug ma yin nam: srog dmar po 'bebs la 'jog don ci: jus pha gzhis shor dus ma thub na: sde don med las la 'bad don medoḥ rta 'do phrug stag mos za ba'i dus: bong ga ma thang la 'gyel don ci: lug g.yang dkar spyang gis za ba'i dus: ra tsher mo gad la lceb don ci: dred sog dkar 'phar bar rtsod pa'i dus: khyi sda lu ngu zug byed don ci: gling 'gag phrug ab sha dmar zan kho: dus da lo gdon gyis smyos pa 'am:bgegs nag pos bkug pa the tshom med: dpa' mi min khrag ral rgyal po 171

khong: stod rgya gar chos khrims bshig mi red: dpa' a ya med par byang rgyal grags: smad rgya nag khrims ra gtor mi red: dpa' ngo ya med par byang rgyal grags: kho ge sar dmag 'go rgod mdog de: byang thang chen dkyil nas shes rgyu mang: sdug thang na yod pa thod la blangs: nyams mtshar ba'i ltad mo mthong nges gda': glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces zer zhing mda' 'phangs pa snye ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang gis phub kyis bkag nas sku lus la ma gnod stabs: yang gcig 'phangs rung rtsal chen g.yas la 'gyur te stag ral la phogs 'dug go: sgye ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang gis da ni nga'i res la babs yod pas shes par gyis zer nas mda' ldong sprad de yin lugs kyis glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: ge sar skyes bu'i srung ma rnams: de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi: byang sgo'i padma lha thang red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sgye ra dpon gyi sras po de: bhe ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang yin: pha mkhar bu yi 'dzin mi la: ge sar rgyal po'i bka' blon yin:'bum tsho snye ra'i rgyal khag nas: ma thub dgra la rting ma len: 'bum dmag dpung gi skyor ya yin: de yod nang de grags nga: 'bum me khrab kyi 172

rgyun thag 'dra: khas len gdong 'bud sngon ma yin: 'bum dpon 'phrul sras zer na smon: dpa' rtsal che ba sge ra'i sde: ha la'i dug tsher 'phrul sras blon: brgya tsho dmag gi kha ya yin: stong tsho dmag gi ngo ya yin:'bum tsho dmag gi 'dems ya yin: g.yul 'thab dpung ya shor ma myong:lan med 'bum thub 'phrul sras grags: ma nus gnyen la drin can yin:byams skyong byas pa grangs las 'das: dpa' chen don gyi snying khams ldan: dpa' med dgra rnams a thang chad: stobs chen dmag dpon 'phrul gyi sras: stobs med dgra bo yi mug skye: rtsal drug rgyas pa 'phrul sras bu: rtsal med dgra yi gshed ma yin: rlung shugs rta yi gong gnon yin: rnon po mtshon gyi rtse ya yin: kho re byang gi sda lu khyi: mi yul mngag na dpa' bo min: ma thub lus na 'phrul sras min: ma sod bzhag na dpa' rtul min: dpa' 'dod snang ba mthon po de: mug srog dgra la phul ba red: 'tshab 'tshub snang ba rlung gis bkyag: rig pa so mal mi gnas pas: rmog dkar nang gi skra lo gzengs: khrab dkar nang gi snying rtsa 'dar: bu mo khrab gyon bas kyang sdug: bshas lug shan par 'phrad dang 'dra: a bar rig la snying re rje: ge sar mchog la gsol thob dang:skyes mchog dgra 'dul dbang gi rgyal: phyi ltar dmag dpon drag po'i chas: bstan dgra 'joms pa'i 'phrin las mnga': nang ltar chos kun 173

mkhyen pa'i gter: sems can bde la bkod par brtson: yang gsang sku gsum 'pho 'gyur bral: ma rig 'khrul ba'i g.yul las rgyal: bag chags dri ma'i ma gos shing: brda don gcig du rtogs pa la: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpa' bo zer: sems can thams cad sangs rgyas te: 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib: dri ma de bsal sangs rgyas dngos: shes par gyis shig bdud kyi bu: kye ma 'khrul 'khyan sems can rnams: ma rig mun sel bla ma la: log rtog skyon gyi dri ma 'tshol: drin lan 'khor med pha ma rnams:dgongs lo bgres na phyi la phud: don med bdud kyi cho 'phrul ma: srog gi phyed ka'i nom la brtsi: chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na: sdig pa'i sa bon ri ltar bsags: mi 'grub 'khor ba'i grub so la: gtan tu re bas 'gro ba blun: drin chen nyams chung dud 'gro rnams: nyes med thub tshod byed drag pas: dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chen po'i nang: rang gis rang 'phangs a re skyo: de min rang las btsan grags pas: dgra bo gdong la byung ba'i dus: 'gran ya ma pher gus phyag 'tshal: srog skyobs ma ṇi 'don 'don byas: da rung kha bshad stong gtam mang: rang mtshang rgya sde'i sngon la bkod: skyag lab tshig la su mi khrel: sdar ma rang la rgod rgod de:don med dgra la rgod rabs med: a la mtshar gyi che ba la: dus ngan snyigs ma'i tha ma ru: zog po rin chen gser las brin: mkhas dang grub 174

pa mtha' ru skrod: ma thub dgra bo pha bzhin brtsi: mdza' ba'i grogs po ring du dor: dam med lug khyus bstan la gnod: ma rabs ngan pas 'jig rten dkrugs: sku rje seng chen bla ma yis: 'gro don byed pa'i dus la babs: zog po bdud kyi bla srog gcod: dam nyams bstan dgra'i klad khrag 'gem: dmag jag rkun ma'i rgyu lam bcad: 'khrul 'khyan rmongs ba'i rgya las grol: yang dag sa chen thob pa byed: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' 'phangs bas: rtsal ldan lu chung rtsal bdes phub kyis ma khog par chu srin dung gis phigs pa ltar srog dang bral: gling dmag rnams kyis rim bzhin 'thab par gda':de'i tshe nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag gi steng nas rtsal ldan rlung dmar shugs ldan gyis mda' dung ba gang bo 'phangs nas gling dmag sum cu lhag bsad rmas byas mthar rdo mang du 'phangs te dmag kha shas brlags rjes mkhar steng nas mar babs te rta 'do ba pho rog stong 'cham gyi steng du bcibs nas rlung bud pa bzhin gling dmag gi nang du brgyugs te 'phru ser can mang po dgrong: 'jang dmag gi dpung dkyil nas ya med g.yu 'brug thog rgod kyis mthong nas thag nye sar gcar zhing gzhu steng du mda' bzhag te glu len par brtsams pa na: rtsal ldan rlung dmar shugs 175

ldan gyis glu len khom ma sbyin par ral gri 'phyar te the tshom med par shor nas gri lan mang du btab pa mtshon ma song: 'jang blon gyis mda' 'phangs ba khor ma thebs: yang skyar gri kha 'gran par 'jang phrug la gnam the'u dkar po'i grogs mdzad de mtshon la ngar chu blud pas bdud phrug kho chom la phab bo: der 'khrugs long lta mi bzod pa ste: ki sgra 'brug stong ldir 'dra: 'do ba'i 'tsher skad lhang lhang: mda' mtshon bu yug 'tshub 'dra: thang chen por dmar po khrag gi chu phran bzhur ba: rnon po'i so kha 'phrad pas sgra sing di re: mi ro dang rta ros yul klung bkang: sod rgyob drag po'i sgra ri lung kun la ma khyab pa med pa zhig gi ngang nas 'thab che bas: snying chung rta las lhung nas brdzis: la las mtshon shor ba'am:rta ma thub pa: mtshon brjed pa sogs kyang byung skad: la la bros lam ma thob par shi: la la shi lceb byas nas 'khrugs: la las sdar skad shor yang ma phan par shi bsad kyi gnam nag gting nas 'thib: ma tshad 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur dang: sgye ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang: mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug: ya med g.yu 'brug thog rgod: bee thul g.yung drung 'chi med: zhang zhung stag mo khri brtan: sog blon me ru khrag 'thung: 'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po: dpa' lang stong thub khri bstan: 'jang blon kun bzang bstan pa bcas dpa' rgod tshang ma rang rang gi phyogs nas byang 176

dmag mang po mtshon la drangs byung ba dang: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas ral gri klad la bskor nas gling dmag chig brgya re bzhi tsam shi rmas btang: 'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po kho'i gdong la bud nas ral gri'i so kha rta rngog la phyi phyi lan 'ga' mdzad nas ya kho re byang blon gyad kyi bu:dpa' tshod zin na rgod po dang: phyug tshod shes na mkhas pa zer: de min rang tshod ma zin na: shi phyi mar 'gro ba'i lag g.yug 'dra zer zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: lha skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang: chos rgyud sde bzhi yi lha la 'dud: lam ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams: lam thar ba'i sa la 'god par gyis:sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: nub rdzong chen khu byug mgrin yag 'gram: wa ga ma'i stag gsob gyon sa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gling ge sar skyes mchog bka' yi blon: 'dan chos bzang dgra yi tho ba yin: dpa' grub chen brgyad cu'i gdan gral zin: sngon smon lam dar gyi mdud pa dam: gdan gcig tu grol ba'i smon lam zab: nga pho lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin: rno bsam chod ral gri'i rtse ya yin: dpa' ya med gling gi 'bum sgar nas: nga yod na dpa' ming 'dogs sa dang: nga med na de phung zer rgyu yin: ya de nas gyad mi gza' rgod bu: khyod rang snang mtho la kha pho che:177

yin nges pa'i bu zhig yin mdog byed: khyod zha bo'i tshod kyi rkang bde red:sde long ba'i tshod kyi mig ldan red: kha lkug pa'i tshod kyi lce bde red: mi sdar ma'i tshod kyi dpa' bo red: nga rgod po'i yid sems bde nas byung:dpa' dmar yag stag la 'thab 'thab nas: wa ga ma gdong len gting nas khrel: gzig khra yag g.yul du bkyes bkyes nas: khyi dom bu mgo gnon zhe re rmongs: dred sog dkar shugs ya byas byas nas: byi ca lir ltag rdo ngo re tsha: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la: khyod shi lceb srog la rtsis med byed: gdon nag pos ded dam byur gyis zin: dpon khrag ral 'chi ba ma yin nam: de min na chu lha lceb thag chod: sde byang gi sprang phrug thal ske kho: 'dre 'byung bos zos pa the tshom med: ltas ma bzang bya ba kho thag red: sde byang gi shi 'phro lhag bsdum 'di: da gcig med rtsad nas chad par nges: mi'i tshe thag dar dkar yug gcig 'di: shi ran na rin thang je che red: mi'i re smon nam mkha'i sprin gsar te: shi ran na bskos bzhag je mang red: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: rta chung chung rgyugs 'dod rlung la 'gran: thang chen po'i byang lam zad pa med: dus tha ma gor mo'i spang thang nas: rdo pha bong bzhin du nyal ba mang: bu chung chung dpa' 'dod snang ba mtho: phyi 'jig rten dgra mtha' chod dus med:dus tha ma sgar chen thal dong nang: pham ro bzhin mgo khrag g.yog pa mang:178

de zer ba'i bden zhig gang na yod: dpe de bzhin byang phrug skyag lang khyod: rdzong pha khyim nang nas rgod mdog byed: mthar gling dmag dug gi klong chen nas: dug ha la'i sdong po chos bzang ngas: khyod bem sgog dug gis ha la 'phen: dug nag po'i don de bstan nas byung: red e bsam byang phrug 'phru nag can: mi nag po stobs rtsal che mdog gis: sems nag po'i dmyal ba ri ltar bsags: las nag po'i sdig pa grangs las 'das: bdud nag po'i bstan pa skyong bsam cing: 'bras nag po'i las mtha' ga la phyin: shi dmyal ba thig nag nang la 'phen: rmog nag po rtse nas gtor la 'jog: khrab nag po gzhung nas gtub la 'jog: mtshon nag po sked nas gcod la 'jog: rta nag po nom la len rgyu yin: sprin nag po rlung gis gtor ba ltar: phyi bem nag bya khyi'i gzan la bskyur:yid nag po'i sdig rgyun chod pa na: mthar thar ba mchog gi grong khyer du:lam sa mkhan ge sar dpon gyis byed: blo chos la brtson pa'i lus bzang thob: rten dal 'byor stong log mi byed nges: de dga' bar gyis shig byang gi blon: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:khyod byang sdug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas glu de thos par bzod mi thub pa'i khong khro zhig 'khrugs nas ral gri'i dpa' 179

lung mdzub mor bskon te ral gri dgung la 'phyar nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral bcas: de ring dpa' bo'i gdong grogs mdzod: mtha' 'dre gling gi dmag sna bzlog:sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: nub rdzong mgrin yag nang shed red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral rgyal gyi bka' yi blon: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa yin: ma thub dgra yi kha gnon yin: gza' nad dug gi kha rlangs yod:thog rgod thog gi mda' mo 'dra: gling sdar wa khyu'i gshed ma yin: ma shes ma rtogs zer don med: lan med 'bum thub nag po grags: ma bshad gling gis shes tshod red: rma khams gling gi las dmag gis: don med byang yul dmag gis gang: yar skyes rtsa ljang zos nas tshar: mar 'bab gzhung chu rnyog par byas: skyes pa'i mi de mda' yis bsad: bsags pa'i rgyu nor dpung gis 'phrog: srin po'i ro khang lta bur bzos: mi khro ka med byang la byung: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs dkar 'og: 'gag phrug ge sar thub le gcig: dpa' rtul mug srog chod le gnyis: 'bum dmag ser bas brdungs 'dra gsum: ma thub bzhag na dpa' bo min: de nas sdar ma kha btsan can: bya rgyal rgod po'i 'phur ya la: ne'u las mi 'ongs lad 180

mo tsam: mgyogs pa rkyang gi bang ya la: bong bu'i mi chod stong sems tsam: tsan tan lo ma'i skye ya la: 'jag ma'i mi 'ongs 'khrul snang tsam:byang dmag khrod kyi gza' rgod nga: gling sdar mi 'gran sha re tsha: 'gran na bu rta shi rmas bzo: 'chi bdag sngon gyi tshe zad 'dra: de min byung rgyu ci yang med: a re gling sdug mi skyo 'am: mi min byang dang khra mo gling: snga dgra da gyod med na yang: gling sdug wa mos tshur 'gebs byas: de sngon rdzong khag mang po phabs: des rkyen sred pa che drag bas: gdon 'dre snying la zhugs pa red: de ring byang gi blon po ngas: rting ma rno ba'i gri la babs: rno gcod 'chi bdag 'bar ba zer: btab na ngo ya ga la yod:yar 'phyar skya rengs mtha' nas gsal: mar bzhag mun pa gting nas rub: phar g.yug rlung nag sked nas gcod: gri shugs glang chen brgya las lhag: gri nus 'chi bdag gshed dang 'dra: gri lha srin po khrag ral yin:btab nas shor ba gcig kyang med: gling sdug shi dga' shi skyid yin: na tsha sdug bsngal ga la shes: 'jigs skrag sems la myong khoms med: pha mar kha chems yod na shod: bza' zla bu phrug bcol dam sogs: yod na ma 'gyang skad cha shod: 'phrin pa 'phrod pa'i go chod byed: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling ba'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag phan tshun gri kha ja yun tsam la 'gran 181

mthar 'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po'i dbu thang la 'phangs nas dgrong:'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po dgrong shor bas bya ba ngan pa de 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur dang: sge ra'i 'phrul sras zla bzang: mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug: ya med g.yu 'brug thog rgod: be thul g.yung drung 'chi med:zhang zhung stag mo khri brtan: sog blon me ru khrag 'thung: dpa' lang stong thub khri bstan: 'jang blon kun bzang bstan pa rnams kyis mthong nas 'chi ba srog la mi 'dzems par kho gri rub brgyab cing mtshon ma song: khos kyang gling gi dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' ya ma pher nas rdzong la bros: gling dmag phyogs bzhi dbus nas chu sna rdol ba ltar rdzong la shor nas bsad gtub bcom gsum gyis ri lung tho sprad pa bzhin byang mi min gyi las dmag la pham kha gnam nag lang 'dra zhig byung nas rang mgo gang thon tsam las g.yul bkye bas rting thag chod par gda': gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa kho rang dang byang blon 'ga' zhig ma gtogs g.yul du pham pa shes nas phyir rdzong sgo la gtad de bros par brtsams nas shor byung pa'i lam khar sog blon me ru khrag 'thung 'dug pa la gri 'gran drag tu byas mthar sog blon la gri rmas che tsam bzos te shar brgyag gis phyi ltas med par bros song ngo: der 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis byang dmag mang du bsgral zhing ki sgra dang bcas rdzong gi rtse la pheb nas sde mi min byang 182

gi dar khra de sa la bsnyil zhing: shar khra mo gling gi dar sngon po rdo rje'i mtshan pa de dgung la bskyod nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyi las dmag g.yul las rgyal ba dang: byang dmag khri tsho gnyis kyis mgo bsgur:sog blon me ru khrag 'thung la rmas bcos legs par byas te zhang zhung stag mo khri brtan dang lhan tu las dmag gis bskor nas nub rdzong mgrin yag gi phyogs kyi 'bangs ru sde dbang du bsdus te dgra la mi shor bar byas nas 'dug go:183

le'u brgyad pa/mi min sras mo gling gis bzung / /byang rgyal rmi gab klong la 'khyan/ /lha yis lung dang dbang bskur te/ /sras mo'i blo rtse gling la gtad/ /der mi min byang gi blon po rnams mun rub pa dang mnyam du byang rgyal po'i pho brang du thon nas dmag nyes kyi lo rgyus thams cad zhu ba phul bas: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po shin tu khros nas nga rgyal gyis re zhig dran med du brgyal ba btsun mo dang blon pos tshogs kyis khrus chu gtor nas dran pa bslangs: der 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis las dmag byangs rnams gling ge sar gyi sgar la thon nas g.yul gyi 'thab tshul dang 'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po dbu nyes shor ba sogs yar zhu phul: ge sar khong yang thugs rab tu skyo bar mdzad nas 'dan gyi chos bzang btsan po sogs g.yul du pham pa'i byang gling gi las dmag shi ba rnams la 'pho ba mdzadoḥ ma tshad 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur sogs la dpa' dar bzang bstod legs par mdzad nas bzhugs so:184

'dir yang byang mi min rgyal po'i sras mo tshe 'dzin lha mos zhu rten dang bcas yab chen gyi mdun du gcar nas yang skyar dran tshor gyi zhu ba phul 'dod kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: gnas shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi lha: ma 'bum phrag yangs ba'i tshogs dang bcas:nga mos ldan bu la spyan gyis gzigs: sems ma rig 'khrul ba'i blo de sol:sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: dus snga mo bde skyid nyi gling la: deng mi 'dod g.yul ngo gnam nag lang: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog sras mo de: blo shes rab gsal ba'i tshad la 'jog: nga ma shes tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: ya de nas yab chen rin po che: sde byang gling mdun ma ma gtam na: byang gces phrug skal ba chad rgyu red: byang rgyal po'i jus srid rtswa mgo'i zil: drod nyi ma thon na dgung la yal: rdzong dngul dkar nor bu'i bang mdzod de: nged byang la mi dbang shor tshod gda': sde rma khams rgyal po ge sar khong: lha rigs gsum rnam sprul yin pas zer: byams snying rje rgyud na yod rabs zer:gtam skad cha'i gnad zhu ma zhan na: jag g.yul ngo gnam nag sangs ba yongs: dpung bu rta'i gral ra ma 'thor na: byang rgyal po'i bsam don 'grub par sla: dus da lo g.yul gyi 'thab ra nas: byang kho rgod zer tshad 185

srog dang bral: mda' kho skyen zer tshad mtheb rtsa zha: rta kho mgyogs zer tshad gad la 'khum: rdzong kho btsan zer tshad dgra la shor: dus da lo g.yul gyi 'thab ra nas: dpa' rgyal nas thon pa shin tu nyung: dpa' rting ma nam lang skar ma 'dra: khyed yab chen dgung gi nyi ma lags:thugs dgongs pa 'di la gtad rogs zhu: don 'di 'dra btang snyoms mi rung bsam: bya yag nyes sngon la ma khed na: dpon dpyod chen zer yang ngos bstod red: gnad mdo 'gag thag gis ma chod na: khrims rang rtsa zer yang mgo g.yog red: nga bu mos sdar skad ga la yin: nga'i dgra bstod rang smad de bas min: drin pha ma'i dga' zhig gang na yod: zas sha thun zhim zhig btsal yang dkon: las sha khrag 'di las gtso zhig med:de bsam nas skad cha bshol thabs bral: kho ge sar bdud kyis gshed ma loḥ rgan spyi dpon blo yi nor bu 'dra: khu khro thung dran rgyu byed rgyu mang:nor dngul dkar bang mdzod rin thang che: da ci yin a mo'i mi dpyod do:stag dmar yag 'dzum drug rgyas na yang: gangs dkar po'i seng la 'gran thabs med: rta 'do ba rgyugs la mkhas na yang: byang kha dkar rkyang la 'gran thabs med: glag rog mo gshog rtsal rgyas na yang: khong bya rgyal khyung la 'gran thabs med: nged mi min byang gi las dmag gis: kho rma khams gling la 'gran na dka': dpa' ngar rgod che ba gling gi dmag:186

bdud 'chi bdag las la rgyu rgyu red: dpung kha grangs mang ba gling gi dmag: lho dgung sngon drag char babs babs red: mthu rdzu 'phrul ldan pa gling gi dmag: nub rlung nag 'tshub ma khol khol red: lus sgyu ma'i gzugs kyi phar la zhog: gzugs med pa'i sde tshogs a thang chad: bden e bsam yab chen rin po che: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: yab rgyal po'i thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po gdon gyis smyos shing gling lhas blo kha bsgyur stabs: sras mo'i tshig la nyan ma 'dod nas ma tshad nam yin yang sras mo 'dis skal med sa la ske bsrings:dmag jag g.yul gyi bya ba la skad cha thon 'dug pas ngo tsha rgyu yang med:re zhig rdzong 'di dang kha bral thabs ma byas na bya ba yag po zhig sgrub kha mi 'jug pas mo la nyes chad mgo la babs yongs: de bas srid don phran bu la mo rang mngags na 'grig khrig khrig red bsam nas tshig de rna bar ma song yang ci bya med par na re: 'o na na chung tshe 'dzin ma: nga rgyal po'i jus la thugs sems dkar: da ma 'dug la mo las la chas: khyung bo'i tshe dbang bstan pa la: khyod gnas sa gnyen rtags bzhag pas phyir: dpung chen po'i brgyab dpung mngags rogs zhus: sde byang gling gnyis kyi gnas tshul shod: dpung g.yul chen grogs la khug pas na: ste byang gi rgyal kha 187

yag po lon: sdang dgra la mdun ma gtam thabs med: lha bdud las kyi dgra ru bskos: bsam blo snying khung gting nas thongs: da ma 'gyang dgra yi bar chad yod zer ba dang: sras mos thugs la bya de'i byed thabs ci yin rtogs kyang khas mi len thabs med byung nas mi min gyi bu mo zhal ta ma bco lnga dang bcas rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub sogs dmag mi brgya yis bskor zhing khyung bo'i yul la chas par brtsams so:de'i skabs su 'dzam gling skyes bu chen po: khams gsum dbang sdud kyi rgyal po: srid gsum zil gnon gyi bdag nyid de: lha gur mthong ba don ldan: phyi na chon thag med pa: 'ja' tshon 'od kyi chon thag: nang na ka ba mi dgos: padma stong ldan gyi ka ba: stong nyid sgom khang yangs ba de ru: steng dar gdugs 'ja' 'od lam me: 'og khebs gdan ri mo shigs se: mtshams bkra shis g.yang byin khrig ge: ting 'dzin sgom gyi lta ba la gzhol bas thun mtshams su: mdun nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyi klong nas na chung ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa zhig gis mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur lam mer zhal dgyes pas spyan zung tshur phyogs nas chos nyid don gyi mgur glu 'di gsungs so:na mo ḍā ki tsand+ra ye: rang snang dag pa rab 'byams nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum: byin rlabs sprin phung 'thibs se 'thibs:188
