dngos grub sbrang char ya la la: de ring bu mo'i glu sna drongs: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog: gnas 'di mtha' bral nam mkha'i khams: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sring lcam tha le 'od dkar yin: 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ge sar lags: ma g.yel snyan gyi dbang po gtod: sang nyin tshes bzang brgyad 'dzoms la: mi min sras mo mngon shes can: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bdag yin: skyes bu'i grogs la khas len byas: rten 'brel dus la babs pa red: mi min rgyal po'i blo 'phrul gyis: khyung po'i yul la mngags 'dug pas: lam bsgug dpa' rtul 'ga' re song: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub kho: ci ma yin la 'gran rgyu dka': 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gcig: rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra gnyis: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas gsum: thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal bzhi: hrag bsdus rta dmag sum brgya bcas: ma 'dug seng thang gong ma nas: rgya rdzong nags kyi gseb la yub: mi min bu mo tshe 'dzin ma: sdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro red: ge sar skyes bu'i zung ma 'am: dngul rdzong 'bebs pa'i lde'u mig yin: ma shor la mo zin pa dgos: gser zhwa can gyi bla ma de: mkho ba mun nag phyi mar mkho: thob thang can gyi dpon po de: mkho ba yag nyes gyod la mkho: 'gro'i mgyogs can gyi rta pho de: mkho ba byang lam gcod dus mkho: lha nas bskos pa'i mkha' 'gro de: mkho ba dngul rdzong phab 189

dus mkho: ma 'gyang las la myur du byon: lung bstan dus dang khrig khrig red: don zab glu yi mchod pa 'di: skyes bu'i snyan gyi bcud la bzung:go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: ge sar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung nas stong ba'i dbyings la 'ja' ltar mi snang bar gyur to:ge sar skyes bu chen po de nyid myur bar yar bzhengs nas gsol dpon mi chung thang rtse gnyis la 'du ra dgos tshul bka' phab pa ltar dung bus nas gling dmag rnams lha gur du 'dus: der 'dzam gling skyes bu chen pos lung bstan byung tshul dang skabs kyi dmag bkod kyi glu 'di tshe glu 'gyur med kyi ngag rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: gnas spyi bo bde chen pho brang nas: khong gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs: bu'i 'gro don thogs med 'grub par shogoḥ gnas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo nas: dpal rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas mthu stobs can: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs: bu'i 'gro don thogs med 'grub par shog: gnas snying kha sprul ba'i zhing khams nas: lha padma 'byung gnas 'khor dang bcas: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs: bu'i 'gro don thogs med 'grub 190

par shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min seng thang bar ma nas:gling lha gur phyug mo'i nang shed red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: smad mdo khams gling gi sa cha nas: nga sku rje seng chen bla ma yin: ya de nas 'dir tshogs gling gi sde: nga 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po la: steng gong ma lha nas smon lam gyis: rten dam tshig 'gyur ba mi srid pas: phyogs rgyal khams zung ma bco brgyad de: gnas sa mdo mi gcig re na srid: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha na: dpon khrag ral rgyal gyi sras mo de: khong na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo zhes: shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yod: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: nub khyung po'i yul la mngag skad gda': lam bsgug pas dpa' bo yang rgod bzhi: khyed 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gcig: dpa' seng stag dam pa rab rgyas gnyis: khong rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra gsum: dpa' thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal bzhi: dpung hrag bsdus rta dmag sum brgyas bskor: da ma 'dug la mo 'gro shoms kyis: kho na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo de: byang dngul rdzong gter gyi lde'u mig yin: de ma shor dpa' rtul dpung gis bzung: yang rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub de:dpa' thabs mkhas bkod pas ma 'dul na: kho ci ma yin la 'dul thabs dka': thabs spyang grung 'chi bdag nag po byos: da ma 'gyang dpa' rtul pho rgod tsho: ma tshe 'dzin lha mo ma shor na: byang mi min dngul 191

rdzong lon par nges: kho khrag ral ma thub shor ba las: ma tshe 'dzin lha mo shor na 'phung: da la mo rlung ltar bud pa gal: dar dmar po'i srung mdud re re yod: rno btab chod mtshon gyis thub pa min: don go nas e byung dpa' rtul rnams: ma mkha' 'gro'i lung la 'khrul ba med: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu yo go ba la yang len med: gling dpa' rtul thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar gsung ba dang: dpa' rtul so so'i dang du blangs nas 'tshub 'khyil ler seng thang gong ma'i nags gseb tu thon zhing gab: der mi min byang gi rgyal khag nas khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po dang: blon 'khor rnams kyis sras mo tshe 'dzin lha mo la: gos rabs bco brgyad:gser dngul g.yu mu tig byu ru sogs 'jig rten mdzes byed sna tshogs kyi rgyan pas bcu drug na tshod rdzogs pa: gzugs mdzes lta na sdug pa:mthong na yid dbang 'gugs pa: reg na 'jam sha ldan pa: lha yi bu mo dngos dang mtshungs 'dra zhig byas shing rta pho dkar po dung seng 'dra ba la bcibs nas: zhal ta ma rnams kyis bskor te chas pa na: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub dang dpa' rogs 'ga' res rang rang gis rta la bcibs nas nub phyogs khyung po'i yul la song ngo: nyi ma'i gong la slebs skabs seng thang gong mar thon pas khong rnams kyis gong ja bskol par 192

brtsams zhing blon po dang mdun 'dug 'ga' ris gra sgrigs byas: der na chung bu mo rnams kyis chu rtsed brgyab: rtsal ldan dpa' rung 'bum thub kyis dgra la dogs gzon byas: re zhig tsa na nub kyi nags gseb nas thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal khong mi pho gzugs mdzes pa skad snyan pa lang tsho lha dang mnyam pa zhig gi ngang nas glo bur du phebs pa dang: bu mo rnams kyis mdzes sgeg lang tsho phyir ngom gyin mig brda phu brgyag byed do: rtsal ldan dpa' rung btsan pos mthong nas yid la the tshom skyes te sa cha med kyi mi pho kher 'gro 'di: don chen po yid la yod tshod red: ge sar gyi sprul ba 'am: spyi dpon gyi ngan 'phrul lam: khro thung gi bya ba ngan pa zhig min nam bsam nas myur bar rta la bcibs nas tshur gdong la thon zhing na re:ya kho re mi pho go bkrag can: sa 'di la yongs ba bzang rgyu med: nged mi min byang gi sa cha la: phyi mi nang la yongs sa med: nang mi phyi la 'gro sa med: khrims kha dmar bo me las tsha: khrims gzhung sngon mo chu las ring:gson la mi mngag kho thag yin: su yin skad cha la mo shod: don dang bya ba ci zhig yod zer ba dang: thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal gyis: ya 'o na lha blon rin po che: gtam de 'dra ma gsung ci go red: pho nga 'dra mi min byang gi grogs: gnyen dang dgra ya nor dogs med zer zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:193

glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: mchod cig bstod gnyis a sngon dgung: a sngon dgung de ma mchod na: rmog dkar gtad so mi 'ong ngo: mchod cig bstod gnyis bar snang khams: bar snang khams de ma mchod na: khrab dkar gtad so gang la byed: mchod cig bstod gnyis dog mo sa: dog mo sa de ma mchod na: lham chung gtad so yong pa min: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang ba mi min sa cha nas: seng thang gong ma'i nags gseb red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nye nas ma yin ring nas yin: ring bo khyung po'i yul nas yin: khyung po'i tshe dbang bstan pa yi: bka' blon nor bu bzang po yin: rtsal chen mtheb kyi mda' mo yin: pha rol 'ben la phog dgos yod: rgyal po'i mngag pas bka' blon yin: las dang bya ba 'grub nges dgosoḥ khyung po mthing gi rgyal sa na: pho brgya'i blo rtse gtod sa dang: mo brgya'i smon pa 'chor sa de:rgyal sras dung gi zla ba khong: gangs ri'i mdog gsal sku lus rgyas:bkrag mdangs nyi 'od phyogs bcur 'phro: pi wang rgyud ltar gsung dbyangs snyan: ldem drug 'gyur khug rna bar 'jebs: dwangs gsal sprin bral blo sgo 'byed: 'das dang ma 'ong lung du ston: pho brgya'i nang gi gtso bo yin: mig brgya'i lta rin yod sa yin: gangs dkar sems kyi bu lon yin: da lo rgyal pos srid dbang bskur: de sngon gnyen gtam ci bzhin 194

du: chung ma tshe 'dzin lha mo babs: khrag ral rgyal la zhu dgos gsung: chu lha sman la gros kyis zer: na chung nub la brdzangs bar smon: de ltar yid la bcag nas ni: thag ring lam du 'ong ba yin: don chung ma yin don chen yin: de nas byang blon dpa' bo lags: bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis thongs: blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga khod: brgya lam mi dbang gsod zer na:lag chung mi bsgul thabs med red: gom gsum gom pa ma spos na: sgo them la mo mi rgal to: tshig gsum skad na ma bshad na: thos pa che yang phan pa med: mi med nags klong chu 'gram na: na chung mdzes ma'i tshogs dang bcas: byang blon gang dang ci zhig mdzadoḥ rgyal srid jus don yin thag chod: lo rgyus glu ru 'dren rogs zhu: khyung po'i rgyal sras skar gsal dang: mi min mdzes ma tshe 'dzin gnyis: phan tshun mthun pa'i mdun ma zab: mnyam 'dzoms 'dzam gling spyi la phan: de bas dga' gcig yod don med: dgung nas nyi zla mtho ldeb mdzes: sa nas byang khyung btsan ldeb bzang: e rtogs byang blon dpa' rung bu: khyung po'i tshe dbang bstan pa yis: ci gsung bka' te a phos 'phrod: ci dga' khyod rang bsam blo thongs: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang blon thugs la de ltar zhog:ces smras pa dang: rtsal ldan dpa' rung btsan po'i sems la: byang 195

dang khyung po'i gnyen don thams cad bshad lugs la brtag na gling dang ye mi 'dra: 'on kyang mi gcig rta gcig kher 'gro lar nas bzang po zhig ma red bsam nas glu zhig len par brtsams pa dang: nags gseb nas 'bru sras byang rong btsan po: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas gnyis kyis zhags pa re re bzhin 'phangs nas kho yi ske la bskon zhing phar 'then tshur 'then byed skabs thang rtses mda' rgyab nas de nyid bsgral: der dmag mi gzhan ma rnams dang bu mo thams cad kyis ki co ri lung bkang nas sa bros rdo bros brgyab nas yod tshe: dpa' rtul rnams kyis phyogs bzhi dbus nas bskor zhing lam ma ster bar dmag mi rnams kyis mgo bskur: byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mos gri chung g.yung drung 'bar ba bzung nas mi thub par 'dug pa 'bru sras byang rong btsan po dang: thang rtse g.yu yi 'brug rgyal gnyis kyis bzung nas gling sgar du khrid nas byung ngo:der 'dzam gling lho yi rgyal po: rngams brjid rakka thod phreng: dkar po lha yi yang lha: sgom chen sngags kyi rig 'dzin: dam ldan snying gi mun sel: nag phyogs g.yul las rnam rgyal: sku rje seng chen rgyal po rin po che de nyid stong nyid sgom gur chen mo'i nang shed: dar gdugs 'ja' sprin 'khor lo'i gdengs khang: stag gzig gdan gyi yang steng: dar zab gos 'phrug gi klong na khams gsum dbang sdud kyi byin dang bcas bzhugs yod 196

pas mdun du: byang gi bzung dmag sras mo 'khor dang bcas pa khrid nas bzhag: der sku rje bla mas zhal 'dzum pa'i sgo nas mi min sras mo tshe 'dzin lha mo la yang dag don gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: lha bla ma padma 'byung gnas la: mgon rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: dus de ring skyes bu'i grogs la byon: snyan nges pas glu de 'gugs rogs mdzod:dpal yi dam khros pa yongs 'dus la: 'khor drag pa khro bo khro mos bskor:dus de ring skyes bu'i grogs la byon: snyan nges pas glu de 'gugs rogs mdzod: ma mkha' 'gro rgod lcam dkar mo la: mdzes mo rgyud ḍā ki 'bum gyis bskor: dus de ring skyes bu'i grogs la byon: snyan nges pas glu de 'gugs rogs mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min yul gyi sa cha red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: skyid 'dzam gling sa yi thig le ru:mtho pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse srid: steng lha klu gnyan gyi 'phrul mkhar red: mkhar mthong na sdig ltang nyes pa 'dag: gnas yul bdag rma chen spom ra la: sa sde bdag ge sar rgyal po yin: ya de nas na chung byang bza' ma: mgo mu tig lan tshar mar 'og nas: rgyan dngul dkar mdzes phreng gong ba nas: snyan dar lung dbang po tshur la gtod: don gnas lugs 'dra ma 'di ltar yod: ma khyod dang 'u gu gnyis po la: steng gong ma 197

lha yi zhing khams su: sngon smon lam 'brel ba'i dam tshig zab: byang mi min dngul rdzong phab pas dus: khyed gter bdag lde'u mig khas len mdzad: blo nam lang nyi ma shar 'dra la: ngas dran bskul brjed tho e dgos lags: yul 'jig rten dri mas ma bag pas: mchog lang cho1re gzi byin ngo mtshar che: zhal dung mdog zla ba nya gang la: mdzes mkhur tshos padma rā gas byug: spyan khra chung shar gyi skar gsal la: yang nag snum smin ma khyung gshog rgyas: kha dung so mu tig bstar yag la: yang so gdan byu ru'i lcags ri bkod: sgyug gsar skyes 'dra ba'i sku lus la: mdangs 'ja' tshon bkrag 'dra'i rgyan rabs tshang: dar pad lham mdzes pa'i pa tra la: yang dung skud brgyad slus nywa chab sgrogs: mjes me tog tshom bu'i cod pan la: g.yang rin chen nor bu'i gtsug rgyan ldan: 'od dung mdog rin chen gyis grub pas: mgul rkang lag rgyan gyi drwa ba mang: blo dran 'phrul ma mang bsam blo thongs: sra gangs dkar gnam gyi ka ba de: seng g.yu ral can gyi 'khor khyim red: nags g.yu ljon tshang tshang ra ba de:dpa' rgya stag ngar ma'i rten gnas red: rma gser mdog chu yi rlabs phreng de: klu nya rigs mang po'i 'khyugs sa red: mdzes me tog padma'i skyed tshal de: 'bu phye leb bung ba'i rtsed ra red: dpe de la gnas lugs snying po mchis: sde byang gling g.yul gyi yo lang 'di: nga gling la snying rje med 198

pa min: nged rma khams gling yul phyug mo de: skyid zho bzhin chags pa khrag bzhin dkrugs: sde nyes med mgo la zhwa nag gab: 'di lha bdud las kyi bskos thengs red: don rtogs na na chung tshe 'dzin ma: shar khra mo gling gi mna' ma babs: byang dngul dkar rdzong gi lde'u mig byos: blo ma g.yeng sdig ltang nyes bshags dang: lha'i dal chab khrus la nan tan mdzod: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod na chung thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mi min bu mo tshe 'dzin lha mo'i sems la: kho rma khams gling gi rgyal po la zhu ba zhig phul na e go: da bya ba 'di 'dra thug dus sngon gyi smon lam ci 'dra yod kyang sems can gyi mi rtogs pas pha bla btsong ba gtan nas mi 'ong: don yang dag gi bya ba bzang po zhig 'grub na ma rtogs blun po glang sna gar khrid cig gtan nas mi 'os bsam nas zhal dkar dmar chu yi padma gsar du kha 'bus pa lta bu de tshur phyogs nas cung zad 'jigs 'jigs kyi ngang nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: rang yul byang gi srung ma rnams: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: glu len don dang ldan par shog: ngag 'gugs re ba 'grub par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes 199

na: mi min byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min khrag ral sras mo nga: na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: de nas rma khams gling gi rgyal:gson dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod: gong ma lha yi zhing khams nas: smon lam thebs pa bden mod kyang: de la blo gtad ga la 'os: 'jig rten chos dang brtun dgos yod: da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la: byang gling g.yul 'thab khrag gi byas: nga lan khyod lan dgos pa chung: don med mi rta khrag la bsgyur: rgas po rnams kyi lag rten chag: bu phrug thams cad dwa le bzos: na chung bu mo yugs sa byas: sdig pa'i na bun 'thibs nas 'dug: sdug bsngal las 'di a tsa ma: rma khams gling dang byang ba gnyis:mdun ma 'grigs mthun e yod bsam: mdun ma 'grigs mthun yod pas na: mi min bu mo tshe 'dzin mas: ge sar rgyal la zhabs phyi 'grub: bu mo shi gyel mngag kyang 'gro: de min g.yul ngo ma bzlog na: mi min byang gi sras mo nga: dgra la mgo 'dog ga la srid: phyi sna nang khrid cis phyir byed:pha ma'i drin lan ma sod kyang: pha ma dgra la gang nas btsong: rma khams gling gi dpa' bo tshos: nyag phran mda' yi 'been la zhog: skye 'chi ri gzar rbab chu la: blo gtad ci yod bu mos shes: sgyu lus 'doms gang gru bzhi de: mi khas 'dam la ga la 'phen: rigs dang rus pa brlag don med: e red ge sar rgyal po lags: ci dga' gang drag thugs bsam 200

thongs: byang phrug tshe 'dzin lha mo nga: btsan po'i dpung gis 'phrog pa 'di: mi shi rta 'gyel gyod rtsa las: don bzang ci yang yod pa min: a re skyo zhing sdug pa la: bu mo shi na mi mjos sam: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: ge sar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces smras pa dang: byang gling gi dpa' bo thams cad kyi yid la smon pa skyes nas byang mi min gyi sras mo don la mkhas po 'dug: shi yang mi skrag pa kho thag bcad chog: skad cha thams cad kyang don dang ldan pa sha stag red: khong rgyal po'i gsung lan ci zhig yod bsam nas yod tshe: sku rje mi yi nyi ma rin po ches zhal 'dzum pas mdangs dang bcas khyod bu mo'i gsung la 'khrul ba mi 'dug: nged dpa' rtul thams cad kyis de ma shes pa ci yin: lnga brgya'i tha ma'i dus 'dir bdud kyi bstan pa dar nas sems can gyi bde skyid 'phrog: spyi'i phug nor rnams lkog zos byas:btsan po la ngo dga' bltas: nyams chung la thub tshod byas: chos dang yang dag pa'i khrims rnams nog: bzang bo 'di yin zhes ming 'dzin sa med pa zhig byas 'dug pas dus 'dir nged rma khams gling ba rnams las la mi bzhengs thabs med lhas bskul ba yin: khyi mi zug thabs med rkun mas nag 'bur: wa mi brgyal ka med 'dre yis gram lcag byas pa red ma gtogs: dmag phar bkyes: sde phar brlag byed pa gtan nas med:201

nyes med la nyes chad gtan nas 'gel ma myong: dgras tshur rgol gyi lan ldog pa ni khyed sras mo rang la kyang bshad rgyu yod tshod mi 'dug kho thag red: khyed mi min gyi sras mo pha jus dang rang rigs la de 'dra blo dkar ba nga tsho la yang spro ba phul byung: khyed kyi bsam blo zhib tu thong la nga la lan thob gsung nas de nub las gur du gdan drangs nas ngal gsos: der byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo'i bsam blo mang du btang mthar byang gling mdun ma'i skal ba zhig e yod kyi re ba dang bcas sha gos stod thung gshags pas ngor sgron ma'i me tog gi sol ba btul nas yi ge 'di 'dra bris:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: ma rje btsun sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'bod: don dmigs pa thams cad 'grub pas phyir:thugs dgongs pa dbyings la mi g.yel bar: rkyen ngan pa bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang glang ma'i seng thang bar ma red: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang mi min khrag ral sras mo nga: ma na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: ya de nas rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas: gtam snyan mo'i zhu ba phul rgyu med: sdug a thang chad pa'i glu zhig len: nged 'khor bcas lam dgra'i lag la tshud: blon dpa' rung ma dbang dgra la shor: nged 'phro lus dmag nyob bu mo rnams: phyi bkyig sdoms a long sne 202

med la: nang bkyig pa gru gu 'phar med byas: gling ge sar dpon gyi mdun la khrid: khrims btsan po'i skad cha rna la gzan: las gnyom chung sdug 'di a re gyod: mon spos dkar yul gyi me tog de: byang dug gi 'bras dang brdab nas byung: shar rgya mo'i lag gi dar zab de: nub gsang me'i klong la bsregs nas byung: mtha' rgya mtsho'i bcud kyi byu dmar de: sman rdo gzhong nang la sprugs nas byung: byang mi min yul gyi sras mo nga: sde cha med btsan gyi khrid nas byung: yid skyo ba nam mkha' lang med red: sems gnyom pa byi'u chung rdo phog red: yab rgyal po'i thugs la nges lags sam: kho ge sar rgyal po'i skad cha la: sde byang gling mdun ma yod rabs zer: mi chen po'i kha yag gang nas yin: don blo gtad chog pa khrig khrig red: da ma 'dug bu mo skyob phyir dang: deng phyin chad byang gling bde 'tshams ched: dpa' byang gi rgyal blon thams cad kyis: blo gros 'cham rdo la ri mo byos: ngag bde 'jog 'khrul med tshig thag chod: sde byang gling g.yul gyi 'khrug mtshams zhog: nga sras mo rang sde rang dbang mdzod: blon dpyod chen dgu thigs skya mo ste: khong shes rab lha dar la mo rdzongs: tshig bzang bo'i mdun ma yang dag gtams: da de min a med lan med na: byang sras mo dgung gi nyi ma nga: rmag mun pa'i klong nas thar dus med: sde cha med rma khams gling yul du: nga na chung ngang mo kher 'khyar 203

ran: yab chen po mi min khrag ral rgyal: don mdza' drag 'di la thugs bsam thongs: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:dpon khrag ral thugs la de ltar zhog:ces bris nas gur sgo la thon nas snang srid 'gugs pas ting 'dzin gyis mo'i bla bya rnams brag dmar rdo rje dgu brtsegs na yod pa skad cig la bkug cing yi ge sked la btags nas brdzangs so: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po'i rdzong la yi ge bla bya rnams kyis 'phrod pa rgyal pos zhib par bklag tshar rjes dug sbrul la tsher lcag brab pa ltar gzhan skad cha ci yang med par go mdzod las khrab rmog dpa' chas thams cad blangs nas bdud 'chi bdag dgra la khros pa ltar sus kyang bshol ba med par rta 'do ba sprin dkar lding shes la bcibs nas rlung bud pa bzhin gling sgar la shor:der byang gi bka' blon dpa' bo 'khor dang bcas pa las dmag gi bskor ba 'tshub 'khyil ler rgyal po'i rjes bzhin snyeg par gda': de yang ge sar sa bcu'i nyi ma: theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor: sa bcu lam lnga'i bdag nyid: khams gsum 'dren pa'i ded dpon: mchog gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugasoḥ mtshungs med 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon khong lha gur du ting 'dzin la gzhol ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' 'gro ma gzugs mjos pa kun gyi khyu mchog: chu dar ser dmar gyi na bza' can: rus rgyan do shal 204

gyis g.yog pa: phyag g.yas ḍa ru dkrol ba: phyag g.yon dril bu bsil ba:'ja' sprin dri bzang gi ngad dang bcas 'od zer bye ba 'bar ba'i klong nas lung bstan gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:na mo ḍā ki dhe wa ye: chos dbyings spros bral pho brang nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum 'bod: chos kyi bar chad g.yul ngo bzlog: chos bzhin bsam pa 'grub par shog: gnas 'di 'od gsal don gyi mkha':nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: shes rab rtsal 'byed na chung ma: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro nga: gsal byed ḍā ki tā re sgron: o rgyan padma'i pho nya yin:ge sar mi yi nyi ma lags: ma g.yel glu la tshur gson dang: don 'bras 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la: mi min bdud phrug khrag ral rgyal: las dmag dpung gi rgyab gnon bcas: khra mo gling gi sgar la yongs: stag rong dpon po khro thung khong: rta mgrin lha yi yang sprul red: sgyu 'phrul rol gar dag la mkhas: da res bskul ba'i dus la babs: phyogs bzhi sgrub shing btsugs pa gal: gling sgar gzhan gyis mi mthong bas: rdzu 'phrul glog gi srung gur phub: mi min khyung gshog rgyal po kho: gzhan dang lar nas 'dra ba min: stobs shugs snying khams 'dzoms nas yod: 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs par: brgya byin byon kyang dka' khag yod: gling sgar phyogs bzhi gtor nges dang: dpa' rtul chag rtse bzo 205

nges gda': dal dal las la ma gzhol bar: brel brel da lta myur du mdzod: 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po lags: stag rong dpon la mthu nus bskyed: ma rung dgra la dmu gab khobs: rang dpung bde dang ldan par gyis: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: ge sar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung zhing mi snang bar gyur: der 'dzam gling yongs kyi rgyal po:seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul: log rtog dpung 'joms dug mda': smon log bstan dgra'i kha gnon: drag khros gshin rje dmar nag khong gis dpa' rtul phu nu ru 'dren bka' blon thams cad 'du ba'i dbus nas stag rong dpon po khro thung rgyal po la dgu tshan dar dang rgyu nor gyi rigs mang po mdun du spungs nas don gal chen gyi bskol bzhag gi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: gnas rgya gar lho nub dha sha'i mtshor: mdog dmar ser padmo bzhad pa'i khar: khong brdzus skyes rgyal po padma 'byung: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs:gnas dur khrod khrag mtsho rba rlabs g.yo: dpal dmar nag me ru 'bar ba'i klong: lha khro bo yongs 'dus khros pa rtsal: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: yang spros bral thig le'i zhing khams nas: rtsal sgyu 'phrul 206

las shar shes rab sgron: ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gter gyi bdag: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: sde byang gi seng thang bar ma red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga tshe stod 'gag mo'i jo ru zer: sa rma khams a bra'i ya bdag 'bod: nga tshe sked dgra 'dul rgyal po zer: gnas khams gsum bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal: nga tshe smad bla ma ge sar zer: ma 'gro drug 'dren pa'i ded dpon yin: glu de yan yin lugs 'dra ma tsam: ya kho re tsho chen lha sde dang: sde stag rong dug gi tsho chen nas: dug nag po'i lo ma khas che ba: yang sgos su stag rong dpon po nyon: don chen po'i las bkal 'di 'dra gda': khyed khu bo mngag 'dod ma yin te: dus de ring ma mngag thabs med byung: me dmar bo'i kha ya yongs mkhan la: chab gaṅga'i chu klung ma gtogs med:dug nag po'i kha ya yongs mkhan la: lho sgro ldan rma bya ma gtogs med:gnas sde brgyad las la bkol mi la: sngags mthu ldan zhal ngo ma gtogs med: don de phyir stag rong rgyal po yis: dbu srin rmog nam mkha'i thog thub la: mjes dar 'phru snga 'phru gra sgrigs kyis: rgyab srin khrab mu de tshem tshem la: rno go mtshon dgu tshan tshang ba gyis: sde srin rta 'phar ba rnga nag la: 'dzoms sga srab 'ja' tshon bkrag 'dra byos: khyed mi pho rgas yang dpa' rtsal rgod: rta na so mtho yang bang kha mgyogs: dgung bar snang 207

rlung dang sdebs la pheb: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po kho: dpung rgyab gnon dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcas: dpa' tshod med gling la rgyugs rgyu red: lam mi mthong sgrib shing 'khor lo tshugs: gling mi mthong ngan sngags drag po bzlos: sde gling sgar chag 'jigs med pa gyis: nom dgu tshan dgu yi 'bul ba 'di: dpon khyed la dpa' ngo mtshon tsam yin: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: dpon khro rgyal thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung ba dang khro thung dga' spro dang bcas lags so zhes bka' dang du blangs nas gra sgrigs thams cad 'grub tshar ba dang gling sgar gyi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la sgrub shing rdul rdzas yongs sgrib te btsugs tshar ba dang: mi min khrag ral rgyal po kho btsan dar ma las la chas pa ltar gling dmag gi sgar 'dab nas phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs 'ga' byas nas ci bya gtol med par gyur tshe: byang dmag rnams kyis rgyal po'i rjes chod nas thugs gso dang zhu ba nan gyis phul zhing phyir pho brang du mi log thabs med gyur: dpon mo byang bza' chu yi lha mo'i sems la: da lo g.yul gyi 'khrug mtshams 'di nas 'thab ya rgod che: rgyal po khong yang mi thub u tshugs kyi dpa' kher ngoms dang: dpung kher 'gran byed khul byed 'dug pa 'di dgras chag sgos ded pa thag chod: da rang srog blos ma btang gong 208

la thabs gcig bya bsam zhing gsol chang gi bcud la mun chu dwangs med kyi rul bu blug nas phul bas rgyal po nag thom me 'dug pa las thabs ma byung: de yang byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo dpon g.yog bco lnga la gling dmag brgya bskor tsam gyis bskor nas mi min seng ri dgra 'dul gyi rtse la skyo bsang du btang bas: gling gi dpa' bo rnams kyi sa cha med kyi lo rgyus la nyan 'dod che bar yang mi 'ga' res ri gan la ming ci 'dra yod: sa gan la lo rgyus ci 'dra 'dug ces yang yang dris pas tshe: byang gi bu mo rnams kyang rgyal khang las 'gro sdod mang po ma myong bas rkyen gyis sa cha med du song gshis bltas nas 'dug pa las lan ci yang bshad rgyu ma rnyed:byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mos phyag gi bya ra mdzad kyin ldem 'gros gar stabs shigs se tshur sngon la pheb cing khra bo ri brtsis kyi glu 'di byang glu ngang dkar ldem drug la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: chos sku kun tu bzang mo dang: longs sku rdo rje phag mo'i sku: sprul sku khros ma nag mo sogs: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro rnams la 'dud: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min seng ri dgra 'dul red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi lus gcig la bskos thengs gnyis: lo chung dbang bo dar ba'i dusoḥ mi min khrag ral rgyal po yi: sras mo tshe 'dzin dbang mo yin: mnga' thang dbyar gyi mtsho la 209

'gran: tshe mtha' las kyi bskos thengs te: cha med sde mtha' nag po nas:skyid sdug mi lag rgyud dgos byung: bde sdug nyi ma gar chod red: ci byung ci nyes bya ba rnams: gangs dkar sems la nges tshod min: de nas 'dir tshogs gling gi dmag: yang sgos na chung bu mo rnams: gson dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod: ma phyin rdzong la bsdad bsdad nas: rang yul sa la gsal cha med: ma bshad tshig sgo gdams gdams nas: glu len ngag sgo mi khrol 'dug: sgra 'dzin dbang bo tshur la gtod: khra chung mig gi ltad mo gzigs: gzigs dang mig gi mthong lam na: 'dzam gling byang gi yul sa rnams: lag mthil ri mo bzhin du mthong: ltad mo ci 'dra che nas 'dug:lo rgyus gtam gyi bshad srol yod: dpag tshad dgu yi yar phyogs na: ri mtho gnam la zug 'dra gan: byang ri gnam bya mthon po red: bre ser 'brong gi pha yul red: dpag tshad mang po'i phar mtha' na: ban dhe khri la bzhugs 'dra gnoḥ srin po khros pa'i rngams ri zer: gyad mi stong bdud bla ri red: de nas mar la lta mtshams na: dung gi mchod rten brtsigs 'dra gan: gter brag spos ri mchong yag red: mi min byang gi dngul gter gnas: de nas mar la lta ba'i sar: dred mo'i ri rtsib 'grim 'dra gan: dred kyi lha ri dgu thogs zer: gcan gzan bu dgu'i gnas sa red: de nas mar la lta mtshams na: rta rgod sgrogs la bcug 'dra gan:210

bla ri 'brong rgod 'gying yag zer: gyad mi gza' rgod bla ri red: de nas tshur la lta mtshams noḥ chu chen rba rlabs nyi li li: gangs chu lu ma rab med red: de nas tshul la lta mtshams na: dpag tshad mang po brgal ba'i sar: gangs dkar dgung gi ka ba gan: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red:khrag ral dpon gyi rgyal sa red: bu mo nga yi pha mkhar red: 'byor phyug g.yang gi ra ba red: de nas shar la lta mtshams na: srin po bgegs la khros 'dra'i mkhar: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: de nas tshul la lta mtshams na: gshin rje dgra la shor 'dra'i mkhar: lho rdzong dkar po dkris yag red: de nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: rdzong btsan rin chen spungs 'dra gan: nub rdzong khu byug mgrin yag red: de nas byang gi phyogs rol na: 'chi bdag las la rgyugs 'dra'i mkhar: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: sa btsan brag ri sgo med la: rdzong btsan lcags mkhar bsribs med gda': rdzong phran rtsi rtsi grangs med yod: 'gag dogs gshin rje'i rgyu lam yod: dug thang mun pa thar med yod: mi min bdud kyi grong khyer yod:go don yid la e yod thal: mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa yi: legs nyes shan 'byed nus pas lha: dgongs pa dbyings la ma g.yel la: byang gling sdig pa'i na bun 'di: mi 'gyang mtshams 'jog yod par shog: rma khams gling gi ge sar kho: sangs rgyas sprul ba yin pas zeroḥ sdig ltung 211

las la e 'dzems bsam: byang thang me tog ra ba de: mi rta shi ba'i dur sa byas: de nas na chung bu mo rnams: mgo 'phang ma dman a bar rig:rgyal pham tshangs pa lha la yod: skye 'chi mgo nag mi la yod: dar rgud 'gro ba yongs la yod: chag 'jig gor mo rdo la yod: skrag na pha ma mi 'bod rgyu: grab brgyag pho yi ngang tshul yin: sdug na mchi ma mi 'don rgyu: na gzhon snang ba'i khyer so yin: ltogs na rang sha mi za rgyu: 'jig rten mi yi chos nyid red: skoms na 'dam chu mi 'thung rgyu: kha dkar rkyang gi ngang tshul red: 'jig rten las kyi bskos thengs la: rang cag na chung bu mo yi:pha yul gtan gyi sdod sa min: skye sa na sa 'chi sa gsum: gshin rjes khram la gar btab red: 'chi bdag dpon la bros sa med: rgas pa'i gnyer ma byi rgyu med: sngon gyi las la zur rgyu med: rang thag rang gis chod pa gyis: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: 'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du bu mo rnams kyis kyang byang sras mos glu la yid ches nas mgo 'phang mtho 'dzin byas: srung dmag rnams kyi yid la sha tsha yang phyir mi mngon par gnas tshe: ma ne ne gong sman rgyal mos byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo ge sar la blo mi gtod par dam tshig la mi gnas pa rtogs nas de ma thag a sngon nam mkha'i dbyings rim nas me 212

tog gi char phab pa tsam pa ka dang: gur gum: u dam wa ra: utpal sogs dang: khrus bzang chu gtsang brgyad kyi bcud kyi gtams pa brab cing: sprin dkar dmar 'thab pa'i klong nas mdzes sdug lang tsho'i chos kun tshang ba lta ba mig gi bu lon sod nus pa zhig byas shing tshe chang tshe ril sogs phyag tu bsnams te mgur glu snyan pa'i sgra ldan mkha' 'gro'i ldem chen 'gug pa'i lha dbyangs la drangs nas blangs so:na mo ḍā ki ka li bo: glu a la skye med stong ba'i glu: glu tha la thams cad sgrol ba'i ngag: rtsal 'gags med snang stong mnyam pa nyid: don chen po'i brda don char du snyil: gnas 'di 'dra skye med nam mkha'i khams:sprin 'ja' tshon 'khor lo'i nang shed red: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:sman 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral nasoḥ nga a ne gong sman rgyal mo yin: dpal ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gror bzhengs: ya de nas na chung tshe 'dzin ma: blo sems chung ma byed tshur la gson: gling 'dzam gling skyes bu ge sar khong: mgon sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sprul red: phyi drag po'i mdzad tshul g.yul 'khrug cing: nang stong nyid don la g.yo ba med: 'di'i bsad 'dren gnyis la rang dbang thob: spyir 'dzam gling yongs kyi dpa' bo red: khong dngos yod mi dbang rgyal po red: yang dngos med lha yi gtso bo red: ma na chung khyed dang dam tshig gcig: sems 'gyur ba med 213

pas blo rtse gtod: yab bdud rgyal nyes pa shes par mdzod: don chen po btang snyoms ga la rung: dus de ring rten 'brel dang po la: ngas gtsang ma chab kyis khrus mchog gsol: rkyen bar chad bag sgrib dag bar shog:lus ngan pa'i lam de bsal du gsol: da yang dag las kyi mgo ma la: ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gros dbang zhig bskur: yid dam pa gsum gyi gzhung bskyed cig: gnas bde chen spros bral pho brang nas: lha mdzes ldan gangs ri'i mdog can ma: yum kun tu bzang mos sher dbang bskur: don stong nyid rtogs pa'i mthu thob shogoḥ gnas longs spyod rdzogs ldan zhing khams nas: lha ratna'i mdog can mkha' 'gro ma: dpal rdo rje phag mos rtsa dbang bskur: dgra gnyis 'dzin log rtogs rtsad nas gzhom: gnas dur khrod so so'i zhing khams nas: lha 'phrin las lnga yi mdangs ldan ma:dpal khros ma lha lngas srog dbang bskur: phyi dug lnga dug gsum dgra las rgyal: nang rtogs tshogs rang grol sangs rgyas shog: ma mthing mdog mkha' 'gro sngon mo'i tshogs: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi dbang bskur bas: rtsal chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur shog: ma dung mdog mkha' 'gro dkar mo'i tshogs: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: shar rdo rje rigs kyis dbang bskur bas: rtsal me long ye shes mngon gyur shog: ma 214

gser mdog mkha' 'gro ser mo'i tshogasoḥ gnas mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: lho rin chen rigs kyis dbang bskur bas: rtsal mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur shog: ma mtshal mdog mkha' 'gro dmar mo'i tshogs: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: nub padma rigs kyis dbang bskur bas: rtsal sor rtogs ye shes mngon gyur shog:ma g.yu mdog mkha' 'gro ljang mo'i tshogs: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: byang las kyi rigs kyis dbang bskur bas: rtsal bya grub ye shes mngon gyur shog: gzhan tshe chang tshe ril la sogs pa: rdzas 'chi med mkho rgu'i longs spyod rnams: ma na chung khyed la phul ba bzhes:sku mjes sdug lang tsho ldan par shog: gsung zab don 'gag pa med par shog: thugs 'khrul med sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par sho ga: sku seng chen bla ma'i zhabs phyi 'grub: bod dbu nag 'gro ba'i don chen rnams: lha'i dam bca' gnyan po ma g.yel bar: ma 'gro ba'i las la brtson bar mdzod: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: ma byang bza'i thugs la de ltar zhogoḥces gsung ba dang mnyam du ma mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde sde tshan lnga ru gril te: dbus mthing mdog ḍā ki thams cad yi ge oṃ dkar po la sprul te dbang bskur: shar dkar mo'i sde tshogs yi ge ā: dmar po: lho ser 215

mo'i sde tshogs hūṃ mthing ka: nub dmar mo'i sde tshogs swā ser bo: byang ljang mo'i sde tshogs hā ljang gu rnams kyis rang bzhin gyis dbang bskur don dang ldan par byas te sku'i bkrag mdangs la nyi ma shar: gsung grags stong la sngags dbyangs 'khor: thugs bde stong la smin grol gyi skal ba mchog dang ldan zhing mi min byang gi sras mo la sngar las dge sems che bas snod du gyur nas: gling ge sar rgyal po la mi phyed pas dad pa rgyud la skyes: lhas bka' las mi 'da' bas dam bca' thob nas byang mi min dngul gyi rdzong chen gling gis len thub pa'i lde'u mig rang lag la byung ba yin skad do:216

le'u dgu ba/gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gtsos/ /'brug rgod rtsal ldan 'khor bcas kyis/ /dung skyong dpon gyi sgar la gtugs/ /ri lung khrag gi kha mdog bsgyur/ /de'i skabs su byang gi lho rdzong nas gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gis blon tshogs rnams la dmag gros mang du byas mthar dmag phar rgyugs kyi rting ma thengs gcig len rgyu thag gis bcad nas de nub rang rang gi rdzong la log: nyi ma de yi phyir nyin gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang dang:'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod: rtsal ldan byang ri stong thub: rtsal ldan dug dung nag po: rtsal ldan padma grags rgod: rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang bcas la khri dmag brgyad kyis bskor nas rdul rlung tshub se dung skyong gi sgar la song ngo:der gling gi so ba rnams kyis mthong nas brda sprad pa dang: mu stegs a bu kha bde: g.yu bses stobs ldan nag po: mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang: a bses lha 'bum rgyal sras bcas kyi go gyon mtshon thogs 217

kyis sgar bzung nas bsdad: dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar dang: stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa: 'ol kha'i ya lang nag po bcas dpon blon gsum po tshur sngon la mda' rgyang gi thon pasoḥ byang dmag gi sngon du gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang slebs shing yob 'gyur dang bcas gzhu steng la mda' gcig bzhag nas yin lugs dang dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: yar mkhyen srin po lcags ral mkhyen: dpa' bo'i rting ma dgung la bstod: bar mkhyen bdud btsan me 'bar mkhyen: bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:mar mkhyen sman mo rkang 'jibs mkhyen: ma thub dgra la rting ma longs:rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral mkhyen: byang gi bu rta dar bar shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi pha yul nas: lho rdzong dkar po dkris yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes noḥ khrag ral khri gdugs nyi ma la: khrag 'thung dpa' bzang dung zla tshes: dung zla phu nu'i snying bcud la: khrag 'thung dgra gshed nag po yinoḥ de nas bu sdug rta dkar can: yin nges dung skyong dpon dang 'dra: dung skyong blun po bla btsong khyod: khyi rgan dgu las thu nges red: rgod 'dod rting ma'i zan khrid deoḥ gces srog dgra la shor rtags red: go khrab mtshon gyi rgyan cha dang: 'do ba rta pho rgyugs 'gro'i 218

can: thob nges a pho'i rting ma babs: sprang ma'i bsags pa'i sbrang ji de:tha ma gzhan gyis spyod pa bzhin: sdar ma'i gyon pa'i dpa' chas rnams: ya med dpa' bo'i rgyan la len: gling sdug dpa' med skyag lang rnams:mi min yul du rgod pa min: byang stod mi min sa cha na: khrag ral rgyal po dbang thang che: gyad mi che bzhi dpung re btsan: rtsal ldan blon por stobs re che: 'bum dmag kha grangs ser ltar 'bebs: yang sgos gyad mi khrag 'thung ngas: ma bsad dgra la gcig kyang med: ma 'phrog nom la gnyis kyang med: ma thub rgod po'i gnya' nas gnon: ma nus gnyen la nga 'dra med: dpa' rgod snying khams gzhan las che: dom nag khrag gis bzi ba 'dra: rtsal drug myur mgyogs rlung la 'gran: rang bstod min de 'dra ma yin: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: mda' gcig mi 'phen thog gi mda': me stag zi ra 'tshubs se 'phen: gzhu gcig mi 'gugs brag gi ri: brag chen ri bo mdo nas 'gugs: lcags ral srin pos yar mchog srung: 'brug sgra glog 'od 'khyug se 'khyug: rkang 'jibs sman gyi mar mchog srung: me stag zi ra 'tshub se 'tshub: bdud btsan me 'bar 'chang bzung srung: 'ur sgra 'brug stong ldir ri ri: brag ral lha yis mda' sne srung: ma thub dgra yi snying la ya: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:219

ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs pas: dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar gyis brang la thebs nas sing sgra dang bcas khrab gtor yang nang du ge sar gyis srung mdud yod pas mtshon ma blangs:der dung skyong na re: 'o na byang phrug kha spobs can: gtam de 'dra bshad pa ngo re tsha: stong gtam g.yu 'brug grags grags nas: lag len stong ba'i 'ja' la dpe: nga dpa' bo'i sngon na ci go red zer zhing mda' ltong sprad de glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: mgon skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang: yul gnas bdag rma rgyal sbom ra sogs: ngas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: bdud ma rung dgra 'dre rdul du bzlog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas lho rdzong dkar po dkris yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo shes na: lho mon pa g.yang gi sa cha nas:mkhar dung mkhar rgyang grags nang bcud nga: bu dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar yin: dpung 'bum dmag kha lo bsgyur mi yin: dpa' klu bdud nag po'i ngo ya yin: gling 'bum dmag dkyil gyi ru 'dren yin: khyod bdud phrug sngon gyi gshed ma yin: mda' rtsal chen shugs kyis kha lo bsgyur: byang bdud phrug rgod kyang rten sa med: shi phyi ma'i yul gyi 'phreng ring la: skyabs mgon med byang phrug snying re rje: de min pa'i byung rgyu ci 220

yang med: dpe da nang nam mkha' lang dang gcig: yang do dgong mun mgo rub dang gnyis: kho gshin rjes pho nya byung dang gsum: de khebs chen dpon gyis khebs sa med: dpung btsan po'i dmag gis srung sa med: phyug che nas rgyu yi bslu sa med: nyam chung yang yi mug 'don sa med: mda' 'phen pa 'phur shes thog gi lce: dpe de dang khyad par ga la yod: khyod byang phrug brag dkar gtor 'dra byed: khyod ma bzhag mda' mo 'phen par bskul: ngas ma phog zur na skyen po min: yang ma chod lus na thog mda' min: da ma bros ma bros byang gi bu: bros zer yang thar ba ye nas med: snying dmar po'i dkyil la phogs pa zhig: phyi rus pa'i gses mkhar gtor ba zhig: nang khrag gi yur chu 'dren pa zhig: sha bya khyi'i zan la bor ba zhig: rta 'do ba nom la lon pa zhig: dus gcig la ma nus dpa' bo min: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang: mda' myur bar 'phangs ba gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gi snying kar phogs mod ci yang ma gnod: ral kha 'gran yang pham rgyal ma byung zhing stag g.yag la rtsod pa ltar byed skad:der stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa dang: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod gnyis 'phrad nas dang po byang blon des yob snga sor rgyangs nas yin 221

lugs dang dpa' gtam sgrogs pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: ma thub gling sdug srog rtsa chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: lho rdzong dkar po dkris yag gi: lho thang 'o mtsho'i ya gong red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min khrag ral rgyal po yi: bka' blon dgra yi tho ba nga: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod yin: rtsal chen glog gi kha ya yin: 'khyugs chen nya yi 'gyur ya yin: ngar chen stag gi kha ya yin: stobs chen gyad kyi dpung ya yin: de 'dra ya med byang blon nga: byang ba bsod nams che nas dbang: de nas gling phrug dmag sngon nas: khyad par sngon ma sngon po skya: ro rna ro yis ma gab na: glu len tshig la dpyad pa thongs: byang yul zho bzhin chags pa de:gling sdug sdar mas khrag bzhin dkrugs: des lan 'bum dmag phyed dgos byed: dpung med mtha' ma dpa' rtul rnams: bros bros g.yang la lhung ba zhig: ge sar zer ba'i rgyang grags can: thag nag sha le khrims la khrid: de dus rdzu 'phrul e 'dug lta: lha yi mgon skyabs e myur shes: klu yi gdong grogs e byung rig: btsan gyi 'thab rogs e 'dug mthong: de min byung rgyu ci yang med: ge sar dpung gi dmag rgod des: tshe stod rgyal 222

khams bcom bcom nas: rgyu nor longs spyod dpung gis 'phrog: mi sde sdug la bkod bkod nas: tha ma byang la 'gran ya tshad: rtsal ldan stag mo'i ngar lam nas: sdar ma gling sdug shul med bcom: gzhan la byas pa'i sdug bzhag rnams: rang la byung dus yi re mug: sngar 'gyod bsam na mchi ma shor: da 'gyod bsam na brang khog brdung: dga' 'am sdug to gling gi bu: dga' na mug ngo 'dzum 'dzum gyis: sdug na snying nas 'gyod bshags rem: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod ngas: dpa' rtsal rting ma mi ngom na: gling sdug shul med mi bzo na: 'bum dmag dug mtsho lud 'dra na: dug gi sdong po khrag ral yod: blon tshogs dug gi dpa' ngar ldan:'gran na dgra srog dmar bo gcod: rta pho rgyugs chen nom la len: rting ma yongs la grags pa byed: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs nas kho yi glu lan ci 'dug la bsgug pa dang:stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa na re: mi min blon po dpa' rgod can:skyag lab ma mang glu la nyon: byang na dmar gzhung gi kha dkar rkyang: mi khyod kyis 'og rta e nyan na: dbus ri rab lhun po'i bre ser 'brong: pho khyod kyis rwa rdo e sprod dam: kha stong gtam tshig gi lo ma la: 'bras e smin ltad mo zur nas lta zer zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:223

glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: zhing mngon dga' dpal ldan bde ba can: yang las rab rdzogs dang stug po bkod:lha rdo rje sems dpa' rin chen 'byung: dpal snang mtha' don yod grub pa dang: mgon rnam snang la sogs rigs lnga'i lha: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sdang dgra srog chod la rting ma longs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: sde mi min byang gi lho rdzong gi: lho thang chen 'o mtsho'i ya gong red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nub stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa yin: gling dka' rtul rnams kyi gral gyi rgyan: rmog dkar po'i nang nas dbu 'phang mtho: khrab dkar po'i nang nas sku tshe ring: rta 'do ba'i steng nas dgra bla 'khor: yang de sngon nyi ma yan chad la: dpa' de byas rting ma blang ba bden: byang mi min tsam la a 'u ci: rkang ldog 'og 'bu la mi rtsi lags: sde nag po bdud dang ser bo hor: yul smug po 'jang dang ku ne mon: phyogs bdud chen ru bzhi chom la phab: dpa' ngar rgod byang gi che zhig red: dmag kha grangs byang gi mang zhig red: yang da rung de yi ga la tshad: rdzong chen po dgu dang rdzong phran rnams: nom phul 'dod min te dbang du bsdus: stobs ma 'gran mgo 'bul byas pa min: g.yul chen po'i dpa' rtags me chen 'bar: skyen mda' rtags byang gi yan zhig red: dpa' snying khams byang gi che zhig red: dus da lo mi min byang ba 224

tsho: shi ran pas nad pa 'tshab chen 'dra: gto sman dpyad med pa a re skyo: snum tshad pa'i mar me kong chung 'dra: yun mi ring las 'di mi skyo 'am: ming rtsal ldan thogs pa don re chung: pho dpa' med wa mo khyu gcig red: stobs 'gran pa'i snying khams phar la zhog: dbugs stod la 'tshang nas ya la la: yang sgos su byang blon khyi phrug khyod: rgyab go btsan mi zin slog hril rdzong: lag mtshon rtags mi zhog 'jag ma'i mda': kha tshig mtshon mi phogs dig pa'i rtse: dpe bzhag na 'jig rten gleng tshul la: pho sdar ma'i tshul chos don la med: dpa' snying khams 'gran na bag la zha:ma bu mo'i dpa' snying gting na med: mda' tsha mo phul na sdar skad shor:rta rgod ma'i bang la rgyugs sna med: thang yangs po'i dkyil nas sa la 'gril: de zer ba bzhin du byung ba mang: nga zhal dkar khros pa'i ngar lam nas: dgra 'chi bdag yin kyang phyir bros brgyag: byang sdar ma khyod la khag po med: rgyab khrab dkar phud la mgo 'bul gyisoḥ mtshon sngon mo longs la thang du zhog: srog mi gcod zhal dkar dpa' tshod 'dzin: da de min g.yul du 'thab 'dod na: dpa' stag mo da mchong zhal dkar bu:gyad dpa' bo'i 'jigs rngams kha kha yin: rta 'do ba da rgyugs rlung gshog rta: bya thang dkar 'phur ba'i gshog ya yin: nub stag gzig dpung gi bdag nyid nga: rtsal myur mgyogs glog gi las la gzhol: gtam 225

e bden da lta gsal nas yongs: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod kyis go btsan bzung nas 'dug pa la mda' brgyab par kho la byang mi min gyi srung ma sman mo rkang 'jibs kyi bla gos ljang gu zhig yod pas mdas phigs: khos mda' zhal dkar gyi brang nu ma gnyis kyi mtshams la phogs kyang stong log tu gyur: der mdung 'gran byas par 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod kyi mdung ring ba'i stabs kyis zhal dkar gyi rta bsad: de dang lhan tu byang blon gyis kho la mtshon mi 'gro ba shes nas rdo lug ro tsam zhig gong len gyis blang ba 'phen thengs gcig gis zhal dkar gyi brang la phogs nas sa la sgril zhing re zhig brgyal: de nas rtsal ldan padma grags rgod dang: rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang: rtsal ldan byang ri stong thub: rtsal ldan dug dung nag po rnams gcig rgyab gnyis gnon gyis mchong byung ba dngoḥgling sgar nas mu stegs a bu kha bde: g.yu bses stobs ldan nag po: a bses lha 'bum rgyal sras: mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang rnams rgyang rgyang gi sngon la thon te phan tshun mda' rgyang gi sa mtshams nas so sos go bzung te 'tshub 'khyil ler 'dug pas skabs su: gling dpa' rtul gyi khrod nas mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang tshur gdong la gcar zhing yob snga 226

sor rgyangs nas rta kha bkag cing dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dngoḥ rgyud sde bzhi yi lha la 'dud: byin rlabs —dngos grub ci 'dod stsol: dgra bgegs ma lus rtsad nas chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi lho rdzong gi: thang chen 'o mtsho'i ya gong red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ge sar rgyal po'i bka' yi blon: rting ma dgra la ngoms mi nga: mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang yin: rgya bod yongs la grags pa che: 'dzam gling bod kyi sa cha na: dpon la ge sar chos gyi rgyal: blon la grub chen brgyad cu bzhi: 'bangs la lha sde dkar po'i tshogs: me tog bzhin tu 'khrungs nas yod: rtsi shing bzhin tu rgyas nas yod: bu yug bzhin tu 'tshub nas yod: skar tshogs bzhin tu bkra nas yod: kha ya e yongs bsam blo thongs: de nas byang blon rta ser can: ri rgyal lhun po'i kha ya la: bye phung skya bo'i yongs ba min: g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i grags ya la: a tshags ba tshags ga la rung: dmar yag stag gi kha ya la: sdar ma wa mo'i mi lo lags: de sngon nyi ma'i gdugs 'og nasoḥ gling sde zho ltar chags pa la: byang gi khrag ltar cis phyir dkrugs: rma khams gling gi sa cha nas: 'bum dmag mi byung ka med 'di: byang ba'i bkug pas mgron po yin: srid pa mi yi bshad srol la: snga dro rang rdzong gru bzhi 227

na: gsar skyes stag shar snang ba mtho: dgung mo g.yul gyi bas mtha' nas: g.yul pham wa skad shor ba yod: snga dro rang khyim g.yang ra na: na chung bu mo mgo 'phang mtho: dgung mo mun nag sde mtha' na: gnyom chung gzhan ngo 'tshol ba yod: snga dro rang yul byang mkhar na: khas len stag mo ngar ngar te: dgung mo shar gling dpa' sngon nas: shi lam nag po snyeg pa yod: zer bas gtam dang mi mthun nam: pha ma'i sngon gyi dpa' gtam de: btsan po dgra la 'gro ba min: brtse ba'i grogs la kha spobs de: lag len dngos la babs pa min: pho gsar dpa' grogs mang na ngar: mda' gsar pha rol 'ben la 'gro: rta gsar rtswa chus 'grangs na rgyugs: ban gsar snang ba mtho drag na: sdom li shor bas snga ltas yin: shes med bu mo rang snang che: kha dgu 'khor bas snga ltas yin: byang phrug dpa' med mug snang mtho: g.yul du pham pas snga ltas yin: blun po u thug gnyen la thung:gri ngan lag pa'i steng la rno: e shes byang ba mi min sde: gling rgod dpa' rtul dpung gi tshogs: mgo 'bul skyabs zhur gang nas yongs: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: khrag ral mug srog gcod dang gcig: rtsal ldan shul med btang dang gnyis: 'bum dmag phyed bgos bzo rgyu gsum: dngul rdzong gling gi len rgyu sogs: ma bzhag rang bzhag las 'gan yin: dang po g.yul gyi che rtags la: nyag phran mda' yi gser khal dang: rno ba 228

mtshon gyi dngul khal gnyis: khra ring mdung gi nor rgyan gsum: khrag ral dpon la che 'bul byed: rtsal ldan dpung la 'bring 'bul byed: 'bum dmag dpung la chung 'bul byed: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du rtsal ldan padma grags rgod de ngar chen gyis gdong la mchong nas mda' ltong sprad ma thag tu yin lugs gtam gyi gleng mo'i glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: srin lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang:yang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: dgra ma thub gling sdug ngo ya mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: sde mi min byang gi sa cha nas: gnas lho rdzong dkar po dkris yag gi: lho thang chen 'o mtsho'i ya gong red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpa' rtsal ldan padma grags rgod yin: khyod gling sdug gsod pa'i shan pa la: nga rten 'brel las kyis bskos pa 'dra: shing lcang dkar lha shing skye ba 'dra: zhing ma btab lo ma 'khrungs ba 'dra: ya de nas nga la tshur nyon dang: khyod kha bshad stong ba'i 'brug sgra de: don lag len med pa'i snga ltas red: nga dpa' bo'i zhe rtsa 'khrugs nas byung:dpa' rting ma dgung la grags pa len: dus de ring khyod dang 'u gu gnyis:229

pham zer na khyod kyis nyo le gcig: yang sdar ma'i wa skad shor ba byed:dpa' zer na kho rang bstod le gcig: stobs rtsal drug dgung la grags pa byed: de ma thub shi ba'i ro dang 'dra: khyod de ring bros na sdar ma wa:sdar rnga ma sha le bros pa las: stag 'dzum drug shigs se 'chi na dga'oḥ nga gom gang bros pa'i sdar ma min: byang mi min 'bum dmag phyug mo na: bu byang phrug dug gi so kha rgyas: yang sgos su lan med rtse dgu'i mtshon: nga rtsal ldan padma grags rgod srid: yul 'di nas mi thub 'chi bdag kho: nga dpa' bo byung na phyir bros brgyag: ngas lag la bzung ba'i gzhu mo 'di:sra lcags gzhu leb ma 'od ldan zer: 'gugs zer na gnam sa ring nas 'gugs: rno lcags mda' sha zan 'bar ba zer: 'phen zer na dgra srog rbad kyis gcod: don bden min lag len 'debs nas yongs: mig khra chung ltad mo tshur la gzigs: sems gangs dkar dpyad pa zhib du thongs: yang min na mgo 'bul lus 'bul gyis: srog dmar po rang la dbang bar nges: gnyen mdza' bshes kha bral dgos pa min: blo sngon la khed na mkhas pa yin: gyod rjes la lhag na glen pa zer: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang: rtsal ldan padma grags rgod kyis myur 230

mor mda' gcig 'phangs pas: mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang gi nu ma g.yon pa'i thog la phog cing gnod ma thub: khong gis mda' de glog dmar mched pa ltar rtsal ldan padma grags rgod kyi rmog gi pho byang la phog pa go btsan pas ma thags par yang skyar ral kha 'gran mthar mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang gis byang phrug bsgral: der byang dmag gi nang nas rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang gis bya ba ngan pa de mthong nas nga rgyal gyi me 'bar gyin tshur gdong la bud nas yob 'gyur dang bcas rta kha en tsam 'then zhing dpa' gtam yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral srin gyi tshogs la 'bod: rang yul bu rta'i kha mgon mdzod: bdud btsan me 'bar khros pa rtsal: mtha' 'dre dgra yi dmod ngan bzlog: sman mo rkang 'jibs myur mgyogs can: rting ma dgung la grags par shog: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: yul la bde skyid dar bar shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: lho rdzong dkar po dkris yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: de sngon nyi ma yan chad la: dpa' chen dgung la grags pa de: rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang yin: khrag ral rgyal gyi thugs brtse che: gling sdug tsam zhig phar la zhog: 'chi bdag dogs sa'i bu zhig yin: ro yi na thang bzo'i le gan: gling sdug dur sa gsar ba 231

red: rus pa'i ro mkhar de'u chung gan: gling sdug dpung gi beem po redoḥkhrag gi yur chu gsar ba gan: gling sdug mi rta'i snying khrag red: g.yul chen gnam nag 'khrug nas bzung: mi rta'i dpung gral ra ba nas: glu blangs ngag 'gug grangs las 'das: tshig mtshon mda' mo rab tu gzu:gling sdug lkug pa'i khyu min na: glu lan med pa ci go red: byang rta'i bang mgyogs rlung la dpe: gling rta bong lu'i bang kha 'khum: dpung rgod 'thab ya med med nas: gling sdug wa mo'i khyu 'di sdug: 'on kyang mi srid 'khrul snang la: tshod zin med pa'i ge sar dang: byur gyis ded pa'i dpa' rtul tshogs: thabs shes med pas spyi dpon rgyal: rang dbang bral ba'i 'bum dmag bcas: byang thang yangs po'i dga' tshal la: beem sgog dur sar bskyal nas thon: byang phrug sdig la mi 'tsher te: gling sdug shi la mi skrag gam: rtsal ldan 'phar spyang dpung sdeb kyis: gling phrug ra lug khyu mthud de: ra la thug na ra gsod dang: lug la thug na lug gsod byed: mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang khyod: kha bshad che la lag len zhan: snang ba mtho la dpa' rtsal chung: a re rmi lam ga 'dra rmis: bzi ba yin nam smyos pa yin: mi yul nyams dga'i pha khyim na: rdzong dang 'tsho rten longs spyod sogs: gtan tu spyod par mi dga' 'am: skyid ya sdug rogs na chung ma:'grogs yun bsrings na mi legs sam: dal gcig mi lus lon pa 'di:232

don med g.yul du shi 'dod dam: dpa' 'dod rting ma rtsod bsam na:ma 'dug la mo mchong la shog: su rgyal thag de gcod dang chog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs bas mtha' btsan nor bu dpa' bzang gi brang la thebs nas go khrab dang srung ba gang gis ma bsten par chu srin dung gis thags pa ltar dgrong shor: der byang gling gnyis kyi g.yul drag tu bkye bzhin pa'i sgang la 'ol kha'i ya lang nag po thugs khro rab tu bzhes nas nga rgyal bzod mi thub pa zhig gi ngang nas glog 'khyugs pa ltar rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang gi gdong bkag nas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: gling ge sar srung ma mthu stobs can: dus de ring dpa' bo'i kha mgon mdzod: dpa' rting ma dgra la mi shor zhing: don thams cad 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: yul mi min byang gi sprang rdzong 'dab: lho mug rdzong dkar po dkris yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga 'ol kha'i ya lang nag po yin: ya kho re nyon dang byang gi bu: dgra rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang khyod: wa sdar ma stag la rdzi lam nas: khong mtha' btsan 'bum 233

dpon zhal ras nog: sha lan la sha dmar dgu bskor dgos: khrag lan lastag gi mchod pa dgos: de ma lon snying nad ga la zhu: dpa' ya lang dgra yi tho ba nga: 'gran rtsod mi mang yang do zla med: dpa' yang dag thag te de ring gcod: byang mi min dpa' med stag gsob can: sde 'bum dmag dbang med bshas rar bcug: mi mang bsad sdig pa'i kha gnon red: dpa' khas len yod na gdong la bud: da de min dpa' bo'i lag sdig 'dzem: byang mi min khyi phrug sdar ma wa: khyi rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang lags: go btsan po gyon yang dpa' rtsal zhanoḥ mda' gzhu la 'gengs yang mtheb shugs chung: glu 'bras med ngag te 'dar ra ra: khyod yin gcig min gnyis shi ba las: lam bzang po 'dems dbang de ring med:khyod sdar ma'i nang gi nyes can red: bya pho rog nang gi kha ta red: khyi rda li'i nang gi ha tsha red: glang rog po'i nang gi bong lu red: gson yan por shor na dpa' bo min: wa ga ma'i ming de btag na chog: sngon 'jig rten gna' mi'i ngag rgyun loḥ ban khom 'dod las gral 'tshang ba de:sdom dam tshig rtsis med byed shom red: rgan mgo dkar gyod la dga' ba deoḥ bu tsha bo dgra khar skyel rtags red: sman na chung 'ur mgo mtho ba de:sdug lan chags las la 'khor rtags red: khyi rda li ngar tshod med pa de:rdo gor mo klad la phog rgyu red: de zer ba bzhin du thon nas byung: shar 234

dung seng g.yu yi ral ba can: gangs srin 'bu nag pos sku la gnodoḥstag dmar yag mtshal gyi ldab sha can: sgang tsher ma can gyis kha la rmas:dpa' ya med mtha' btsan 'bum dpon khong: than byang phrug sdar mas lag nyes phog: nyams skyo ba'i las de a re sdug: dpa' yod mdog dpung ba phul mi khyod: yun mi ring phyi ma'i lam la bskyal: rta mgyogs mdog kha ru bkag mi dgos: nga dpa' bo'i nom la khrid nas 'gro: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces smras pa dang: mda' de me stag khrobs se 'phangs byung ba de rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang gi ya thod dpral ba'i gzhi mdo la phog nas mar me rlung gis bsad pa bzhin 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam la drangs: rtsal ldan byang ri stong thub kyis don de mthong nas 'chi ba srog la mi 'jem par phar gri bton zhing mchong yongs ba'i sngon la: a bses lha 'bum rgyal sras dngoḥmu stegs a bu kha bde: dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar: g.yu bses stobs ldan nag po: stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa: 'ol kha'i ya lang nag po:mon phrug sha zan khri gces: rong gi ra rgod ya med bcas byung pas: rtsal ldan byang ri stong thub kyis ral gri klad la 'phyar nas shor byung ba la: 'ol kha'i ya lang nag pos mda' brgyab nas kho'i rta bsad: myur bar yar 235

lang nas rtsal ldan khro ri ya lang gi rta sga stong du 'dug pa bcibs te the tshom med par dmag 'phru khra can mang du bcom: slar yang 'ol kha'i ya lang nag pos mdung phul nas rtsal ldan dug dung nag po mdung rtser skyon nas bsgral: gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang dang: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod gnyis kyis gdong blangs te ral kha 'gran nas nyi zla sprin gyis sgrib 'dra byas shing de nyin g.yul mtshams bzhag par gda':236

le'u bcu ba/stong bdud la sogs dmag la chas/ /bal sras dpa' bos sha lan blangs/ /shan pa 'khor bcas dpa' rtul dang / /stong bdud la sogs byang la 'thab/ /de yang nyin 'ga' yi rjes su shar rdzong nas gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig: thog lha gshin rje nag po: rtsal ldan me lha grags pa: rtsal ldan rdo rje grags pa: rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug thog rgod: rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod bcas rta dmag khri tsho drug gis bskor te shar brgyag gi gling sgar la chas:gling sgar gyi so ba rnams kyis mthong 'phrad brda sprad pas tshe sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po dang: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan: bal sras thog rgod ya med: stobs ldan grags pa thog rgod: li yi me ru ngo nag: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur bcas drag rim dpa' bo 'ga' yis 'bum dmag dug rlangs rdol ba bzhin du byang dmag gi sngon la gtug pas thog mar byang dpung nas gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig mda' rgyang gi dmag sngon la thon nas dpung ba dkrug: yob rnga sor rgyangs nas yin lugs 237

dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: lcags ral srin dang bdud btsan rtsal: sman mo rkang 'jibs myur mgyogs can: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: dpa' bor rting ma thob par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes noḥ mi min byang gi sa cha nas: shar rdzong nor bu'i 'gying thang red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig yin:'dzam gling yul gyi 'jig rten na: stong bdud thogs pa gcig las med:'do ba rlung 'dzin gnyis las med: dpa' ming don dang ldan pa ngasoḥgling phrug ma bsad bsam pa med: rgyu nor ma 'phrog bsam pa medoḥ de ring nyi ma'i gdung gang la: pho la su rgod mi lta re: rta la su mgyogs mi 'gran re: mda' la su skyen mi lta re: gling phrug skyag lang ngan shor te:byang rgod sngon la 'gro ba min: kha grangs mang ba gling ru'i dmag: byang thang ro yis bkang bar nges: rgod hrag e ldan de dus shes: seng ges g.yu ral ma bsigs na: 'brug sgras bar snang 'ur gyis gang: rma byas sgro mdog ma mngon na: ha la'i dug la 'gran ya med: mi min dpa' rtsal ma ngom na: gling sdug sdar ma dpa' mdog ston: a la mtshar gyi che ba la: de ring rting ma mda' la babs: mda' 'phen thog dmar kha lo bsgyuroḥgazhu 'gugs gnam sa ring nas 'gugs: gzhu 'di'i gzhu ngo ma shes na:238

lcags gzhu ri bo 'gugs chen zer: gzhu rgyun sra ba'i lcags la grub:shugs chen dpung gis rgyang lam nas: nyag phran gar gtad rang dbang thob: mda' 'di'i mda' ngo ma shes noḥ lcags mda' sha zan 'phur shes zer: 'phangs na dgra bo thar ba med: gshin rje'i zhags pa thebs pa 'dra: bros thar shor sa'i lam zhig med: phyi yi khrab dkar gtor ba gcig: nang gi sgyu lus gtub pa gnyis: khrag gi yur chu 'dren pa gsum:rus pa'i gram thang bzo nas 'jog: nam mkha' bya yis bkang ba dang:ri khyi sha yis tshims nas gda': ltad mo mig gi lam du 'dug: srin po lcags ral srin gyi rje: srin dmag bye ba 'bum dang bcas: sdang dgra gsod pa'i kha mgon mdzod: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar rtsal: bdud dmag bye ba 'bum dang bcas: ma thub dgra dpung chom la phob: sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs ma: 'gong po mi min mang pos bskor: sgos dgra'i bla tshe chod la shog: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral can: snang srid gzhi bdag 'khor gyis bskor: rang dpung srung la dgra srog chod: de ring stong bdud kha mgon mdzodoḥ dpung grogs mdzod la ma g.yel cig: kho re gling phrug dmar po skya: me dpung chu yis bsad pa bzhin: phyi ma'i yul la ltad mo song: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:239

ces glu de ltar blangs nas mda' de ldir sgra dang bcas 'phangs yang sdig gcod shan pa rgyal pos phub kyis bkag pas ma gnod: der shan pa na re: ya kho re stong bdud mig gcig bu: brel brel ma byed glu la gson zer zhing mda' ltong sprad de glu 'di 'bras thung dgra dpung zil gnon gyi ngag rta la drangs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: sde ser bo hor gyi lha tshogs dang: dpon ge sar skyes bu'i srung ma rnams: dus de ring shan pa'i glu sna drongs: mtha' bdud dang dam nyams chom la phob: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: ngas nye mo mig gis ma mthong ste: thag ring bo rna ba'i thos tshod la: sde mi min shar gyi sprang sgar gyi: yul 'gying thang bye ma'i yar mtha' red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga ser po hor gyi ru 'dren yin:gling ge sar skyes bu'i bka' blon yin: dpal gshin rje gshed kyi yang sprul yin: nga sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po yinoḥ ya de nas stong bdud mig gcig lags: nyan bsam na shan pa'i glu la gson: dpa' sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po nga: dgra rig rig gsod pa'i shan pa yin: dgra du sod shan pas rtsi ma myong: dgra de sod byas na shor ma myong: ngas rang bstod min te gnas lugs dngos: yid dad pa'i lha la gcig las med: yul rgya gar mi gcig lha gcig 'dra: pho rgod po dpa' rtul min pa med: byang 240

rtsal ldan wa mo'i khyu gral nas: khyod gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dpon:khyod gdon gyis ded dam byur gyis ded: srog dmar bo phul du yongs lugs la: nged rma khams gling gi pha dmag 'di: dpa' ngar rgod stag gzig kha sprod 'dra: khyod stong bdud mig gcig dpa' ming de: dpa' nga 'dra byung na gar song med: wa rnga ma sha le gad la gcar: kha skyag dri sha le bros lam btsal: nged khra mo gling dang mi min byang: sngar gyod dang da 'khon med sa nas: khyod byang phrug khyi mo skyag zan gyis: sde gnyis po khrag ltar dkrugs nas byung: dpa' med pa'i stong bdud 'phung rgan khyod:khyod rang mtshang mi shes gzhan la smad: dus tha ma pha jus gling gis 'phrog:khyod de dus dpa' gtam rlung gis 'khyer: dpa' snying khams rtsal drug dgung la yal: mda' de 'dra dgra la 'phen pa las: bu shugs chen 'ur rdo 'phangs na gzu: dpung 'bum tsho hor gyi sa cha nas: dpa' che nas dgung la grags pa nga: khyod ma shes shan pa me ru yin: dgra su thug gson la mngag ni med: rta mtshal sgong zer na rlung dmar 'dra: sdug khyod 'dra 'bu la mi rtsi to: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' 'phangs yang kho 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs pas gnod ma thub: de nas ja yun tsam la star gris 241

so kha 'gran kyang pham rgyal ma byung: de dang mnyam du thog lha gshin rje nag po dang: li yi me ru ngo nag gnyis thug pas thog mar thog lha gshin rje nag pos ngar chen gting nas 'khrugs shing stangs stabs dang bcas rta 'do ba'i kha ru 'then cing mda' ltong sprad nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la la mo a la len: nam mkha' mthing gi gur khang nas: lha chen srin po lcags ral mkhyen: bar snang yangs ba'i 'ja' 'od klong: srog bdag bdud btsan me 'bar mkhyen:sa gzhi mi 'gyur g.yang gi dkyil: yul bdag sman mo rkang 'jibs mkhyen: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: gter rdzong ri bo brag ral mkhyen:dpa' bor rting ma thob par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:thog lha gshin rje nag po yin: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po yi: blon brgya'i nang nas thugs brtse che: rta brgya'i nang gi mgyogs dar thob:dpa' brgya'i nang nas rting ma blangs: mtshon brgya'i nang gi go chod yin:pho brgya'i blo 'dri byed sa yin: mo brgya'i yid sems 'khor sa yin: thog lha gshin rje nag po nga: gling sdug ma shes yod tshod min: 'bum dmag mang po'i srog bdag byas: byang thang ro yi na ba bzos: sha rlangs khrag dri sna la sdug: rgod po sha la zhen pa log: ri khyi khrag la sun snang skyes:242

btsan bdud yul lha'i thugs sems dkrugs: sdig pa'i na bun sprin ltar 'khrigs: thog lha gshin rje ngar lam nas: gling sdug sdar ma gad la gcaroḥ de ring bsad na snga thal bsam: sang nyin bsad na phyi thal bsam: 'chi lam ma gtogs med pa shes: a kyang nyam nga yi re mug:gling sdug sang shi snang shi red: byang la 'jigs pa mi srid do: mi min khrag ral rgyal po khong: khebs rgya che ba a sngon gnam: bkrag mdangs gsal ba nyi zla skar:mnga' thang dar ba dog mo sa: ci ma yin la 'gran rgyu med:dpung rgod 'dzoms pas byang ba rnams: dpa' ngar stag gzig khyu gcig 'dra: 'do phrug sha rkyang bang kha 'dzoms: gser sga srab mthur ri mo bkra:bal gdan rgyan cha yid du 'ong: dpa' chas tshang ba dug gi ri: 'chi bdag khros pas ngar lam la: shi 'dod yid la yod le khyod: shi la spro ba ldan le khyod: shi la snga phyi rtsod le khyod: shi lam sgo mor 'dzul le khyod:dur sa nag po byang la byas: dur khung nang nas ltad mo gzigs: shi 'dre'i lus shig e lon ltos: byang gi mi nor 'khor bcas la: chen po'i gnod pa ga la thub: chung ngu'i nad yams rgyu gzer tsamoḥ gtong bas nus pa e thon ltos: de min byed thabs ci zhig yod: shi mig gson la lta rgyu gyis: shi sems gson la chags rgyu gyis: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:243

ces glu mjug rdzogs ma thag tu mda' de glog lce chad pa ltar 'phangs byung bas: li yi me ru ngo nag gi brang la thebs shing go khrab gang gi ma rten par ba dan rlung gis rdzogs pa ltar dgrong shor: der gling sgar nas bal sras thog rgod ya med kyis mda' ltong sprad nas gza' rgod dgung gi rgyugs pa ltar thon zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la len: glu tha la la mo tha la len: lha bla ma padma 'byung gnas mkhyen: dpal yi dam khro bo rta mgrin mkhyen: ma mkha' 'gro maddha ra ba mkhyen: ngas blo sna chos la 'gyur bar shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: sde mi min byang gi sprang sgar red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes noḥ nga bal sras thog rgod ya med yin: lho bal yul skyid kyi lhas ra na: bal rgyal po gser gyi ri bo 'dra: nga bal sras gser gyi me tog 'khrungs: sa bal bod kun la 'brug ltar grags: da de nas byang phrug ham pa can: khyod thog lha gshin rje rang snang che: byang khrag ral g.yu 'brug sngon mo kho: gling ge sar seng ge'i zil gyis gnon: yang gyad mi dpa' bo che bzhi de: nged ru 'dren bzhi yis ha la 'phen: gzhan dpa' bo thog 'brug glog gsum de: gling yang rtul gsum gyis srog snying 'dren: sgos sdar ma dug chu rnam pa gnyis: pho ngar rgod gces phrug dpung gis rib: dpa' gang 'dod rting ma thob sa med: sde 'bum dmag rdul gyi bye ma de: gling dmag rgod chu 244

rlung kha la 'dren: khyod sgos dgra thog lha gshin rje'i ming: nga bal sras stag mos lag sdig byed: byang bu phrug khyi phag skyag zan rnams: sems yi mug mchu ma shor ba byed: khyod byang sdug wa mos lag snga nas: sde li yul dmag gi dar 'phru bcad: kho 'bum dmag dgu yi 'dems ya yin:'dang mal nyal rmi lam bzhin du dgrong: dpa' khong gi zhal ngo dran pas dus: sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brjes nas byung: ngas dran pa bskor log rgyab nas byung: grogs bzang po'i sha khrag gser las dkon: ngas sha lan dgu bskor ma lon na: dpa' khas len stong gtam mdo med yin: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: rgyud yon tan med pa'i bla rdzun des:mgo zhwa ser blun po'i mig brid red:dpa' pho bzo med pa'i sdar ma des:lag mtshon cha dud 'gro'i ltag bdud red: byang mi min yul gyi las dmag des: rdzong ru 'dren byi ba khung 'dzul red: dpe de min bshad rgyu ci zhig yod: dpa' snying stobs med pa'i thog lha khyod: kha stong gtam btsan dang ma btsan med: g.yul drag po'i dkyil na mug ngo zhum: mgo rmog dkar nang nas dbu 'phang smad: rgyab khrab dkar nang nas snying rtsa 'dar: ngo rgya bo hre ring khyi la 'dra: khyi rda li nag po'i bu rgyud khyod: kha smra ra ag tshom 'dar ra ra: mig dgra ngo mi thub ltem se ltem: tshig ngag sgo mi thon khog nas 'khun: khyod a bar rig la sha re tsha: 'dra bsam na ma 245

'dug mchong la shog: khyod stag mo bzhin du mchong nus na: nga 'brong mo bzhin du bsgug mi yin: rno dug gi rwa co nyams pa med: dpa' stag g.yag gnyis kyis la rtsod bzhin: rtsod nges pas gting mtha' chod dgos yod: ngas snying nad 'khon sha ma lon na: kha phyir la 'khor na dpa' bo min: thob khri chen bal bo'i rgyal po yi: yang pha bla 'dren dang khyad par med: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: mda' de thog dmar dgung nas lhung ba ltar thog lha gshin rje nag po'i ya thod dpral ba'i bzhi mdo la phog nas rgyu 'bras mngon gyur gyi lam la drangs nas sha lan gyi thog ma don dang ldan zhing las dmag dpa' rgod mang du bsgral lo: der shan pa dang: shan tsha:bal sras: thog rgod: 'brug lha bcas ser rgod mkha' nas babs pa ltar ki sgra bsgrags: mda' gri mdung sogs char ltar phab pa'i tshe: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dang: rtsal ldan me lha grags pa: rtsal ldan rdo rje grags pa: rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug thog rgod: rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod bcas tshur mchong nas ral kha dang: mdung 'gran mda' 'gran sogs 'khrug 'khrug long long gi skabs su gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis gri btab nas stobs ldan grags pa thog rgod dgrong: shan tsha dang: 'brug lha 246

gnyis kyis gri mdung gang phog gis dpa' 'gran yang kho la ci yang ma thub:khos tshur gri btab nas 'brug lha'i mdung ske bcad: shan tsha'i stag ral gyi rgyun thag breg: 'brug lhas mda' 'phangs nas kho'i lcags 'phru bar ma bcad nas sar 'phang bas khos rten 'brel mi legs pa shes nas dmag khrod du mchong nas dmag 'ga' bsad shor: shan pa kho gar song gi rjes snyeg nas ma btang bar kho phyir 'khor nas ral kha 'gran pa rting thag ma chod: rtsal ldan rdo rje grags pa dang 'brug lha gnyis thug nas mda' mdung gri sogs dpa' mnyam la khad kyi dus su 'brug lhas kho'i khrab sham nas btsugs te tshe dus la babs: rtsal ldan me lha grags pas gling dmag 'ga' re bcom byung ba dang: bal sras kyis 'thab ya byas par khos gri ngo ma lon nas phyir bros brgyab nas thar: rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug thog rgod kyis gri klad la 'phyar nas mchong byung ba shan tsha dang thang ba'i khri btsan dpa' bzang gnyis kyis dpung rib brgyab par khos khri btsan dgrong:shan tshas gri yi ngar chu byas te lus phyed gshags btang nas bsgral: rtsal ldan rlung ri dung thod kyis 'chi ba srog la mi 'dzem par shi lceb byas mthar shan pas star gri la drangs nas khrag dmar dgung la mchod cing rting ma blangs ba dang: byang ba phal che ba zhig gis mgo 'bul byas nas de nyin ngo mtshar stong dang ldan pa'i dpa' rtags bzhag par gda' 'o:247

der gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig sgar du log pa na: rtsal chen me lha grags pas rting ma mang du blangs khul gyis rdzun gtam bshad: khong gnyis kyis bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa byas mthar mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po'i mdun du song nas lo rgyus zhib du bsnyad dgos phyir glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: mi min byang gi lha tshogs dang: srin po lcags ral la sogs rnams: yod na de ring grogs la byon: ma thub dgra yi mtha' rgyud chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi rgyal po'i sa: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong nas: tshom chen ra ba'i nang shed red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig yin: de nas rgyal po rin po che: da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrugs 'di:red bsam a phos sems la med: gling sdug dpa' rtul rgod hrag che:'bum dmag dpung grangs mang mang nas: mang sne nyung gis mi bstan no:de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: 'bum tsho dmag gi 'dems ya de:dpa' rtsal lo 'dabs rgyas mi khong: thog lha gshin rje nag po red: gling sdug lag la shor nas thal: rtsal ldan dpa' po mang po shor: ma shi me lha grags pa tsam: de min rmi lam rjes su thal: 'bum dmag chu kha'i bye ma de: shul med chu yi phyag nas thal: phar bsad gling sdug rtsi grangs med:248

mang mang nyung mtha' mi rig to: da lo gnam lo tshur tshes la: las de lam la mi 'gro to: ci byas rdo thog chu blug red: mi dbang rgyal po chen po lags: ci 'dra byas na dga' rgyu red: phar song dmag gi lag snga nas:pho res rting ma re re blangs: mtha' ma srog dmar shor nas thal: nga dang rtsal ldan me lha gnyis: mtheb mdzub bar gyi shig dang 'dra: sang 'chi nang 'chi nges pa med: a re bsam na skyo lugs la: skyo yang phan pa ci la yod: yar sngon byang sde dar ba'i dus: sha ri mthing sngon nam mkha' na:khrag ral khri gdugs nyi ma shar: sras gnyis dung gi zla ba tshes: gyad chen skar tshogs mtha' nas bkrag: 'bum dmag bkra gsal 'od kyi khyab: da lta bshad na 'gyod pa'i rgyu: 'on kyang khrag ral ma shor na: dgra lan sprod rgyur la thang med: brag ral khyung gshog rgyal po lags: bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis thongs: blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bkod: 'on kyang 'jig skrag ci yang med: 'dra gnyis thug na rting ma len: mang nyung sngon las 'gyod rgyu med: ma thub bros na mi yis 'phya: srog dmar shor na 'gyod rgyu med:'gag mo'i jo ru'i 'bum dmag la: gyad mi stong bdud dpa' bo ngas:sha len dgu bskor len nges yin: nged cag byang gi rgyal blon tshos: srog dmar dgra la ma shor bar: jus gzhi mi gtong pha 'bum dpang: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig ngasoḥ sgyu lus dgra la ma shor bar: shi 'thab 249

gson 'thab gang rung byed: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: khrag ral rgyal gyi yid la zungs zhes glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po'i mun chu dwangs med 'thung bas rkyen gyis ci yang ma dran zhing khyad par gling lha'i blo kha bsgyur bar gsungs mi 'byon par nag rog ge re zhig btang snyoms la lus skad:des skabs su lha gur dkar mo stong shom gyis nang du dran gsal blo yi bdag nyid: mkhas pa gtam gyi rgyal po: dpyod ldan ma 'ongs da mkhyen: sdig gcod shan pa rgyal po de nyid gzim 'od gsal la gnas tshe:tho rengs dang po'i dus su khro bo'i rgyal po phur ba rdo rje gzhon nu'i lung bstan gyis mgur glu 'di gsungs so:na mo padma ki lā ya: gzhi skye med don gyi klong yangs nas: rtsal 'gag med gsal stong chen po'i gar: lha gu ru padma khro bo lod: ngas ga sol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: gnas 'di 'dra stong gsal 'od kyi zhing: 'ja' 'od dang thig le'i klong dkyil red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gnas gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i zhing: dpal khro bo rgyal po'i ki lā ya: bdud log rtog ru ṭa'i kha gnon mdzad: las sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las byed: rgyu sna tshogs gdan gyi yangs steng nas: khyed shan pa 250

rgyal po lha yi bu: da ma g.yel snyan gyi dbang po gtod: ngas lung bstan snyan pa'i sbrang char bshad: byang shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag de: seng nyi mar gling gis lon pa gyis: kho nang bzhugs rtsal chen me lha bu: skye pho ming thog kyang dpa' bo min: phyogs bzhi nas rdzong btsan la mo bskor: khos gling la srog skyobs byed nas yongs:byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po khos:blon stong bdud mig gcig zhus lan la: bka' ma rtsal da dung sgug nas yod: da ma 'gyang la mo shar rdzong longs: pho phyugs po'i bsags pa'i rgyu nor rnams: jag btsan pos lam zas bsod nams 'dra: byang mi min yul gyi dngul rdzong rnams: khyed khra mo gling gi bsod nams 'dra: khyed dpa' rtul grub chen thams cad kyis: 'bad zer na bdud dgra 'dul la bskos: des 'bras bu sems can bde la bkod: mthar thug na rang gzhan bde skyid 'byung: yang dkar po'i lha chos bstan pa dar: bdud nag po'i bstan pa dung la snub: khong sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i thugs sprul te: mgon ge sar skyes bu don 'grub kyi: thugs dgyes bskong 'phrin las da lta byosoḥ mchog 'bral med yid du byin chen 'bebs: yid blo sna chos la 'gyur ba dang: chos blo phug brag ltar bstan par shog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi byos: glu ma go ba la 'brel ba med: khyod shan pa'i yid la de ltar zhog: 251

ces gsungs nas ka dag nam mkha' lta bu'i klong la mi snang bar thim: phyi nyin nam lang ba dang mnyam du gros la dbang ba'i blon po thams cad shan pa'i las gur du bos nas mkha' khyab nam mkha'i klong yangs nas yi dam phur ba gzhon nus lung bstan tshul rnams chad lus med par zhus: zhus nas kyang las dmag khag bzhi la bsgos te 'gro lugs sdod tshul gyi glu blangs ba rnams yi ge mangs par dogs nas bzhag: shan pa'i bka' ltar gra sgrig byas tshar te byang mi min gyi shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag gi phyogs bzhi nas bskor zhing 'thab ra bzung tshar ba rnams rtsal ldan me lha grags pas mthong ma thag tu lu gu'i spyang smyon mthong ba ltar 'jigs skrag skyi zing nge zhig gi ngang nas go khrab phud de mda' mtshon thams cad dor zhing srog skyabs zhus: shan pa'i lung bstan yid la bzung ste kho srog thar la btang: der shar rdzong gi rtse la gling gi dar btsugs shing rting ma dgung la grags par gda': stong bdud kyi sems la: da ci la thug kyang rgyal po'i 'di byos kyi gsung tshig mi 'dug: da 'di mus bsdad na rtsal ldan me lha'i sku tshe e bstan mi shes bsam zhing rta la bcibs te rlung bud pa ltar shar gyi rdzong la song ngo:de'i skabs su shar rdzong gi rtse la gling gi dar khra rdo rjes mtshan pa de rlung gi zum zum skyod pa mthong zhing glo bur du tshigs pa gting nas zos:252

dran pa bskor log brgyab: rmog gi 'dabs ra phab: khrab kyi rgyun thag bsdams: 'do ba'i glo len 'then zhing shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag la gtad de dpa' hang pa zhig gis mchong byung ba dang de ma thag gling gis sgo bzhi bsdams: dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal po dang shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan: pā thul zer tsha 'phru dmar: bal sras thog rgod ya med: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur rnams kyis rdzong sgo'i phyogs so so nas mda' gri mdung sogs kyi so kha phyir bstan nas 'dug pa'i skabs su: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis myur bar mda' ltong sprad de yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la len: glu a la ngag gi bkug lugs red: mchod gcig a sngon nam mkha' nas: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral mkhyen: ma thub dgra yi bla srog chod: rting ma dgung la grags par shog: mchod gcig bar snang 'ja' yi klong: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar mkhyen:rang dpung bu rta dar ba dang: dgra sde chom la 'bebs par shog: mchod gcig sa gzhi'i g.yang ra nas:yul bdag sman mo rkang 'jibs mkhyen:khrag ral dbu 'phang dgung la bstod:mtha' 'dre gling la rting ma longs:mchod gcig gter bdag nor bu'i khang:yul lha ri bo brag ral mkhyen:sa bcud byin chen byang la phob:dgos 'dod nor gyi dngos grub stsol:253
