sa 'di'i sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: sdar ma'i tshur 'geb byung pa'i sa: shar rdzong nor bu spungs yag gi: nub kyi nyag lam lha thang red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral khri gdugs nyi ma la: skyo grogs dung zla 'dzum zhal can: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig yin: rmog dkar steng gi lcags 'phru yin: khrab dkar steng gi snang ba yin: 'do chen steng gi gser sga yin: mi brgya'i nang gi yang rgod yin: phar 'gro'i dmag sna drangs pa'i dus: 'chi bdag bzhin du sngon la 'gro: tshur 'ongs gru gu bsgril 'dra la: rlung nag bzhin du rjes nas 'dug: da lo gnam lo shar ba'i tshun: gling gi ma byas tshod med red: byang gi mi byed ka med byung: gling sdug mi gsod shor bsam med: a sngon mthing gi gzhal yas nas: sprin dkar dpung re 'thug na yang: rlung drag byung ba'i kha sngon na:bsdod bsam bstan sa lar nas med: myur mgyogs rlung gi la rgya red:dog mo'i gzhung gi rgyang lam nas: chu chen gtsang rgyud chad med kyang:dgung dar chags pa'i kha sngon nas: mjes bsam dbang med 'og tu gnon: 'chags rom dgun gyi la rgya red: brgya grong yul sde'i 'grim lam nas: gling sdug tshod med byang la byung: stong bdud ngar ma'i dpa' lam nas: rgod 'dod thar lam lar nas med: gyad mi nga yi la rgya yin:dga' do bsam mam gling sdug rnams: de nas nga la nyan rgyu la: khyod rang 254

sdar ma dpa' rtul tshos: sprin dkar steng la mda' mo 'phen: ri mtho'i rtse nas ki shar rgyag: a re ci 'dra bsam gyin red: kha sang nyi ma'i sngon rol la: byang thang stag mo'i ngar lam nas: wa mo stag la 'gran mi de:dga' ldan sprin tsha me 'bar dang: li yi khro mi dpa' brtan gnyis: me nyag mchong zhags dug chu gsum: li yi me ri ngo nag bzhi: dmar bsad khrag gi 'khor lo bskor: bskor mi byang gi dpa' bo yin: sprin dkar gling gi dgra bo min: thub dang ma thub yod sa med: ri 'bur mgo yi ki 'debs 'di: dpa' rgod sngon na yod sa med: yod na da lta sgo la bud:dpa' rtul wa mo khyu gcig gi: srog bdud stong bdag mig gcig yin:bla ma yod na gsol ba thob: ge sar yod na bka' drin zhus: dpa' rtul yod na 'bod sha 'then: a sngon mthong ba de ring yin: dog mo mjal ba de ring yin: mi lus rin chen gces 'dzin can: de ring bral ba e skyo lags: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la 'grel ba med: shan pa'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu 'jug rdzogs pa dang khos rdzong sgo 'ur gyis phyes te shan pa sngon du mchong ba dang: mda' de me stag 'tshubs se 'phangs bas shan pa dpa' bzang rgyal po rtsal chen g.yon la 'gyur tsam byas pas mda' ma thebs: shan pa ngar chen gyi tshur thon nas ya kho re dpa' med stong bdud 255

bu: wa mo gra kha bkrag na yang: dmar yag stag la 'dzum mdangs che:skar tshogs khra mo bkrag na yang: rta bdun nyi ma 'od snang che: byang phrug ham pa che na yang: dpa' rgod shan pa dpa' ngar che zer zhing gzhu steng la mda' sbran nas dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: mtho gnam sa bar gyi lha la 'bod: khyad par du lcog lha mtshar rtse sogs: da ma g.yel byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: khyod sdar ma byang gi dur sa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sde 'bum tsho hor gyi sa cha nas: rta mtshal dmar gong gnon dpa' bo nga: nga shan pa dpa' bzang rgyal po yin: dgra nag phyogs yan bor mi gtong rgyu: dpa' shan pa dmar bo'i khyad chos yin: ya 'o na stong bdud mig gcig lags: rta 'do ba bra nag 'dur la bskos: rgyugs med pa bong tshe bas kyang sdug:khyod mi pho dpa' med sems kha brel:wa sdar ma khyi snying stong bdud khyod:dpe bzhag na 'dra ma 'ga' re yod: rang pha bla btsong du 'ong ba las:bros bros nas shar rdzong gling la thob: ngo tsha le e shes rang snang can: byang mi min dpon gyi blon po tsho: dus rang 'dug rgyang grags stag mo la:'gram gcar na wa mo 'dar yu red: dpa' ci yod ci tshod shes nges yin:byang sa stong mi ro'i na thang bzos: gzhung yul chu khrag gi kha mdog bsgyur:256

spyan khra chung sdug gis ma sgrib na: khyod ltos dang rig rgyu 'ga' re gda':ya kho re stong bdud mig gcig pu: khyod ngo stod chu yi gnyer ma 'dra:rgas so chad dmag la chas lugs la: byang mi min mi zad thon pa 'dra: da a re 'gyod dam snying rje'i yul: drin pha ma'i skyong ba 'dra 'dra la: dpa' thabs mkhas mi 'dra kha kha red: drin pha ma'i bskyangs pa 'dra 'dra red:dpa' thabs mkhas ma 'dra so so red: mda' nyag phran khyung sgro 'phen lam nas: dgra 'chi bdag yin kyang shor ba med: dus de ring tshe zad khyod la 'phen: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:khyod stong bdud yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs par mda' de 'phangs pa'i gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gi brang la thebs cing khrab gyi byang bu kha shas gtor ba las 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs par ci yang ma gnod: der gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis ral gri shubs nas byangs te mchong byung ba dang:shan pa'i dug ral bton nas phar mchong: de bzhin du shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan gyis ral gri bton: bal sras thog rgod ya med kyis mdung thogs: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur gyis mda' gzhu bton: pā thul zer tsha 'phru dmar gyis ral gri bton nas so sor rang rang gi rdzong sgo ma srung mtshams bzhag te shan pa'i dpung rogs la thonoḥ shan pa dpa' 257

bzang rgyal pos dug ral gyi mang du btab kyang mtshon ma song: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur gyis mda' gsum 'phangs pa: brang dang dbung g.yas rmog la thebs kyang rdo rje'i brag la ser ba babs pa ltar gyur nas ci yang ma thub: kho yi ral gri ngar chen gyi klad la bskor nas lan mang du btab par dpa' rtul so so thebs kyang shan pa: thog 'gyur: shan tsha:bal sras bzhi la ma gnod: pā thul zer tsha 'phru dmar gyi ske la thebs nas khrag dmar rgyang nge dbu sa la 'phangs nas dgrong: der ja yun mang po'i ring la phan tshun dpa' kha 'gran par pham rgyal ma byung: der gyad mi stong bdud kyi 'thab na kho rnams mi thub pas ma tshad rdzong nang du shor thabs mi 'dug pa thag chod: da rang tshod bzung na dga' bsam nas phyir bros song ngo:258

le'u bcu gcig pa/a stag dmag gis byang rdzong skor//rkang ring ha ri rnam gnyis bsgral//chos 'grub dang ni stobs chen gyis//rtsal ldan dpung gi gral ra gtor//der nyin 'ga' yi rjes su byang phyogs nas a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo dang: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub: sog blon stobs chen stag dmar: a grags nyi ma grags pa: gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen stag: smug gu'i stong bdud lag ring: bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po: gzhi ga dar blon po byang sngon bcas dpa' rtul grags rim rnams kyis: 'bum dmag bu yug 'tshub pa ltar khrid nas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag gi phyogs la chas so:mi min gyi so ba rnams kyis mthong nas brda sprad pas: byang rdzong nas chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring: rtsal ldan ha ri khrag mig: rtsal ldan gzig mo gra gsal: rtsal ldan shes lha brtan pa: rtsal ldan nor bu 'dzin pa: rtsal ldan 'brong rgod stobs rgyal: rtsal ldan lha dbang ye shes: rtsal ldan dngul 259

khrab rdo rje bcas rdzong zur du byung nas so so'i dgra skal rnams la 'thab par brtsams pa'i tshe: gling dmag phyogs bzhir bsgos nas shar sgo nas a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo dang sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal gnyis kyis 'bum dmag kha lo bsgyur nas byung ngo:lho sgo nas sog blon sog blon stobs chen stag dmar dang: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub gnyis kyis 'bum dmag khrid nas mchong byung ngo:nub sgo nas smug gu'i stobs bdud lag ring dang: gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen stag gnyis kyis 'bum dmag khrid nas byung ngo:byang blon rnams kyang phyogs bzhi la bsgos nas rgyugs byung ba'i sngon mar shar sgo nas a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo'i gzhu steng la mda' gcig bzhag nas yin lugs dang dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs dang: ge sar skyes bu'i srung ma rnams: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: ma thub bdud phrug chom la phob: sa 'di'i sa ngo ma shes na: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag gi: shar gyi lcags sgo chen po'i 'gram:nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: yar khams byang ma'i ri brgyud nas: pho brang lcags ra rtse dgu mtho: 'bum tsho kha lo bsgyur mi la: a stag khros pa'i klu mo yin: ri 'dren dpa' bo che bzhi na: stag dmar bzhin du ngar le dang:260

rgya khra bzhin du spyang ba yin: de sngon nyi ma yan chod la: ma thub dgra la gcig kyang med: shor ba'i las la gnyis kyang med: byang phrug rang snang che na yang: dpa' rtul rnams la 'gran rgyu med: kha sang khes nas de sngon la: dpa' med stag ming sdar thung ma: gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal kho: tshod med gling la shor nas byung: rgod po'i rting ma ma lon te: rang srog dgra la skyel nas thal: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal khong: dpa' rtul dpung gi gzhi dkyil nas: ma bzhugs sdar ma'i gdong la byon: dpa' med dpa' ming stag gsob can: mal nyal rmi lam bzhin du byas: de bzhin byang mi yongs la byung: mtha' ma mi zad byung nges yin: dngul rdzong gling dkar rgyan la len: dga' to bsam mam sdug nas byung: da rung de yi gang nas tshad: dpa' mo dpon gyi khros lam nas: bdud phrug srog dmar ha la 'phen: 'phen nges dpa' mo'i khyad chos red: ma thub dgra bo chom la 'bebs: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs gang la: rting ma nyag phran mda' la babs: mda' mo gnam lcags 'phur shugs can: nags la me btsan phog pa bzhin: 'byung g.yar lus po me la bsregs: mar me rlung gi bsad pa ltar: rnam shes dbang med phyi mar drangs: nam mkha' mthing gi gdengs khang nas: shel dkar lha yi gzhal yas su: tshangs pa dkar po lha yi tshogs: ma g.yel dpa' mo'i grogs la byon: mda' kha srung pa'i 261

dus la babs: lha dmag bu yug 'tshub 'tshub kyis: dgra srog chod cig rtsal ma zhan: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len medoḥ byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung zhing mda' de 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs byung bas chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gi snying la thebs nas glu len dang 'thab long med par bsad do: rtsal ldan ha ri khrag mig gi snying la tsher ma zug pa ltar 'chi ba srog la mi 'dzems par mchongs pa dang: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal dang thug pa'i dang po rtsal ldan ha ri khrag mig gis rta kha bkag yob snga sor rgyangs shing dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: srin lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs sogs: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas:gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: pho rtsal ldan dpa' bo sum cu nas: dpa' yang rgod pho brgya'i bstod sa yin:ming rtsal ldan ha ri khrag mig yin: gling dkar bo zer ba'i sdar ma tsho:sems bsam pa ci 'dra 'khrul nas 'dug: dus de ring nyi ma'i snga dro la:wa sdar ma 'drogs mgo rgya rdzig khyod: pho mi byed dgu byed khyod kyi byas: pho mi rgod rgod mdog khyod kyis byed: mi bzang kyang bzang mdog khyod kyi 262

byed: mi yag na yag khul khyod kyi byed: kha 'dar ba rlung rta g.yug g.yug ste: yang kha chu sbrang char 'bab 'bab red: lus 'dar ba lcang lo bsigs bsigs la: kha wa skad khyi mo zug zug red: sde dbang chung lag gi nor rnams 'phrog: rdzong chung chung mang po nom la blangs: kho khyi rgan skyag pas rgyag na ngar: pho mi ngan nang lob nang la btsan: de zer ba'i dpe bzhin gling la 'dug: khong gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal de: sde rdzong khag dgu yi dga' nges yin: dmar bsad de khrag gi 'khor lo bskor: dpa' chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring de: dmag 'bum tsho dpung gi ru 'dren yin: mal nyal ba'i rmi lam bzhin du bzos: yang da rung nyes bzhag khur tshod med:dpa' rgod po me ru'i sha lan dang: yang chu 'dren blon gyi yang lan dang:dmag mang po bsad pa'i khrag lan bcas: dus gcig la a phos ma lon na: pho shi ba dgu las mi dga' re: lus skye 'chi mgo nag yongs la srid:yang min na gling sdug zer ba zhig: nga rtsal ldan blon po shi le gcig: yang min na byang blon zer ba zhig: dpa' rting ma dgung la grags pa zhig:gcig ma nus mi bzhag lcags ral dpang: wa ga ma khrab gyon khe tshe bu:khyod de ring byung ba ma bzang thal: sdug mug srog dgra la shor rgyu red:mtshon go khrab 'do ba dbang sa med: chung lo gcig lo gnyis son pas thog: ngas sbyang ba nyag phran mda' la byas: yang 'phen ya a sngon nam 263

mkha' byas: khong nyi zla skar gsum sa la 'phangs: yang 'phen ya dog mo sa la byas: sa nag po'i mchin pa thar se gtor: yang 'phen ya brag dmar dkyil la byas: bya rgod po tshang nas sa la 'phangs: yang 'phen ya chu bo'i gzhung la byas: nya gser mig lto dkar skam la btags: yang 'phen ya sdang ba'i dgra la byas: dgra'i snying khrag dog mo'i sa la phos:dus de ring khyod la de ltar mtha': glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs bas sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal gyi brang la thebs cing go btsan pas ci yang ma gnod: der dpa' bo sog gi bka' blon des mda' ltong sprad cing ya kho re mi min rtsal ldan bu: mda' de 'dra rtsed mo mtshar zhan che: nga btsan po'i dgra la 'gro rabs med: mda' de so la yog can zhig red zer zhing dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: ser bo sog gi srung ma dang: ge sar skyes bu'i lha tshogs rnams: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: ma thub dgra bo'i bla tshe khrol: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:mi min byang gi sa cha red: nye mo mig gis ma mthong ste: ring bo rna ba'i thos tshod la: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:264

dpa' chen dgung la grags pa nga: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal yin: mi lus gcig la skye lugs gnyis: tshe sngon dbang po dar ba'i dus: o ral rgyal po'i bka' blon yin: ma thub dgra yi kha gnon yin: byams pa'i grogs la pha ltar brtse: dar dkar bzhin du ngoms rgyu yin: lha sku bzhin du bshams rgyu yin: tshe smad ge sar lha blon la: dgra bo'i g.yas ru gnon mi dang: bgegs dpung thal bar bzlog mi yin: ge sar skyes bu don 'grub dang: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal gnyis: mkha' las grags pa'i nyi zla yin: sa nas grags pa'i ri brag yin: bar nas grags pa'i thog 'brug yin: 'dzam gling lho na grags pa che: ge sar rgyal dang khe tshe blon:de min yan na yod bsam med: de so yin lugs glu zhus tsam: yang dag 'dra ma 'di ltar yod: dpa' rtul khro chu'i pha bong 'dra: rting ma mang ste pham pa med: khyad par khe tshe 'brug rgyal nga: grags pa g.yu 'brug bas kyang che:lta ba nam mkha' bas kyang mtho: de nas byang blon rang snang can:rgod rgod dpa' mdog byed mi khyod: 'chi bdag ha la 'phen mdog kha:mi ngar ngar 'dogs byed mi khyod:stag mo'i mgo nas 'dzin mdog kha:mi bzang bzang mdog byed mi khyod: skyag sgye gser la rtsi mi red: mi shes shes mdog byed mi khyod: gzhung brgya yid la mkhyen 'dogs kha: blun po mkhas 'dod snang ba che: mkhas pa'i mdun na yi re mug: gna' mi bod 265

kyi gtam dpe la: yon tan med pa'i bla ma des: mang po 'ga' la gnod chen bskyal: yag shes med pa'i bu mo des: ngan g.yos phu nu re thag gcod: sdom pa med pa'i grwa ba des: rang sdug gzhan skyo las ngan bsags: dpa' snying med pa'i bu tsha des: stong gtam mkhas kyang zhe nas khrel: zer yang zer la bden kyang bden: de nas byang phrug khyi yi blon:khyod dang nga gnyis 'dra sa med: gling dkar lha yi sa cha na: dpa' rtul grub chen sum cu dang: zhe rtul gsum dang yang rtul bdun: de min a pho'i yan na med: ru sna 'dren pa'i dpa' bo yin: sgang bzhi ro yis gang mi yin: gzhung gsum khrag la bsgyur mi yin: mi ro'i bam thang bzo mi yinoḥ khe tshe 'brug rgyal mchong lam nas: rtsal ldan wa mo e rgod ltoḥ rno gcod ngar ma'i so lam na: go mtshon khrab rmog slog rul bzhin: mda' rgod 'phen pa'i ngar lam nas: lhu bzhi dum bur gtor nges yin: mdung ring phul ba'i ngar lam nas: snying khrag sa la pho nges yin: nyam chung btsan por 'gran pa deoḥ mgo chag rang gi nyo rtags red: sprang pos phyugs por 'dres pa de: za kha rang gis bkag pa red: de min byung ba ci yang med: dpa' med byang gi khyi phrug tsho: re re bzhin du srog dmar gcod: gling dkar rting ma'i brgyan la byed: grags pa bod la yod pa dang: dkar po'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: bdud phrug srog la ho ma ya:266

go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs pa dang: dpa' bo khe tshe 'brug rgyal gyis mda' de 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs pas: rtsal ldan ha ri khrag mig gis snying kar thebs nas chu srin dung gis phigs pa bzhin bsad: dpa' rtul rnams kyis dpa' the tshom med par rdzong la shor: mi min gyi dmag rnams kyis mda' mdung gri sdo ci rigs kyi 'thab par gling dmag ma khog nas byang mi rnams lam gang thob kyis bros:der lho sgo nas sogartsoblon stobs chen stag dmar dang: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub gnyis kyis dpung gshibs byas te rdzong mthar thon pa dang: byang rdzong nas rtsal ldan gzig mo gra gsal dang: rtsal ldan shes lha bstan pa gnyis kyis gdong bkag nas thog mar rtsal ldan gzig mo gra gsal gyis 'do ba'i kha ru bkag nas yob snga sor rgyangs te glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: nged mi min byang gi lha tshogs rnams: dus de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rdza dkar nag khra gsum sa cha ru: mtho pho brang byu ru thog 267

dkris nas: dpa' che nas dgung la grags pa nga: dpa' rtsal ldan gzig mo gra gsal yin: ngas mgo la gyon pas lcags rmog 'di: mdangs nam mkha'i mdog ldan rtse lnga zer: yang rgyab la gyon pa'i lcags khrab 'di: sra mun pa dgu bsgrigs nag po zer: nga'i g.yas g.yon stag gzig ral chen nang: sra lcags gzhu 'gugs pa'i 'od ldan 'dis: rno rgyun thag 'brong gi ko la byas: gzu lcags mda' leb ma dgu cu 'dis: zas sha khrag dmar la rang dbang thob: mdung ba dan lcags nag rtse brgyad 'dis: brgyan dug sbrul nag po dgu 'khyil yin: rno lcags nag ral gri 'bar ba 'dis:yang btab na mi chod gang yang med: nga'i 'og la bcibs pas 'do ba 'di: rta bra nag rlung gshog 'phur shes zer: glu de yan yin lugs 'dra dpe la: da yang dag don gyi rtsa ba ni: gnas 'dzam gling bod na grags che ba: nga rtsal ldan gzig mo gcig las med: rta bra nag rlung gshog gcig las med: nga khros nas dgra la chas pa'i dus: mtho gnam la 'phur dgu gshog rtsal 'khum: yang rang dbang med par sa la lhung: dma' sa la 'dzul dgu sder rtsal nyams: lus 'dar zhing bros sa e rnyed lta: chung na gzhon dbang po dar bas dus: dpa' dmag jag dpung gi mang po bcom: nga yar song rgya gar yul la song: stod rgya gar chos mdzod gong ma de: nga dpa' bos dpung gis 'phrog pa yin: dpa' ngar rgod dpung ba 268

ngoms pa'i dus: kho rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po des: nga skyabs 'jug zhus de zhu bshags phul: gnas rgya gar 'phags pa'i grong khyer na: nga mi min dpa' blon zer zhing grags: yang sgos su rtsal ldan gzig mo ngas: ming thos na dran pa bor nges yin: nga mar song rgya nag yul la song: smad rgya nag khrims sgo mda' yis gtor: yang sgyu ma'i nor rdzas dpung gis 'phrog: kho rgya nag khrims kyi rgyal po des: nged mi min byang la skyabs zhu byas: gnas rgya nag yul khams bco brgyad na: byang mi min dpa' blon zer zhing grags: yang sgos su rtsal ldan gzig mo ngas: ming go na 'jigs skrag bzod med skye: rgya gar nag gnyis na 'brug ltar grags:'thab zer na gling sdug snying re rje: byang yul sde 'bum tsho mang po de: nged byang rgyal dbang du ma 'dus med: mthong ma myong dmyal khams bco brgyad de: sde gling phrug ltad mo chog le byed: yang khrab rmog 'khor gsum dpa' chas rnams: nged mi min byang la thob pa byed: ya de nas mi dmar rta dmar can: khyod dpa' 'dod snang ba mtho nas gda': pho su dang gang gi dpa' rtul yin: khyod rigs dang pha ming ci 'dra yod: yang gnyen dang nye ba ci skad yod: tshod med par byang la byung ba 'di: yul pha jus dgra la sprod pa 'dra: bya de so bzlog med las shig red: ngas de ring rting ma mda' la babs: mda' 'phen nges khrag 'thung 'bar ba yin: dgra 269

gtad sa dmar bo skya la byed: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod dmar bo skya yi yid la zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mda' de 'phangs pas: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub kyi brang la phogs kyang go btsan pa dang srung bas byin rlabs kyis mtshon ma song: der byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub tshur sngon la byon nas 'do ba'i kha ru bkag: ral gri shubs nas byangs shing yin lugs kyi dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang: rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs rnams: de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: mtha' bdud srog rtsa ma g.yel chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha nas: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byu ru'i rgyal khag bco brgyad nas: stag rtse rgyal po'i sras po nga: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub zer: ge sar rgyal po'i lha blon yin: log 'dren bdud kyi gshed ma 'dra: de nas rtsal ldan gzig mo bu: stong gtam che la lag len chung: khrag ral khyi mo skyag zan kho: ge sar lha yis chom la 'bebasoḥ rtsal ldan wa mo khrab gyon rnams:dpa' rtul so sos ha la 'phen: 'bum dmag lug khyu bshas phab ltar:gling dmag sngon nas thar ba med: da lo byang gi 'bum dmag 'di: ston 270

gsum smin pa'i me tog 'dra: mi rtag dgung la yal nyen che: che don rtsa ba bshad pas na: ge sar g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'dra: dpa' rtul thog lce ngar ma 'dra: 'bum dmag ser rgod babs pa 'dra: byang phrug rgyas pa'i 'dab ma rnams: dbang med sa la los gtor bsam: skye rgyud rtsad nas los gcod bsam: sa gzhi'i kha dog los bsgyur bsam: dpe bzhag 'dra ma 'ga' re gda': gor dad can gyi bla ma des: shi gson 'bum gyi za skal 'phrog: 'dren stobs thugs rje ma yod noḥ dmyal ba mi 'grim zer sa med: stong gtam can gyi byang phrug des: shar gling dmag la 'thab 'khrugs brtsam: rgod po'i dpung ba ma 'phar na: dngul rdzong shor ba'i snga ltas tshang: e bden ltos dang gsal nas yongs: mi min sprang sgar khyu gcig tsho: dpung ya yod na ran tshod red: ran pa'i mi tshad phyi nas thal:rgya gar yod na khrid la shog: rgya nag yod na bos la shog: ma dal brel mo bya ltar byos: mi 'gyang pha jus shor la nye: da rung byang gi 'bum dmag tshos: mi 'bod bzhag nas ci zhig byed: mi min byang sdar khyi phrug tshos:don med gling la tshur 'gebs byas: skyes pa'i bu rta gsod 'dod zer:chag sgo nyo ba'i snga ltas 'dra: bsags pa'i rgyu nor 'phrog 'dod rnams:pha jus shor ba'i byur 'dre 'dra: nga rgod bsam pa'i byang ba khyod: lus 'dar lcang los rang mtshang rdol: rgod 'dod khrab rmog gyon pa rnams:271

dar cog rlung gis sdeb pa 'dra: mkhas 'dod glu chung len na yang:'gug med rwa dung phu brgyag 'dra: byang phrug gces srog ha la 'phen:mar me rlung gis bsad pa bzhin: ma thub bzhag na dpa' bo min: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du ral gri klad la 'phyar nas mchong byung bar: rtsal ldan gzig mo gra gsal gyis ral gri bton nas phan tshun ral kha 'gran pas tshe: glo bur du byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub kyis gri btab nas kho'i sog phrag kha phyes nas bsad: der sog blon stobs chen stag dmar dang rtsal ldan shes lha bstan pa gnyis thug pa'i thog mar byang blon gyis ral gri btab pa 'bum gcod shubs nas byangs shing dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: srin khrag ral rgyal po'i srung ma rnams: nged mi min byang gi dpa' mgon mdzod: dus de ring ma g.yel grogs la byon: yang ma thub dgra dpung phab rogs kyis:sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang yul chen sum ri 'dus sa nas: mtho pho brang rgod po dkris ldan gyis: yang nang rdzong dgra yi kha ya nga: dpa' rtsal 272

ldan shes lha bstan pa yin: ya kho re mi pho rgod 'dod can: chas brgyan cha bkrag mdangs mdzes lugs sogs: 'dra nges pa ser bo sog la 'dra:yin nges pa stobs chen stag dmar red: a la la mtshar gyi che lugs sam:sog mun pa'i o ral rgyal po kho: grags che ba g.yu yi 'brug dang 'dra: kho gsod mi ge sar rgyal po red: des dgra sha gling la mi rtsod par: nged mi min byang la 'gran don med: jus 'phrog mi dgra bo khrag ral min: rgyu 'phrog pa'i jag pa byang ba min: sde gling sdug sems na ci 'dra yod: don med par mi sha bgo donased: byang sde ba zho bzhin chags pa 'di: khrag ltar du dkrugs pa ci zhig yin: lus 'doms gang 'ben la ma bzhag na:jus gru bzhi dgra la bskul don med: thengs dgu la shi yang 'gyod pa med:dpa' rgod hrag can gyi khrag ral des: snyan grags pa can gyi dngul rdzong de: pheb 'dod pa can gyis 'phrog bsam na: rang pha jus shor ba'i snga ltas red: de min pa'i 'bras bu ci yang med: dpa' rtsal ldan shes lha bstan pa ngas: rtsal sbyang ba rno gcod gri la sbyang: mtheb rgyang 'phen mda' la ngo so chung: gri thung g.yug dpa' bo'i snying khams mtshon: yul 'jig rten khams na dkon pa'i gri: rno lcags sna dgu yis brdung ba yin:bdud srin po 'bum gyi 'phrul brdung byasoḥ gri btab na srid 'dir mi thub med: mtho gnam la g.yug na gnam sgo phye: dma' sa la g.yug na 273

mchin pa gtor: sra brag la btab na thal gyis bshig: yul stong ba'i 'ja' la btab na gcod: rno 'ja' gri ya lang 'phrul 'byed zer: gsher chu la btab na sked nas gcod: rno chu gcod cho 'phrul 'bar ba zeroḥbar rlung la btab na dum gyis gcod: rno rlung gcod sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor zer: sdang dgra la btab na shor ba med: rno ral gri btab pa 'bum gcod zer: dgung yar la 'phyar na skya rengs 'dra: gnam skya rengs skya mda' mched pa 'dra: dgra mun pa'i dpung la ngo mtshar ston:rno so kha dgra la ngom pa'i dus: dgung mun pa mar la rub pa 'dra: mtho mgo dpon btsong bas blon po la: sdug dpa' ming btags na than la rtsi:rje o ral rgyal po gling gis bsad: khyod dran na khyi phrug snying rtsa 'khrug: da ma dran dpa' bos gsal zhig 'debs: sde byang ba dpung gi sde tshogs la:pho rgod po 'debs gsod ci la yin: bya rtsod rgyu spu tsam med sa nas: yang 'thab rgyu ri ltar ci la yin: ya kho re stobs chen stag dmar bu: khyod mi gcig shi la ma 'tsher noḥ dpa' rgya stag bzhin du mchong la shog: dus de ring tshur mchong ma nus na: rje o ral rgyal po'i sha la zo: ma li khri skar chen khrag la 'thung: sde bud med brgya yi skra khu bzhes: yang phur thogs dgu brgya'i glud du gtong: lha srin po lcags ral khros pa rtsal: rno ral gri'i so kha 'tsho rogs mdzod: ngas ma thub dgra bo chom la phob: glu go na 274

rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod sog blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: sog blon stobs chen stag dmar gyis rno gcod ral gri shubs nas byangs te srog bdag be har dgra la chas pa ltar: steng dpa' bo'i 'gying stabs stag mo khros 'dra: 'og 'do ba'i bang kha rlung las mgyogs pa: rno btab chod so kha me las tsha ba: dgra 'chi bdag thon kyang nyam nga med pa zhig mdzad nas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: pha myang rgyud kyi srung ma dang: ge sar skyes bu'i lha tshogs rnams: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag ces: 'dzum drug khrag la 'dre sa red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma sheso na: mtha' bral g.yu yi mdzes ljongs kyi:phyogs kyi khor yug rnam par brgyan: g.yu thang mun pa'i gling chen nas:sog blon stobs chen stag dmar yin: stobs chen gyad kyi shugs ya la:stag dmar dgra yi gshed ma 'droḥ 'jig rten dpe yi 'dren tshul la:nam mkha' sprin gyi sgo brgya nas: g.yu 'brug g.yu yi ze ba can: gnam lcags thog gi bu yug 'tshub rkang thung mgo 'phang mtho zhan 'droḥ 'dab 275

ma sa la mi snyil re: g.yu ljongs nags kyi tshang tshang nas: rgya stag mtshal gyi ldab sha can: gdug rtsub mche sder khrag gis sbag: 'do phrug la la yan zhan 'dra: sug bzhi sa la mi breg re: gting bral g.yu yi mtsho mo nas:stobs ldan nya ba ngom nag la: lcags kyu ngar ma'i a long ldan: mtsho mtha' skor tshod ma zin na: gser shog skam la 'dren no zer: kho re rtsal ldan shes lha lags: khyod kyi bshad pa de ring bden: o ral sog gi rgyal po dang: las dmag dpung gi tshogs dang bcas: shar gling dmag gi sngon nas pham: o ral sog la ci byung rnamasoḥ byang sdug mgo la yongs bar nges: de sngon g.yul gyi 'khrug mtshams nas: gyad mi rtsal ldan dpung dang bcas: shi bsad pham pa'i grangs ka rnams: de ring khyod kyis ma brjed dam: 'bum dmag khri la zin pa dang: khri dmag stong la nyung nas 'dug:stong dmag brgya dang brgya dmag bcu: mi zad rtsa ba thug pa rnams: phar bltas tshur la gsal nas 'dug: da rung stong gtam nag po bshad:bsam blo ma btang skad cha dngoḥ don dang bral ba'i ki co bsgrags: a kyang nyam nga yi re mug: sha re tsha la snying re rje: de ring stobs chen stag dmar ngas: rting ma rno gcod gri la babs:byang phrug sdar ma wa mo khyod:sgyu lus khag bzhi bsgo la 'jog: ri sha lung ba khrag la bsgyur: de min skad cha mang po med: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:276

byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du sog blon stobs chen stag dmar mchong byung ba dang: khos kyang gri bton nas phan tshun ral kha ja yun tsam la 'gran pa'i mthar sog blon stobs chen stag dmar gyis ral gri'i so la drangs nas mi rtag lnga ba'i lam la mngag: gzhan dpa' rtul rnams kyis ki bswo dang bcas rdzong la gtad nas shor byung ba dang: byang dmag rnams kyis rdzong sgo bkag nas gri mdung sogs kyi so kha phyir bstan:rang rang gis nus tshod kyis rdzong gi 'thab ra'i drwa ma nas mda' 'phangs nas gling dmag mang du dgrong: der byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub kyis gri rdzong sgo la btab nas yar gshags mar gshags 'phred gshags 'ga' byas kyang sgo gtor ma thub par g.yul 'khrugs drag tu byas te mi min gyi rdzong shor ba la the tshom med par gda':277

le'u bcu gnyis pa/nyi grags mda' yis nor 'dzin phigs//lha blon mtshon la stobs rgyal drangs//smug gus rtsal ldan lha dbang bsad//bdud 'dul blon gyis dngul khrab bsgral//der nub sgo nas a drag nyi ma grags pa dang: gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen rtags gnyis kyis 'bum dmag khrid nas byung bar: byang gi rdzong nas rtsal ldan nor bu 'dzin pa dang: rtsal ldan 'brong rgod stobs rgyal gnyis kyis so sos gdong la mchong de thog mar rtsal ldan nor bu 'dzin pas 'do ba'i kha ru bkag: rmog gi 'dabs ra phab: khrab kyi rgyun thag bsdams: 'do ba'i glo len 'then zhing: zangs gzhu me ri 'bar ba'i steng la: zangs mda' glog rtse 'phur shes bzhag nas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: glu mchod cig mchod gnyis mchod ma gsum: yang mchod cig a sngon nam mkha' nas:dpa' lha chen srin po lcags ral 'bod: kho ma thub dgra la rting ma longs:278

glu mchod gnyis bar snang yangs ba nas: yang bdud btsan me 'bar khros pa rtsal: nga dpa' bos gus pas 'bod lags na: bus bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol: glu mchod gsum sa gzhi'i g.yang ra nas: ma sman mo rkang 'jibs dmar mo 'bod: rang dpung gi bu rta dar bar shog:yang gter rdzong lhun 'grub 'bum yag nas: dpal rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: gnas sa bcud byin chen byang la phob: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpon nyi ma 'dra ba'i bka' blon la: gnas ye stod lha mkhar phyug mo nas: zhing chu ma'i re'u mig bdag po nga: ming rtsal ldan nor bu 'dzin pa yin: mgo zangs rmog rtse lnga'i yang steng na: mtho zangs 'phru rtse gsum 'od re mdzes: rgyab zangs khrab 'bar ba'i yang steng na: srab chu dar khra mo'i rgyab dar mdzes: 'og 'do chen mtshal mdog 'phur shes la:brgyan srab bskon sga stan rnam par mdzes: dpa' rtsal ldan dpung gi skyor ma la: dpung 'bum dmag snying bcud nor 'dzin nga: rtsal rting ma ma lus lus la tshang: pho nga la 'gran pa ma bzang lags: de 'on kyang tshe sngon bkod thang red: phyir 'gyod pa khyod la yod na yang: tshe sngon las srog gi lan chags red: don de la 'gyod pa skye rgyu med: sngon las rlung drag po'i ded lugs la: khyod thar ba med pa lag pa'i mthiloḥ sngon gna' mi bod 279

kyi gtam dpe la: ban cha med 'don pa lkog 'don 'di: yon mi dgyes yid gnyis the tshom za: pho rgod mdog rting ma mthong med 'di: grogs mi dgyes 'phya smod rgyu zhig yin: gling dpa' med byang la tshur chas 'di:dpa' mi grags snying rtsa 'dar rogs red: de zer ba'i gtam de bden nges gda': yang khyad par wa blon tshur chas rnams: 'dre 'chi bdag bdud kyis mdun nas bsus: phyir bzlog med gshin zhags ske la thebs:las dkar nag rgyu 'bras thog babs 'dra: ngas mda' gcig mi 'phen thog gcig 'phen: thog dmar po'i ya bo srid na dkon: nga rtsal chen thog mda'i rgyang lam nas: khyod tshe zad gling phrug snying re rje: gson mi yul mthong ba de ring red: tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'grim ran 'dug: nged byang gi rgyal po'i dbang thang la: khyod khra mo gling gi sgar jus 'phrog: sde gling yul mi med lung stong byed: 'dre 'ug pa gnyis kyis ki co rgyag:btsan ma mo gnyis kyi shugs glu len: mkhar gyang ral lhang nger skyo le byed:btsan zer na ya bo bral ba de: dpon khrag ral 'chi bdag nag po yin:phyugs zer na 'gran ya med pa de: byang mi min bdud kyi dngul rdzong yin:dpa' nyes bzhag tshod med byang la byas: nged byang phrug re res lag snga nas: dmag 'bum 'bum dpung gi kha grangs gsod: da de nas nyung mtha' e rig lta: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len 280

med: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: mda' 'phangs ba a drag nyi ma grags pas phub kyis bkag nas ma gnod: der a drag nyi ma grags pas gzhu steng la mda' bzhag nas na re: kho re bdud phrug stong gtam can: yang dag rgod po yin zer na: mda' de 'dra 'phen pa ngo re tsha: sman na chung gi 'phang thur mi 'dra 'am: gling phrug dpa' bo'i mda' rtsal de: de 'dra lar nas yin lugs med zer zhing dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: bla ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis bskor: mi 'bral byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: blo sna chos la 'gyur bar shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: a drag yul gyi dpon po yin: chos la dad pa che mi yin: bdud la zhe sems gnag mi yin: a drag nyi ma grags pa yin: kho re rtsal ldan yin mdog can: mthong gsal rting ma sus che lta: kho re byang blon wa mo tsho: me la lceb na bsregs par nges chu la mchong na khur nas 'gro: gling dkar zho bzhin chags pa loḥ byang gis khrag ltar dkrugs pa yin: dpa' rtul mi khro ka med byas: 'bum dmag mi byung tshod med red: sdug na rang nyos 'bras bu red: gling rta rlung gshog bang kha mgyogs: rtsal ldan nor 281

'dzin khyi gdong khyod: de ring khyod dang 'u gu gnyis: nyag chen mda' yi dpa' 'gran byed: khyi snying dmar bo len rgyu yin: pho rgod gling gi nyi grags ngas: dpa' bo'i rting ma mda' la babs: mda' 'phen khyung sgro leb chen 'phen: byang phrug wa mo'i khyu tshogs na: bu mo khrab gyon 'phru dmar can: sdar ma hrag brdzi wa skyes blon: a bar rig la snying re rje:shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing: rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas: lus ngan rtsal ldan rnam shes de: thar ba'i go 'phang thob par shog: lho phyogs dpal ldan zhing khams su: rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor dang bcas: dam nyams bdud phrug rnam shes de: thar ba'i go 'phang thob par shogoḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhingoḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'khor dang bcas: rtsal ldan rnam shes rlung khyer de: thar ba'i go 'phang thob par shog: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing: don yod grub pa 'khor dang bcas: byang phrug rang phung rnam shes de: thar ba'i go 'phang thob par shog: dbus phyogs 'og min zhing khams su: chos sku kun bzang yab yum sogs: lus ngan bdud kyi sdig rgyud chod: rnam shes thar ba'i go 'phang thob: 'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun 'grub shog: glu 'di thos tshad sems can rnams: phan bde rnam gnyis 'byung par shog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:282

ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs pas rtsal ldan nor bu 'dzin pa'i ya thod dpral bas bzhi mdo la phog nas bsad:de nas gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen stagatregis ral gri mun pa so dkar de shubs nas byangs shing rngam stabs kyis rang gi dgra skal gyi gdong la mchong nas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: steng dkar po'i lha tshogs thams cad bswo: dgra nag phyogs bstan pa dung la snubs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen stag yin: dpal grub chen siṅga'i rnam 'phrul yin: chos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yinoḥdam nyams pa rnams kyi thod la dpa': yul lta log bdud kyi srog bdag yin: sdom dam tshig can gyi kha mgon yin: khyod mang mang nang nas yongs lugs la: rang gces srog 'phang med byed mi red: mgo klad med byang gi khyi phrug rnams: gtam go ba med pa'i glang rgan 'dra: yang 'ded mkhan byung na rlung dang 'dra: khyod bros bros bye thang rgya lam bzos:la bde gzar med par ri mo dodoḥ thang yangs dog med par rta rjes dpar: yang da rung glu len ngag 'gugs byed: ngo tsha rgyu med pa'i mi tshad par: bya 'khrul ba'i nang gi a 'thas red: dpung dmar nag g.yul du 283

'thab sa nas: ngas khyod la snying rje lta lugs med: dpa' lag slod mtshon tshod 'dzin thabs dka': kha ma ṇi shes na lan gsum bzlos: dus phan chad 'don khom yod re shi: drin pha ma yod na kha chems zhog: dus phan chad gtam mtha' yod re shi: mda' nyag phran 'phur shes dmar po'i me: khyod bdud phrug rnam shes sgron me sbar: gnas dag pa'i zhing mchog shasgyu lar: lha rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor tshogs su: deng skad cig nyid la bgrod par byed: lus ngan pa bdud kyi 'khrul gdon khrol: ki bswo bswo chen po lha rgyal lo: yid dga' bar gyis shig byang gi blon: pho dpa' med ming la rtsal ldan zeroḥ rtsal mi ldan tho yol khrab gyon red: gtam mang po'i nyi ma gtong khom med: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du ral gri bton zhing mchong shom byas pas: rtsal ldan 'brong rgod stobs rgyal na re: dpa' med gling phrug tshur nyon dang: rgod 'dod snang ba 'khrul lugs la: 'chi bdag gdon gyis zin pa 'dra: de min byung rgyu ci zhig yod zer zhing gzhu steng la mda' bzhag nas dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la redoḥ glu a la la mo a la red: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral mkhyen: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar mkhyen: sa yi sman mo 284

rkang 'jibs mkhyen: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral mkhyen: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang yul skyid kyi pha sa nas: rdzong mkhar chu klong dgu yag yod: rtsal ldan mang po'i blo ya nga: rtsal ldan 'brong rgod stobs rgyal yin: khrag ral rdo rje'i brag ri las: rtsal ldan rgod po 'dab sgro rgyas: 'bum dmag dug gi mtsho mo las:rtsal ldan dug gi sdong bo 'khrungs:de nas gtam gyi 'dra ma la:chu chung 'ur sgra chen po ma: lung chung nang la sgra yis gang: rgyab ri gangs rgyun yod pa'i rtags: med na gdeng tshod shes tsam yin: mi chung snang ba mthon po ma: don med rta jag las la brtson: rgyab dpung btsan po yod pas rtags: med na ci tshod shes tsam yin: gling phrug dpa' med snang ba mtho: byang la 'jab rgyugs byed zhan 'dra: dmag rgyab dpung mang yod pa'i rtags: med na dpa' tshod shes tsam yin: khyi phrug wa mo dpung bshibs nas: bu mo khrab gyon gangs ri'i blon: ge sar ab zan zer ba kho: ngar rgod ci 'dug shes tshod yin:ma tshad dpa' med sdar ma rnams:bkod pa thabs 'phrul ci yod shes: mgo 'phru gong len mi byed re: byang gi rtsal ldan dpa' bo'i dpung: 'chi bdag bdud phrug sha stag yin: dgra ya tshe zad gling gi bu: a bar rig la snying re rje: rang jus dgra yis lag la bzhag:ma tshad gces srog 'ben du btsugs: da rung de yi ga la tshad:285

tshe sngon las dbang bzlog med de: skabs bstun khyod kyi steng la red:rtsal ldan 'brong rgod stobs rgyal nga: ci ma yin ma 'gran rgyu med: byang sde khra mo phyugs kyi rdzong: na nang lo yi gzhes nangs lo: 'phru dmar dpon gyis 'gran no byas: a dkar glang ma'i gzhi dkyil las: 'phru dmar dpon gyi gces phrug de: ya med lha bu ngang yag gis: dngul rdzong hab thob dgos snang skyes: mchan khebs g.yung drung 'bum dga' kho: mda' kha thog la 'gran no zer: 'gran ya byang la byed bsam nas: tshur byung 'phru dmar blon po rnamasoḥ a pho'i mda' yis ngar la drangs: yin na dpa' bo de 'dra yin: do dgong nyi ma'i phyi dro la: gzhu gcig mi 'gugs brag gcig 'gugs: mda' gcig 'phen pas dgra srog gcod: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dngoḥ mda' de 'phangs pas gangs ri'i lha blon 'phen stag gi snying dkar nag mtshams su thebs kyang srung ba btsan pas ma gnod: de nas ral kha 'gran pas pham rgyal ma byung bar gnas tshe:a drag nyi ma grags pas gri bton nas dpung rib byas te dmar bsad khrag la bsgyur: der gling dmag rnams kyis ki sgra dang bcas chu sna rdol ba bzhin shor:286

der byang sgo nas smug gu'i stong bdud lag ring dang: bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kyis 'bum dmag ser rgod 'bebs pa ltar rtsal ldan lha dbang ye shes dang: rtsal ldan dngul khrab rdo rje gnyis kyi gdong la byung ba dang: smug gu'i stong bdud lag ring gis gzhu mo gser dkris mchog yag gi steng la mda' mo 'phur shes srog gzan bzhag nas yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas: lha rgyal sras 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs: rdzas shes rab ral gri po ti bsnams: dus de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: ngas nye mo mig gis ma mthong de: yang ring bo rna ba'i thos tshod la: gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga smug gu'i stong bdud lag ring yin: gling dpa' rtul dpung gi skyor ya yin: ngas mgo la gyon pa'i byur rmog 'di: mdzes byur rmog nam mkha' rtse brgyad zer: steng dar 'phru dgung la 'phyo ba la: lha dkar phyogs dbu 'phang bstod dar yod: ngas lus la gyon pa'i byur khrab 'di:sra byur khrab rdo rje khyung rdzong zer: steng rgyab dar chu ras rlung gis bskyod:dgra nag phyogs khrag la bsre ba'i rtags: ngas 'khor gsum dug gi lo 'dab rgyas: steng dgra dar 'dzum drug mche ba ngom: dpa' 'thab na rting 287

ma mtho ba'i rtags: sra phub mo gling bdun dngul las grub: rno dug mtshon 'jigs las rnam rgyal yin: g.yas gzig ral thig le mda' yis gang: rno lcags mda' sgro gshog rlung la rtsen: g.yon stag ral 'dzum chen gzhu yis gang: sra lcags gzhu gnam sa ring nas 'gugs: 'phrul sbrul zhags lcags kyu a long 'dzoms: dgra thar med sha btson ske nas 'dzin:rno ral gri'i so la mun pa 'thibs: mdzes shubs khra dpa' bo'i brgyan du bzang: mdung skya ring rtse mo spu gri 'dra: phul zer na chu srin dung 'phrad 'dra: don bden min ltad mo gzigs dang gsal: dpa' 'gran med gling gi bka' blon nga: phyi gnam sa rub kyang ya bo med: sgos khyi phrug wa mo byang blon gyisoḥ dpa' 'gran 'dod rgod gtam nyan na sdug: rgod nges pa yin na mchong la shog: re e bsam byang phrug gos ljang can: 'phru ljang gu dgung la 'phyo na yang: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdung gang la: pho byang phrug snang ba dgung sngon can: khyod sdar ma'i sdar rtags bstan nas 'dug:don shes na 'chi bdag a pho sgoms: de min pa'i 'gro sa lar nas med:glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du: mda' de thog mar lhung pa ltar du 'phangs pas: rtsal ldan lha dbang ye shes kyi snying kha la phog nas go 288

khrab gang gi ma bsten par rgyab phyogs nas mda' de phar thon nas bsad:rtsal ldan dngul khrab rdo rjes dran pa bskor log rgyab te tshig pa gting nas zos zhing mda' stong sprad cing sha lan sha dang khrag lan khrag gis byed bsam zhing dpa' hang ba zhig gi ngang nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral dang: bar snang sa gzhi'i lha la 'bod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ya thang ri bo'i gong ba nas: rdzong chen gzi khri 'od chen nas: rtsal ldan sum cu'i gral ra nas: rtsal ldan dngul khrab rdo rje yin: grags pa che la g.yu 'brug de: pho brgya'i nang na ngar rgod che: rta brgya'i nang na rgyugs 'gros bzang:mi min khrag ral rgyal po yi: nga la thugs brtse che ba yin: rmog dkar steng gi 'phru chung 'dra: khrab dkar steng gi tshe mdud yin: 'do ba'i steng gi gser sga 'dra: 'bum dmag nang gi snying bcud yin: de 'dra a pho'i yin lugs la: da rung de yi tshad pa min: dpa' med gling phrug wa skyes tsho: shi la brel brel mi dgos dang: gson snying a pho'i mda' la drangs:'khor gsum rting ma nom la len: grags pa bod la yod pa zo: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: rgya khra'i gshog sgro ngom lam nas: byi'u chung 'dab sgro rlung la bskur: rgyal stag nags la 'gro lam nas: wa mo gab nag khung 289

la 'dzul: rtsal ldan dpa' kha ngom lam nas: gling phrug gces srog dgra la shor: rgan pas gtam la de 'dra grags: de bas bden gcig yod tshos med: byang phrug stag mo thang gang la: gling phrug wa mo khyu gcig 'gran:sprin dkar mkha' la lang na yang: rlung nag shugs kyis gar gtor yin:'gyod pa sprin dkar kho la yod: yang 'gyod sbrang char bsil ma gda':nags tshal rkang grangs mang na yang: me chen dpung gis gar bsregs red: 'gyod pa nags tshal kho la che: yang 'gyod lo 'dabs 'bras bur gda': dpa' med gling gi 'bum sgar de: mi min byang gi gar bcom red: 'gyod pa rgyal srid shor dus che: yang 'gyod gces srog dor dus gda'oḥ rgod la kho ba'i med bsam pas: dpa' med gling sdug khyu gcig rnams: ya med byang gi kha sngon na: go btsan e yod ltas na gsal:lcags mda' ngar ma'i so lam na: rdo rje'i brag ri mi bsten te: gling sdug sha khrag ga la 'tsham: go btsan yod na bzung nas bsdod: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dngoḥ mda' 'phangs byung ba bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po'i rmog gi pho byang la phog pa khra thar se gtor yang nang du ge sar gyi srung mdun yod pas mtshon ma song: der khong gis mda' ltong sprad nas na re: ya kho rā rtsal ldan dngul khrab bu: a ya med par grags 290

lugs la:mda' de 'dra min na ci 'dra yin: ro rna ro yis ma gab na:nga dpa' rgod glu la tshur nyon dang zer zhing glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo na: lha bcom ldan rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas: khong mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs: bu dad pa can gyi kha mgon gyis: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: gnas byang rdzong stag mo 'dzum yag red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po yin:shing tsan tan sdong po'i lo ma yin: gtsang chu mig dkar mo'i mgo khung yin: dpa' mi brgya'i nang gi yang rgod yin: mgyogs rta brgya'i nang gi byang ma yin: ngas yang dag gtam gyi 'dra ma la: khyod mi min byang sdug wa mo rnams: bsad zer na dmar bo khrag la bsgyuroḥ de ma thub dpa' rtul min pas rtags: ya de nas mi pho rta sngon can: khyod rtsal ldan dngul khrab rdo rje red: ming grags pa che ste g.yu 'brug red: dpa' lag len med pa 'ja' la nor: khyod 'dra ba'i dpa' bo dkon na yang: dus de ring rting ma nga la babs: sa byang yul ri shod lung ba na: dgra dmar bsad khrag gi 'khor lo bskor: shar gling ba zer na kun gyis smon: dpa' rting ma zer na yongs la grags: ya de nas rtsal ldan byang gi bu: khyod bsam blo ci 'dra bkod nas yod: 'dang mal nyal rmi lam ci 'dra rmis: chang skyen pos rtsa 291

khams ma rgyas sam: dpa' khas len sla yang lag len dka': gling dpa' rtul grub chen brgyad cu 'di: don dngos gnas ye yin sangs rgyas red:ma 'gro ba'i don chen bdag gir mdzad: las bya ba bdud dgra 'dul la bskos: bya srol ngan g.yo rgyu'i tshang tshang dkrugs: yul mi bde'i du:kha khongs nas 'joms: don legs bya'i 'jig rten dga' bar byed: gling dkar po'i mdzad pa de ltar lags: khyod tshur chas dmag gi gdong len la: dpa' rtsal ldan ming gi stong sgra las: don lag len mi nus nam lang skar: don bden min da lta gsal nas yongs: dpa' go btsan yod na la mo bzung: pho su rgod rting thag chod pa byed: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'ur sgra thag ger 'phangs byung bar rtsal ldan dngul khrab rdo rje'i brang la thebs te dmar gtor mgo mjug bsgyur ba bzhin bsad do: gling gi dpa' rtul rnams ki sgra dang bcas rdzong la shor nas byang dmag mang du bcom par gda'oḥlho sgo nas byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub dang sog blon stobs chen stag dmar gnyis kyis slar yang rdzong sgo gtor nas nang du mchong ste byang dmag mang po shi rmas bsad gsum gyi ngang nas 'khrugs long drag po byed skabs su byang dmag rnams bros sa ma rnyed par la la rta las lhung zhing 292

brdzis nas bsad: la la dran pa bor nas shi: la las mda' mtshon ci nus kyis 'thab pas mthar dpa' rtul rnams kyi dpa' ngo ma lon par khri dmag gsum tsam gyis skyabs zhu byas shing srog thar ba byung: dmag lnga brgya tsam shi rmas bsad gsum byas nas mi ro'i bam thang dang khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil mthar rdzong gling la thobaX gling dmag gis mi min gyi byang rdzong castag mo 'dzum yag gi rtse la gling gi dar sngon po rdo rje'i mtshan pa zhig btsug naka g.yul las rgyal:293

le'u bcu gsum pa/khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po khos//blon rgan mkhas pa mtha' la sgyugs//bla bya khyung khrung dkar mo yi//ming sring rnams kyi 'phrin pa khyer//de'i skabs su blon rgan shes rab lha dar gyis bsam blo mang du btang nas cis kyang byang gi pha jus shor nges yang blo la 'gyod pa med ni zhig bzo dgos snyam de rgyu nor mang tsam zhig mi min khrag ral rgyal po'i mdun du bzhag nas dad phyag dang bcas zhu 'bul gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: spyi bo gtad sa a sngon dgung: mi 'gyur 'od kyi gdengs khang na: srog bdag srin po lcags ral can: de ring ma g.yel glu sna drongs: bar snang sprin gyi bang rim gyi:sna tshogs 'ja' yi klong dkyil nas: lha mchog bdud btsan me 'bar ya:gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs: rkang chung gtad sa g.yang gi gnas: mi 'gyur me tog lhas ra nas: yul lha sman mo rkang 'jibs ma:thugs rje'i mthu dpung myur bar mdzod: mi min byang gi sa cha ru: gter 294

rdzong g.yang gi ra ba nas: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral can: rang dpung srung la dgra sde choms: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi 'gyur byang gi rgyal sa ste: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: lus rgas phung po'i drang shing nyams: sems rgas dbang po'i gsal kha 'thibs: mi brgya'i gral la mi the rung: bsam dkar shes rab lha dar yin: shel dkar khang mdzes nang shed nas: dmar sngon dar gdugs mar 'og tu:dngul khri seng brgyad 'gying ba'i steng: mi dmar khrag gi mig rtsa can:khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po lags: gson dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod: mi rgan shes rab lha dar nga'i: tshig la nyes 'gal yod pa'i tshe: byang phrug 'been du bzhag kyang chog: skye ba yod na 'chi ba srid: skye ba'i 'byung lus thob pas na: mi 'chi bsam pa yi re mug: pho lo brgyad cu gya bdun yin:tshe stod dmag dang jag la zad: pham kha rang gis khur ma myong: tshe smad khrag ral bka' blon byas: blo dang dam tshig 'gyur med yin: da lta rgas pa'i dus skabs 'dir: mi brgya'i nang nas dbang chung red: rta brgya'i nang gi rgyugs med red: yin yang zhu ba lan gsum yod: da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrugs 'di: chags bzhag 'dra ma 'di 'dra ste: bya rgyal gnam 'phang gcod sa la: ne'u les gshog rtsal 'gran pa 'dra: rgya stag ngar ma'i dpa' lam na: wa mos rtsal drug ngom pa 'dra: 'brong mo'i ru thur 295

gzer lam nas: glang rgan ru 'gran byed pa 'dra: 'chi bdag dpa' rtul thang gang la: byang ba tshe zad 'gran pa 'khrul: rdzun dang g.yo rgyu byed don med: mthong ba mngon gyur yongs nges yin: de sngon nyi ma'i yan chad la:gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal gcig: chu yi chu 'dren rkang ring gnyis: me yi me ru dmar po gsum: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod bzhi: thog lha gshin rje nag po lnga: rtsal ldan dpa' bo de tsam shor: 'bum dmag dpung rgod phyed bgos byas: khrag ral sku khams bzang ba'i dus: mgo 'bul gling la byas na bzang: rgyal pos rang sde rang bdag 'ong: de min byung ba gcig las med: spyi dpon blo yi rje bo des: dus gsum bya ba lag mthil yin:khro thung rdzu 'phrul stobs la mkhas: dpa' rtul dpung rgod gshin rje dngos: 'bum dmag kha grangs bgrang las 'das: de sngon bshad pa thig nges kyang: rgyal po'i thugs la ma song lan: sang nyin nyi ma rtse shar la:byang gling mdun ma gtam zer na: mi rgan mi 'dug 'gro na chog: zhus pa'i don go chod ni byed: e red rgyal po'i thugs la bskor: phyin chad 'gyod pa med nges dgos: blon rgan snying gi skad cha de: bden bsam las de byas pas na: 'di bde phyi skyid thon nges red: de min g.yul 'thab rjes bskyangs na: gling rje ge sar rgyal po kho: rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul ba red: khros na khro bo rta mgrin red: ma khros thugs rje chen po 296

red: skyabs na 'di phyi kun tu bzang: byang gi dmag tshod bzung na dga': rma khams gling gi las dmag rnams: 'phru dkar kha ba babs babs red: 'phru nag grub so gug gug red: 'phru ljang dbyar skyes 'khrungs 'khrungs red: 'phru sngon g.yu mtsho rdol rdol red: 'phru ser spang me mched mched red: 'phru khra rtsi tog rgyas rgyas red: bsam pa sems kyi mi long ngo: dran pa yid kyis mi thig go: dpa' rgod che ba 'chi bdag red: kha grangs mang ba bu yug red: mang sna nyung gi ga la brten: mdo don 'di la dpyad pa thongs: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: rgyal po'i thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po'i blo kha gling lhas bsgyur nas blon po'i tshig rnams rna la ma song nas tshig pa gting nas zos shing byang gi gros ra bsdu ba'i bka' phab pa bzhin 'du ra gcig la 'dus byung ba dang: mi min khrag ral rgyal pos 'jigs pa'i chas dang bcas ngoms stabs kyis khri thog la hor 'dug cig byas nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: byang mi min srog bdag lcags ral dang: khong lha mchog bdud btsan me 'bar rtsal:gnas yul lha sman mo rkang 'jibs moḥ rdzong gter bdag ri bo brag ral 297

sogs: don chen po'i tshig thag gcod rogs kyis: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:yul gnam sa dbang bsgyur rgyal po nga: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po yin:nga ma thub dgra yi gshed ma yin: sdug mtha' 'dre gling ba gang nas shor:nga gnam sa'i bar na 'gran mkhan med: yang 'gran kyang kha ya su yi nus:da yang dag gtam gyi snying po la: shod zer na 'dra ma 'di ltar gda':yul mi min byang gi rgyal po ngas: blo shes rig dran 'phrul glog dang 'dra:yul dus gsum lag mthil ri mo yin: da mi gsal mi dpyod ga la srid:phyi gling bzhi gling phran ri brag mtsho: phyogs 'dzam gling che ba'i yul khams kun: mtho nam mkha'i ma khebs ga la lus: dpal nyi mas ma khyab zer sa med: rgya gar nag bal bod sog po'i yul: mtha' 'dzam gling yul gru thams cad kyang: nga khrag ral dbang du ma 'dus med: kheb chen po'i ma kheb yod don med: kho mtha' 'dre gling rus tshur 'gebs 'di: sdug bsnyas bzhag tshod med byas pa red: bya de 'dra a phos khur rgyu min: blon rgan pa shes rab lha dar khyod: yang a bar rig la snying re rje: dpa' rang smad dgra bstod than skad de: bya phyi nang brje ba'i skad cha red: stag dmar yag khrag gi ldab sha dod: wa ga ma'i gra kha dgos pa min: bkra gzig mor thig le 'bum rdzong shar: than grum pa'i gra lo dgos pa med:298

rta 'do chen gyi ling bang kha myur: bong ga ma'i 'dur rgyugs a dgos chung:nga khrag ral g.yu 'brug sngon mo la: khyod shes med kha ta dgos don med:gtam kha ta mi 'dra snying tshim 'dra: nga rgyal po'i yid dang 'gal nas thal:wa ga ma'i ngang tshul ston ston nas: dmag khra mo'i jus la gnod nas byung:yang de sngon kha than mang du bsgrags: blon rgan song rtsis nas bzhag na yang: tshod ma zin sdug gtam rgyun chad med: dus de ring tshig ngan rna ba bcag: shar gling sdug rnams kyi lo rgyus la: gtam gsal bo rang sde'i khung bzhin bshad: yid 'di la the tshom skye le byas: rgan shes rab lha dar zer ba 'dis: yang de sngon nyi ma'i bzhag so la: byang rgyal po'i jus don byed myong bas: srog mi gcod tshe thar de yis gtong: khyod ma 'dug rgyal khams gzhan la song: sde mi min yul la 'dug mi chogoḥ 'dug srid na srog dmar 'been la 'jog: ya de nas 'dir tshogs blon gyi dpung: kho 'gag mo'i jo ru nag rtsog gi: dpa' srog bdag mi min rgyal po yod:yang de min dpa' rtul sdar ma tshooḥ dpa' nga 'dra khyod 'dra mang pos chom:gyad stong bdud stag mo 'dzum rgyas dang: gzhan gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa gnyis: dpa' rgod po dug smyon nag po gsum: mtho pho brang srung ba'i thugs 'gan bzhes: mgyogs pho nyas myur rtsal bang kha phyesoḥ blon gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang khong: da ma 'dug la mo bos la shog: 'gag 299

phreng gsum dmag gis dam du bzung: darmeg phar 'bud dpung 'gran dgos pa med: dgra tshur byung srog dang bral ba gal: dpa' mi brgya kha sems mthun pa gyis: mgyogs rta brgya srab mda' gcig pa dgos: kho mtha' 'dre gling sdug ma thub par: gzhan phyi mi nang la yongs sa med:yang nang mi phyi la 'gro sa med: dpa' go gyon dgra dar 'tshub se gyis: rta sga stan ri mo khrig ge gyis: mgyogs 'do ba chas kyis sos le gyis: gzhan dmag rtsal dpung sbyang ma zhan cig: ya kho re gyad mi stong bdud dpon:nga rgyal po'i jus la blo rtse dkar: kho mi rgan ma bzhag gzhan la mngog:yang phyi dgra mi thub nang dme sogs: byed zer na byang gi khrims lugs bzhin: mi ma shi gson spags mi bshu re: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la:glu ma go ba la yang len med: dpung 'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs ba dang: blon tshogs rnams kyi blon rgan mtha' la sgyugs pa shin tu 'phangs yang sus kyang yar zhu ma nus:nyi ma de yi phyir nyin gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar khrid nas yar skyel thang dgu ru slebs tshe stong bdud kyis blon po khyed nyid sa gang du dga' na song dang zer nas mig mtha' mchu ma 'khor gyin gser dngul gyi gnang sbyin mang du mdzad nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:300

glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: 'bru drug tshig gi bcad so red: don gtam glu yi 'gugs tshul red: mi min byang gi srung ma rnams: yod na de ring spyan gyis gzigs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:byang gi yar skyel thang chen red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gyad chen bzhi yi rtse 'dzin nga: dpa' rgod grags pa ldan mi la: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig yin: de nas shes rab lha dar lags: gson dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re gda': da lo gnam lo tshur shar la: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po kho:sngar dang da gnyis mi 'dra do: ci bshad rna la mi 'gro lags: snying gtam bshad na khrel la phog: byang gling g.yul 'khrug byed pa 'di: byang rgyal sku jus shor ba 'dra: shor yang 'gyod pa ci yang med: lan med shes rab lha dar khyod: mtha' med yul la 'khyar pa 'di: a re 'gyod kyang rang dbang chung: byed thabs med pa gsal nges red: de nas lha blon rin po che: shes ldan snying gtam 'chad 'chad de: bsam med rgyal po'i khrel la bsgyur: ci bya gtol med byung nas thal: shul lus nged cag gyad blon rnams: sang shi gnang 'chi cha med red: rgyu lus 'ben la ma bzhag na:rgyal po shi yang mi sdod nges: rin chen gser dngul gya nom 'di: yid sems nang gi mtshon tsam yin: dal cig 'jig rten 'khor yug nas: mi min khrag ral rgyal po yi: bka' blon bskos pa 'dra 'dra la: skyid sdug ri 301

mo kha kha byung: sa mtha' 'grim pa'i lha dar dang: gri khar 'chi kha'i gyad mi gnyi sa: de ring so sor bral ba 'di: bsam na mchu ma zag las ci: nged cag shul lus gyad mi rnams: lcags kyu'i kha yi nya mo bzhin: skam la btags rgyu'i snga phyi tsam: gzan gyis bkug pa'i wa mo bzhin: gra yag shor nges snga phyi tsam: rgya stag sngon gyi 'do phrug bzhinoḥ sug bzhi breg ste snga phyi tsamoḥ sngo ljang khrod kyi bung ba bzhin: sad ser byung ste snga phyi tsam: red de gyod pa lar nas med: dpyod ldan blon rgan lha dar lags: khyod dang 'u gu gnyis po dang: 'gro ba mi yi chos nyid la: dang po skye dus gcig pur skyes: bar du skyid sdug gcig pus khur: mtha' ma 'chi yang gcig pur ste: bsam na yi mug 'chor ba'i rgyu: byang yul mi min dngul rdzong 'dioḥ gling gis brgyan la shor bar nges: mtha' ma byang gi sa cha 'di:gyang ral 'jag skya'i shug glu len: 'gong bo than gyi bro gar 'khrab: mi 'dod las shig yongs bar nges: rma khams 'gag mo'i jo ru des: de sngon rgyal khag mang po phab: de bzhin byang la yongs nges gda': shes chen skad cha rgyang nas nyon: mi 'gyang las 'di mgo la thon: 'on kyang nam 'chi bsgug nas 'dug: dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar lags: tshe la bar chad med par shog: gar 'gro las ma geg med shog: gar 'dug gnas sa bzang bar shog: bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par shog: go na 302

rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: blon rgan thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar phul bar dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar gyis rin po che mu min 'od ldan de gyad mi stong bdud la gnang zhing yid skyo bas ngang nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la redoḥ lha yod na lha yis gdong grogs mdzod: lha med na bos pas ci zhig phan: sems skyo ba'i mun pa ma sel na: glu mgrin pa'i dbyangs chung mi khrol lags: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang yar skyel thang chen gong ma red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: chung gzhon lus dar la babs pa'i dus: dpa' rgod po zer nas kun gyis gleng: nga tshe mtha' rgas sdug thog babs la: pho snying chung zer nas dpon gyis smad: skyid pha yul gson skyur byed mi la: nga sprang rgan shes rab lha dar yin: rgas pho lo brgyad cus sngon nas bsus: yang rang lo bdun cus phar la bskyal: gnas 'chi ba'i yul la rdog pa spos:gson mi yul phyogs la re thag thung: mig khra chung dbang po nyams nas thal: lam rgyang ring sa mtha' mi mthong lags: lus sgyu ma'i rtsal drug zhan nas thal: yob khra mo ldog pas mi non to: mi'i skye thengs rim pa rnam gsum de: yang skye sa shi sa dur sa gsum: kho gshin rjes dur la gar 303

btab red: nga mi rgan de la skyo ba min: sde mi min byang gi rgyal po la: tshe 'di nas re thag zab zab nas: jus g.yul 'khrug 'di la sdug blo thim:bya gang la brtags kyang 'di la zug: blo bsgyur med rang blo kher gcod 'di: mthar ma legs bya ba rang la 'byung: rgan 'chi ba'i mtshan ma thogs babs 'dra: nga mi 'chi zer sa gang na yod: dpa' khyed cag shul lus blon po rnams: bya ci byung legs nyes dka' mo ste: phyi dgra la khra 'thab sbyang 'thab kyis: bu rgod kyang ngar 'thab snying bo med: rgod zer yang tha ma srog dmar 'chor: rta rgyugs rgyugs bang kha rdo la thug: 'di sngon las nag po'i pham kha red: dpung g.yul 'thab rting ma gang nas lon: lha bla ma'i byang chub sems khrid de: kho slob ma ngan pas yid na med: drin pha ma'i byams sems kha ta de: kho bu rgyud ngan pas khrel gyis bor: nga shes rab rgan po'i bslab bya de: kho khrag ral dpon gyis snyan la phog: ya kho re stong bdud mig gcig lags: tshig mang po bshad pa'i dgos pa med: bshad mang na mtha' ma dgra ru lang: nga mi 'dug rgyal khams gzhan la 'gro: blon stong bdud dpa' rtags che na yang: don yang dag las la zab nan gyis: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: dpa' stong bdud thugs la de ltar zhog:ces zer zhing 'bral mi phod pa tsam du gyes: der dpyod ldan shes 304

rab lha dar gyis chibs kha lho la bsgyur nas song: lam khar bsam blo mang du btang mthar dam pa'i chos la mos pa thob: yid skyo drag pa'i mchu ma mang du zag: ri mthon po nags shugs kyi bzung ba zhig gi nye 'gram du thon pas mi med lung stong de na bya byi'u gcan gzan las 'gro ba mi yi grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu med pa'i mod la 'jig rten 'dus byas kyi chos la snying bo med pa sems la yang dag par nges nas rgan kher 'khyar skyo glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: bla ma lha la gsol ba 'debs: blo sna chos la 'gyur bar shog: yi dam khros pa yongs 'dus 'bod: bar chad nag po'i mun pa sel: mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus mkhyen: phyi ma mkha' spyod zhing la drongs: chos skyong bstan srung tshogs la 'dud: ma rig 'khrul ba'i dgra bo sgrol: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: sngo ljang nags kyi tshur mtha' red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: tshe stod dbang po dar ba'i dus: gzhon nu'i snang ba dgung las mtho: rtsal drug lus la tshang tshang nas: grags pa g.yu 'brug bas kyang che: tshe sked dus kyi bzhag so la:mi min dpon gyi bka' blon byas: brgya thag gcig gis bcad bcad nas: mtha' ma nyes pa'i khur bo khur: mi med lung stong ri bo nasoḥ rgan pos sdug glu rlung gis khur: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: yid skyo rdza 305

mgo'i smug pa red: lus gcung la mtho'i dar krog red: 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid la: bden pa med pa ngang gis mthong: a sngon gnam gyi nyi zla gnyis: gza' skar mang pos 'khor gyis bskor: dal cig dgung lam ring mo nas: nyi zla gza' yis kha la shoroḥ skar tshogs sprin pas 'obs la drangs: mi rtag rang mtshang snang nas byung: bar snang yangs pa'i thog 'brug glog: sprin gsal 'thug po'i klong na skyid: dal cig rgyu ba'i lam kha nas: g.yu 'brug seng ge'i zil gyis mnanoḥ glog zhags stong ba'i dbyings la thim: sprin dkar rlung gis kha nas gtor: sa gzhi g.yang gi ri brag mtshooḥ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis bskor: dal cig brjid pa'i lam kha nas: ri brag bskal ba'i dbang la shor: gling bzhi mi rtag mtshang gis zhig: zhag dang dus la dpe blangs na: dbyar zla'i me tog sna tshogs la: bung ba gzhon nu'i mgrin snyan 'khor: bde skyid ldan pa'i dal tsam la: me tog ser rgod dpung gis gtor: bung ba mi rtag skye 'chi byung:ston zla 'bru drug zhing gi sa: nas 'bras gro sogs smin pa la: rlung gi snyan pa'i glu chung len: 'bru drug zor ba'i kha la 'thim: rtswa ljang rkang bzhi'i so nams byed: rlung chen mi skyo ka med byung: dgun zla ri thang 'khyag gis bzung: chu mtsho rgya dar dbang la shor: ri bo'i bzhin ras dkar la 'tsher: dal gcig chu mtsho drod kyis bcom: gos dkar khri gdugs nyi 306

mas bsnyul: dpyid zla shing la lo 'dab 'khrungs: khu byug mon nas bod la byon: drug 'gyur snyan pa'i ri lung khyab: bsam na dga' ba'i snang ba spro: skyid pa'i nyi ma shar nas byung: dbyar gyi pho nya yin no bsam: dga' spro las la brtson khom med: mi rtag 'chi la je nye red: lo gcig lo gnyis zhag grangs kyi: gsod par 'khrid pa'i bshas zog 'dra: rgas khog shes rab lha dar ngas: srab mo so yis mi chod do: zas zhim sa la re ba med:gos yag gyon 'dod nga la med: tshe stod skyong skyong 'jig rten red: phyi ma'i thar lam bkag zhan 'dra: srog gcod las 'bras bsags bsags nasoḥ rang thog smin tshe a re 'gyod: 'jig rten mi rtag 'khor ba ni:skyid skyid lo chung bsam med red: sdug sdug 'chi kha'i rgan po red: yag yag na gzhon lang tsho red: rtsog rtsog rgas pa'i chos nyid red: lo chung pho gzhon yin dus suoḥ rgas zer rna thos ma gtogs pa: rang thog 'ong bsam yid la med: sprang sdug zhe brnyas smad smad nas: rgas sprang byung bsam yid la med: skyid pa'i ja chang rol rol nas: 'chi bdag byung bsam yid la med: nyam chung kun la brnyas brnyas nas: rang thog babs bsam yid la med: sdang sdang nyam chung steng la sdang: rang sdug khur dgos bsam ma myong: mi rtag skyid sdug sos ka'i gnamoḥ mi rtag nam pa 'gyur nas 'gro: bsam med blo chung 'gro ba rnams: skyid 'dod mi tshe 307

stong zad sdug: brgyad cus 'bod pa byung bas dus: re sa bla ma ma gtogs med: bsten sa dam chos min pa med: kho thag nang nas chod nas byung: de ring nyi ma phan chad la: gsol ba bla ma lha la 'debs: dad pa dam pa'i chos la byed: rje btsun pad 'byung sprul pa'i sku: nyams chung bdag la byin gyis rlobs: 'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo la: rtag pa mi 'dug stong ba'i 'ja': kha dog mtshar yang dgung la yal: ma rig 'khrul ba'i shes rab nga: 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem du gsol: glu 'di thos tshad sems can rnams: nges shes kho thag chod par shog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med:ces smras nas blo chos la gtad nas byang mtha' rin chen mtsho bdun zer sar sgrub pa la gzhol nas thar ba'i lam sna zin par grags so: gyad mi stong bdud phyir rdzong la thon: der gong mngag byang mi gnyis po gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gi rdzong la rgyal po'i gsung bkod rnams chad lus med par bshad pa la nyi ma de yi phyir nyin gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gis las dmag rnams khrid de mi min rgyal po'i pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong phyug mo'i phyogs la khra chem mer pheb 'ong: byang dmag rnams kyis gra sgrig 'tshub se rgyal sa bzung nas 'dug go: de'i skabs su phyogs bzhi'i gling dmag rnams kyis rdzong bzhi bo'i nang la dmag mi dang 'go 'dzin 'ga' 308

re bskos shing rtse la gling dar rdo rje'i mtshan pa re btsugs nas gda':dpa' rtul 'bum dmag mang phyogs sgar tsho gcig tu bsdus nas mi min khyung thang gling dbus kyi sa cha bzung: de'i nyin 'ga' yi rjes la mi min khrag ral rgyal po'i sras chung gnyis dang sras mo gnyis pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi thog khang steng la thon nas khong tshos lag pas bya ra byed cing gling sgar la gzigs par: phar gyi bar snang khams nas bya khrung khrung rnams tshur gcar nas 'phur byung zhing: rgyal khang gi bya khebs kyi steng la babs pa dang: sras ming sring rnams kyis 'phrin glu zhig bskur na a ce la e 'phrod bsam nas yod tshe: rgyal sras zla gsal gyis skad phra la snyan pas drug 'gyur dang bcas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: khong yab chen rgyud pa'i srung ma rnams: dus de ring glu chung 'gugs rogs mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang sha ri'i yang thog red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang khrag ral rgyal gyi sras po nga: dpa' byang phrug rtsal ldan ga ri ṭa: yin nges pa zla gsal 'bum lu yin: mtho a sngon mthing gi rgyud lam na: sprin dkar dmar gshags pa'i nus mthu can: khyed bla bya khrung khrung spun gsum lags: nga bu chung glu la tshur gson dang: phyogs 'di nas shar la e 'gro lagasoḥ khyed shar gyi phyogs la 'gro zer na: dpung 309

'bum sgar dug chu khol 'dra na: bu chung chung nga yi a ce ste: ma tshe 'dzin lha mo zer ba gan: sde mtha' dmag gling gis bzung nas yod: bsad tshar ram gson pa su yis shes: byang bla bya khrung khrung spun gsum lags:don de la ltad mo gzigs rogs kyis: deng ma bsad gson po yin zer na: nga bu chung 'phrin 'di zhu rogs mdzod: byang rgyal sras pha khyim dbang na yang: nga bu chung sems pa mi skyid do: chung 'dab sgro ma rgyas khrung khrung nga: sang gnang mo nam 'phang gcod yongs kyis: chung g.yu ral ma 'khrungs seng phrug ngoḥ sang nangs mo gangs la 'gying 'ong gyis: chung gshog drug ma smin nya phrug ngoḥ sang nangs mo mtsho mtha' bcad 'ong gyis:mgyogs bang kha ma rgyas 'do phrug nga: sang nangs mo byang lam 'grim 'ong gyis: dpa' rtsal drug ma rgyas bu chung ngas: sang nangs mo dgra sha rtsod 'ong gyis: khyed sku lus lang tsho'i me tog de: sad ser bas dpung gis ma bcom na: dus dbyar tshugs sang nangs slebs nges shod: gsung snyan mo dpyid kyi pho nya de: bya kha tā'i ag 'gyur ma rgyags dang: ljon g.yu lo'i rang mdangs gsal nges shod: thugs klong yangs dkar bo'i dung sems la: rmag mun pa'i yol ba ma 'khor dang: sang nangs mo nyi ma shar 'ong shod: byang mi min na chung tshe 'dzin ma: khyed blo sna dgra la ma gtad dang:nga nu bos dgra dpung bcom 'ong shod: da 'on kyang mi rtag 'khor ba 'di:310

bshad zer na dgod re mi spro'amoḥ las skyid sdug 'thag gi rkan so 'dra:dus da lo byang gling g.yul 'gyed de: dpe bzhag na 'dra ma 'ga' re gda': kho gling lha cho 'phrul che dang gcigoḥ gling ge sar dbang thang che dang gnyis: khu khro thung bya lag mang dang gsum: dpon spyi dpon blo sgo yangs dang bzhi: gling dpa' rtul gtum drag tsha dang lnga: bya sngon las bzlog pa med dang drug: khong yab chen dran 'phrul zhan dang bdun: bya de bdun 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod la: rdzong jus srid bstan rgyu dka' na yang: yid 'gyod pa ming sring rnams la med: blon dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar khong: 'dug ma bcugs sa mthar skrad nas thal: de ci yin blo yis mi dpyod do: dpa' gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal gtsos: dpa' yang rgod blon po de drag shor: yin bsam pa sems la mi 'dug lags: bya ci bya blo yis mi theg go: ya a ce tshe 'dzin lha mo lags: skyid ming chung nga yi glu lan la: da ma 'gyang skad cha gsal bo dgos: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len medoḥ khyed khrung khrung yid la de ltar zhog:ces smras shing mig nas mchi ma zags kyin gar 'gro gzigs skabs gshog 'gyur lan gsum brgyab nas khra mo gling gi sgar la gtad nas 'phur song: ming sring rnams kyis lab gleng mang du byas mthar pho brang gi nang la phyin: bla bya khrung khrung spun gsum sras mo tshe 'dzin lha mo'i gzim 311

gur gyi thad la thon nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red khrung khrung: glu a la la mo a la red khrung khrung:bla ma yon tan gter mdzod mkhyen khrung khrung: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs khrung khrung: ma rig 'khor ba'i la yog khrol khrung khrung: dag pa ye shes rang zhal ston khrung khrung: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na khrung khrung: khra mo gling gi 'bum sgar red khrung khrung: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na khrung khrung: brag dkar rgod tshang gong ma nas khrung khrung: na chung khyod kyi gsos bya yin khrung khrung: de nas byang bza' tshe 'dzin ma khrung khrung: snyan gyi dbang po tshur la gtod khrung khrung: mi min byang gi rgyal sa ste khrung khrung: pho brang sha ri'i yang steng nas khrung khrung: bu chung dkar la mdzes pa'i mdangs khrung khrung: skyo ba'i 'phrin chung nga la bskur khrung khrung: rgyal sa pho brang skyid na yang khrung khrung: ming chung sems pa mi skyid zer khrung khrung: 'dab sgro ma rgyas khyung phrug kho khrung khrung: chung nas gnam 'phang ma chod kyang khrung khrung: sang nangs da yi dus tshod la khrung khrung: gnam 'phangs bcad nas slebs 'ong zer khrung khrung: g.yu ral ma 'khrungs seng phrug kho khrung khrung: chung nas gangs khrod ma zin yang khrung khrung: sang nangs da yi dus tshod la khrung khrung:gangs dkar rtse la 'gying 'ong zer khrung khrung: gshog drug ma smin nya phrug kho khrung khrung: chung nas rgya mtsho ma chod kyang khrung khrung: sang nangs da yi 312

dus tshod la khrung khrung: mtsho mtha' skor nas thon yong zer khrung khrung:bang kha ma rgyas 'do phrug kho khrung khrung: chung nas skya gral ma chod kyang khrung khrung: sang nangs da yi dus tshod la khrung khrung: byang lam 'grim nas thon 'ong zer khrung khrungoḥ mi min byang gi rgyal sras kho khrung khrung: chung bas 'thab 'khrugs ma nus kyang khrung khrung: sang nangs da yi dus tshod la khrung khrung: a ce'i ra mda' thon yong zer khrung khrung: sku lus lang tsho'i me tog te khrung khrung: sad ser gnod par ma gcar zer khrung khrung: gsung snyan ngag gi drug 'gyur te khrung khrung: dgra la ma len don chung zer khrung khrung:thugs klong shes rab mda' smyug gi khrung khrung: gshis rgyud drang mor ma ston lags khrung khrung: skad cig ming sring kha bral 'di khrung khrung: mi rtag mtshan nyid yin no zer khrung khrung: ming po'i 'phrin pa de tsam red khrung khrung: chad lus med pa zhus ni yin khrung khrung: de nas na chung tshe 'dzin ma khrung khrung: sku lus bde thang ci 'dra 'dug khrung khrung: skyid sdug lo rgyus ci 'dra yod khrung khrung: pha yul mdzes pa'i zhing khams te khrung khrung: ma mthong de sngon deng gi bar khrung khrung: na chung bsam pa ci 'dra 'dug khrung khrungoḥ rang yul rgyal bo'i sku khams bde khrung khrung: mnga' thang sngon dang 'dra nas 'dug khrung khrung: byang bza' chu yi lha mo de khrung khrung: bde skyid ngang du 'tsho gzhis gda' khrung khrung: ming po rin chen dpa' bzang de 313

khrung khrung: brjid chags sngon dang 'dra'o lags khrung khrung: ming chung zla gsal 'bum lu de khrung khrung: gzhon lus dar zhing rgyas bzhin gda' khrung khrung: mdzes chung 'od gsal sgrol ma de khrung khrung: nad med lang tsho 'phel nas 'dug khrung khrung: a ce chos kyi mtsho mo de khrung khrung: mdzangs ma'i yon tan tshang nas 'dug khrung khrung: mi min byang gi pha dmag rnams khrung khrung: rdzong btsan gcig tu bsdus nas thal khrung khrung: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong na khrung khrung: go gyon bu yug 'tshub 'tshub red khrung khrung:mtshon thogs ser ba babs babs red khrung khrung: rta gzhon smug pa lang lang red khrung khrung: gra sgrig dus gcig byas nas 'dug khrung khrung: tshur byung dgra bo bsad cing gda' khrung khrung: phar mchong rting ma len 'dod che khrung khrungoḥ da rung de yi ga la tshad khrung khrungoḥ dpyod ldan shes rab lha dar kho khrung khrung: nyes can min de sa mthar sgyugs khrung khrung: pha yul bral nas byon song lags khrung khrung: yab chen khrag ral rgyal po de khrung khrung: sngar dang da gnyis mi 'dra 'dug khrung khrung: gtam bshad bden la 'dzin rgyu med khrung khrung: tshur bshad khrims dang 'gal ba red khrung khrung:ci yin yid kyis mi dpyod do khrung khrung: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la khrung khrung: ma go glu la yang len med khrung khrung: zhes glu mjug rdzogs par bla bya khrung khrung gsum des sgro sprugs re byas 314

te 'dug go: der mi min tshe 'dzin lha mos ming sring rnams yid la shar nas mig gnyis las mchi ma mang du shor: blon shes rab lha dar la sha tsha snying nas skyes shing bla bya khrung khrung gsum la 'phrin lan gyi glu 'di ltar phul lo:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: skyid zer na ja chang mtshar glu len: sdug zer na rang sems gso glu len: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: dpung 'bum dmag dug rlangs 'thib pa'i dkyil: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: lus skye lus gcig la skyid sdug gnyis: chung tshe stod bsod nams dar ba'i dus: byang pha yul g.yang gi ra ba nas: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong rngams: dpon khrag ral gser gyi nyi ma la: tshe gtan grogs chu yi lha mo srid: sras nyi zla zung gi 'od snang gsal: sman sras mo mched gsum 'bring ba nga: ma na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: skyid zer na pha ma mgo 'dzoms red: 'bangs ru sdes gus zhabs yid la 'thad: brgyan gos 'phrug mig gi bu lon 'phrog: dpal 'byor ba klu dbang gnyis su med: yid skyo yang bu mo dbang chung redoḥ las zer ba ri gzar rbab chu 'dra: deng tshe smad gar 'khyam su yis shes: khyed ming sring dran na mig chu 'thor: dus da lo g.yul gyi 'khrug pa 'dis: yab rgyal po'i thugs sems dkrug drag pas: bya ci brtsam phyin ci log pa red: blo 315

gang bkod rang thogs dgra 'bod red: don yang dag bya ba ci yang med:chung byis pas rtsed mo rtse rtse red: dus da lo yab chen rgyal po khong: las dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa 'dra: sems dkar po'i skad cha khrel la bsgyur:bya rang thag rang gis bcad bcad nas: mthar rang srog 'dre la phul ba 'dra: deng rang sems rang gis rmongs rmongs nas: da rang yul pha jus shor nges red: blo khra mo bkod la dpa' tshod bzung: gling ge sar dpon la 'gran ya med: 'di mi go phag gi gsang gtam yin: tshe 'jig rten 'di na rang srog gi: bya don chen gzhan 'ga' yod pa min: khyad par du zla gsal 'bum lu lags: 'phur sgro gshog khrung la rgyas na yang: mtho nam mkha'i mtha' la chod dus med: seng g.yu ral rtsal drug rgyas na yangoḥmatho gangs stod kha rgya 'dzad du med: nya gser mig 'dab gshog rgyas na yang: klung chu bo'i gting mtha' chod dus med: khyod byang phrug na tshod rdzogs na yang: kho ge sar dpon la 'gran blo med: bya de la dgongs pa ma mdzad cig: sdug chag sgo rang gis nyo nges yin: nga a ce'i snying gtam yid la bzung: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:skyid ming sring rnams kyi sems la zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: bla bya khrung khrung rnams kyis bka' deng du blangs nas phyir 'phur zhing sras ming sring rnams pho brang steng khang gi 316

rab gsal khar 'dug pa mthong nas de gar babs shing a ces 'phrin lan rnams zhu 'dod kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red khrung khrung: glu a la la mo a la red khrung khrung:mchu to ra la grub pa'i rkyen khrung khrung: glu len ngag 'gugs shin tu dka' khrung khrung: mi len ka med tshe 'dzin mas khrung khrung: gtam gyi pho nya skyel mi yin khrung khrung: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na khrung khrung: sha ri gnam rdzong yang steng gi khrung khrung: rab gsal yangs ba'i spen pad red khrung khrung: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na khrung khrung: tshe 'dzin lha mo'i bla bya yin khrung khrung: de nas mi min rgyal po yi khrung khrung: ming sring g.yang gi sde tshogs nyon khrung khrung: skyid nges pha ma mgo 'dzoms red khrung khrung: ru sdes gus zhabs yid la 'thad khrung khrung: brgyan gos mig gi bu lon 'phrog khrung khrung:dpal 'byor klu dbang gnyis su med khrung khrung: skyo yang bu mo dbang chung red khrung khrung: las rlung ri gzar rbab chu 'dra khrung khrung: tshe smad gar 'khyam su yi shes khrung khrung: ming sring dran na mig chu 'thor khrung khrung: da lo g.yul gyi 'khrug pa 'dis khrung khrung: rgyal po'i thugs sems dkrug drag pas khrung khrung: gang brtsam phyin ci log pa red khrung khrung: blo bkod rang thog dgra 'bod red khrung khrung: yang dag bya ba ci yang med khrung khrung:byis pas rtsed mo rtse rtse red khrung khrung: dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa 'dra khrung 317

khrung: sems dkar skad cha khrel la bsgyur khrung khrung: rang thag rang gis bcad bcad nas khrung khrung: rang srog dgra la phul ba 'dra khrung khrung:rang sems rang gis rmongs rmongs nas khrung khrung: rang yul pha jus shor nges red khrung khrung: sras gnyis ma 'khrug dpa' tshod bzung khrung khrung: ge sar dpon la 'gran ya med khrung khrung: mi go phag gi gsang gtam yin khrung khrung: 'jig rten 'di na rang srog gi khrung khrung: don chen gzhan 'ga' yod pa min khrung khrung: khyad par zla gsal 'bum lu lags khrung khrung: 'phur gshog khrung la rgyas na yang khrung khrung: nam mkha'i mtha' la chod dus med khrung khrung: seng la rtsal drug rgyas na yang khrung khrung: gangs stod kha rgya 'dzad du med khrung khrung: gser mig 'dab gshog rgyas na yang khrung khrung: chu bo'i gting mtha' chod du med khrung khrung: byang phrug na tshod rdzogs na yang khrung khrung: ge sar dpon la 'gran blo med khrung khrung: bya der dgongs pa ma mdzad cig khrung khrung: chag sgo rang gis nyo nges yin khrung khrung: a ce'i snying gtam yid la bzung khrung khrung: ma 'ong las kyi bzhag so la khrung khrung: mi min byang gi rgyal khag 'di khrung khrung: mgo med ca la rlung gis khyer khrung khrung: sdug gi a thang chad pa na khrung khrung: pha bzang bu khyod las dbang btsan khrung khrung: ma brjed bu chung thugs la bzung khrung khrungoḥ shi yang kha ta 'di las med khrung khrung: go na rna ba'i 318

bdud rtsi la khrung khrung: ma go glu la yang len med khrung khrung: ming sring yid la de ltar zhog khrung khrung:ces zer zhing 'phrin rnams 'phrod par byas te rang rdzong brag dmar spo mtho la chas so: 319
