le'u bcu bzhi ba/gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dang //rgyal sras mched dang 'khrug pa'i mthar//ge sar dpon gyis bdud blon bsgral//lha yi dus babs lung bstan byung //nyin 'ga' yi rjes nas byang sgar gyi dmag dpon gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis bsam blo mang du btang nas sems la: da lo byang gi sa cha 'di: khra mo gling gis bkang nas byung: yar skyes rtswa de rta yis bzos:mar 'bab chu de mi yis 'thung: brnyas pa tshod med byas na yang: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po de: da lo gdon gyis zin pa 'dra: 'di byed bya ba ci yang med: shes chen blon po mtha' la sgyugs: sku jus shor ba'i snga ltas red: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig ngas: dpa' rtsal zhag gsum bad mo 'dra: gling sdug nyi mas bcom la nye: mi 'chi 'dug sa lar nas med:sang 'chi gnangs 'chi khyad par med bsam nas go khrab dgra dar 'tshub se 'do chen la bcibs nas rlung bud pa ltar gling sgar gyi phyogs su song ngo:320

der gling gi so ba rnams kyis mthong nas brda sprad par gling sgar nas rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod: 'bum pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po: rong sras lha rgod 'bum lu:'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me: rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra: gser ba'i dung zla nyi shar 'khor dang bcas pas: mi drag rta bkrag 'tshub se rgyang rgyang gi gdong la thon nas byung ba dang: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis dran pa bskor log brgyab: khrag gi ngo mdangs log nas mda' ltong sprad de ya kho re gzhon nu'i khyu tshogs nas: da lta sngon ma dmar po skya: dpa' 'dod snang ba mthon po ma: rang snang gzhan las che ba shes: su dang gang gi dpa' rtul yin: de ring rting ma nga la babs zer zhing dpa' glu 'di rngams 'gyur ldem chen dgu 'khyugs la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la redoḥ mtho gnam gyi srin po lcags ral dang: yang bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar mkhyen:gnas sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs dang: khong rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: dpung 'bum dmag gling gi sprang sgar 'dab: chung byis pa'i snang ba 'khrul sa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang khrag ral rgyal po'i bka' blon nga: dgra ma thub steng gi tho ba yin: ming btags na btags chog tsam zhig gda': nga gyad mi stong 321

bdud mig gcig yin: skye pho brgya gdan la tshogs pa'i dus: ming gleng na kun gyis yid smon 'chor: dpa' stong bdud zer ba gcig las med:sdang dgra bo'i g.yas ru gnon pa'i dus: ngas dgra nor nom du ma blangs med: rkang sog lham pa tra'i mar 'og na: sdang dgra bo'i mgo 'phang dma' zhing zhum: dgra rkang mthil yan la mngags ma myong: rdza mthon po'i mgo yi 'brong mo yin: nga'i ru thur dgra la ma ngoms med: nags chen po'i ljon pa'i khu byug yin: gsung snyan mo kun la ma grags med: mtho a sngon gnam gyi nyi ma yin: 'od zer mdangs ma khyab gling 'ga' med: nga ma thub dgra yi 'chi bdag yin: dgra yan por shor ba gcig kyang med:khyod pho gsar snang ba mthon po can: sems bsam pa ci 'dra shar nas yodoḥ nga gyad mi stong bdud khros lam nas: khyod mi yul mngag na dpa' bo min: khong khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po yi: skyid pha bla btsong ba'i bu zhig min: sde tsho drug chags pa'i gzhi dkyil nas: sman na chung mdzes ma snang mtho ma: sprang 'chal bo rig na hab bgod byed: dgon khra khra'i chags pa'i gzhi dkyil na: ban btsun 'dod gzhan la 'phya smod mkhas:sgar dug rlangs rgyas 'dra'i tshur mtha' nasoḥ dpa' med pa'i gling sdug 'phru dmar can: khyed snang ba a sngon dgung las mtho: don med pa'i dmag nyob dmar gsod byed: dus mtha' ma gces 'dzin sgyu lus dor:322

ske khrag 'phro sha le snying re rje: ngas mda' gcig thog dmar lhung 'dra 'phen: khyod dgra bo brag ri gtor 'dra la: nang snying khrag dmar po sa la pho: phyi sgyu lus bya khyis gzan la 'phen: sha phu nu'i mig chu zag pa dang:gtan tshe rogs dran pa 'thor le bzo: rgyan 'khor gsum a pho'i jag la len: byang mi min zer nas grags le byed: yang sgos su stong bdud rngams brjid che: dpa' kha gting gnyis la 'gran dpe med: pho nga 'dra 'jig rten 'di na dkon: dpa' a ya med pa'i 'chi bdag yinoḥ yang ngo ya med pa'i gshin rje 'droḥ dgra gcig kyang gson la mngag ni med:yul mi min byang gi srung ma rnams: thugs dgongs pa dbyings la ma g.yel bar: nga dpa' bo'i grogs la thogs med byon: skyen mda' kha 'tshos la mdel sne drongs: khyod snying gi dkyil la ho ma ya: glo mchin pa'i zur nas phud la shog: glu go na snyan gyi bcud la zhogoḥ glu ma go ba la dpyad pa thongs: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhogoḥces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod tshul la mchong byung ba dang: khos mda' de 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs pas rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod kyis brang la phog kyang srung ba btsan pas mtshon ma song: rtse rgod kyis myur bar mda' zangs ltong ma zhig gzhu steng la bzhag nas ya 'o na gyad mi stong bdud bu: mda' de 'dra 'phangs pa ngo re tsha:323

dpa' gtam sngon la bshad na yang: lag len rjes nas ma byung thal: a bar rig la snying re rje: nga rgyal sras rtse rgod dpa' bo la: gtam yang dag 'dra ma 'di ltar yod gsungs nas dpa' glu ya la dgu 'gyur gyi rta la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: lho nub rang byung dpal ri'i zhing: padma 'byung gnas khros pa'i sku: dbang drag rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: ma rung bdud dgra'i rnam shes de: thar ba'i go 'phang thob par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: a sngon gnam gyi mdzes rgyan la: gsal byed nyi ma 'od ldan yin: dog mo sa yi mdzes rgyan la: gangs dkar ti se rgyal po yin: khra mo gling gi mdzes brgyan la: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod yin:gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: mtsho chung mtshe'u mang na yang: mtsho rgyal ma pham g.yu mtsho grags: sa 'dzin lhun po mang na yang: ri rgyal mchog rab gling na mdzes: rgyal phran mi dbang mang na yangoḥ dbang rgyal 'dzam gling spyi yi bdagoḥ yin nges chos rgyal ge sar red: lta log bdud kyi gshed ma bskos: 'gran ya 'dzam gling bod na med: kho re mi chung stong bdud khyod: khyod 'drar dpa' ming ngo re tsha: stong ba'i khams kyi 'ja' dang 'dra: kha shom che yang snying po med: zer ba'i dpe de khyod la 'grigs:324

dpa' rgod che ba'i dpa' rtul dang: dpung hrag rgod pa'i 'bum dmag de: ri mgor smug rlangs rgyas pa 'dra:brag ri mtho yang yib nas 'gro:dpung rgod chu bo bzhur ba 'dra: bye thang che yang bshig nas 'gro: ngar rgod me ru 'bar ba 'dra: nags tshal 'thug yang bsregs nas 'gro: kho re stong bdud wa mo'i bu: khyod rang bshad pa de ring bden: mda' rgod thog dmar lhung ba 'dra: thog dmar ngar shugs ma yod thal: pho rgod 'chi bdag nag po zer: 'chi bdag zhags pa'i khrid mkhan la: rgyal sras a stag nga rang babs: de ring khyod dang 'u gu gnyis: sngon las dbang gi 'phrad pa yin: da nang nam mkha' lang dang gcig: do dgung mun pa rub dang gnyis: 'chi bdag zhags pa theb dang gsum: bzlog rgyu med pa'i las gsum yin: phyi yi go btsan gtor dang gcig: nang gi gces srog bskum pa gnyis: khrag ral 'gyod pa'i khengs le gsum: ma byas bzhag na dpa' bo min: bla ma yod na gsol ba thob: thar lam phyogs la mi re med: yi dam yod na thugs dam bskul: gces srog thar bar su mi 'dod: mkha' 'gro yod na dus la babs: dman sar ma gtong thugs rje bskul: de min byung ba ci yang med: rgod po da mchong rtse rgod bu: 'chi bdag dgra la rngams pa 'dra: mgyogs pa da rgyugs rlung 'dzin rta: dgung nas glog dmar chad pa 'dra: dgra bo da sod stong bdud bu: dmar 325

gtor mgo mjug bsgyur 'dra bzo: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: stong bdud yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de sing sgra dang bcas 'phang bas: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gis brang la phog kyang kho bdud kyi bu dngos yin stabs ci yang ma gnod par slar yang ral gri bton nas mchong ste khong gnyis gri kha 'gran pa'i skabs su gling gi dpa' rtul rnams bya rgod sha la rub pa bzhin tu so sos gri dang mdung thog te ki sgra dang bcas dpa' rub brgyab par lha mtshon rno ngar che yang kho la mtshon ma song: khos gling gi dpa' bo rnams la mtshon mi 'gro ba shes te 'bum dmag gi khrod du mchong nas stag gzig dang: hor bdud a drag sogs kyi dmag 'phru sna tshogs can la dgu bcur nye ba zhig bcom byung skabs byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub dang thug nas dang po mda' 'gran: de nas mdung 'gran: mthar gri 'gran mang po byas kyang pham rgyal dbyer ma chod:kho slar yang byu ru'i dmag khrod du shor nas byu ru'i bstan grags rdo rje'i gtsos dmag mi bsad nas ki sgra dang bcas shor byung skabs: seng a dom mi yi spyang khu dang: gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag gnyis kyis ral gri re re bzhin bton nas gri rub brgyab par phung rgan khos dpa' rtul gnyis kyis gdong ma bsten nas shor byung tshe: 'bri sga bde chos skyong ber 326

nag dang: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur gsum gyis kho yi gdong bkag nas ral kha 'gran par ma thub:khos kyang dpa' ngo ma lon nas dkyil sgar la thon skabs stag rong dpon po khro thung gis mthong nas rgya 'grog ger bros te ge sar la gnas tshul zhus: der 'dzam gling bod kyi skyes mchog: mu stegs bdud kyi kha mnon:'gran bral dpa' bo chen po: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs sras: dpa' bo 'bum gyi dpung grogs: seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul de nyid myur bar go gyon mtshon thogs dus gcig la byas te 'do chen rkyang bu kha dkar la bcibs nas stong bdud mig gcig gi gdong la thon pa dang: khos bsam par mi 'di'i brgyan cha lugs byad bzhin gang la dpyad kyang 'gag mo'i jo ru yin nges pas 'gran ya 'ongs pa dka' ste khrag ral rgyal po sku ma shor gong la shi yang phyi rgyu med bsam nas dpa' the tshom med par mchong byung ba dang: sku rje seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis ral gri btab pa lan med shubs nas byangs te phebs byung ba na: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig na re: kho re mi pho rta rkyang can: 'gag mo'i jo ru yin pa 'dra:yin na bsam don 'grub lugs la: de ring rting ma thengs gcig 'gran zer zhing ral gri'i so kha de rta rngog la lan 'ga' byi byi byas nas gtam gyi mtha' ma'i dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:327

glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: mtho gnam gyi srin po lcags ral can: dus de ring dpa' bo'i glu sna drongs: yang bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar 'bod: ngas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: gnas sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs ma: byams thugs rje yod na dus la babs: khong rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: byang rang dpung bu rta'i kha 'dzin mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: dpung 'bum dmag mang po'i sgar dkyil nas: dmag 'bum tsho khrag la bsgyur sa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gyad chen po bzhi yi dang rtse la: pho dpa' rgod stag mo'i snying khams can: nga gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig yin: khyod ma thub dgra yi kha gnon dang: rang byams pa gnyen gyi snying bcud yin:dpon khrag ral g.yu 'brug sngon mo la: nga stong bdud thog mda' ngar ma srid: dpon khrag ral rgya stag ngar ma la: nga stong bdud 'jigs pa'i mche sder srid: dpon khrag ral 'chi bdag bdud po la: nga stong bdud gshin rje zhags pa srid: dpa' rgod po'i rting ma lus la tshang: yang ma thub dgra bo shor ma myong: ya kho re mi pho rta rkyang can: phyi go bkrag mtshon bkrag che lugs la: khyod 'gag mo'i jo ru yin pa 'dra: sde byang gling khrag gi 'khor lo de: don rtsa ba bshad na khyod la thug: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: dpa' gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig ngas: yang rting ma 328

dgung la grags pa len: byang yul sde spro bas khengs pa zhig: sde gling ba yi mug skye ba zhig: sdug rang byas rang la smin pa zhig: bya de 'dra byed par su yis bzlog: g.yang lug brgya bsad pa'i spyang rgan de: dus tha ma rdzi bzang 'ur rdos gsod: rgyugs rta brgya gsod pa'i stag mo de: yang tha ma sa mdas ngar la 'dren: byi'u tsi tsi gsod pa'i khra rgan de: sdug mtha' ma sgro gshog sa la 'thor: mi brgya stong bsad pa'i dpa' ming de: yang mtha' ma 'gran med dpa' bos gsod: rdzong chung chung bcom pa'i ge sar khyod: dus mtha' ma byang gi ha la 'phen: khyod pha jus shor dus a bar rig: da de min byung rgyu ci yang med: khyod dpa' bor khra spyang ma 'dzoms na: sdang dgra bos thog brdzis rang bzhin yin: de sngon chad dbang thang yar dar la: bya ci byas 'grub pa'i ngan rloms can: dpa' kha bshad stong gtam mkhas mkhas te: pho rang gcig sa na rgod rgod tsam: glang ru thur gad la gzir gzir de: nga bre btsan 'brong la 'gro le min: dus de ring nyi ma'i bzhag so la: dpa' rting ma rno ngar gri la babs: gling mi rkyang rta rkyang skya le khyod: phyi gzugs bzhi'i lus phung phyed gshags bzo: nang don lnga'i khrag dmar sa la 'pho: de min pa'i byung rgyu ci yang med: glu go na snyan gyi bcud la zhog: glu ma go ba la dpyad pa thongs: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:329

ces glu blangs pa dang mnyam du gri de ngar chen gyis lan gsum btab kyang nam mkha' stong bar g.yug pa ltar ci yang ma gnod: de'i skabs der 'dzam gling skyes mchog nor bu dgra 'dul sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras: rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul de nyid kyis ral gri btab pa lan med kyi so kha las me lce mched bzhin du sdang dgra dpung mtha' nas bcom pa'i dpa' glu 'di 'jigs rung khro bo'i bzhad sgra la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: rang byung o rgyan mtsho gling du: dmar ser padma 'bum brdal steng: mtsho 'khrungs khye'u padma 'byung: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: 'jigs rung me 'bar dur khrod nas: drag khros gu ru gtum chen 'bar: khro tshogs bye ba 'bum dang bcas: gsol ba 'debs so dgra dpung choms: snang stong gzhom gzhig bral ba'i zhing: dhu ma tha la'i ma tshogs nasoḥ shes rab lha mo mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so 'bral med mdzodoḥ sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:mi min byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rma yul g.yang gi ra ba nas: pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse mtho: mgo nag mi yi rje bo la: skyes mchog nor bu dgra 'dul yin: kho re stong bdud mig gcig bu: a ya med pa'i stong gtam de: skyes bu'i rna bar mi 'gro lagasoḥ ngo ya med pa'i 330

dpa' 'dod de: ngar rgod blo dang gros la dbang: 'od stong ldan pa'i nyi ma dang: zhag gcig chags pa'i ba mo gnyis: 'gran na ba mo snang ba 'khrul: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig dang: ge sar dgra 'dul dpa' bo gnyis: 'gran na stong bdud srog dang bral: yar ltos a sngon gnam la ltosoḥ la thag nye ba'i rta ljang can: mi sdod nub ri'i phag la yib: stong bdud mig gcig de la bla: da nang shar ba'i nyi ma dang: dpa' 'dod che ba'i stong bdud gnyisoḥ dbang phyogs gnas la mnyam 'gro yin: mar ltos dog mo sa la ltos: char babs rjes kyi chu phran dang: a ya bral ba'i stong bdud gnyis: dma' ba'i sa la mnyam thim yin: phar ltos bar snang khams la ltos: gnam 'phang gcod pa'i bya rgyal rgod: mi sdod rgya snyis ngar la 'dren: gyad mi stong bdud de la bla: gshog rtsal ldan ba'i rgod po dang: kha shom che ba'i stong bdud gnyis: rgya snyis ngar la mnyam 'dren yin: 'gag mo'i jo ru rgyal po ngoḥ gyad mi stong bdud mi 'dra de: ma thub dgra bo shor ma myong: 'gag mo'i lha sras jo ru ngas: las su 'gro ba'i don chen byed: thugs rjes gzhan don sgrub sgrub nas: rang 'dod nag po bsgrub ma myong: de sngon nyi ma yan chad la: pho bdud klu btsan thod mda' sprad: bdud yul dkar po'i chos la bsgyur: byang bza' a stag grogs la bkug: bdud yul skyid pa'i nyi ma shar: hor bdud gur dkar gnya' sga 331

bstad: hor dmag khrag gi so nam byas: hor yul stod smad bde la bkod: mgar bza' chos sgron grogs la bkug: 'jang rgyal sa dam 'phrul gyis bsad: 'jang phrug g.yu lha gson bzung byas: 'jang bza' chos sgron grogs la bkug: 'jang yul dga' spros lhas rar bsgyur: mon gyi shing khri'i mgo ske bcad: mon phrug dung skyong zhags pas bzung: mon bza' lha mdzes gling la bsus: mon la skyid pa'i dngos grub bstsal: de min drag po'i rdzong chen dgu: rdzong phran bcu bdun dpung gis phab: lta log bdud phrug gson snying blangs: nag po'i bstan pa dung la snubs:smon lam dkar po thebs pa rnams: gling dkar stod la dpung gis bzung: lha blon dpa' rtul brgyan la bzhagoḥ yid gtad lha dang dkon mchog byas: dga' skyid las kyi mtha' de bzang: bzlog med 'thab mo byed bsam kyang: dmyal bar mi gtong khas len byed: thar ba'i lam sna nga yi ston: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi loḥ ma go glu la yang len med: stong bdud yid la de ltar zhogoḥces glu de ltar blangs pa dang mnyam du ral gri btab pa lan med kyi rtse nas me stag gi zi ra 'tshub bzhin thugs g.yo med mnyam nyid khyab brdal chen po'i ngang lan gcig btab pas phyi'i sgyu lus rta dang bcas pa phyed gshags su btang zhing nang rnam shes te rtsal po che'i mda' 'phangs 332

pa ltar zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs kar thim nas rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas par gyur: 'dzam gling skyes bu chen po ge sar mi yi nyi ma de nyid tshur lha gur du byon nas dga' spro dang bcas bzhugs so:der mi min gyi rgyal blon kun gyis nyi ma rub rag bar du bltas kyang gyad mi stong bdud phyir thon rgyu ma byung ba'i blo mi bde ba'i ngang gros mang du byas kyang ci bya zad de mthar byang gi dpa' blon thams cad dpa' chags nas yi thang chad de stong bdud la mya ngan zhus: shar khra mo gling gi 'bum sgar gur dkar po kha ba babs 'dra: ja rlangs smug pa lang 'dra:me dmar po dgung la mched 'dra: dmag dar dkar ser dmar ljang sngo mthing sogs rlung gis bskyod kyang 'ur dur re sgar brgyab pa'i dkyil du lha gur mthong ba don ldan de dar gdugs 'phan yab lhabs se: dri bzang ngad pa 'thul le: byin chags gangs ri brjid bzhin phub pa'i nang du stag gzig khebs gdan brtsegs pa'i khar bzhugs nas ja chang bza' btung sogs lha yi dga' ston la rol bzhin pa'i skabs der mkha' 'gro ma chu dar dkar po can zhig gis lung bstan gyi mgur ma 'di rgyal mchog nor bu dgra 'dul gyi snyan pad ma dkar po'i thad du glu 'di ltar blangs so:333

na mo ḍā ki dhe wa ye: gzhi stong nyid don gyi zhing khams nas: khong gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang: yum kun bzang mo dang gnyis med sbyor: ngas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: gnas 'di 'dra stong chen mkha' dbyings red: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gnas mkha' spyod dag pa lnga ldan nas: nga ḍā ki mkha' spyod dbang mo zhes: ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo yin: don shes rab bde 'byung chen po yin: ya de nas mgo nag mi yi rje: gling ge sar dbang gi rgyal po lags: khyed gson dang zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod: gnas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas:dpal padma 'od 'bar zhing khams nas: mdog dmar ser chu skyes bzhad pa'i khar: khong rig 'dzin sngags 'chang padma 'byungoḥ g.yas dpa' bos rngams stabs shigs se shig: g.yon dpa' mos bro gar lam se lam:sngags rghaṃ gi sna glu di ri ri: phaṭa drag pos brda skad sing se sing: 'khor mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: mtsho dwangs gsal gza' skar bkra ba bzhin: zhal 'dzum dkar bco lnga'i dung zla la: mdzes bkrag mdangs 'od zer ya la la: dgung nyi ma 'bum gyi zer mdangs bzhad: don lung bstan snyan pa'i gsang tshig las: chags chen po'i snyan 'gyur 'dri don zab: sang nyi ma rtse shar dang po la: yul mi min byang gi rdzong btsan nas:kho gyad mi stong bdud sha lan dang: dpa' rtsal ldan mang po'i yang lan 334

rnams: rtsod khas len dug smyon nag po de: bdud 'chi bdag dgra la rngams ltar yongs: gling dkar po'i sgar la shor mi rung: dpung 'bum sgar zur la ma thon gong: gling dpa' rgod dpa' rtul yang gral nas:blon 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod gcig: 'bru'i sras po byang rong btsan po gnyis: dpa' seng stag dam pa rab rgyas gsum: thog dmar po bzhin du mchong la song: dpung 'bum dmag mang po'i dgos pa med: sngon gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: gzhung chu bo kha rgya che na yangoḥ rgya zam pa'i 'og tu gar bzhur yin: sde byang blon ngar rgod che na yang: rgod dpa' rtul gsum gyis gar bcom yin: de o rgyan bla ma'i bka' gsung rnams: glu'i pho nya mkha' 'gro nga la babs: glu ma go ma thos med pa gyis:da ma 'gyang don 'bras yid la zungs: ya de nas ge sar rin po che: khyod sku lus ri rgyal lhun po la: rkyen g.yo ba med pa'i bkra shis shog: gsung rab snyan zab mo'i chu rgyun la: don tshig bzang kun khyab bkra shis shog:thugs klong yangs g.yo ba med pa la: dpal kun bzang rgyal po'i bkra shis shog: yon tan gyi lo 'dab rgyas par shog: 'phrin las kyi 'bras bu smin par shog: sde 'dzam gling bod kyi sa cha la: nang mi la na tsha med par shog: phyi phyug la gyong gud med par shog: skyid zer ba rgyun chad med par shog: sdug bsngal gyi bskal ba med par shog: glu 'di thos 'gro ba sems 335

can rnams: sems byang chub rgyud la skye bar shog: blo dad gus mos pa'i 'bras thob nasoḥ rang bzhin gyi don gnyis 'grub par shogoḥ glu go na snyan gyi bcud la zhog: glu ma go ba la dpyad pa thongs: khyod ge sar yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung nas mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur mang du byas mthar dga' spro'i nyams dang bcas mi mngon pa'i dbyings su thim mo:der 'dzam gling bod kyi lha skal: skyes mchog seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul: rmog dkar rtse sgro spungs se: drag po gshin rje dgra la khros pa ltar:'jigs rung rngams brjid 'tshub se gra bsgrigs dgos tshul rnams bka' phab pa nang ltar gros dbang blon po thams cad 'dus byung ba la: zas sna phun sum tshogs pa dang: chang rigs zad med rgya mtsho lta bur longs spyod tshe: seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rin po ches zhal 'dzum tsam mdzad cing glu 'di tshe glu 'gyur med la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: sangs rgyas byang sems dge 'dun tshogs: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: lus la gzi mdangs bkrag tu 'tsher: ngag snyan 'gag pa bsal du gsol: yid la bde stong dngos grub stsol: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:336

tshe stod 'gag mo'i jo ru de: rma smad lha lung bdag po yin: tshe sked dmag dpon dgra 'dul de: log bdud 'gong bo'i gshed ma yin: tshe smad chos rgyal ge sar de: rma yul g.yang gi ra ba nas: pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse mtho: mgo nag mi yi rje bo la: skyes mchog nor bu dgra 'dul yin:padma'i bstan pa skyong mi yin: de so yin lugs 'dra ma la: yang dag brjod don 'di ltar yod: khebs ldan 'ja' tshon bkrag 'dra nas:dpal rtul skar tshogs bkra ba bzhin: rmog dkar dar 'phru dgung la 'phyo: khrab dkar rgyun thag sra zhing bstan: 'khor gsum dug tsher rab tu rgyas: ma g.yel rgyal po'i glu la nyon: da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrugs 'di:gcig tu gling dkar dgos dgra la: sgos su 'gro ba'i spyi dgra red:dngul rdzong gling la ma phab na: mi la dngul g.yang ga la thoboḥ 'gro drug dbul phongs las grol phyir: rin chen dngul gyi g.yang gter rnams: mi 'gyang dpung gis rgyan la len: mi min khrag ral rgyal po khos: mi lus 'byung g.yar la mo dor: mi yul 'dug res tshang nas 'dug: kha sang khas kyi de sngon la: dpa' rgod ya bo dka' le de: gyad mi stong bdud zer ba kho: dpa' rgod ldan zhing blo sgo yangs: rtsal drug che ba rlung dang 'dra:snying khams btsan po bdud dang 'dra: de 'dra bod na kha kher tsamoḥ mal nyal mi lam bzhin du bzos: mi min khrag ral khyung gshog la: de bas 337

yan na rgod po med: rting ma ri rab las kyang mtho: de min byed thabs ci yang med: sang nyin nyi ma rtse shar la: mi min byang gi rdzong chen nas: gyad mi stong bdud ltas rtsod la: ngar rgod glen pa lang shor de: dug gi dug smyon nag po kho: ri rtsib 'grim pa'i lug chung bzhin: spyang tshang sgo la thon nges red: brag gseb 'grim pa'i ra ma bzhin: 'phar ba'i sngon la thon nges red: la bzhi 'grim pa'i 'do ba bzhin: stag tshang 'gram la thon nges red: rang dbang chung ba'i byi'u bzhin: rgya khra'i sngon la thon nges yin: 'bum dmag gling dkar khra mo nas: ngar rgod a ya bral ba gsum:ma 'dug la mo byon shom gyis: 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod khyod: mi byon thabs med dgra yi gshed: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas dang: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gnyisoḥ mi byon thabs med dus la babasoḥ dpa' rgod mi pho rnam gsum lags: khra spyang 'gran zla bral ba gyis: byang phrug glen pa lang shor kho: 'bum dmag dkyil la shor mi rung: shor na jus nyes byung nges yin: dpa' rtul mi rgod gsum po la: srung ba mdud pa re re dngoḥ tshe chang tshe ril re re yod: dog zon mi dgos sla mo yin: lha chen tshangs pa dkar po dang: gnyan chen sku lha ger mdzod gnyis: klu chen gtsug na rin chen gsum: dpa' rtul gsum gyi kha mgon mdzod: sku la dgra rkyen med pa'i phyiroḥ khro tshogs 'bum gyis srung bar shog: ngag 338

'gugs glu la mkhas shing sbyang: snyan 'gyur dri za'i ldem drug shog: yid la sdug bsngal med pa'i phyir: bde skyid kun dgas bkra shis shog: 'dir tshogs dpa' rtul dpung gi tshogs: 'phru dkar kha ba babs 'dra red:tshangs pa lha yis kha mgon mdzod: 'phru dmar khrag mtsho rdol 'dra red:dmar bo btsan gyis kha mgon mdzod: 'phru sngon g.yu mtsho lud 'dra red:sngon po klu yis kha mgon mdzodoḥ 'phru khra 'ja' tshon shar 'dra red: khra bo gza' yis kha mgon mdzod: 'phru ljang dbyar gyi ri dang 'dra: drag po khro tshogs kha mgon mdzod: 'phru ser nyi ma shar yag red: ser po gnyan chen kha mgon mdzod: 'phru nag grub so bkug 'dra red: dmu dang mgon gyi kha mgon mdzod: gling gi dpa' rtul thams cad la: steng mir na tsha med par shog: 'og rta chag 'gril med par shog: glu 'di thos tshad sems can rnamasoḥ skyid pa'i nyi ma shar bar shog: sdug gi mun pa dwangs bar shog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len medoḥ 'dir tshogs yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar gsung pa dang: dpa' rtul rnams dga' spro dang bcas mgrin gcig gis thon pa ltar mngon par bstod do:339

le'u bco lnga ba/dug smyon nag po phyi mar bskyal//gling gis dgra blar dpung bstod mdzad//bdud 'dul gyad ma'i lag la shor//byang gling shi bsad na thang bzos//nyi ma de yi phyir nyin mi min gyi pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong nas dug gi dug smyon nag pos lcags rmog 'bar ba rtse dgu la: lcags 'phru rtse gsum nag po btsugs: lcags khrab mun pa dgu 'thibs la: 'khor gsum dug gi kha rlangs bskor: stag ral 'dzum chen bkrag yag nang: lcags mda' lu ma drug cu'i bkang: gzig shubs thig le stong 'phro'i nang: lcags gzhu ha ri mchog dkar bcug: ral gri skya rengs shar yag dngoḥ dug mdung nag po'i gnam sa sogs dpa' chas lus la rdzogs pa: bkrag mdangs 'od du 'tsher ba: bdud rta ro lang dgu zan la: lcags sga nag po sbrul thod bstad: srin po dgra la khros pa bzhin shar skya rengs kyi skya mda' ma bkyag: sngo rengs kyi sngo mda' ma gsal gong la go bkrag mtshon bkrag dang bcas mi min khrag ral rgyal po'i mdun la phyin nas nor bu 'od ldan 340

me 'bar gyi zhu sna drangs nas ya kho re mi min byang gi nor: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po lags: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: dgra bo'i rang yul gnon pa'i dus: ma bu mo yin kyang dmag la chas: shing lcang dkar yin kyang mtshon la thogs: g.yag rog po yin kyang rna bshu byed: dmag de sod ma min du sod yin: zer ba'i dpe bzhin dus la babs: de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la: de min na gling sdug zer ba zhig: dug smyon dgra la shor ba byed: de min na byang rgod zer ba zhig: khrag ral dbu 'phang mtho nges byed: ma thub bzhag na 'chi ba yin: 'chi nas dmyal bar 'grim pa yin: de nas rgyal po mi yi nor: e mjal mi shes bde bar bzhugs: mi mjal zer ba dgra la bsgyur: dgra bsgyur ba gling sdug mgo la bsgyur: ci yin a pho'i shes pa min: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig deoḥ 'bum dmag dgu yi 'dems ya yin: gling sdug 'dre yis dmar bsad byas: de byas sha lan ma sprod na: pho shi ba dgu las mi thu red: ltad mo pho brang rtse nas gzigs zer ba dang: rgyal po yang yid skyo bas ngang nas rting ma lon par yid smon mdzad: dug smyon nag po gling phyogs la mda' 'phangs ba ltar chas so:der gling sgar nas 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod dang: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gsum gyis rang rang gi rta 341

la bcibs shing rlung bud pa ltar byon nas nam lang ba dang mi min 'brong ri brag btsan gyi rdza brag 'thab pa'i brag lam zhig nas dpa' rtul gsum po sa khug gsum du bsgug nas gtso bo seng stag dam pa rab rgyas kyis glu len rgyu byas nas: 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod dang: 'bru sras byang rong btsan pos mda' gzhu 'gengs nas gra bsgrigs tshar bar byas: dug gi dug smyon nag po kho tshe zad dus la babs nas dpa' the tshom med par shor byung ba dang: der bsam pa'i snang yul du med pa zhig la glo bur du brag lam dogs po zhig nas bu chung dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa:mnyen lcug lang tsho 'bar ba: rta pho dung bya 'dra ba: sga srab 'ja' tshon bkrag 'dra: lha phrug mi yul byon 'dra zhig thon byung ba mthong bas dgra gnyen gang yin blo yi dpyod dka' yang thabs shes shig ma btsal na ga la rung bsam nas thabs blo sgo 'byed pas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la redoḥ glu a la la mo a la red: lha mchod cig srin po lcags ral can: dpon khrag ral sku byas dgung la bstod: lha mchod gnyis bdud btsan me 'bar 'bod: dus de ring dpa' bo'i gdong grogs mdzod: gnas sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs ma: thugs dbyings la ma g.yel dgra srog chod: khong rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral 'bod: byang rang dpung bu rta'i kha 'dzin mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma 342

shes noḥ mtho rdza brag me chen 'bar 'dra'i ri: byang 'brong ri'i brag dmar la kha redoḥ pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga dngos yod dngos med gnyis ka yin: bdud nag po rnams kyi gtso bo yin: btsan ma mo gnyis kyi kha ya yin: ming dug gi dug smyon nag po yin: ya de nas bu chung mtshar sdug can: khyod gling gi yin pa sus mi shes: sa 'di la byung ba ma bzang thal: srog thar ba med pa'i dus la babs: dgra lug khyu za ba'i gshed ma de: spang gor mo'i ri spyang sngon mo yin: dgra byi'u khyu bcom pa'i dar ma de: brag dmar yag rgya khra hor ba yin: dgra ri bong bcum pa'i gshog ldan de: dgung sprin rim rgyud pa'i glag mo yin: rgod thag chod byang gi dpa' bo la: khyod gling phrug 'gran snang yi re mug: sde skyid po byang gi yul gru 'di: khyod rma khams gling la dbang lugs med: dpe dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu 'dra: sdug mug srog shor ba'i snga ltas red: gling 'gag mo'i jo ru ham pa can: byur nag pos bkug pa ma shes sam: rgyu rkyen la 'bras bu thog pa red: lus 'chi bdag zhags pas 'gugs la drangs:khyod gling sdug rnams la ngo tsha med: dpe stag rong dpon po khro thung bzhin:dgra nag por pha bla btsong mi red: khyim chung ma'i steng la thog ltar ngaroḥchung bu phrug dgra yi kha la brdzangs: mi de 'dra'i tsha bu jo ru loḥ don yang dag bzang bshad ci zhig yod: rdzong chung chung 'ga' re lon pas noḥ343

sdug mug snang a sngon dgung las mtho: pho ngan pa ngan lob gcig gis brlag: sde don med yul la dmag rgod phab: dpa' bu rta khrag gi so nam byas: las rgyu 'bras nog pas tha ma la: nged byang gi dpa' rgod kha sngon nas: lus sgyu ma'i phung po 'ben la bzhag: yul pha jus dgra la shor bas dus: yid 'gyod pa drag po ltas mi shong: dpa' rting ma me rlung bzhin du 'tshub: mgyogs bang kha bsil ma rlung la dpe: mda' 'phen pa thog gi ngar shugs ldan: glog dmar dang dug rlung zung du 'brel: sdug khyod rang mi thub ga la shor: byang mi min yul gyi srung ma rnams: dus de ring rlung ltar byon la shog: bus kha mgon mdzod la gdong grogs byos: lha dbyings la g.yel ba'i dus ma yin: sde byang yul skyid pa'i lhas ra de: gling mtha' dmag sdug gi mun pa 'khrigs: tshul 'di la btang snyoms ga la rung: bu dpa' bo'i dpung ba 'tsho rogs kyis: dpa' rting ma yang dag lon par shog: glu go na snyan gyi bcud la zhog: glu ma go ba la dpyad pa thongs:khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: khos glu lan ci 'dug la nyan: de nas ci bya rang lag na yod bsam zhing rta kha bkag nas bsgug pas tshe: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas kyis rta kha en tsam 'then zhing mda' gri mdung la ma snyabs par rdzun glu 'di ltar blangs so:344

glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas: rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas: nyan thos dge 'dun 'khor gyis bskor: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs:sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: rdza brag me chen 'bar 'dra'i ri: 'brong ri'i brag dmar la kha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mon 'jang gnyis kyi sa mtshams na: pho brang smug po bcug dkris bzhengasoḥ seng stag mi yi spyang khu la: rtse rgyal dug gi spu gri srid: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas yin: de nas dug smyon nag po lags: ci yin skad cha don rtsa med: dpa' med lag snga ci la byed: khyod dang nga rang gnyis po yang: 'thab na dpa' rgod mi 'dra de: de ring mi 'gran don 'bras med: ge sar mi yi nyi ma la:byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo des: zhu ba yang yang byas pas 'bras: mi min khrag ral rgyal po dang: gling gi ge sar rgyal po gnyis: btsan po mtho sdeb byed dgos zer: bzang po dpung sdeb byed dgos zer: des phyir myur bar mngag le red: go mtshon dgra dar 'tshub na yang: mda' shar tsam zhig ma 'phen byas: khyod dang nga gnyis mi 'dra lags: de nas dug smyon nag po lags: yin lugs skad cha ma thos gong: sdar ma'i lag snga ma byed dang: gom gsum gom pa ma spos na: rgyang thag lam de ga la chod: glu len ngag 'gugs ma byas na: phyi nang gnyis la nor dogs che: de 'dra gna' 345

mi'i gtam gyi dpe: khyod la nga rang mi 'tsher de: ge sar bka' gsung bcag phod med: ngar ngar ma byed dgos pa chung: da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrug 'di: ma 'thab rang tshod bzung na dga': byang bza' sras mo tshe 'dzin mas: glu blangs don 'bras bzang nas 'dug: lan pa byang la yod na yang: byang bzas zhu ba gling gis gsanoḥ phan tshun 'thab mtshams bzhag na zer: mi pho shi la dga' mkhan med: rta pho chag grum byung 'dod med: mi 'dug la mo phyir la phebasoḥ mi min khrag ral rgyal po la: mi dbang rgyal po'i bka' khyab rnams: mi 'gyang bshad na don 'bras yod:gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: bla ma bar 'bring mtha' gsum de: bla rab mkhyen dpyod sngon la mnga'oḥ 'gro don gdul bya de la rgyas: bla 'bring rgas gzhon mtshams nas mkhas: tshe mtha' chos kyi snying po lon: bla mtha' mi tshe grong chog rgyugs: 'chi rkyen byung na chos med yin: pho la rab 'bring mtha' gsum de: pho rab blo khog mkha' las yangs: dran 'phrul sprin dkar mnyam pa med: pho 'bring skyid thub sdug thub yinoḥ rang tshod ngang nas tshe mtha' 'khyol: pho mtha' blo mang bya zin med: sdug thug ngang nas mi tshe shor: sman la rab 'bring mtha' gsum de: mo rab yon tan kun ldan zhing: bde skyid ngang la tshe mtha' chod: mo 'bring bzang ngan kun la mkhas: tshod ldan ngang nas tshe mtha' 'khyol: sman mtha' la mtho'i 346

dar cog de: rlung phyogs kun la 'phyo nas zad: de ltar gna' mi'i gtam la sridoḥ de 'dra dgos pa lar nas med: mi min khrag ral rgyal po la: don chen tshig gsum bshad ched du: mi bsdod la mo 'gro shom gyis:brgya lam ma 'gog byang gi bu: yin gcig min gnyis 'thab zer na:khyod rang phyi ma 'grim nges yin: khra mo gling gi sa cha na: seng stag mi yi spyang khu'i bu: sgo nga'i nang nas 'dab drug rgyas: stag tshang nang nas 'dzum drug bkrag: 'on kyang mi 'thab dgos pa chung: go na snyan gyi bcud la zhog: ma go ba la dpyad pa thongasoḥ byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang kho the tshom gyi ngang du ci bya blo khel dka' ba'i tshe: 'dan mas mda' thog dmar lhung ba ltar 'phangs pas kho yi snying kar 'od ljang gu zhig 'khor ba'i steng la phog nas rgyu 'bras bag bye yi lam la btang pa dang: 'bru sras byang rong btsan pos mda' gcig 'phangs ba: bdud rta ro lang dgu zan la phog nas mi rta gnyis ka nag zeng nge mda' 'phen long ma byung bar sa la 'gyel lo: de nas dpa' rtul gsum gyis ki sgra dang bcas lha rgyal bsgrags nas kho yi mgo 'phru gong len du khyer nas 'tshubs 'khyil ler phyag phebs sooḥde'i nyi ma la mi min rgyal po dang blon tshogs rnams kyis pho brang yang thog nas ltad mor gzigs par g.yul gyi zeng 'khrugs dmag gi dal brel 347

ci yang med par ma tshad dug smyon kho yang phyir thon rgyu ma byung pas: mi min gyis rgyal blon rnams yid 'gyod pa'i ngang la mya ngan dang bcas dug smyon dgra la shor ba the tshom med zer zhing du:kha'i gnon bzhin gnas:gong gi dpa' rtul gsum po pheb byung pa gling sgar gyis mthong nas bsu ba dang bcas dpa' dar bzang bstod phun sum tshogs pa byas:nyi ma de yi phyir nyin gza' skar shin tu bzang ba'i nyin la dpa' rtul rnams kyis rta mgyogs bang 'gran mda' 'phen rtsal 'gran mang du byas mthar stag ri khros yag gi rtse la dgra bla'i dpa' mkhar dang bsang khri sogs brtsigs nas dpa' rtul rnams kyis mgrin gcig gis dgra bla'i dpung bstod kyi glu 'di dkar phyogs dgyes pa'i mchod phreng dbyar gyi rnga sgra la drangs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: bswo legs so bswo yis bskul lo bsang: steng dga' ldan lha nas glang ltar gshegs:gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi zhing: yul ser skya'i drung du lha mdzes ma'i:sku lhums zhugs lha mi'i ston pa mchog: chos dge ba rgya mtsho'i 'jings la 'khu: 'khor dge 'dun nye ba'i sras brgyad dang: lha klu sogs sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: dgung mtho la sprin chen 'khrigs pa bzhinoḥ gnas mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: bsang rnam dag bdud rtsi dam pa 348

bzhes: tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do kun: yul 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag mi 'byung zhing: gzhi ka dag ye sangs don rtogs shog: gnas o rgyan nub byang rnya sha'i mtshor: mgon snang mtha'i thugs rje trī yis sprul: mdangs padma ge sar bzhad pa'i khar: rje khye'u chung dkar 'tsher mnyen lhags ldem: chos gsang sngags theg chen 'khor lo bskor: bod 'dzam gling gter gyis sa gzhi bkang: 'khor rig 'dzin pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas:mtsho chen por gser mig rgyu ba bzhin: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs: bsang rnam dag bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i sa thob shog: gnas dur khrod me ru 'bar ba'i zhing:bdud ru ṭa'i kha gnon drag po rtsal: lha yi dam gtum chen me 'bar gyis:tshul drag po'i rgyu phaṭa sgra dang bcas: 'khor khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: ri che la smug pa 'thib pa bzhin: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs: bsang rnam dag bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: bdud log rtog ru ṭa'i skye rgyud chod: gnas ma nges zhing khams so so nas: ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: mdangs dkar dmar ser ljang mthing dang bcas: dgung gan nas 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs: bsang rnam dag bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: lam dga' bzhi ye shes mngon gyur shog: gnas rma yul 349

gangs kyi ri bo nas: khong yul lha rma chen sbom ra dang: mgon bstan ma bcu gnyis gzhi bdag rnams: lho char sna rlung gis khrid pa bzhin: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs: bsang rnam dag bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: sdang dgra khams 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: steng lha chen tshangs pa dkar po bsang: lha dkar phyogs dbu 'phang mtho bar shog: 'og klu chen gtsug na rin chen bsang: sde mi phyugs dar zhing rgyas par shog: bar gnyan chen sku lha ger mdzod bsang: gling chos srid dar zhing rgyas par shog: dpa' dgra bla'i wer ma bcu gsum bsang: bus kha las rlung rta dgung la bstod: ki bswo bswo chen po lha rgyal lo: khong yon tan can gyi bla ma rnams: sku'i tshe la bar chad med par shog: ma 'gro la byams pa'i lha rje des: chos bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog: rgyu 'byor ba can gyi yon bdag rnams: tshe 'di phyi kun tu bde legs shog:sems rnam dkar don la gzhol ba tshos: rkyen phyi nang bar chad zhi bar shog: chos rnam dag brtson pa'i 'jig rten mdzes: sde lta log bdud kyi srog rtsa chod: khyed ye shes spyan ldan srung ma rnams: chos rgyal bstan spel la ma g.yel cig: yang sgos su gling gi dpa' rtul rnams: dpung g.yul chen las la gzhol ba'i tshe: lus 'di la sku yi bkrag mdangs 455: ngag 'di la gsung gi 'brug sgra ldir: yid 'di la thugs kyi dpa' gdeng 350

bskyed: rten 'brel 'byung nam mkha' bkang bar shog: bkra shis pa'i sa gzhi khyab par shog: yang sgos su gling gi dpa' rtul rnams: g.yul chen po'i las la gzhol bas tshe: dpa' rting ma rang gi lon par shog: byang mi min bdud kyi yul gru nas: yun mi ring gling la 'khor bar shog: dpa' dgra mtha' la mo chod par shog: yid smon pa ji bzhin 'grub par shog:glu go na bkra shis lhun re chags: glu ma go med pa'i rten 'brel 'dzoms:steng lha klu snang srid glu skal yin:zhes gsung nas dpa' rtul phu nu thams cad kyis ki bswo lha rgyal gyi sgra gnam sa bkang zhing khra 'tshub se bsang bskor 'ga' brgyab nas sgar la log:der nyin 'ga'i rjes su gling dkar gyi nang nas 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod dang: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur: dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar: dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal po: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas: 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me: bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po bcas la 'bum dmag 'phru dmar can gyis bskor nas khrag mtsho rdol ba bzhin du mi min byang gi rdzong chen sha ri gnam rdzong gi phyogs la chas: mi min gyi so ba rnams kyis mthong nas dgra yod pa'i brda sprad byung ba dang: rdzong bzung ba'i dpa' bo rnams kyi nang nas gyad mi 351

khrag 'thung dpa' bzang: rtsal ldan sha ba dung thod: rtsal ldan bdud rje lcags khrab gsum gyis go btsan bzung nas gros ma byas blo rtse gcig la mthun par shi rogs dpa' bo mgo sprod re e lon bsam nas rgyang rgyang gis dpa' rtul rnams kyis gdong la mchong byung pa'i dus su: gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang ngar chen gyis snang ba 'khrugs: dpung ba'i sha rgod rgyas: gdong dmar por 'gyur zhing gling sdug gi ma brnyas tshod gcig min bsam zhing mda' ltong sprad de glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: ma thub dgra la rting ma longs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: byang thang bde skyid dar ba'i sa: pho brang sha ri'i tshur mtha' red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang gi ya mo stong drug nas:khrab dkar steng gi rgyab dar yin: rmog dkar steng gi lcags 'phru yin:mkhar rdzong steng gi rgya phub yin: gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang yin:g.yu 'brug skad dang khrag 'thung dpa': ma grags sa la gcig las med:'chi bdag bdud dang gyad mi ngas: ma thub lus pa'i dgra gcig med:bsil ma rlung dang 'do chen rtas: ma zin shor ba ga la srid: de so yin lugs 'dra ma yin: de nas dpa' rtul wa mo'i dpung: yang sgos sngon ma 352

rta sngon can: mi chung zhal ras sngo lugs dang: rta chung rgyugs la dga' lugs la: yin nges 'dan ma sngo skyu 'dra: yin na bsam don 'grub pa yin: sdar ma g.yul du bkye ba las: dpa' bo 'ga' re sod rgyu'i dga':gtsang bo'i gzhung gi lcags kyu ngas: gser mig mgron la ma bos te:'gyur gshog sgo skyel skam la 'dogs: ri rtsib 'grim pa'i spyang mo ngas:lug chung mgron la ma bos te: zhim sha sgo skyel longs su spyod: brag dmar dkyil gyi rgya khra ngas: byi'u chung mgron la ma bos te: gzugs phung sgo skyel sgro gshog gtor: dpa' rgod ldan pa'i gyad mi ngas: gling sdug mgron la ma bos te: gces srog sgo skyel mtshon la 'dren: e bden ltos dang sngon po skya: gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la: sdom pa med pa'i ban dhe des:snang ba a sngon dgung las mtho: kha btsan stong lab ri lung gang: phan sems med pa'i dpon po des: g.yo rgyu wa spyang las kyang che: kha yag 'ja' tshon ri mo bkra: blo gtad med pa'i bu mo des: shes rgya khab mig las kyang dog: rdzun dang phra ma rna bar gzan: zer ba'i gtam la cha 'jog yod: dpa' snying med pa'i gling sdug gis: stong gtam rna la byung byung nas: dpa' bo'i zhe sems gting nas khrel: 'dan ma rgan po sngo skyu ma: rgas sdug nag pos mtha' nas bcum: dpa' snying pho bzo 'ja' ltar yal: rang srog dgra yi lag la bzhag: rgas pa'i mi tshad 'chol nas 353

'dug: de sngon ming grags che che nas: ming mtha' rlung la bskur ba sdug:ge sar thob thang mtho na yang: 'dan ma shi na phan pa med: dpa' rtul dpung rgod hrag gzhan 'dra: mtha' ma gal la thug dus med: grags 'dod sngags kyi ngan 'phrul de: rgyu 'bras thigs la ma zhib na: tha ma dmyal ba'i las ngan bsags: phyug 'dod tshong gi kha thabs te: mna' rdzun khrel la ma 'dzem na: tha ma mis 'phya rang sdug 'ong: khra 'dod blo rtse'i bkod pa de: gtan rlangs phug la ma bsam na: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nyen yod: de 'dra dgos pa lar nas med: mda' 'phen 'ben la phog pa gal: gri g.yug rno so 'dzoms pa dgos: rta rgyugs bang kha rlung las mgyogs: gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang nga: khros na ri brag srog med 'dar: srog can rnams la smros ma dgos: khrag ral khyung gshog dbu 'phang mtho: gyad mi ngar rgod dpung re btsan: gling sdug wa mo phar la zhog: gnam sa rub kyang do zla med: mi min yul gyi dngul rdzong la: gling sdug gnyid mi khug na yang: rang srog shor ba'i nyen kha las: bya ba gzhan zhig yongs rgyu med: de ring khyod dang nga rang gnyis: tshe sngon thod pa'i bskos lugs loḥ gyad mi khrag 'thung lag snga nas: 'dan ma 'chi ba lag pa'i mthil: bla ma yod na gsol ba thob: ma ṇi shes na lan re bsgrongs:'chi kha'i lam bro de las med: go na snyan gyi bcud la zhog: ma go glu la 354

yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces zer zhing mda' 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phangs pa: 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod kyi brang la phog kyang srung ba dang go btsan pa'i miyang ma gnod: der bsam 'grub lha yi yang lha: don 'grub bdud dgra'i gshed ma: grub chen brgyad cu'i gtso bo: go bkrag dung zla tshes 'dra:mtshon thogs 'ja' tshon shar 'dra: dpa' tsha zhang 'dan ma bsam 'grub des mthing mdog 'do chen 'phur shes la bcibs shing: rje kun bzang gdod pa'ispagon po ma rig 'khrul ba'i dgra la khros pa ltar snang srid 'khrul ba'i chos kun chos nyid gcig gi klong du grol ba la dka' ba med pa: yang rtul bdun gyi gtso bo: zhe rtul gsum gyi ya gyal: 'dan yul shog gi mnga' bdag: dgra 'joms thog rgod 'bar ba de nyid kyis gzhu steng la mda' bzhag nas yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la redoḥ gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi zhing: mgon grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan sa ra ha: dus de ring dpa' bo'i kha mgon mdzod: yid 'khrul ba'i rnam rtog rtsad nas chod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: khyod sdar ma byang gi sa cha nas: mthing pho brang sha ri'i tshur mtha' red: bu nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpon ge sar gser gyi 355

nyi ma la: 'od stong 'bar nyi zer 'dan yoblon: snyan grags pa stod smad bar la grags: nga ma grags sa zhig yod pa min: snyan grags pa g.yu 'brug sngon mo la: dpa' rtsal drug rgya stag ngar ma yin: ngas sbyang ba nyag phran mda' la byas: rno rgya khab rtse yi rul ma te: ngas dpag tshad dgu nas lang gis gcod: mtho bya lam rgyud pa'i thang dkar rgod: mda' mig la gtad na gzur ba med: nga skyen po'i mtheb rtsal ldan nas yod: khyod ltar du 'jigs chen ma yin de: dgra su thug gson la mngag ma myong:mtho a sngon dgung na nyi zla skar: nga sgra gcan byung na bkrag mdangs nyams: yang bar snang khams na 'brug dang glog: nga seng chung byung na dung la yub: kho dog mo sa na sra brtan bragoḥ nga thog dmar byung na rtse nas bshig: byang mi min yul gyi sdar ma tshos: dpon ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul la: dpa' 'gran ya bzung ba 'khrul pa'i rtags: gyad mo snying khrag 'thung dpa' ming can: sman mo ngan bya ba khyod la tshang: drin pha ma'i snying gtam khrel gyis dor: pho khrel med byi rjes khyi bzhin 'khyam: ngan khyi ming brgya sde'i kha nas gleng: pho yang mtha' gyad mi wa thul can: khyod snang chen skyag lab ma mang bsdod: dgra pha rol mi thub nang la btsan: nang bza' tshang steng la shin tu ngar: gtam ngag sgo mtho la mtshang tshig 'dri: lag snga phyi rtsod nas rdung shom byed: pho mi rgod rang mtshang ma yin nam: grong rgya sde 356

chags pa'i zur zhig nas: dgra btsan po klad la shor pa'i dus: rkang sug bzhi sa la ma bsdabs sam: lag mthe mong ras rnga ma slang ngam:bden e bsam byang blon kha pho can: gyad khrag 'thung dpa' bzang stag ming che: drin pha ma'i sngon gyis dpa' rgod dang: bza' tshe rogs zur nas stong bsam te: nga 'dan ma blon la 'gro rabs med: de e bden ltad mo mthong nas yongs: glu go na snyan gyi bcud la zhog: glu ma go ba la yang med med: khyod byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces de ltar blangs ba dang: mda' rgod de gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang la thebs kyang 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs pas rdo rje'i brag la dbyug pa brgyab pa bzhin lus: de nas phan tshun gyis ral gri bton nas ral kha ja yun la 'gran kyang pham rgyal ma byung: der gling dmag gi nang nas bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po 'dan ma'i dpung grogs la byon zhing ral gri shubs nas byangs te yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: rigs gsum mgon dang rigs brgya'i lha: mi 'bral brtse ba'i rjes su bzung: dpa' rtul phu nu rnams la gzigs: ma thub dgra yi bla srog chod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: sdar ma byang gi sa cha nas: mthing shod jag gi 'grim lam 357

red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpa' rtul dpung gi gral ra nas: bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po yin: de nas gtam gyi 'dra ma la: ma mthong ltad mo mthong nas byung: ma go skad cha mtshar bo gda': mi min khrag ral stong ming can: ma mthong rgyang grags che zer kyang: gcar na wa mo khung 'dzul red: byang gling dpa' bo'i g.yul 'khrugs de: mi lo phyed gnyis 'gor nas thal: da rung mig gis ma mthong la: gar yod su yi sems na gsal:gad la gcar ram khung du yub: brag la 'dzul lam ma nges lags: dal dal pho brang nang rol na: skyid skyid ston mo e zhim bsam: bsad bsad khrag gi 'khor lo bskor: pham pham byang la brtsi tshod med: de min dpa' rtags ston zer na: ma 'dug la mo gdong la bud: nyag phran mda' yi kha btags yod: skya ring mdung gi 'bul ba yod: rno gcod mtshon gyi rting gnon yod: de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang la: rting ma nga la babs pa yin:mda' gcig mi 'phen gri gcig g.yug: ral gri srin po khros pa 'dra:gnam la 'phyar na skya rengs 'dra: skya rengs mtha' nas gsal ba 'dra:dgra dpung mun pa mtha' nas bcom: gri stegs 'thug la gri so nag:btab na srid na mi thub med: brag la btab na brag ri gtor: brag gcod ha ri 'bar 'dra zer: stong ba'i 'ja' yang sked nas gcod:'ja' gcod rdzu 'phrul nag po zer: rno gcod gzhan gyi 'gran zla med:358

bdud 'dul rtsal drug rgod dang gcig: rno gcod so kha btsan dang gnyis: 'do chen bang kha mgyogs dang gsum: 'di gsum 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod loḥ ngo ya 'jig rten khams na dkon: yod na ma 'dug gdong la gcor: phyi ma'i yul la ltad mor mngags: gshin rje khrims kyi rgyal sgo na: byang dpon dbu 'phang mtho sa med: byang blon dpa' rtsal rgod sa med: byang dmag kha grangs mang sa med: de min bya ba ci zhig yod: snying rlung stod la mi 'tshang ngam: mchin pa steng 'og mi brje 'am: sdug bsngal mngon du mi 'gyur ram: 'on kyang rang byas rang la smin: gyod pa che yang phyi nas thal: a bar rig la snying re rje: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi loḥ ma go glu la yang len med: byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces zer zhing ral gri bton nas mchong bar gyad mi kho la glu len ngag 'gugs kyi dus tshod ma byung nas gri 'gran mang du byas mthar khos bdud gri de bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po'i lus stod smad gnyis su bsgos nas dgrong: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas dang: 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me gnyis kyis gri mda' ci phogs byas kyang kho la mtshon ma song:khos ral gris ngar la gling dmag 'phru dmar can mang du drangs: dpa' rtul rnams kyis mda' mtshon ser ba ltar kho'i lus stod smad la thebs pa ci yang ma gnodoḥ khos gling dmag ram nag ser ba'i bcom pa ltar byas 359

te mthar rang rdzong la log:der 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur dang: rtsal ldan sha ba dung thod gnyis thug pas dang por 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis rta kha bkag nas yin lugs dang gtam 'ga' med pa'i dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: nged rang yul 'jang gi dgra bla dang: khong ge sar skyes bu'i srung ma rnams: gnas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rgyud bskul: sngon smon log dgra yi skye rgyud chod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na:byang mi min bdud kyi bshas ra red:pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: lho 'jang yul mtshal ra smug po nas: nga 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur yin: ya de nas byang blon rta ser can:yin zer ba'i mi pho su zhig yin: dus de ring khyod dang 'u gu gnyis:dpa' rgod po'i rtsal drug 'gran na 'khrul: thog dmar bo spar 'dzin g.yu lha'i nus: khyod rtsal med byang ba g.yag dang 'dra: snying rje ba'i las la 'di las ci: nged rma khams gling gi yul gru na: lha rma rgyal gangs kyi dbu rtse mtho: rma gter g.yang dngos grub char ltar 'jo: dpon ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul bzhugs: don gang brtsam las la gdong grogs mdzad:grogs rgyal yum skya lo'i seng lcam ma: mdzes lang tsho srid pa'i khyon la grags: dpung dpa' rtul grub chen brgyad cu bzhi: bdud nag po 360

'joms pa'i tho lum 'dra: gling 'bum dmag dgung gi skar tshogs bkra:dpa' g.yul 'khrugs las la mnga' dbang bsgyur: dpung bkyes na bskal ba'i chags 'jig 'dra: yul bskal ba'i chags 'jig su yis bzlog: re e bsam byang gi sdar ma tsho: wa ga ma'i snying rtsa e 'dar lags: yul 'jig rten gna' mi'i gtam dpe la: chos rgyud na med pa'i bla ma des: yul chags sdang ngan pa'i rgyal khams dkrugs: dpyod jus gzhi med pa'i dpon po des: ma 'gro la mi 'dod sna tshogs gtong: khrel ngo tsha med pa'i bu mo des: sde bza' tshang bu rgyud sdug la bkol: de zer ba'i gtam dang ci mi 'dra: dpa' med pa'i byang gi rgyal blon tshos: sde ru 'bangs dgra yi lag la bzhag: dmag bu rta rdzong gi nang la gab: rdzong lcags ri'i 'gram na 'dar ra ra: kha skyag dri pha le sha re tsha: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang loḥ bu g.yu lha rting ma dgung la grags: dpon ge sar rgyal po'i zhabs pad bstan: sde gling ba dkar po'i ngo mtshar gtam:gnas srid pa kun tu khyab pa byed: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: sde byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: rtsal ldan sha ba dung thod na re: 'o na gling phrug rta sngon can: yin nges 'jang phrug g.yu lha bu: pho khyod 'dra'i rgod po ma yin te: nga'i pha bla dgra la btsong ma myong: khyod ma g.yeng glu la 361

tshur nyon dang: dpa' rtsal drug 'gran rgyu dka' mo min zer zhing 'brong ra nag po'i gzhu steng du lcags mda' gser ltong ma zhig bzhag nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: ma thub dgra bo chom la phob: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes noḥ mi min byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:rtsal ldan sum cu'i gral ra nas: ming don gnyis kyi phyug pa nga: rtsal ldan sha ba dung thod yin: khyod 'dra rgod po ma yin te: rting ma lag la ma thob med: rtsal drug khyod 'dra mi che de: pha jus dgra la bskur ma myong: de nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha bu: ya med nag po zer ba khyod: ming tsam thos na zhe nas khrel: 'jang yul mtshal ra smug po nas: sa dam stobs kyi rgyal po khong: rgya gar rgya nag bal bod dang: sog po a drag la sogs kyi: rgyal po rnams kyi rtse rgyan yin: pha sha jo ru'i lag la bzhag: da rung kha pho ngo re tsha:'jang gi dug mi dpung dang bcasoḥ ya chung sems la mi dran nam: da lta gling gi dmag dkyil na: khas len zhabs phyi byed pa de: khyi rgan nag po'i ngang tshul tsam: brgya sde'i kha na gtam ngan gyioḥ bshad pa sna tshogs 'u ru ru: de 'dra'i las shig byed pa lasoḥ thengs dgu shi yang sngon las yin:362

mtha' dmag gling gi 'dod sred kyis: mi min dngul rdzong len 'dod 'di: mi lus 'dom gang gru bzhi de: mda' mtshon sne la ma drangs na: pha jus mi bskur kho thag yin: rtsal ldan sha ba dung thod nga: gshin rje nag po'i kha ya yin: gling phrug srog dmar chod tshod gda': sdar ma dpung gshibs wa blon tsho: rta pho rgyugs gshibs bong bu tsho: byang thang kha rgya che che nas: bong bu'i rgyugs thag chod sa med: byang phrug stag mo ngar ngar nas:gling sdug wa mo khe sa med: khyad par 'bum dmag dpung dkyil nas: mi sngon dpa' 'dod ra thong mgo: rta sngon rgyugs la byang khul can: dpa' med dpung gi grib la gcar: mi pho jus shi ma nus na: khrab rmog gyon pa lji byed red: 'khor gsum bskor ba kha re bskyangs: mi ming btags pa khyi dang 'dra: de sngon nyi ma yan chad la: ma byas gling gi tshod med red:gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig de: 'bum tsho dgu yi 'dems ya yin:mal nyal rmi lam bzhin du bzos: gyad mi me ru rtse rgyal de: 'bum tsho dmag gi kha ya yin: dmar bsad khrag gi 'khor lo bskor: thog 'brug dpa' bo'i 'dzum drug nogs: me chu dug gsum ha la 'phangs: 'bum dmag phyed dgos gyong gud bzos: de lan a phos ma lon na: shi ba dgu las mi thu ri:byang phrug mi khro ka med la: khros na khro bo gshin rje'i gshed:gling gi ma shes yod tshod min: 'do chen rlung gi bang kha can: rgyugs na 363

bang kha lon tsam yin: de ring nyi ma'i dgong kha la: yang na rtsal ldan shi ba gcig: yang na gling sdug ya le gnyis: ma nus e bzhag rig nas yongs: thabs shes rang la ma yod na: rgya mtsho'i g.yang nor srog gi gshed: dpa' rtsal rang la ma yod na: g.yul chen dmag jag pham kha'i rgyu: sdeb kha tshad du ma phyin na: nad 'joms nus pa gang nas thon: e red gling ba dpung gi tshogs: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du 'jang phrug gis mda' 'phangs ba rtsal ldan sha ba dung thod kyi go khrab sing sgra dang bcas gtor yang nang du srin po lcags ral gyi srung 'khor yod pas mtshon ma blangs:khos mda' 'phangs ba 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis phub kyis bkag nas ma gnod: der ral kha 'gran par dpa' 'dra mnyam ltar byung skabs seng stag dam pa rab rgyas phebs nas gri rub brgyab mthar byang phrug rtsal ldan kho srog dang bral: rtsal ldan bdud rje lcags khrab dang: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gnyis thug pa'i dang por mi min byang gi dpa' blon des ral gri 'brong ra dgu gcod shubs nas byangs shing dpa' gtam brjod pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: srin lcags ral 364

bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: yang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sdang dgra bo'i g.yas ru gnon par shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha red:pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang padma nyi ma'i thang stod nas: mtho mkhar btsan bum pa dkris yag gi: rdzong ya bdag rtsal ldan gral 'dzin la: nga rtsal ldan bdud rje lcags khrab yin: ya kho re gling gi pho gsar lags:mjal zer na phyag rtags dang po la: nga'i ral gri 'brong ra dgu gcod yod: 'dis thebs tshad mi chod ga la srid: gri 'di yi lo rgyus shin tu mang: rno lcags sna dgu yi brdung ba yin: yang ngar chu srin po'i khrag la byas: gri btab na nyi zla sa la 'phen: sra sa gzhi'i ri brag thang la bsnyil:mtho nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon sked nas gcod: lho g.yu 'brug sngon mo sa la 'phen: thog dmar bo'i glog zhags gri la 'tshub: sra rdo rje'i go yi ga la bsten: dus de ring tshe tshad khyod la g.yug: gson mi yul mngags na dpa' bo min: dus da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrug 'dis: sde gling ba'i dbang thang rdzogs pa red: kho 'gag mo'i ab sha dmar mchan des:dpung dgra sna byang la gtad don ci: dpon rgya tsha byang gi ma dgrong lags:bu rong tsha byang gis bsad pa min: kho gzig 'phen chu la ma bskur lagasoḥdon med pa'i tshur 'gebs ci go red: nged dpa' rgod byang gi blon po 365

tshos: yang khra ring mdung gi mjal dar dngoḥ mda' nyag phran gzu mo'i legs skyes yod: rno ngar chen mtshon gyi ja 'dren byed: yang sgos su rtsal ldan bdud rje nga: dpa' a ya med pas mi zhig yinoḥ gtam go ba can gyi tshig zhig yin: zas bro ba can gyi rigs shig yin: dpa' gyad chen srin po'i gral ra nas: yang gshin rje nag po'i ngo ya la: nga rtsal ldan dpung gi sde tshogs rgod: stobs dgra la ngoms na 'bod rgyu red: dmag g.yul du chas na med 'thab med: dpa' rang bstod skad cha ga la yin: ma ngan pas bu bstod byed rabs yod: rta ngan pa slas la 'phreng rabs yod:mdzo ngan pa rdang la nyal rabs yod: bu de 'dra dgos pa lar nas med:bu skyes na rang mgo thon pa gal: rta rgyugs na mgyogs dar lon pa bzang:mda' 'phangs na 'ben la phogs pa dgos: tshig bshad na snying la zug pa gyisoḥ glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po na re: 'o na byang gi rtsal ldan nyon: sdar ma ngag 'dar rdzun rkyal khyodoḥ lus 'dar dar cog rlung gis sdebs: rta pho sngo nag thal ba'i mdog: rgyugs med bang kha rdo la thug: a bar rig la snying re rje zer zhing ral gri shubs nas byangs te lag g.yon pas 'gram pa skyor: g.yas pas ral gri'i dpa' lung 366

la 'jus nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: dmar nag dbang gi gzhal yas nas: padma dbang gi lha tshogs rnams: dgung nas kha ba babs pa ltar: mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir byon cig: yid kyi 'dod pa kun 'grub nas: phyogs las rnam rgyal 'phrin las mdzod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min bdud kyi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rma yul skyid pa'i lhas ra nas: yang skyid chos kyi pho brang nas: nam mkha' thog 'gyur 'das pa'i sras: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po yin: 'bru yul stod smad bar gsum na: 'bru sras zer na dad pa 'khrungs: smon lam dus su sad pa'i rigs: sngon gnas rjes su dran le yin: bag sgrib ye nas gus ma myong: btsan po klad la mi shor zhing: nyams chung mtha' nas skyong mi yin: de nas nyon dang 'dra ma yod: nged cag gling gi sa cha na:rma yul g.yang gi ra ba ru: co ka'i drug 'gyur brgyag sa red: khu byug mgrin dbyangs snyan sa red: pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse yod: mkhar rtse lha yis 'phrul bzhengs byas: bka' dang bstan bcos mdo sngags gzhung:lha klu mi dang thams cad kyisoḥ rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bzhengs ba yi: gser dngul zangs mtshal snag bris sogs: chos phung ri rab dgung la snyeg:mkhar sked gnyan gyis 'phrul gyis bzhengs: rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang: o 367

rgyan bla ma'i rnam thar gtsos: gdod ma'i mgon po nas bzung ste: bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi:gyang lha tshon gyi drwa ba yod: mkhar gdan ma gros klu yis bzhengs: ngo mtshar 'od kyi gzhal yas na: rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu dang: bod kyi mkhan slob chos rgyal bcas: 'ja' tshon dgung la shar 'dra'i dbus: khri chen gser khri zil gnon rngams: sku rje lha yi sde tshogs dang: dpa' rtul dpung gi bzhugs gnas yin: mjal na tshe 'di'i sgrub pa 'dag: bsam na don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub: khyad par sku rje lha'i bla ma: gzugs can gzugs med gnyis ka red: bdud dang dgra yi gshed ma red: 'gran na byang ba snying re rje: pha jus shor ba'i snga ltas red: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po ngas: ma bsad dgra la gcig kyang med: lus ngan sdig rgyud bcad ma thag: thar ba'i zhing khams gang 'dems la: bya brgya 'ur rdos bskyog pa bzhin: skad cig nyid la 'dren par nges: rtsal ldan bdud rje lcags khrab khyod: bshad bshad gtam la 'bras bu med: yod na srid pa'i khams 'di ru: khyod las rgod po yod sa med: rang 'dod smon lam shar tshig la: 'bras bu yod pa su yis shes:go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la zhog: ma go glu la yang med med: byang phrug yid la de ltar zhog:368

ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du phan tshun ral gri bton nas mchong zhing ral kha ja yun la 'gran kyang pham rgyal ma byung ba'i mthar:dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar: dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal po: 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me gsum gyis so sos mdung dang ral gri bton nas mchong byung bas: rtsal ldan bdud rje lcags khrab kyis khong rnams kyi gri ngo mi lon pa shes nas rta kha myur bar g.yon la bsgyur zhing rlung bud pa ltar gling dmag gi khrod nas dmag mi drug cur nye ba zhig bsad rmas su btang:'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod kyis mda' gcig 'phangs pas: rtsal ldan bdud rje lcags khrab kyi ya thod dpral ba'i bzhi mdo la phogs te klad khrag gnam la gtor nas bsad: der gling dmag rnams kyis ki sgra dang bcas lha rgyal 'then: dar 'phyar nas dgra la snying tshims dris shing de nyin g.yul mtshams bzhag nas bdud 'dul dbang gi rgyal po la gdong sbyangs yang dag byas par gda' skad: der ge sar mi yi nyi mas bka' blon shor ba la thugs 'gyod dang bcas 'pho ba ma sgom sangs rgyas kyi bskyed rims mdzad nas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su gtan pa thob par byas: ma tshad rjes sor dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gro phan gling ba zhes par sprul nas sems can gyi don dpag med byed par lung bstan pa lags: sa ma ya:369

dzoji le'u bcu drug pa /dgyes tshogs bkra shis chang gis brngan//byang rgyal pho brang dmag gis skor//gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang dang //glog dmar drag rgod la sogs pham//'dir lha gur mthong ba don ldan: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i chon thag: rdzu 'phrul chu skyes phur ba: me tog padma'i ka ba: mthong grol lha gur phyugs mo'i nang du khebs gdan brtsegs pa'i yang steng: shākya'i bstan pa'i bdag po: log 'dren bdud kyi kha gnon: sku lus ri rgyal lhun po: chos skyong sprin dpung 'thibs se: wer ma zi ra 'tshub se: bkrag mdangs 'ja' tshon lam meoḥ zab gsang padma'i pha phogs: 'dzad med 'gro la 'byed pa: 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po: lha yi yang lha dkar po: mgon gyi yang mgon chen po de nyid kyis gsol chang mang du bzhes nas thugs spro ba'i ngang la bzhugs yod pa'i skabs su: gnas o rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mooḥ sku mdog padma rā ga:mdzes sdug yid dbang 'gugs pa: gsung snyan ga la piṅga: drag sngags 370

'gro la 'byed pa: thugs klong nam mkha' yangs ba: chos nyid don la gzhol ba: ma cig seng ge'i gdong ba can des skad cig gi 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mdun nam mkha' 'ja' sprin gyi klong nas mdzes pa'i zhal gzigs: snyan pa'i gsung gi dbyugs dbyung: me tog ug chos dang: lug mig: padma ge sar: u dam wa ra sogs kyis char phab:chopi wang dang: rnga chen: rdza rnga sogs rol mo sna tshogs bsgrags: 'ja' lcags kyu 'dra ba'i 'od 'khyil ba bar mtshams med pa'i klong nas mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mos sku rje seng chen bla ma la lung bstan gyi mgur ma 'di ltar gsungs so:na mo sibha ḍā ki ye: gzhi skye med don gyi klong yangs nas: lha bla ma padma 'byung gnas la: 'khor rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor:yid rnam dag gsol ba 'debs lags na: don bkra shis g.yang gi dngos grub stsol: gnas 'di 'dra mthing gsal nam mkha'i klong: sprin dkar dmar 'ja' yi dkyil 'khor red: ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: gnas o rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas: nga drag byed mkha' 'gro seng gdong yin:ya de nas ge sar mi yi rje: snyan dar lung ma g.yel tshur la gsonoḥ bya khyung chen rgyal po mkha' la 'phur: 'dab gshog ldan rgyal po'i mtshan nyid red: lho g.yu 'brug ngar skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: gnyan che rgu las la 371

'gyed pas red: nya gser mig mtsho mo'i nang la 'khyugs: lus dung gshog dkar mo 'dzoms pas red: gling ge sar g.yul 'gyed chad med 'di: steng lha nas bskos thang ri mo red: chang bdud rtsi bzhes nas dbu 'phang mtho: thugs dgongs pa chos nyid don la gzigs: ma 'gro ba'i skyid sdug las la brtson: khyed sku rje seng chen bla ma la: phyogs rdzong khag bdud kyi sde tshan mang: rdzong gcig la lo mang 'das mi rung: brgyan rin chen dngul gyi gter rdzong de: da ma 'gyang myur du lon pa gyis: gling dpa' rtul thog 'brug glog 'dra rnams: dpa' dpung gshibs stag gzig kha sprod bzhin: yang ser rgod dgung nas babs babs kyis: dgra byang dmag ram nag bcom bcom gyis: byang mi min khrag ral rgyal po kho:dus da lta dbang thang rdzogs nas gda': dpung chen pos rting ma myur du longs: klu'i ma gros phugs kyi nor bu de: rje tshong dpon thabs kyis lon pa gyis: lho tsan tan sman gyi ljon pa de: sman mkhas pas rdzas la sdeb kha sgrigs: bya rma bya'i sgro thig ri mo de: lag bum chung rtse la bstar rgyu gyis:shar rgya ja me tog yongs 'dzin de: bod chu gtsang 'o ma'i grogs la bsres:byang mi min yul gyi dngul dkar gter: shar khra mo gling la lon pa gyis:dus ma 'gying 'gor na dgos pa chung: shar nyi ma'i nyin bskor 'dzam gling dro: chab chu bo'i nyin bskor skoms pa sel: rlung drag po nyin g.yug 372

'chag rom bshig: dpung dpa' rgyugs gcig gis dgra mtha' chod:yun ring na a med lan med red: bya de 'dra dgos pa lar nas med: sku seng chen bla ma'i thugs la zhog:ces gsungs ba dang: 'dzam gling mi yi nyi ma de nyid kyis gsol kar gyi nang du chang rigs mang du blug nas dar dkar po'i rtsibs pa dgung la btegs shing glu 'di mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i tshogs dbyangs la drangs te blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: skye med mthing gi gzhal yas nas: mdzes sdug nyi ma'i zhal bzang can: dgyes pa'i zhal gzigs ya la la: snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs di ri ri: thugs rjes rjes 'dzin dbyer ba med: lung bstan dbugs dbyung thugs rje che: rting rag tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med ngang: gdod ma'i btsan sa zin par shog: de ring bkra shis dus bzang la: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod cig phul: bsod nams ye shes tshogs shig bsags: yul ni khyab brdal chos kyi dbyings: gnas ni rang bzhin ka nas dag: chos sku kun bzang snang mtha' yas: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni nges pa lnga ldan zhing: gnas ni 'og min 373

bde chen nas: longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' che: bdud ji chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas:'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni kun khyab phyogs bral gling:gnas ni rang snang dag pa ru: sprul sku ro lang dgyes pa'i rdor: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni o rgyan nub byang mtshams: yan lag brgyad ldan padma'i mtshor: rang byung badzus skyes padma 'byung: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar shar gyi phyogs: gnas ni dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal: thugs rigs rdo rje bsam 'grub rtsal: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dngoḥ tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar lho yi phyogs: gnas ni dur khrod sku la rdzogs: sku rigs rdo rje drag po rtsal:bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar nub kyi phyogs: gnas ni padma brtsegs pa'i sar: gsung rigs padma drag po rtsal: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su 374

smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar byang gi phyogs: gnas ni liṅga brtsegs pa'i sar: phrin las rdo rje thod pa rtsal: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul:smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar shar lho'i mtshams: gnas ni lhun grub brtsegs pa'i sar: yon rigs rdo rje gro bo lod: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smrin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar lho nub mtshams: gnas ni gsang chen rol ba che: rbod rigs rdo rje dbang sdud rtsal: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smrin pa dang:tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog:yul ni rgya gar nub byang mtshams: gnas ni nye chen brdal ba'i sar:mchod rigs rdo rje gshogs rgod rtsal: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul:smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: yul ni rgya gar byang shar mtshams: gnas ni 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i sar: drag rigs rdo rje mtheb gshog rtsal:bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: gnas 375

yul rang byung dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'khor dang bcas:'bum phrug yangs ba'i sde tshogs la: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul:smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: chos longs sprul ba'i mkha' 'gro la: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i mkha' 'gro la: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i sde tshogs dang: chos skyong bstan srung yul gzhi'i bdag: 'go ba'i lha lnga la sogs la: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: shar gyi a mye rma chen dang: bod skyong mgur lha g.yang lha'i gtsos: dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad la: bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: smon lam dus su smin pa dang: tshe chos sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: glu blangs don dang ldan par shog: tshig brjod 'bras bu zab par shog: 'dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis shog:ces gsung nas rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong 376

thams cad la bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa nam mkha' mdzod la dbang ba zhig phul nas 'phrin las rab 'byams kyi don la gzhol lo: der 'dzam gling skyes bu chen pos bka' bzhin gling dmag drag gral rnams 'du ra la 'dus te: 'bum dmag sngon bzhin khag bzhi la bsgos nas mi 'gyang bar mi min byang gi dngul rdzong len rgyu la zab gros mang du byas shing ja chang gi dga' ston la rol ba'i tshe: stag rong dpon po chang gis bzi nas dpa' bo'i stangs stabs dang bcas g.yas 'gying seng ge ngar ngar: g.yon 'gying stag mo 'jigs 'jigs: smra ra g.yas byug g.yon byug: nam mkha' bsten med la skyil krung mdzad: rno ral gri'i rtse nas me sbar: rdo gor mo la chang bu bzos te gral dkyil nas yar phebs dang mar byon 'ga' mdzad de bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa zhig ge sar la btegs nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: lha sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: yang bon sras bla ma'i tshogs dang bcas: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: don gzhi la 'khrul ba med par shog: sa lam la gol 'phyugs med par shog: mthar 'bras bu'i btsan sa zin par shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: ldong smug po gnam gyi rgyangs shing la:377

pha khu bo nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms: gling ge sar lha yi bla ma la: nga khu bo stag mo 'dzum dgyes gda': ya de nas ge sar mi yi nor: gling dpa' rtul stag gzig thang gang nyon: dus de ring bkra shis nyi ma la: dgra ldog 'og gnon la dka' khag med: nom dngul rdzong len pa'i dus la nye:bod sgang ba'i bstan jus grub nas byung: steng lha yi byin rlabs nyi ma shar:bar gnyan gyi gdong grogs sha ra ra: 'og klu yi kha mgon mel tshe byed:khyed de 'dra min na ci 'dra yin: lha 'jam dpal sku yi tshul du grub:dpal 'phags mchog gsung gi rol ba shar: mgon phyag rdor thugs kyi klong la nges: rje gu ru'i 'phrin las pho nya ba: mchog rgyal kun gsang gsum bdag nyid bsngags: dus de ring rten 'brel bzang bo la: bzhes gsol kar khyung gshog rtags brgyad yin: 'dis lo rgyus lan gsum gleng zer na: gdugs dkar bo dar gyi 'phyangs 'phrul can: rje dbu 'phang dgung las mtho ba'i rtags: dpal rgyal mtshan 'dab ma 'khyug ris can:yul chos srid mnga' thang rgyas pa'i rtags: 'dam chu skyes padma'i re khā bkra: ldong rigs rgyud dar zhing rgyas pa'i rtags: bcud g.yang ldan bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang: nom bang ba gang stong med pa'i rtags: skyid gser mig nya mo chu la 'khyugs: nang phu nu zhal 'dzom bzang ba'i rtags:g.yang dpal gyi be'u khug brgyad ldan: yul 'jig rten dga' ba'i chos 378

brgyad mtshon: gser rin chen 'khor lo g.yas su 'khyil: skyid lha chos mi chos zung 'brel 'grub: dung g.yas 'khyil gser gyi kha phor can: snyan grags pa kun la khyab pa'i rtags: nang bcud ldan bdud rtsi g.yang du 'khyil: dri mkha' la 'phyur na lha klu dgyes: bcud kha la rol na yid sems skyid: lha bla mas bzhes na dbu 'phang mtho: gong dpon pos bzhes na gros gzhi zin: stag shar bas bzhes na dgra bla 'khor: ma bu mos bzhes na glu bro 'khrab: bden e bsam 'dir tshogs gling gi dpung: yang sgos su sku rje bla ma lags: nga khu bo'i chang phud 'di bzhes la: thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi phob: byang mi min dgra mtha' myur du gcod: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang med: khyed 'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: sku rje seng chen rin po ches thugs dgyes pa'i ngang nas chang de bzhes shing dmag ston yid tshims pa zhig byas shing de nub rang rang gi sgar la phyin: nyi ma de yi phyir nyin ru 'dren bzhi yis dmag sna khrid de shar skya rengs kyi skya mda' ma chad: sngo rengs kyi 'dab ma ma bkyag gong la mi bkrag rta bkrag 'tshub se mi min gyi rdzong la gtad nas song ngo:mi min gyis so ba rnams kyis brda sprad par byang gi rdzong btsan des 379

shar sgo la gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa la dmag 'phru dmar can khri gsum gyis bskor nas btsan rdzong bzung: lho sgo la gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang la dmag 'phru sngon can khri dmag gong bzhin bsdad: nub sgo la glog dmar drag rgod ya med la dmag 'phru nag can gong dang mtshungs ba:byang sgo la rtsal ldan grags pa thog rgod dang: rtsal ldan sgyu ma mngon shes gnyis la dmag mi 'phru khra can khri dmag gsum gyis bskor nas rdzong btsan bzung nas gra sgrigs byas:de'i skabs su shar phyogs nas dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal pos 'bum dmag ru dar dmar lhab lhub khrag mtsho kha lud pa ltar thon pas sngon la gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa bud pa dang: dang po hor sdig gcod shan pa rme ru rtses mda' ltong sprad de glu 'di 'bras thung chu bo dal 'bebs la drangs nas blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnam sa bar gyi lha tshogs dang: 'go ba'i lha lnga skyobs pas mgon: mi 'bral yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: mtha' bdud dgra yi g.yul ngo bzlog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min byang gi sa cha red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: 'bum thub shan pa rgyal po yin: de nas byang gi gyad rgod lags: dpa' med srog la rtsis med khyod: a bar rig la snying re rje: gna' mi bod kyi gtam 380

dpe la: yon tan med pa'i skye bo rnams: snang ba a sngon dgung las mtho:nus pa zhan pa'i sngags rgan rnams: kha bshad stong gtam 'brug la 'gran: khog shes med pa'i bu mo rnams: col chung pha ma'i steng la btsan:dpa' snying med pa'i byang phrug rnams: g.yul 'thab byas na gar song med: zer ba'i gtam la cha 'jog mdzod: 'bum dmag khrag mtsho rdol ba 'di: shar gling dpung gi las dmag red: dmag dar dmar bo dgung la bskyod: dar 'phru rlung gi rtse ya byas: btsan dmag las la rgyu ba bzhin:thon pa mi min byang la thon: thon pas las 'di bzang rgyu med: byang gi pha jus gru bzhi de: mi 'dod dgra la shor bas rtags: dngul rdzong g.yang gi sgo mo de: byang la ma dbang kho thag chod: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa khyod: mi gcig rgod pas ci zhig byed: rta gcig mgyogs pas ci zhig phan: mda' gcig skyen pas dgos pa chung: rma khams dpung gi pha dmag 'di: gshin rje las la rgyu rgyu yin: go bzung ser ba babs babs yin: mtshon thogs thog dmar lhung lhung yin: ki sgra 'brug stong grags grags yin: sod rgyob rna ba'i mi bzod do: byang phrug khyi mo skyag zan rnams: g.yo rgyu'i las la mkhas pa las: dpa' rgod rting me lon rabs med: de ring thug pa'i gyad mi khyod: gom gang phar la mngag 'dod med:mngag na hor gyi shan pa nga: dpa' med wa mo btags na chog: dpa' 381

bzang shan pa rgyal po ngaḥ mi dmar btsan gyi rje bo la: rta dmar rlung gi gshog pa thogs: ru 'dren dpung gi dug klong nas: ha la nag po shan pa grags: bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba na: dmyal ba'i gting rdo grub pa red: dpon po'i yid la ma babs na: chad pa'i 'gong kha 'khor ba red:mdzes ma'i rgyud dang ma mthun na: grogs med kher rkyang lus nyen yod:skyag phrug lang shor byang ba tshos: dang bo don med mi sha bsgos: tha ma 'gyod pa ltas mi shong: yang mtha' pha jus dgra la shor: shan pa'i sngon nas byang ba rnams: glag nag sngon gyi ri bong dang: rgya khris sngon gyi byi'u chung bzhin: mi shor dgra yi kha la tshud: shan pa khros na gza' dang 'dra:shan pa rgyugs na rlung dang 'dra: shan pa 'gran na bdud dang 'dra: kun thub shan pa lan med yin: e bden ltad mo thengs gcig gzigs: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang blon yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: mda' glog dmar 'tshub se 'phangs bar gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa shan pa'i 'dul skal ma yin stabs mda' ma song: der gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas dpung ba'i sha rgod 'phar: lus kyi rtsal drug rgyas: dpa' rting ma len 'dod kyi snying nad dang bcas yob snga sor rgyangs: gzhu steng la mda' 'gengs nas yin 382

lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so: glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: srin lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: yang rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sdang dgra la rting ma lon par shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas: mtho pho brang sha ri'i nye 'gram red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa yin: byi'u brgya bo chom la phab phab nas: khra dar ma mi shes zer sa med: nya gser mig skam la drangs drangs nas: rno lcags kyu mi shes zer sa med: sde gling sdug srog dang bral bral nas: dpa' gyad mi mi shes zer sa med: hor gur dkar gling la shor ba'i dus: khyod shan pa sdar ma wa dang 'dra: wa gad pa'i rtsa la ma nyal lam: mgo klad phor 'dan mas lag la shor: sgo phyi khyim bar gyi dmag nyes red: dpa' che nas rting ma gang nas yin: dus tha ma gur dkar rgyal po kho: gling ge sar rgyal po'i lag la bzhag: bya phyi nang brjes pa sus mi shes: khyi nag po gling dkar stod la khrid: kha khyi zas phyin nas ma gsos sam: dus da rung dpa' gtam ngo re tsha: pho sdar ma'i lag snga byas nas tshar: dgra ma thub snying rtsa chad la khad: dbugs stod la 'tshang yang phyi nas gda': chags bzhag na 'dra ma 'di ltar yod: byi'u bse rag 'phur tshod ma zin nas:383

khra hor ba'i sgo la babs nas byung: bra tsi gus rgyugs tshod ma zin nas:gcan byi las 'gram la thon nas byung: hor shan pa'i sdug tshod ma zin nas: srog dmar po gyad mi nga la gtad: nga gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa la: mi gsod pa'i las la dgyes pa las: srog skyobs pa'i las la dga' ma myong: lho gling sdug wa mo'i khyu tsho 'di: sgo shar nas gtor zhing nub la gtugs: yang byang nas lho dang mtshams bzhi la: ro gsar ba'i ri mo 'bri la 'jog: khrag dmar bo'i thigs shig 'then nas yongs: khyod shan pa ro yi 'phru la 'dzugs: rta rlung gshog a phos nom la len: byang rta med thabs chags ma red de: dpa' rting ma zer na gleng rgyu dang: stobs mthu rtsal zer na ngoms rgyu dgos: dus de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la:dpa' rting ma nyag phrag mda' la babs: mda' gzu mo'i mtheb shugs rgyas nas byung: gzhu 'gugs chen dpung la 'phrod nas gda': skyen zer bas rting thag chod dgos na: phyi khrab dkar a long bzhu la 'jog: nang sha khrag zung du bsre ba dang: sems rnam shes lus dang bral le byed: khyod gling bas mi zer dgu zer la: gyod nag po'i 'byung khungs byang ba zer:khyod smyo ba red dam bzi ba red: lha bla ma'i rang skyon ma shes na: 'bangs slob bu'i re ba stong zad byed: gong dpon po'i rang skyon ma shes na: jus gru bzhi'i rtsa gnad ga la zin: ma bu mo'i rang skyon ma shes na: grogs 384
