dga' ba'i phyi thag ci ltar skyong: sde gling ba'i rang skyon ma shes na: yul byang ba'i btang snyoms byed thabs med: ya kho re bla btsong shan pa lags:srog dmar bo chad la ma skrag na: dpa' go btsan la mo bzung khul gyis:ngas nyag phran mda' la ngar shugs che: 'dis mi thags rdzas kyi gong bu med: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: hor shan pa'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de 'phangs byung ba dang:shan pas go btsan bzung bas mda' ma zug: der shan pas star chen dang khos ral gri bton nas ja yun la 'gran pa su dang gang la ma gnod:las dmag chu bo bzhur ba ltar rdzong gi phyogs la shor: byang dmag rnams kyis dpa' ya ma yongs nas lam gang thob kyi bros pa dang: mgo 'bul byed mkhan mang du byung: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod dang: shan tsha rlung lha mgyogs ldan: 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me: rong sras lha rgod 'bum lu rnams kyis zhags pa bzhi dus gcig la gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa'i ske dang phrag la thebs pa khos ral gri klad la bskor nas dus gcig la bcad:khos gling gi dpa' rtul rnams la ma 'thab par dmag khrod du shor nas dmag mi mang po bcom par gda':der pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi lho sgo nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 385

'gyur gyi 'bum dmag sprin nag thang la khol ba ltar byung ba dang: rdzong gi nye sar gcar zhing dang po 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyis 'do ba gnam yag sngon mo'i kha ru bkag nas yin lugs kyi dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: chos sku kun bzang yab dang yum: longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga dang: sprul sku rig 'dzin padma 'byung: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi: lho phyogs rdo khri sum brtsegs red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: skug po 'jang gi ya bdag de: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur yin: kho re byang gi rgyal blon tsho: pho brang nang nas sdug gab 'di: byi ba tshang la yub pa 'dra: a kyang nyam nga yi re mug: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: nged cag dpa' rtul dpung gi tshogs: khra mo gling gi pha dmag yin: mi min khrag ral rgyal po khos: na nang btab pa'i 'bras zhing de: da lo snye ma 'khrungs nas yod: na nang nyal ba'i dgun chang de: da lo dri bzang thil nas yod: na nang dgra sna gling la gtad: da lo dgra lan rtsod 'dod yod: gdong 'bud yod na dga' tshod yin: med na phugs nom nom la len: phyi yi sa mkhar rtse nas gtor: ka bzhi gdung ma sked nas gcog: chag ro dmar po me la bsregs: don med btsan 386

bcom byed pa de: btsan mtha' e chod ltad mo2 lta: yang sgos gyod kyi gzhi ma de: mi min yul gyi rje bo lags: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po khyod:rdzong la ma gab 'gram la gcor: phyi na yod na gdong la bud: su rgod rting ma thengs gcig 'gran: ma mthong rgyang grags che na yang: don la wa mo khung 'dzu gda': stong gtam brag stong 'brug sgra de: lag len 'ja' ltar mi yal lam: dpa' bo'i gdong len ma nus na: khyi mo skyag zan ming du 'dogs:don la byang gi las dmag rnams: la la rdo mgo rmog gyon 'dra:la la rta rdzi khyi g.yog dngos: la la gla ba khrab can red: la la dbang med nyes chen lags: gling rgod mchong ba'i ngar lam nas: ram nag ser bas bcom bcom byas: de nas mi min khrag ral dpon: de ring gdong 'bud ma nus na: stong bdud shi ba'i ro la zo: thog 'brug ya ba'i khrag la 'thung: rtsal ldan bsad pa'i rus pa 'chos: 'bum dmag shor ba'i snying khrag 'jibs: khrag ral khrag gi ral ba can: khrag gi ral ba'i ci zhig byed: byang ba dpung gi sde tshogs rnams:ma bzhag dgra yi lag la sprad:de ring sgo la ma bud kyang: rdzong btsan phyogs bzhi dbus nas bskor:gshog thogs gnam la 'phur sa med: sder chags sa la 'dzul sa med:bang can thang la bros sa med: yang na rang srog rang gis chod: mgo bo dmag gis phyir la sprod: de min byang la skyid po med: mi 'dod bya zhig 387

mgo la yongs: e bden ltad mo da lta gsal: mda' mo 'phur shes ngar shugs ldan: la mo sgo them steng la brgyag: rgya sgo 'ur gyis gtor la 'jog:'bum dmag rgya mtsho lud pa bzhin: rdzong gi nang la mchong nas yongs:khrag ral rgyal po man chad nas: rta rdzi thab g.yog yan chad de: gang thug 'gran ya bzung mi rnams: dmar bsad khrag gi so nams byed: mgo 'bul lus 'bul byed mi rnams: mi gsod gling gi brgyan la khrid: gang dga' rang gis 'dems na chog: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: byang dmag yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs nas mda' thog dmar zi ra 'tshub se 'phangs pas mi min gyi pho brang gi brgya sgo rno khab len gyi grub rkyen gtor ma thub:der sga bde chos skyong beer nag gis 'jigs pa'i chas dang bcas g.yu lha'i dpa' rogs la phebs nas rdo pha bong g.yag ro 'dra ba zhig phyag g.yas pas shugs kyis blangs: g.yon pas rta kha bkag cing yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: lha mgon po pho rgyud sde tshogs dang: yang sgos su phyag drug beer nag sogs: dus de ring sga bde'i grogs la byon: byang rdzong btsan sgo mo gtor rogs mdzod: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: pha sdar ma rdzong la gab pa'i gnas: byang sha ri 388

gnam rdzong lho sgo red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: stobs che ba glang chen smyon pa 'dra: dpal gur gyi mgon po'i bla bu la: nga sga bde mi chen ser bo yin: mthu drag sngags rgyu shi phaṭa 'gyel shes: chos zab mo rdzogs snying thig shes: don rang rig bla ma'i ngo sprod thob: rten reg bya'i sa mkhar mi dgos dang: mtho gnam gyi 'ju thag a phos chod: dma' sa gzhi'i rten phur rtsad nas rdzogs: yang bskal ba chags 'jig stong nus lags: lus 'di la lha yis byin rlabs thob: sku rgas med bkrag mdangs 'od du mtsher: ngag 'di la bsnyen sgrub tshad du smin: don gang brtsam 'phrin las rab 'byams 'grub: yid 'di la mi g.yo ting 'dzin brnyes:lam 'pho med kun bzang dgongs pa mnga': mgon gu ru'i zhal gzigs rgyun chad med: gling ge sar sku jus srung mi yin: gyang sa mkhar mthon po'i nang rol nas: dpa' rdzong la gcar nas 'dug mi tsho: wa khung la bcug nas dud pas gsod: 'dre brag la gcar nas dam la 'dogs:lug gad la bskor ba rkang nas 'dzin: khyod byang sdug rdzong la bkag nas 'joms: 'bru sga bde chos skyong ber nag ngas: dbus ri bo mchog rabs dpung gis 'phen: brag dmar yag sra yang mtheb kyis gtor: yul 'jig rten gna' mi'i gtam dpe la: sngags mthu ldan dgra yis brnyas na sdug: mthu ngan sngags me ru rang 'bar yin: srog dmar po hom khung kha 389

la 'khyar: gnyan gzhi bdagabyuphog thug btang na sdug: nad mi 'dod rkyen ngan rlung ltar 'tshub: lus 'byung bzhi'i khams la dengs dgos yod:dpe de bzhin rma khams gling ba la: khyod byang bas brnyas tshod ma zin na:mthar rdzong drug shor nas las dmag pham: dpa' rting ma nam lang skar ltar yal: sdug a thang mgo la chad nas yongs: mtha' gling thub ma red byang thub red: byang pha jus shor la rgyang mi ring: dpon khrag ral dbu rmog khrag la bsres: blon gyad chen phal khyer 'jig rten brjes: dpung las dmag zad nas mtha' la thug: dus de ring sga bde'i rting ma la: rno khab len sra ba'i sgo chen 'di: sgra di re 'brug stong grags pa bzhin: rdo gor mo gcig gis shugs la gtor: nang las dmag ma 'dug phyir la zur: srog dmar po rdo yi 'og la shor: dpa' rting ma zer na khag po red: go e byung mi min byang gi sde: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed byang dmag yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung nas brag rdo de shugs yod dgus 'phangs byung ba lcags sgo la phogs pa'i sgra dang bcas dud skug gi khrod du sgo gtor nas gling dmag ki sgra dang bcas nang la shor ba dang: gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang rdzong gi sgo yi dmag khrod du mchong nas g.yul 'khrug drag tu byas:dpa' lha mi spyang dkar pos kho yi gdong blangs nas glu zhig len bsam 390

yang khos glu len pa'i go skabs ma phyin nas gri bton zhing shi lceb byas byung bar gri 'gran mang du byas kyang dpa' mnyam pa byung: khos gri btab nas gling che rgyud kyi lha bu thog rgod gtsos dmag mi mang du 'jig rten phyi mar bskyal: der 'bru sras byang rong btsan pos mda' gcig thog dmar 'phangs ba ltar bsrings bas bdud phrug 'phong rgan gyad mi khrag 'thung dpa' bzang gi ming gi lhag ma 'jig rten dang kha bral bar byas pas gling ba rnams dga' spro dang bcas ki sgra bsgrags kyin rdzong nang du shor: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi nub sgo nas dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar dpon blon rnams go bkrag 'tshub se shor byung ba dang: glog dmar drag rgod ya med ngar chen gyis dran pa bskor log brgyab nas dpa' rogs mgo sprod cig ma lon na skye pho lus thob pa'i dga' rgyu med bsam nas tshur gdong la mchong zhing gzhu steng la mda' bzhag te yob snga sor rgyangs nas dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so: glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: lcags ral bdud btsan rkang 'jibs dang: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral sogs:gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sdang dgra zil gyis gnon par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas: pho brang sha ri'i nub phyogs red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal 391

po la: stobs la gyad chen che bzhi yod: dpa' la thog 'brug glog gsum nas: thog lha gshin rje nag po dang: 'brug rgod btsan lha dung thod gnyis: ma dbang gling sdug lag la shor: glog dmar drag rgod ya med nga:gling sdug rnams kyi gshed ma yin: bsad bsad byang thang ro yis gang:rdung rdung sdig pa'i na bun 'thibs: de nas tshur chas dkar po skya: mi dkar dpa' 'dod snang ba che: rta dkar rgyugs 'dod mgo 'phang mtho:khrab dkar sra 'dod go btsan can: yin nges mon gyi dung skyong 'dra:yin na bsam don 'grub lugs la: de ring rting ma nga la babs: dpa' rtags ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam: byang yul phyogs kyi mi g.yang ngas: rtsal drug brgya phrag lus la tshang: khrag ral dpon gyi mchan khebs yin: phyi sde mtha' nas 'tsho mi yin: nang sde'i skyid sdug lta mi yin: de yod nang gi de drag yin: mi rtsis rin chen gser las che: mi gshis dri med dar la dpe:rang bstod min de 'dra ma red: de ring nyi ma'i gdugs khang la: khyod la rten 'brel legs rgyu med: tshe sngon skye 'chi nag po'i lam: mi 'gyang steng la babs nyen che: kha chems yod na la mo zhog: lho mon mon gyi yul gru la: byang ba sang 'gro gnang 'gro yin: kha chems mi 'phrod ga la srid:rang rdzong nor dang mdzes ma la: ma chags ma zhen rigs kyi bu: gzhis kyi bdag po byang ba rnams: snying rje sha tsha gnyis ka ldan: sbrang mas bsags 392

pa'i sprang rtsi rnams: bsags pa gzhan gyis spyod pa bzhin: mon phrug bsags pa'i rgyu nor rnams: byang rgod dpung gis bdag 'dzin byed: da phrug yugs sa thams cad la: btsan gnon thub tshod ga la byed: rang rang tshod dang brtun pa yis: las g.yog zhabs phyi 'grub na chog: e go mon phrug kha ser lags: dpa' med jag la 'dur 'dur nas: tha ma rang srog 'phen la bzhag: gyod pa drag po mi skye 'am: de ring khyod dang nga rang gnyis: thod pa'i ri mo babs lugs la: glag nag gzan la ma bcum kyang: ri bong thang la lding nas byung: rgya stag sha la ma sred kyang:'do phrug 'gram la gcar nas byung: ri khyi khrag la ma 'khong kyang: g.yang dkar 'ba' sgra ldir nas byung: byang phrug rang sgar bzung na yang: gling sdug shi lceb byas nas byung: ri chu khrag gis kha mdog bsgyur: sha dmar rus dum phyogs bzhir gtor: gang dkar sems kyi gong kha la: spro ba'i tsha drod e rgyas lags: zur gsum snying gi rtse mo nas: dran pa so mar e 'dug lags: byang khog stod kyi gur khang nas: dbugs kyi rgyu ba e 'gag lags: kha bskyangs ngo shor phyi tshul la: ltas na dpa' bo zhe nas khrel: don med dgra yang snying rje 'khrungs: ngo la khrag thigs mi 'dug la:lus 'dar dar cog rlung dang 'dre: a bar rig la sha re tsha: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: mon phrug yid la de ltar 393

zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs nas mda' de 'ur chom gyi sgra dang bcas 'phangs ba dung skyong dpon gyis phub kyis bkag par thar se gtor kyang nang du ge sar gyi srung mdud yod pas mda' ma blangs: der dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar mi dkar lha nas chas 'dra: rta dkar gangs seng lding yag: 'phru dkar sprin dkar spungs 'dra: dkar gsal nyi 'od lam me:dung mdog 'od stong shigs se: lha tshangs pa dgra la khros pa ltar dung gzhu dkar po'i steng la mda' gser ltong ma zhig bzhag nas yin lugs dang dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: steng lha bzang shel gyi gdengs khang nas: lha tshangs pa dung gi thod gtsug can: sde lha dmag dkar po'i dpung dang bcas: dus de ring dung skyong glu sna drongs:sgos ge sar lha yi srung ma dang: shar yul lha rma rgyal sbom ra sogs: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: pho sdar ma rdzong la gab pa'i gnas: mkhar sha ri gnam rdzong nub sgo red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sde lho mon yul la grags pa che: mtho dung mkhar brtsegs dgu'i nang shed nas: dpa' dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar yin:mon dung skyong bu dang ri spyang gnyis: dgra lug chung bcom pa'i gshed ma 394

yin: khyod rdzi bu ma dga' sdug gyong red: mon dung skyong bu dang 'phar ba gnyis: ra tshe zad rnams kyi ltag bdud yin: khyod bdag po ma dga' sdug gyong red: mon dung skyong bu dang 'chi bdag gnyis: yul mi brgya gsod pa'i lag dmar yin: bza' tshe rogs ma dga' sdug gyong red:bden e bsam byang ba khyi yi bu: khyi rnga med mi yi gral 'tshang khyod: kha stong gtam che la lags len med: khyod mi zer rgyu zhig med pa la: tshig ngan pa'i don med zhe sha bcad: rdzun nag po'i rang mgo rang gis g.yog:srog dmar bo dung skyong dpon la sprad: kha bskyangs na bskyangs rgyu de na 'dug: ngo shor na shor ran thon nas gda': gtam kha chems bzhag na bzhag ran tshang: khyod bdud nag rang tshod ma zin nas: rje ge sar dpon la 'gran snang skyes: khong sku rje lha yi bla ma mchog: lho 'dzam gling skyid la 'dren mi red: ma 'gro drug sgrol ba'i ded dpon red: steng lha phrug sum cu'i gral ra nas: lha thos pa dga' bar bzhengs ba'i dus:dpal phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bka' lung dang: rje padma'i mi yul mgon du mngags: khams sku rgyal bod la 'khrungs ba'i dus: mthu rdzu 'phrul me rlung dmar nag 'tshub: sdang dgra khams 'dul ba'i gshed du bskos: lha gong ma'i lung bstan rgyun tu myur: yang bar ma gnyan gyi gdong grogs yod:sde 'og ma klu yis mel tshe zab: khyod bdud phrug ma rig 'khrul bas sgrib:395

gling ge sar rgyal la 'gran ya bzung: bya don med nyes pa 'tshab chen bsags: yul 'jig rten che dgu thugs khros nas: stod rgya gar yul gyi chos zor dang: yang ma mo'i rims nad drag po dang: sde gshin rje'i khrag gi zor la sogs: yul ban bon ngan sngags dmod zor gyis: bya mi 'dod sna tshogs mgo la yongs: yang sgos su g.yul gyi lte ba nas: mda' nyag phran snying khrag 'thung la dga':rno btab gcod sha dmar za la brel:mdung skya rengs tshil dang snum la dung: khyod gang dga' rang gi 'dems na chog: da de min dpa' 'gran ma nus na: mda' gzu mo gcig gi rtse la skyon: phyi go khrab slog rul thang la brdal: nang don snod khag bzhi bsgo la 'jog: lus sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor zhig ma thag: shi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mig la gzan: las srog chad sdig nyung skar ltar bkra: kho gshin rje'i me long gsal sgrib med: yang las kyi rgyu 'bras thigs ltar zhib: mthar rang byas rang la smin nges pas: khyod rigs drug dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las:thar zer ba'i skabs shig med na yang: ngas 'pho ba gshin po rjes 'dzin gyis: zhing dag pa'i lam du 'dren pa'i chog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed glog dmar yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' de thog dmar dgung nas 'phangs pa ltar me rlung 'tshub se bsrings byung ba glog dmar drag 396

rgod ya med kyi snying kar nag mtshams sa phogs nas chu srin dung gis ༄phigs pa bzhin srog dang bral zhing rnam shes shar mngon par dga' bar spar: gling dmag rnams kyis rang gi thad kyi dgra la 'thab kyin rdzong gi nang la shor byung: 397

stso le'u bcu bradun pa/ dpa' mos rtsal ldan grags pa bcom//sgyu ma mngon shas khro lus bsgral//seng chen rgyal pos byang rgyal btul//dgra lhas gyad mi gza' rgod phab//de'i skabs su byang sgo nas dpa' mo a stag klu mos 'jigs pa'i chas dang bcas dmag sngon la shar brgyag gis thon pa dang: mchan khebs sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub gnyis rlung nag 'tshub pa ltar phebs: sha ri'i byang sgo nas rtsal ldan grags pa thog rgod de tshur gdong la myur stabs kyis thon nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: gnam gyi srin po lcags ral can: 'bod pa'i dus la bang ma bul: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar mchog: rbad pa'i dgra la rting ma longs: sa gzhi'i sman mo rkang 'jibs ma: mthu stobs nus pa ma zhan cig: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral can: dpa' rgod bu la gdong grogs mdzod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi 398

min bdud kyi sa cha nas: pho brang sha ri'i byang phyogs red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rtsal ldan grags pa thog rgod yin: rtsal chen bu la nga 'dra med: rlung nag rgyu ba sked nas 'dzin: sprin dkar g.yo ba mtheb kyis gtor: chu bo 'khyil ba spar gyis bkag: mgo la gyon pa'i rmog dkar 'di: thog thub bkrag mdangs rang shar zer: rgyab la gyon pa'i khrab chen 'di: sra bstan thig le rang gsal zer: g.yas la btags pa'i gzig shubs nang: khrag 'thung mda' mo drug cu'i bkang: g.yon la btags pa'i stag ral nang: gzhu mo 'brug sgra 'bum yag bcug: mdung mo spu gri reg gcod la: mdung dar sprin dkar dgung la bstod: ral gri ngo dmar btab chod la: dpa' lung chu dar sna lnga mjes: phub mo dom nag khros yag la: 'dzin byed sgyu ma'i 'chang lung bstar: 'do ba gzig mo dgu 'dur la:sga stan 'ja' tshon shar ba 'dra: gzhan pa'i mi dang mi 'dra la:'gran na ltad mo mig la 'jog: de nas tshur chas bu mo khyod: dme mo gdong dmar su 'dra yin: pho shi yugs sa gang nas bud: sdug gi a thang gang nas chad: mi dar dgu dar mtshar lugs la: dme mo gdong dmar sdang sems can: sha za 'dre mo mngon rgyugs te: 'gong bo kun gyi sna 'dren ma: de ring tshur chas ma bzang thal: nga yi snying rje shes ma myong:rig rig gsod la bzhengs ba 'dra: mi sha dmar bo za mi yin: mi khrag 399

skoms su 'thung mi yin: khyad par dme mo tshe zad ma: bza' tshang sdug la sbyar sbyar nas: mug snang a sngon dgung las mtho: mi dran las kyi mtha' ma la: srog dmar dmag gi g.yul la phul: gling sdug mi zad thug lugs la: a kyang nyam nga yi re mug: ge sar zer ba'i 'phong rgan kho: sdang dgra byung na rdzong la gab: ma mthong kha yi rgyang grags te: don la wa mo sna nag red: dpa' rtul zer ba'i pho rgod tsho: 'bum dmag khrod nas mug srog gab: gdong 'bud dme mo skya gcig la: dpa' med mchan khebs sdar ma gnyis: me 'bud chu len su 'dra yin: dang po 'dre mo dmar nag khyod:dmar gsod lung ba khrag la bsgyur: de nas sdar ma khyi phrug gnyis: ma shi dmyal ba'i gnas la 'phen: ma thub mi min byang gi dpa': mi bden khyi yi ske la 'dog: sdug khyod sdar mas brnyas brnyas las: dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 'grim pa dga': 'chi ba dbugs thogs kun la srid: kun la ma bsgos thun mong red: mi shes rgyu de gang na yod: da rung de yi ga la tshad:kha ba'i brgyan pa'i gangs dkar la: seng chung g.yu ral rang rgyas yin:kha rgya che ba'i gtsang chab la: gser mig 'khyugs gshog rang 'dzoms yin: las dbang ldan pa'i byang ba la: dpa' rtsal rting ma rang thob yin:thob kyis bskyangs ba'i dpa' bo tsho: rgyal srid g.yul la mkho gal yod:gal chen dus la rting ma longs: chas kyis gsos pas 'do ba rta: byang 400

lam gcod dus mkho gal yod: mkho ba'i go de chod pa gal: rtsal ldan grags pa thog rgod ngas: mda' gcig sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: gzhu mo dpung gis thengs gcig 'gugs: yar mchog sha rwa dkar po yin: sha pho'i rwa rtsis gtam na che: mar mchog 'brong rwa smug po yin: 'brong rwa 'di la brjid rngams cheoḥ 'chang bzung gnam lcags ngar las grub: gzhu rgyun sra ba'i rno skud slas: yar mchog mgo nas pho 'brug grags: mar mchog mgo nas mo 'brug grags: 'chang bzung nang nas glog dmar 'khyugs: mda' mo'i rtse nas me stag 'phro: ltong kha'i nang nas zi ra 'tshub: dme mo gyod kyi sna 'dren khyod: gzugs mdzes khyi lud dar gyis btum: go btsan bzung yang phan pa med: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go ba la yang len med: dme mo'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: mda' sing sgra dang bcas 'phangs ba rtswa ku sha'i a stag klu mos phub kyis bkag pas ma gnod: de nas sha za mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'phrul: 'bum phrag yangs ba'i gral 'dzin: khros na bdud kyi gshed ma: ma khros snying gi mun sel ma de nyid kyis gzhu steng la mda' khra sgro ma zhig bzhag nas yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnas dur khrod so sos yul gru nas: dpal ki li ki le 'od zer can: lha khros ma nag mo 401

la sogs pa: ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bod: ngas mgon skyabs gdong grogs ma g.yel cig: byin rlabs chen dngos grub stsal du gsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho sha ri gnam rdzong phyug mo'i 'dab: byang lcags ri ra ba'i zur zhig red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:yul chen po byang ma ri brgyad grags: mkhar mthon po lcags ra rtse dgu nas: bdud klu btsan dpon gyi sde bdag la: nga dpa' mo a stag klu mo bskos: pho khyod 'dra'i brnyas bzhag byed sa min: nga de sngon nyi ma yan chad la: dpa' zer na khyod kyi rgod la thug: gtam de 'dra nyog bshad mi dar lags: stobs 'gran ya thog dmar glog zhags red: ngas yan por ma mngag srog dang bral: nga de min dpa' mo ci la thogs: byang rtsal ldan ming can khyi phrug khyod: sdug skyag lang ngan pa gang nas shor: dpa' rting ma blangs ba ma thos lags: ngas lag sdig bas kyang mi 'dug ste: khyod mi gsod tshe thar gtong mi rung: gtam skad cha ngan pas zhe sha bcad: don de lan mi 'phrod bzhag thabs med: byang bdud dpon a stag klu mo ngas:dgra ma thub zer na snying re na: mthu ma ngoms zer na zhe re khrel: gtam ma shod zer na tshig pa za: dgra su thug gson la mngag ma myong: nga dpa' mo ma rgod ci la zer: ya de nas rtsal ldan srin gdong khyod: gtam thos pa med pa'i glang rgan 'dra: don rtogs pa med pa'i dud 'gro 'dra: sgom lta 402

ba med pa'i sngags rgan des: kha stong lab rdzogs pa chen po zer: don gnas lugs phyogs na tshig gcig med: sdom dam tshig med pa'i ban 'khyar des: rang la rgya'i kha pho che rabs zer: don rnam dag bya ba gcig mi byed: khrel ngo tsha med pa'i bu mo des: yul 'jig rten mthong rgya che rabs zer: bya gal chen ma shes rgyal khams dkrugs: blo bkod pa zhan pa'i byang blun des: kha stong gtam dpa' rtsal rgod rabs zer: yul rting ma ma lon pha jus shor: gtam tshig sgo mtho ba'i phan pa ci: don snying bo bshad na de 'dra red: khyod dpa' snying med par 'dar ra ra: glu ngag 'gugs mi bde ngu ba 'dra: go btsan po ma zin lhung la khad: sdug khyod 'dra dmag la chas pa ste: sde mi min byang gi jus btsong dngos: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po kho: sde mug shi red dam lceb shi red: shi song na dga' thog dga' bzhag red:byang sdug shi jag shi'i mtshams te chad:nged gling dmag rting ma rang la thob: dpa' g.yul 'thab mi dgos dngul gyi rdzong: bcud byin chen lam mer thob pa 'dra: re e bsam byang gi rtsal ldan ming: ming stong ba zhig gi ci zhig byed: dpa' rting ma mi lon gting thag chod: snying tshims po e byung byang gi blon: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod rtsal ldan yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: mda' 'phangs ba rtsal ldan grags pa 403

thog rgod kyi ya thod dpral ba'i gzhi mdo la phogs nas mun nag phyi ma'i lam la bskyal: gling dmag gis ki sgra sod rgyob dang bcas shor nas byung ba dang: rtsal ldan sgyu ma mngon shes kyis go gyon mtshon thogs dus gcig la byas te tshur mda' rgyang gi sngon la thon nas gzhu steng la mda' dgu bzhag nas yin lugs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la redoḥ mchod gcig nam mkha' sngon mo nas: srin po lcags ral mthu rtsal can: srin dmag bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas: de ring dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: mchod gcig bar snang yangs ba nas: bar gyi bdud btsan me 'bar mchog:bdud dmag stong gi 'khor gyis bskor: bskul pa'i las la myur du bzhengs: mchod gcig sa gzhi'i g.yang ra nas: sman mo rkang 'jibs nag phyogs lha: 'gong bo 'phrog ma'i tshogs dang bcasoḥ mos pa ji bzhin 'grub par shog: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral can: dpa' rgod bu la spyan gyis gzigs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min bdud kyi sa cha nas: pho brang sha ri'i byang phyogs red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sgyu ma 'phrul la rang dbang mnga': mthu dang nus pa'i bdag po la: rtsal ldan sgyu ma mngon shes yin: de nas khra mo gling gi dmag: yang sgos sngon ma gdong dmar ma: a stag klu mo ma yin nam: de ring sdar mas lag snga nas: rtsal 404

ldan srin gdong stag dmar de: 'bum dmag dgu yi 'dems ya yin: ma dbang mun pa'i rmag la shor: sha lan sha dang khrag lan khrag: yang lan dgu bskor ma lon na: rtsal ldan shi dang khyad par med: ngan lob dme mo gdong dmar ma: sdug khyod brnyas pa khur 'dod med: gling sdug wa mos tshod med 'di: mchin pa steng 'og brje dgos byung: 'khyar bo gling gi sdar ma tsho: ngan lob kha pho che don ci: hor gling gong ba rtsod pa'i dus:rgya tsha zer ba'i g.yer grags can: khra ring mdung gi rtse la bskyon: rong tsha zer ba'i dpa' shom can: hor phrug mang pos rtsed byad byas: 'brug mo zer ba'i rgyang grags can: thag nag sha le hor gyis khrid: ge sar nag po dung la gab: dpa' rtul tsha dang tshong la bros: dgra lan ma 'phrod pham par nges: da rung kha pho a bar rig: da lo byang gi yul gling la: gling dmag ro lang gang nas brgyab: de ring rting ma nga la babs: na chung dpa' 'dod gdong dmar ma: pho re rig na pho re brjed: kha dgu 'khor ba'i dred ma khyod: bzang bshad spu tsam yod bsam med: don med bla tsags skad cha dang: khrel med byi 'bod g.yo zol sogs: ngan ma'i las la mkhas na yang: jag chen g.yul la 'gro rabs med: nyag phran mda' yi rgyang lam nas: dpa' med na chung snying re rje: gsol 'debs lha 'bod klu 'bod kyis: sdug bshad ngu 'bod ri lung bkongs: mgo 'bul 405

lus 'bul la mo gyis: dred ma chung mar mi 'os kyang: thengs re lan re brtsis na chog: bed spyod rtsed byad tsam zhig las: 'jig rten snang ba mthun lugs med: spyod pa gtsang bas byang ba dang: dme mo gyod kyi snye mo gnyis: las dbang gcig du gang nas srid: 'on kyang tshe thar btang na chog: ci dga' bsam blo zhib tu thongs: 'thad na mug ngo 'dzum 'dzum gyis: mi 'thad zer ba gna' bo'i gtam: rang srog mi gces su zhig yod: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang med med: dme mo'i yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: mda' re re bzhin 'phangs bas dmag mi 'ga' bsad: a stag ma la mda' ma song: dpa' mos khrel rgod dang bcas mda' zhig bsrings pa kho'i go ma thags: ral 'gran cung zad byas: der gling gi dmag thams cad sgo bzhi nas nang la lud de g.yul 'thab drag tu byas rjes dmag mang che ba zhig gis mgo 'bul lus 'bul byas nas srog thar: gling gi dpa' bo rnams kyis mda' mo bu yug 'tshub 'tshub: mdung mo skar mda' chad chad: ral gri glog 'od 'khyugs 'khyugs: sod rgyob 'brug stong grags grags kyi ngang nas byang ba rnams pham pa grangs kyis mi long ngo: stag rong dpon po khro rgyal dang: spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan: gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag: gser shog ka la 406

khri bstan: sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub rnams kyi gdong la rtsal ldan sgyu ma mngon shes thon pa dang: stag rong dpon gyis rmog gi 'dab ra phab: khrab kyi rgyun thag bsdams: 'do ba'i glo len 'then zhing 'jigs pa'i tshul drag tu mdzad nas glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: mgon sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: yang bon sras bla ma'i tshogs dang bcas: dus de ring ngar rgod glu sna drongs: sdang dgra bo chom la 'bebs par mdzod:dpal yi dam padma dbang gi lha: khong khro bo rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas:dus de ring a phos glu sna drongs: kho ma rung bdud dgra rtsad nas 'joms:ma mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus dang: dpal seng gdong ma tshogs 'khor dang bcas: dus de ring khro bo'i glu sna drongs: dpa' rting ma dgung la grags par shog: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho sha ri gnam rdzong phyug mo'i 'dab: byang sgo them dmag gis gtor sa red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: sa btsan po rdza ma yar 'gag nas: rdzong btsan po pho rog snying rdzong yod: dpon yang btsan 'gran med khu bo nga: dpa' stag btsan stag rong khro thung yin: glu 'di yi glu ngo ma shes na: dpon stag rong stag mo'i ngar glu zer: thob chung chung ma yin ldong gi rgyud: ldong rgyal rgyud 407

nam mkha'i mtha' thigs yin: mi gnyom chung ma yin btsan po'i rigs:mthu ngan sngags gnyis kyi bdag po yin: sngags bzlas na gnam sa 'khor lo bskor: mthu mngags na brag la me ru 'bar: gnad sgom na mkha' la skyil krung bca': rtags bstan na nyi ma thag pas 'dzin: stobs nga las che ba su zhig yod: dpung nga las gnyan pa su zhig mchis: gling ge sar khri gdugs nyi ma la: dpon stag rong dung gi zla ba tshes: sde 'bum dmag skar tshogs mtha' nas bkrag: ya de nas byang blon tshur la gson: khyod de ring thar ba ga la thob: nga sngags nag stag rong khro rgyal gyis: sems bsam nag dgra bo shor ma myong: sde bdud nag yongs kyi gshed ma 'dra:khyi dom nag 'dra ba'i byang ba rnams: go lcags nag zer yang sgyu ma'i rdzas:mthu ngan sngags sngon na phan pa chung: lus bem nag srog dang bral bar nges: dpe bzhag na 'jig rten zer tshul la: ban chos med mug kha bdag med des: rdzun dad log gtam la sbyang sbyang nas: khyim yon bdag blo kha bsgyur ba mang: dpon khrel med ngo 'dzum g.yo rgyu des: 'bangs ru sde sdug la sbyar sbyar nas: khrims bzang po'i kha mdog nogs pa mang:sman mdo med blo thung skra ring mas: kha sdug gtam ngu khul bgod khul gyis:bza' 'grig mo'i bar la gtor brlag mang: gtam zer ba'i dpe la bsam blo thongs: pho dpa' med byang ba mi min sdes: shar rma khams gling 408

la 'gran 'gran nas: dus mtha' ma dpon med sde med bzos: rdzong mkhar rdzong mthon po rtse nas gtor: pho rgod 'dod thams cad srog dang bral: rta kho rgyugs zer tshad nom la len: sman de yag zer tshad grogs la 'gugs: dus de ring byung ba'i khyi phrug khyod: nga stag mo'i sngon nas dpa' rgyu med: sngags mthu chen rgas kyang brnyas rgyu med: mthu ngan sngags gza' rgod mngon rgyugs yin: nga dpa' bo rgas kyang brnyas rgyu med:dpa' snying khams dmar yag stag mo bzhin: rta 'do chen rgas kyang brnyas rgyu med: bang bsil ma rlung dang ci mi 'dra: nga lo gzhon dbang po dar ba'i dus: srin khe tshe ru lu zer ba de: dpa' che ba gling bzhi yongs la grags: stobs 'jig rten khams na 'gran med zer: kho'i skra nas lag pa g.yas pas bzung: mtho bar snang khams la lan gsum bskor: ngas lag g.yon khu tshur gcig gis bsad: yul 'jig rten khams la grags pa rgyas: dpa' khro rgyal zer na de 'dra yin: sku seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi: dpal gdul bya rgya mtsho'i pho nya yin: pho byas pa che ba'i mi zhig yin:rta sa mtha' chod pa'i g.yang zhig yin: bden e bsam byang ba mi min sde:don dngos gnas thag de chod ran yin: lta bsam na ltad mo gzigs pas chog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med:khyod byang dmag yid la de ltar zhog:409

ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du mda' bsrings bas rtsal ldan sgyu ma mngon shes kyi snying kar thebs nas 'chi ba mngon du gyur to: gling dmag rnams the tshom med par rdzong la shor: der pho brang gi rab gsal nas rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis bya ba thams cad mthong yang rgyal po la mun nag gi ril ba'i dug phogs pa zab rkyen dga' sdug chags sdang ci shar med kyang ci bsam 'di bsam med par dpa' chas mtshon btags dug tsher rgyas 'dra zhig byas te mig rtsa dmar lhog lhog: gdong nag rog ge:dran pa bskor log brgyab nas g.yul du chas par brtsams pa dang: der rtsal ldan ri bo dpung 'phen gyis rdo pha bong mang du 'phangs nas gling la dmag nyes bzos: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas thog khang gi sgo srung nas mda' dung ba bkang po zad: slar yang gri g.yug nas gling ba mang du bcomoḥ der lho yi thog tshoms nas mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po 'khor bcas mar babs nas rta la bcibs shing gling dmag gi nang du shor te dmag 'phru sna tshogs khrag la bsres byung ba dang: sga bde mi chen ser bo: gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po:'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod: dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal po: a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur bcas kho'i gdong la gcar nas mda' mtshon mang du phul ba stong log tu gyur: der 'dzam 410

gling ge sar rgyal po de nyid chos nyid don gyi brda rtags thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i bkod pa dang bcas 'do chen rkyang dmar 'phur shes la gser sga g.yu mthur dngul srab sogs ma tshang ba med pa zhig byas pa la bcibs pa de nyid 'ja' 'od lnga 'khyil gyi klong nas phebs pa ni: lta ba'i yid dbang 'phrog pa: sgom pas phu thag chod pa: bsam pas gting mtha' bral ba: bdud 'dul las kyi rje bo: mtshungs med dbang gi rgyal po: rdzu 'phrul glog gi zhags pa sku mngon sum du phebs par byang mi min bdud kyi rje bo des mthong nas dpa' de byas kyi rting thag chod pas dpa' gdeng dang bcas gza' khyab 'jug nag po dgra la khros pa ltar tshur gdong la gcar zhing lcags gzhu srin po'i 'phrul brdung gi steng la lcags mda' dgra sha dmar zan de bzhag nas yin lugs kyi dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: spyi bo gtad sa srin gyi rje: srog bdag srin po lcags ral can: dgongs pa dbyings la ma g.yel bar: de ring dpa' bo'i gdong grogs mdzodoḥ mgrin pa ngag gi gzhal yas nas: bdud btsan me 'bar khros pa rtsal: ma 'gyang dgos gal 'bod rbad tsheoḥ rgyal po'i jus dang srid la gzigs: snying nas dad pa'i lha yi mchog: sman mo rkang 'jibs mthu rtsal can: 'gong bo 'phrog 411

ma'i tshogs dang bcas: byang rgyal dpung gi skyor ma mdzod: rdzong bdag ri bo brag ral can: dus babs las don ma brjed la: mi min byang gi rgyal po yi: 'phrin las 'grub par spyan gyis gzigs: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na:mi min byang gi rgyal sa de: pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal: pha ni bdud po khrag mig dang:ma ni mi min 'gong po'i rgyud: ral ba'i nang nas me stag 'phro: smin ma'i nang nas thog char 'bebs: lus la khyung gshog thus phran rgyas: gnam la 'phur na rang dbang mnga': chu la 'dzul na dung gshog 'dzoms: 'byung ba'i khams la mnga' dbang thob: gnam sa rub kyang 'gran ya med: de nas rma khams gling gi rje: 'gag mo'i jo ru kha ser khyod: tshe sngon las kyi dgra ru lang: khyod shi nga gson g.yul 'thab 'di: rtsa ba bshad na khyod la thug: mi min byang gi yul gru la: mthu sngags dmod zor drag po 'phangs:don med mi sha nag po slang: da rung las dmag byang la phab: brnyas bzhag de las ci zhig che: de ring khyod dang nga rang gnyis: mang po'i nang gi don chen yin: stong gi nang gi mdo rtsa red: gri so'i steng gi nang 'bru dang: rgyal pham las kyi mtha' la thug: mi min byang gi rgyal po ngas: don med mi sha bsgo ma myong: tshur 'geb brnyas bzhag tshod med la: mi thub bzod pa ga la sgom: 'do ba rta yi khyu gral na: gyi lang sngon mo gcig las 412

med: g.yag rog nag po'i slas ra na: 'brong tsha kwa ba gcig las med:skyes pa pho yi dpung gral na: yang dag rgod po gcig las med: de ring shan te 'byed la yongs: stag ral 'bar ba'i nang rol nas: lcags gzhu srin po dpung bsdar 'di: mi bzhag 'don pas dus la babs: gzig shubs khra mo'i nang rdzong nas: lcags mda' dgra sha dmar zan kho: khas len lteng la bud nas byung: rting ma zer na gleng rgyu zhig: snying nad nag po'i rtsa ba zhi: gyad mi stong bdud mig gcig gtsos: dpa' rgod mang po'i sha lan dang: thog lha gshin rje'i yang lan dang: 'bum dmag dpung gi khrag lan rnams: dus gcig ma lon thabs dang bral: yang na rgyal po shi bas rtags: mi min byang gi srung ma rnams: yod na de ring dus la babs: nyag phran mda' kha 'tsho rogs kyis: rgyu 'bras gnam gyi gzigs rogs mdzod: kho re gling sdug 'gag mo'i bu: go btsan yod na bzung ran gda': nyag phran thog gi ngar lam na: 'dus bya'i gzugs snang mi lam 'dra: stong gtam skad cha bshad don med: lag len dpa' bo'i ngo so yin: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: 'gag phrug yid la de ltar zhog:ces zer zhing mda' glog dmar 'tshub se 'phangs mod nam mkha' stong ba nas mda' thon khom ma byung bar me la bsregs song: khos yang 413

skyar mda' gcig 'phangs ba sa khug gcig tu thung nas lhung: der mi dbang ge sar rgyal po: lha yi yang lha dkar po: mgon gyi yang mgon dam pa: mtshungs med rgyal kun bdag nyid des gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil ba'i yang steng du lha mda' log pa kun 'dul bzhag nas byang mi min gyi dgra mtha' gcod pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so: glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnas rang byung lho nub dpal ri nas: mgon grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan padma 'byung: sku mdzes sdug nyi ma 'bum phrag 'byed: byin 'thib se 'gro ba'i don la gzigs: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: gnas dur khrod me ru 'bar ba nas: dpal khro bo'i rgyal po gtum chen drag: yul gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod: phyogs bdud kyi bstan pa dung la snubs:gnas rnyu ma tha la'i grong khyer nas: rje 'bum phrag gtso mo mtsho rgyal ma:yid dad pa'i gsol ba snying nas 'debs: mchog thun mong dngos grub char du snyil: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul yin:mgon shāka thub bstan pa skyong mi yin: ma 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel mi yin:bod dbu nag las don byed mi yin: mi khyod kyi bshad pa shin tu bden:shar rma khams gling gi yul gru la: don med par dmag rgod phab pa bden:414

gyod mi sha dmar po bzos pa'i rjes: nged gling dmag mi yongs ka med byung: dpa' g.yul 'thab gnam nag lang ba 'dra: byang las dmag ram pa ser bas bcom: mthar sdug thug gtam gyi 'dra ma la: 'bag phar g.yar 'jigs ra tshur la bstan: sdug rang skyon gzhan gyi mgo la bkal:dpe mi dar sa la dar cog btsugs: ri lam med sgang la skya lam bzos:nyams dpyad na gad mo steng nas shor:bya sdug thug min na ci zhig yin:dus da lo mi min byang gi rje: dpon khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po khyod:las dbang thang rdzogs pa mthong nas byung: blo shes gsal nam mkha' lang 'dra de: dus da lo mun pa 'thib nas 'dug: dpa' ngar rgod rgyal stag ngar ma de: dus da lo wa mo gad 'dzu 'dra: stobs mnga' thang mtha' med rgya mtsho de: dus da lo 'chag rom dar gyis bzung: dpa' gyad chen rtsal ldan dpung dang bcas: dus da lo sdar ma go gyon 'dra: dpa' rting ma med pa u mthong lags: gling ge sar stobs bcu'i bdag nyid nga:khyod da shog mi dgos thon nas yod: glu stong gtam cha 'jog med nas thal: don lag len ma zhog a bar rig: mda' de 'dra 'phen pa ngo re tsha: ma na chung bu mo'i lag rdo gzu: khyod mgo bsgur lus 'bul mi bzang ngam: sman tshe 'dzin lha mos re ba red: srog mi shor bya ba bzang bo 'byung: sde byang gling sngar bde da skyid byed: da de min g.yul 'thab byed 415

zer na: khyod khrag ral khrag gi nang la sbag: mda' nyag phrag thog dmar dpung du sdeb: yul 'jig rten khams na 'gran mkhan su: kha stong gtam blun po'i 'ol tshol min: don lag len gnam lcags ral gri yin: bden bsam mam byang ba bdud kyi rgyal: go btsan po yod na la mo bzung: 'dre 'gong bo yod na grogs la bos: lha srin po yod na gsol ba thob: gtam kha chems yod na bzhag pa'i chog: sde byang ba rnams la bsgrags nges yin:glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod byang rgyal yid la de ltar zhog:ces gsung nas mda' de 'phangs ba lha klu gnyan gyis 'tshos shing sgra 'brug stong dus gcig la grags pa ltar me rlung 'tshub se: sde mi min khrag ral khyung gshog rgyal po'i snying kar nag mtshams su phogs nas shing su ru la me sbar ba bzhin bem bo me yis gzhob: rnam shes bde ba can la btsan thabs kyis spar nas sdig pa'i rgyun chad par gda': sa ma ya: der gling ba rnams kyis lhag par ki bswo bsgrags: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pas rgyal po shor ba mthong nas snying la tsher ma zug pa ltar shi lceb kyis 'thab pa dang: gling dmag gi khrod nas 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod dang:seng stag dam pa rab rgyas: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod: 'bum pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal: seng a dom mi yi spyang khu: sga bde chos skyong ber nag rnams kyis 416

byang ri khyis sha ba rub rub byas nas mda' mtshon ci dga' la blo dris pa dang: khos dpa' ngo ma lon nas rdzong dkyil nas rlung bud pa ltar phyir thon zhing sde khyung bo'i yul la gtad nas bya 'phur ba ltar bros: der yul lha rma chen sbom ra rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la bcibs nas bdud blon kho'i gdong bkag pa dang: khos mi 'di ge sar gyi sprul ba 'dra yin na ma gtogs gzhan mi ngo ma zhig gtan nas mi 'dra: da bros kyang thar ba mi 'dug pas shi rogs mgo sprod cig e lon lta bsam nas glu zhig len par brtsams yang dpa' rtul rnams kyis rjes chod pas len khom ma byung zhing ral gri lan 'ga' g.yug pas kho yi dbang thang rdzogs shing da res kyi mi dkar rta dkar can te mi snang bar gyur: 'dan mas mda' gcig 'phangs bas kho yi bdud rta de'i gdong lcags gtor zhing mda' sgros bar la zug nas bsad: gyad mi kho rkang thang la ral gri klad la bskor nas phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs byed pa dang: dpa' 'bum pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal gyis rno ya zi skar phran shubs nas byangs shing yin lugs dpa' gtam gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la rngo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: bla ma padma 'byung gnas mkhyen: rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: de ring dgra lha'i glu sna drongs: ma rung bdud kyi bla srog chod: rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu 417

dang: bod kyi bka' gter rig 'dzin bcas: ma g.yel dpa' bo'i grogs la byon: sdang dgra 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: sdar ma'i wa lam skya mo red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rma ri bzhi yi 'dus mdo nas: pho brang dngul chu khro rdzong nas: rgya tsha dpon gyi gdong rgyud la: 'bum pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal yin: 'bum dmag dug mtsho rgyas 'dra nas: ser rgod dpa' rtul pho gzhon rnams: mi la bkrag mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rta la rlung rtsal bang kha rgyas: bu rta btsan gyi sde ba nas:'bum pa'i dung zla dgra yi gshed: rmog dkar steng gi dar 'phru yin:khrab dkar steng gi tshe mdud yin: 'do ba brgyan pa'i sga srab yin: stag ral 'dzum chen rdab sha yin: gzig shubs khra mo'i thig le yin: ba dan mdung gi dar chen yin: bum tog mkhar gyi gser 'phru yin: mun pa gsal ba'i sgron me yin: pho brgya'i nang gi dpa' bo yin: rta brgya'i nang gi gyi lang yin: ge sar dpon gyi sku tsha yin: dpa' rtul brgyad cu'i gtso bo yin: skar tshogs nang gi dung zla yin: gcan gzan nang gi seng ge yin: ma thub dgra yi kha gnon yin: ma nus gnyen gyi pha ma yin: 'do ba khyung gshog sngon mo yin: ded na rlung nag bang gis zin: lag la bzung bas ral gri 'di: pha ral ya zi skar phran yin: btab na lcags nag pha bong rdum: de ring gyad mi khyod la g.yug: sha dmar bya khyi'i gzan la 418

'phen: khrag dmar sa yi hub la 'dren: go khrab ro shun shul du lus: a bar rig la snying re rje: srog 'phang de yi che lugs la: bros bros brgya la ma ri mo bzos: gzar mo'i brag la gab sa btsal: dma' mo'i chu la lceb shom byas: bde mo'i thang nas byi khung snyegs: dgra yang snying rje skyes nas byung:bdud nag dngos la mi the na:mi gsod tshe thar btang bas chog:'on kyang byed thabs zad nas byung: mi min khrag ral man chad nas: rta rdzi thab g.yog yan chad rnams: bsad bsad zad mtha' rig nas thal:gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa khyod: dgra lhas ya zi'i ngar la shor: phyi yi yan lag nying lag dang: nang gi don lnga snod drug rnams: so so phyogs bzhir gtor ba zhig: ma thub bzhag na dgra lha min: dgra gnyen g.yul gyi bskos thengs la: gling dmag dpung gi dug klong na: gyad mi gza' rgod grags pa khyodoḥ ma grags rkang thang nyam re nga: dpung rgod mda' 'ben bzhag na chog: rtsed mo thengs gcig mthong na yang: mi gcig thub thub mi byed lags: ral gri ngar mas so 'og nas: na tsha sdug bsngal shes pa min: dngangs skrag 'jigs snang skyes khom med: thebs pa shi ba dus mnyam yin: tshe dus 'chi ba nag po la: skyid po lar nas mi srid mod: gri 'og 'di ru mi skyid ci: e bden ltad mo thengs gcig ltos: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la:ma go glu la yang len med: gyad mi'i yid la de ltar zhogoḥ419
ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du ral gri klad la bskor zhing btab thengs gcig gis lus bem po sa la rdzogs nas rnam shes gzugs dang bral bar byas te phyir phebs so: 420

le'u bco brgyad pa/rgyal sras ming sring 'khor bcas bzung //sngon smon dag pa sad par byas//lha yi lung bzhin dngul rdzong gi/g.yang sgo 'byed pa'i las la gzhol//der dpa' bzang shan pa rgyal po dang: dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar:sog blon khe tshe 'brug rgyal: bdud blon ga dar phying sngon: a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo: lcags mo'i 'brug lha thog 'gyur: sog blon stobs chen stag dmar: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub: a drag nyi ma grags pa: stag gzig zhal dkar ldem pa: rong sras lha rgod 'bum lu: stag rong dpon po khro thung rnams kyis byang rdzong phu dkrugs mdo dkrugs byas: rtsal ldan ri bo dpung 'phen gyis mda' 'phangs nas gling dmag mang po dgrong: byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub kyis kho mda' la drangs: de'i skabs su mi min byang gi rgyal sras gnyis kyis re re bzhin go bkrag mtshon thogs byas te ral gri bton nas the tshom med par mchong byung ba dang: thog mar sras chung zla gsal 'bum lu des gri bton zhing dpa' glu 'di ltar blangs so:421

glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: sde rang yul mchod pa'i srung ma rnams: dus de ring gang la g.yeng nas yod: nged byang gi skyid sdug e gzigs lags: gzigs srid na mthu stobs nus pa ston: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: yul mi min byang gi rgyal sa de: mtho pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi: brtsegs bar khang nub kyi tshoms chen red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: drin khri gdugs shor ba'i sdug rgan nga: dgung phyi dro'i nyi nub mtshams sprin yin: dpon yab chen shor ba'i rgyal sras nga:chung dwa phrug zla gsal 'bum lu yin: ya de nas gling sdug sdar ma tsho:dpung 'bum dmag dug rlangs nag po'i nang: kho phung rgan jo ru e yod lags: yod zer na ma 'dug gdong la gcor: pho su rgod thengs gcig 'gran dgos yod: dpa' snying khams rting ma rtsod na bsam: sha lan la sha dmar kham gang dang: khrag lan la snying khrag hub gsum 'thung: lus 'doms gang rin thang che na yang: rno mda' mtshon ngar la ma drangs na:ngas pha jus mi bskur kho thag yin: a la la mtshar gyi che ba la: sde mi min byang gi sa cha ru: dgra nag pos tshur 'gebs gdug rtsub che: mi bsad pa'i sha yi ri bo grub: rta bsad pa'i khrag gi yur chu drangs: pho gang rgod bsad pa'i mtha' ma la: jus bzang bo'i bkod pa 'thor na yang: dpa' g.yul 'thab srog la sbom phra med: ya de nas gling ba dpung gi sde: nga'i 422

'gram gyi pho rgod gzi byin can: dpa' phu bo rin chen dpal bzang red:nged spun gnyis bsad na bsad rin yod: sde byang ba dpon gyi gdong rgyud yin: de min na rting ma dgung la bstod: byang dpa' phrug zer nas grags le byed: pho su rgod ma 'dug gdong la bud: dpe 'jig rten mi yi zer tshur la: dgra jag pa de la brgya yod kyang: sgos jag dpon de la gcig las med: dpa' jag dpon thub na thub ni yin: da de min jag phrug bsad nas ci: nad gdon 'dre de la brgya yod kyang: don nad bdag de la gcig las med: de thub na nad gzhi rang nas grol: da de min bse rag thub nas ci: gtam zer ba bzhin du bden lugs yod:byang pho brgya'i mig gi lta sa yin: yang mo brgya'i yid smon byed sa yin: kha zas zhim mchod pa phul sa yin: lag gtsang mas thal mo sbyar sa yin:yid dad pa'i blo rtse gtad sa yin: rdzong phyi nang nom gyi bdag po yin:dpon khrag ral rgyal po thub na yang: dpa' nged gnyis ma thub don med yin: dpa' yang dag rting ma su che lta: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling dmag yid la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang mnyam du ral gri bton nas dpa' the tshom med par mchong byung ba dang: ge sar rin po ches rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' nas dar kha dog sna lnga rlung gis bskyod kyin thon te rgyal sras gnyis 423

kyi lag pa dpung rtsa nas bsdams shing mgul mi thub par gyur nas bzung:der shul lus mi min gyi rgyal mo dpon g.yog sogs las dmag mang po bzung zhing pho brang sha ri gnam rdzong gi rtse la g.yul las rgyal ba'i dar ser bo rdo rje'i mtshan pa zhig skye med nam mkha'i dbyings su dal gyis bskyod do:der mi min rgyal po'i dkor mdzod thams cad kyi kha phyes pas gser mdzod nyi ma shar 'dra: dngul mdzod zla ba tshes 'dra: dung mdzod skar tshogs bkrag 'dra: gos 'phrug ther ma bal gdan sogs 'jig rten sgyu ma'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa zhig 'dug go:dbyings rig mi 'gyur don dam chos kyi sku: rang gsal lhun 'grub rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs: gang shar rang grol thugs rje rgyun chad med:mi phyed dad pa'i dgongs klong mngon tu gyur: drag po'i g.yul rgyal seng chen dgra 'dul gyis: mi min bdud kyi dpung rgod phab pa'i gtam: ngo mtshar dgra bla dgyes pa'i mchod sprin nam: me rlung 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor kun la khyab:ces ngal gsos tshig go: der gling dmag gis byang rgyal sras btsun mo dang bcas pa bzung nas mi min g.yu thang dga' tshal du sgar brgyab cing g.yul las rgyal ba dang: mi min gyi bu mo tshe 'dzin dpon g.yog rnams kyis bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa mang du gling rgyal blon rnams la phul 424

nas dran tshor gyi glu zhus 'di ltar phul lo:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: chos sku kun tu bzang mo dang: longs sku mkha' spyod dbang gi lha: sprul sku marnya ra ba rnams: mi 'bral yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: don dam glu la 'gugs rogs mdzod: gnas lugs bdar sha chod par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: g.yu thang dga' ba'i tshal yangs red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:skye ba 'di yi gong rol la: bag chags dri ma'i ma gos gong: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo bye ba'i gtso mo yin: skye 'dir mi min byang gi sras: na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: de nas gling dkar dpung gi sde: yang sgos ge sar dbang gi rgyal: phar song dmag gi rting ma la: byang ba stobs kyi rgyal khams pham: khrag ral rgyal po khri dang bral: rgyal sras mched gnyis gtso byas pas: yum chen lha lcam btson la bzung: bsags pa'i rgyu nor dpung gis 'phrog: skyes pa'i mi rnams khrag la bsgyur: sdug gi a thang chad pa byas: na chung bu mo'i bsam tshul la: yum chen a ma khri chen khong: ya rabs dam pa'i ngang tshul ldan: dgongs lo mtho ba'i tshad la phyin: sku tshegs 'o brgyal ma gtong cig: gzhan yang sras chung spun gnyis dang: sras mo mtsho kha'i me tog gsum: skyon med rang dbang yod par zhu:las dmag dpung gi sde tshan dang: dpa' rgod btsan gyis bzung ba 425

rnams: srog chad nyes rdung med par zhu: 'dzam gling bod kyi rgyal po khyed:sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sprul red: snying rje byams sems los kyang yod:rma khams gling gi rgyal blon la: rting ma dgung las mtho na yang: mi min byang gi sde tshogs la: gnam nag dgung nas 'thib pa'i phyir: thugs rjes btang snyoms byed par zhu: sdug can sems dang skyid po'i sems: mi 'dra byams sems sgom rogs mdzod: bu mo'i zhu phod ma yin te: mi zhu ka med dus la babs: mi min dpung gi sde tshogs 'di: g.yul 'gyed dpung gis pham na yang: dkar po dngul gyi sde tshogs rnams: da rung brag rdzong phug na yod: bsam blo 'di la btang rogs zhu: lha nas smon lam thebs na yang: mi nas spyod pa bstun dgos yod: de min bu mo shi yang rung:dngul rdzong gling la sprod don med: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go ba la yang len med: ge sar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs ba dang: gling rgyal blon kun gyis byang bzas glu la mthong chen mi byed thabs med tsam du gyur: der byang gi rgyal mo dang rgyal sras thams cad ge sar gyi mdun du bos pas: zla gsal gyi sems la da bya ba ngan pa 'di 'dra ba'i 'og nas yab chen khri gdugs nyi ma de: ge sar gza' rgod kha la shor nas byang yul mi med lung stong du bsgyur zin pas dgra la sha lan zhig rtsod ma thub par shi dgos thug pa red bsam nas 426

dpa' gting rgod kyi ngang du byung: rin chen dpal bzang gi sems la:da yab chen ma dbang par dgra la shor zin pas byang gi jus srid la 'dang brgyag sa med pa'i srog thar thabs shig e yod bsam nas skrag skrag gi nyams dang bcas thon: gzhan rgyal mo sras mo gnyis ci dran 'di dran med par ngo yi mdangs yang shor nas khrid byung ba'i mod la: der kho tshos bkyig thag rnams grol nas gdan re re la 'dug tu bcug par byang sras zla gsal kho mi thub par zhal gyi mdangs la mun nag 'khrig: so sgra bsgrags nas dran pa bskor log brgyab kyang shor la khad byas par: mi min dpon gyi sras mo tshe 'dzin mas bka' bkyon gnang zhing bar 'bud mdzad tshe: byang mi min gyi sras po des dran tshor gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: sde mi min byang gi srung ma rnams: sdug a thang chad na gar song med: nged byang gi skyid sdug mi gzigs par: sde gling ba'i grogs la ma bros sam: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: yul mi min g.yu thang dga' tshal red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: nga rgyal sras zla gsal 'bum lu yin: dgra nag po'i sngon gyi sdug phrug nga: da snga dro shi ba'i snga rgyu dang: sang phyi dro shi ba'i phyi rgyu med: gdan kheb bu brtsegs pa'i yang steng nas: sde ma ngan 'gag phrug kha ser khyod:sems nag po ga 'dra 'khrul nas 'dug: nga mi min dpon gyi rgyal sras 427

yin: khyod btang snyoms slod la ci phyir gtong: ske thag nag grol ba'i dga' rgyu med: khyod phung rgan mgon la bsten pa las: nga shi na 'gyod pa spu tsam med: nga gson na sha lan rtsod nges yin: dpa' rtsal drug ldan pa'i skyes bu zhig: skye zer na brgya sde dga' ni zhig: dgra ngo nag khros pa'i ngar lam nas: shi zer na 'jig rten smon ni zhig: byed ma nus bu skyes wa dang 'dra: yang de min bya ba'i bzhag so la: bu mi ming ma yin khyi ming yin: khyi skyag zan bas kyang mi thu 'am: ya de nas dmar nag gling gi sde:'dre jo ru nag rtsog gtso byas pas: sman ngan ma tshe 'dzin lha mo lags:drin pha rgan gsod pa'i dgra bo la: gtam ngo dga' skad cha ci go red:sems shes med byang bza' col re chung: phyi sde ba'i go na 'phya smod byed:nang sde bas mthong na zhe nas khrel: nga ming chung sngon nas sha re tsha: gtam ma mang don la snying po med: ya de nas gling sdug jo ru dpon: nga bu chung steng gi dpa' rtsal 'di: khyod hor la thug dus e yod shes: hor gur dkar stag zhu rgyal po des: pho rdzong rabs dgu yi 'dems ya dang:mkhar dngul chu khro rdzong nang bcud de: ldong 'bum pa'i rgya tsha rgyang grags can: kho dmar bsad khrag gi 'khor lo bskor: nga bu chung steng gi rdzig nyams te: hor shan pa'i steng la e yod shes: dpon jo ru'i nu bo rong tsha kho: mkhar byu ru stag rtse'i nang bcud zer: hor shan pa mang pos rtsed 428

byad byas: dgra sha lan e lon bsam blo thongs: gzhan gzig 'phen la sogs da pa' rtul rnams: hor ser bos ma bsad shor ba nyung: khyod de dus jo ru gad la yub: byang me bza'i 'gram nas srog mgo thon: khyod snying re rje la sha re tsha: dus de ring zla gsal dpa' bo ngas: sems ya chung byang khog sdug gis mnar: khyod mda' 'ben bsam na mda' 'ben zhog: spags gson bshu bsam na gson bshu gyis: nga byang phrug bu yis bzod nges yin: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyod gling dmag yid la de ltar zhog:ces zer ba dang: bu chung na tshod ma rdzogs pa zhig la ci 'dra kha lce bde la gnad dang ldan: 'di'i blo kha myur du ma bsgyur na yag po mi 'dug bsam mkhan kyang byung: ge sar rin po che'i thugs la snying rje tshad med pa zhig 'khrungs nas ye shes lnga'i dpal bskyed de 'gro blo'i dug lnga gzhom pa'i ting 'dzin bskyed kyang thun gyi rdzas kyis brabs pas byang sras de ru sar 'gyel: dran pa sos pa na thog ma'i nga rgyal drag po de zhu nas ci dran 'di dran med par cung slod la babs par gda': der byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mos sras ming chung la gros 'debs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: de ring bu mo'i mgon skyabs mdzod: don dam 429

glu yi snying bo la: nges shes gting nas 'khrungs bar shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: mi min g.yu thang dga' tshal red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: na chung tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: de nas zla gsal 'bum lu nyon: dung zla sprin gyis ma sgrib gong: skar tshogs zhu sna gsan rogs zhu: bang kha rdo la ma thug gong: spang thang tshal la phebs rogs gnang: gces srog dgra la ma shor gong: a ches zhu ba go bar mdzod: pho rabs blo de nam mkha' 'dra: nam mkha' sprin tshogs rgyu sa yod: pho 'bring blo de bar snang 'dra: bar snang char chu mod sa red: pho ngan blo de gu dog pas: bsam sa dran sa ci yang med: dad pa can de chos kyis 'dren: go ba can la tshig gi chog: rtsa ba med pa'i skad cha des: don med zhe sems dkrugs don med: rang tshod bzung na dga' le gda': 'jig rten mi yi zer tshul la: gangs dkar rtse yi seng phrug kho: thang la 'khyan na khyi dang 'dra: rgya rdzong nags kyi stag phrug de: sa mthar bskor na wa la nor: mkha' lam rgyu ba'i khyung chen de: sgro gshog rul na thang la lhung:gtsang bo'i gzhung gi gser mig de: chu dang bral na rnga ma g.yugoḥ 'jig rten las kyi chos nyid red: yum chen dgung gi zla ba dang: khyed dang sras chung sras mo sogs: mi 'chi mgo thon byung bas dus: don med ku co a bar rig: rang tshod rang gi bzung na dga': pha shi ma bsad g.yul pham 430

gyi: sdug bsngal sus kyang sems na yod: lha bdud las kyi pham rgyal la:btang snyoms mi byed thabs dang bral: phyogs kyi rdzong khag so so nas:thon pas dpa' rtul thams cad kyang: g.yul pham 'di 'dra'i 'og nas thon: sngon gyi dpe la lta sa yod: phyi rabs gtam la nyan rgyu yodoḥ bu chung mthe mong tsam zhig gis: kha che tshig 'phang ma mtho zhig: bya la phyi 'dang brgyag sa yod: go ba zab mo lon par gyis: ge sar dpon la dad pa zhog: tshig ngan gtam la 'gyod bshags mdzod: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: sras chung thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: sku rje ge sar gyi byin rlabs dang a che'i glu yi don la go ba lon nas dbu sa la bsgur nas 'dug: ge sar rin po ches byin rlabs mdzad nas blo mi log pas nges shes thob par byas:gzhan rgyal mo dang sras sras mo rnams la byin rlabs rjes gnang mdzad nas skyon med par thar:de'i skabs su sde mi min byang gi skye pho mo rgan gzhon thams cad 'dus nas blo pham dpa' gzhum pa'i ngang la gnas tshe: gling rgyal blon rnams kyis bka' bsgrags nas deng phyin chad srog gcod sdig la 'dzems rgyu dang: dkar po'i chos ci nus re byed rgyu ma tshad mi min byang gi rgyal sras zung gis yul sde rang rgyu rang bdag chog pa sogs bka' bsgrags 431

pas thams cad yid ches nas dad phyag dpon ge sar la 'tshal: rang tshod dang bstun pa'i rgyu nor gyi 'bul ba mang du phul nas dam chos gsung bar yang yang bskul bar 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po: mdo khams lha yi gtso bo: nyams chung skyobs pa'i pha ma: drag po bdud kyi kha gnon des rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgo nas mang khrus mdzad pas dad ldan 'gro ba kun gyi lus kyi nyes ltung dri ma thams cad 'dag par byas rgyal ba rigs gsum mgon po'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes te spyi bo nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs kyi dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa rnams dag:mgrin pa nas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa rnams dag: snying ka nas mthu stobs bdag po phyag na rdo rje yi lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur bas yid kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag:ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i dbang lung khrid sogs gnang nas sde chos med mi min gyi yul la chos kyi nyi ma shar zhing sems can la bde skyid 'byung bar gda':des nub mo sku rje seng chen bla ma gzim la yul pa'i tho rengs la: ma 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo: a ne gong sman rgyal mo des seng ge dkar mo 'og tu bcibs: rin chen sna lnga'i sku brgyan dkris: 'ja' 'od sprin dpung 'thib pa'i klong yangs nyams dga' ba nas gar bsgyur lam 432

mer byon zhing byang mi min gter brag mchong ri gzi ldan gyi gter sgo 'byed ran pa'i dus babs kyi lung bstan snyan 'jebs dal 'gro'i ring mo 'di ltar gsungs so:na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: gzhi mkha' dbyings 'gyur med don gyi klong: rje mtsho 'khrungs sangs rgyas padma 'byung: bus gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: lam ma rig 'khrul ba bsal du gsol: gnas 'di 'dra a sngon nam mkha'i khams: sprin dkar dmar spungs ba'i gzhi dkyil red:ma nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: dpal o rgyan padma'i pho nya mchog: nga mgyogs byed ḍā ki gnam sman sgron: gling ge sar dpon gyi a ne yin: ya de nas 'dzam gling seng chen rje: snyan dar lung ma g.yel glu la gson: dus da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrugs kyi: snyan grags pa 'dzam gling bod la bzhag: kho mi min khrag ral rgyal po dang: dpa' thog 'brug glog dang me chu'i ming:kho dug smyon rtsal ldan dpung dang bcas: bsad bsad kyi mtha' la gtugs nas bzhag: spyir sems can rnams kyi don chen 'grub: da ma 'gyang dngul gter 'don ran pas: sde mi min byang lung bco brgyad kyi:gnas khu byug dar thang yar mtha' na: mtsho chung chung me long 'dra ba yod:gnas chu skyes padma'i dga' tshal na: bya ngang ngur mang po rang dbang mnga': mtsho de la bskor ba lan gsum rgyob: mtsho de yi yar la 'gro sa 433

na: byang smug po'i lung dang rgya rdzong lung: mdzes padma'i lung dang rnam gsum yod: lung chen po gsum gyi lung phug na: ri mchod rten dkar po'i tog 'dra yod: ri de la rten pa'i brag dmar yod: brag 'bur dod sbrul gyi mgo 'dra yod: mtshams re 'ga' g.yo 'gul nam pa can: des mi tshad sbrul mig 'khyil ba yod: sde byang gi rdzong bdag brag ral red: ma tshe 'dzin thon na g.yo 'gul byed: mda' thog rgod gcig gis sna la gtor: gnas de nas phar la byon pas na: byang mi min bla ri nag po yod: de'i lab tse dpa' rtul dpung gis gtor: khyed seng chen bla mas ting 'dzin gyis: kho bdud btsan me 'bar dam la thogs: gnas de nas yar la cung byon na: byang mi min gter gyi ri bo mthong: steng 'ja' 'od drwa ba lam me yod: bar 'dab chags ri dwags rtsed ra yod: 'og 'dre srin mi min 'byung bo yod: yul sman mo rkang 'jibs 'khor dang bcas:mthu ngan sngags drag pos ngang la sgrol: byang yul bdag srin po lcags ral kho: gling ge sar skyes bus dam la thogs: byang gter brag mchong ri gzi ldan gyi: gter 'byed par tshe 'dzin thabs la mkhas: gtam de rnams ma brjed thugs la bzung: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed ge sar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces lung bstan pa nang bzhin nyi ma de yi phyir nyin gling gi dpa' 434

rtul dpung dang bcas pa thams cad la lung bstan gyi brda don grol:khyad par du ge sar rin po che dang byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo gnyis kyi o rgyan yab yum gyi brgyan cha lugs tshang ba zhig byas te byon: dpa' rtul dpung dang bcas pa thams cad shin tu dga' zhing bkra shis kha smon dang bcas shar skya rengs kyi skya mda' ma bkyag: sngo rengs kyi sngo mda' ma brgyab gong la 'tshub 'khyil ler lam la chas: sde mi min byang lung bco brgyad nas khu byug dar thang yar mtha' na yod pas mtsho la bskor ba lan gsum brgyab: byang lung chen gsum gyi phug na ri mchod rten dkar po'i tog 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i brag 'bur dod sbrul gyi mgo 'dra ba phyir mngon byung ba mda' thog rgod gcig gis sna la gtor: gnas bla ri nag po'i lab tse de dpa' rtul dpung gis gtor bar bdud btsan me 'bar khros nas 'brug grags glog mched thog dmar 'phangs pa sogs rtags sna tshogs bstan par seng chen bla mas ting 'dzin gyis kho bya 'ug pa lcags kyi mchu sder can zhig gi rnam par sar lhung ba la mna' chu blud nas dam la btags shing phyis su yul bdag mchong lha dgu mdzes su mnga' gsol:yul sman mo rkang 'jibs 'khor dang bcas pa ge sar rgyal pos mthu ngan sngags kyis bkug nas bsgral: der srin po lcags ral 'khor bcas kyis drag pos ngan mthu 'byed par 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod dang: 'bum 435

pa'i dgra lha rtse rgyal: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po rnams kyis mda' 'phangs nas yul bdag gi bran gcan gzan gyi mgo can bzhi bsgral: sku rje seng chen bla mas ye shes drag po'i khro tshogs las la bskul nas la las srin po lcags ral gyi rkang lag bsdams: la las skra nas bzung: la las lcags tshan gyis brab nas bkug byung ba dang: kho shin tu skrag nas skyabs zhu byas te bran tu khas len mdzad 'dug pa dam la btags shing ma 'ong pa na nub padma rigs kyi gter ston zhig gi gter srung du lung bstan nas byang mi min dngul gyi gter rdzong len pa la rten 'brel gnad du smin par mdzad: de nas yar byon zhing byang mi min gter gyi ri bo steng 'ja' 'od drwa ba lam me: bar 'dab chags ri dwags rtsed ra: 'og 'dre srin mi min 'byung bo rgyu ba'i gnas de ru ngo mtshar stong gi phyug par gda': der mi min bu mo tshe 'dzin lha mos gter 'byed pa'i rten 'brel dus la babs pa dga' spro dang bcas nor bu bsam 'byung me 'bar zer ba zhig phyag tu bzung zhing 'dzam gling ge sar mi yi nyi ma la bkra shis brda bstod kyi glu 'di byang glu ngang dkar ldem drug la drangs nas blangs so:glu tha la la mo tha la red: glu a la la mo a la red: chos dbyings khyab brdal zhing khams su: dung la nyi 'od shar 'dra ma: chos sku kun tu 436

bzang mo mkhyen: shes rab rgyun chad med par shog: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas: padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan ma: longs sku mkha' spyod dbang mo mkhyen: gnas lugs don dang mthun par shog: sprul sku'i zhing khams so so nas: sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: 'bum phrag yangs ba'i mkha' 'gro mkhyen: rang gzhan don gnyis lhun 'grub shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: gter brag mchong ri gzi ldan red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na:bag chags dri mas ma gos gong: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rtse 'dzin ma:rdo rje rigs la skye ba blangs: 'jig rten mi yi rgyal khams nas: byang bza' tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: glu 'di'i glu ngo ma shes na: dpa' bo dgyes pa'i mchod phreng ngam: dpa' mo spro ba'i bro gar yin: byang glu ngang dkar ldem drug zer: ldem drug dri za'i dbyangs dang 'dra: ci ma yin la len pa min: rten 'brel dus la babs na len: ma dang mkha' 'gros dgongs bskul bzhin: de ring byang bza' tshe 'dzin mas: ngo mtshar gtam gyi bden pa bsdaroḥ brda don tshang ba'i glu zhig len: sku rje lha yi bla ma yi:dbu la pad zhwa mthong grol gsol: gzi byin nyi ma 'bum las lhag:'dzam gling dbang du bsdu bas brda: khams gsum g.yul rgyal mchog la bstod: sku la mthing nag za ber gsol: dug lnga'i g.yul las rgyal bas brda: chos nyid don gyi rje la bstod: phyag na rdo rje phur bu bsnams: mi 437

'jigs gdeng chen thob pa'i brda: theg pa mchog gi rje la bstod: sku la 'od zer sna tshogs bkra: 'gro don thogs pa med ba'i brda: don gnyis lhun 'grub rje la bstod: gsung la grags stong chos sgra ldir: skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda: mtha' bral yon tan rje la bstod: thugs klong khyab brdal nam mkha' bzhin: chos nyid g.yo 'gul med pa'i brda:'khrul med sangs rgyas rje la bstod: g.yas na bya rta rlung gshog steng: mi dkar dung gi zhal bzang can: grogs lha dkar po'i tshul du bzhugs:g.yon na lha rta mtshal mdog steng: mi dkar khrag gi zhal mdangs can:dgra bla btsan po'i tshul du bzhugs: de min gser ba'i nyi 'bum dang:lha rgod 'dan ma la sogs pa: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshul du bzhengs:rten 'brel bzang bo dus su 'dzoms: smon lam yang dag 'grub nas byung: 'phru dkar kha ba babs pa bzhin: lha yi ngo so mtho ba'i brda: 'phru ser nyi ma shar ba 'dra: gnyan gyi rting ma che ba'i brda: 'phru dmar khrag mtsho 'khyil ba 'dra: btsan gyi mel tshe myur ba'i brda: 'phru nag grib so bkug pa 'dra: dpa' rtsal bdud las che ba'i brda: 'phru khra me tog 'khrungs ba 'dra: sde brgyad dpung du gdong ba'i brda: brda rnams zems cad don dang ldan: de nas sku rje bla ma gtsos: dpa' rtul thams cad yar gzigs dang: gter brag nor bu spungs 'dra na: g.yas na me ru 438

'bar 'dra'i ri: rlung rta dar ba'i rtags su shar: g.yon na stag mo mchong 'dra'i ri: dgra 'dul rting ma bzang bar dpyad: brag sked dar gyi lan gsum dkris: las rlung yar la 'gro bar dpyad: brag dkyil 'od dang ldan pa yi: mu tig las grub rgyal mtshan yod: g.yas na rdo yi g.yung drung dang: g.yon na khyung sku 'bur dod yod: o rgyan rje dang gnyis med pas: seng chen mi yi rje rgyal lags: rje 'bangs rig pa 'dzin rnams kyi:spyan 'dren mchod bskul myur du gyis: de nas gter brag ri bo nas:gter bdag sha za mkha' 'gro ma: rdo rje khu byug mgo can gyis: gter gyi lde'u mig sprod nas yongs: ma brjed skyes bu'i thugs la bzung: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: seng chen thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang: bkra shis pa'i dar dgung la bstod pa lho yi sprin chen 'khrigs 'khrigs: gu ru'i las bsnyen gyi sgras dbyangs g.yu 'brug mkha' nas grags grags byas: der gter brag gi mdun la bsang khri brtsigs: dpa' mkhar bzhengs: lha bsang nam mkha' gang ba zhig btang nas bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor bzhin pa'i sgang la: sku rje seng chen bla mas bod kyi rje 'bangs rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i glu 'di 'gags med rdo rje'i rang sgra la drangs nas blangs so:439

glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: gnas rgya gar nub byang o rgyan yul/ mjes pad dkar stong ldan bzhad pa'i khar: rje bla ma padma 'byung gnas la: 'khor rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs:dus de ring bkra shis nyi ma la: thugs ma g.yel gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byang gter brag g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: gnas dur khrod me dpung 'bar ba'i klong:dpal ye shes sgyu ma'i bdag nyid mchog: rje khro bo yongs 'dus drag pa rtsal: dpal khro tshogs bye ba 'bum gyi bskor: sngags nus pa'i sa gsum 'dar zhing g.yo: dus de ring bkra shis nyi ma la: thugs ma g.yel gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byang gter brag g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod:mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: gnas dhu ma tha la'i grong khyer nas: 'od 'ja' zer 'khrugs pa'i mnga' bdag ma: sman mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: 'khor rgya bod rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor: dus de ring bkra shis nyi ma la: thugs ma g.yel gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:byang gter brag yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min gter brag g.yang sgo red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: bod dbu nag yongs kyi lha skal la:steng gong ma lha nas bskos pa de: nga 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po yin: ya 440

de nas dpa' rtul lha yi tshogs: yang sgos su tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro ma:ngas de ring bkra shis nyi ma la: rten 'brel 'byung glu yi mchod pa 'bul:snyan dbang bo ma g.yeng tshur la gson: yid 'dod don 'grub par mdzad du gsol: yul gangs can bsam yas gtsug lag nas: lha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog: rje khri srong lde'u btsan thugs dam bskul:dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: mkhar chu bo dpal gyi phug ring nas: lha bde gshegs thugs kyi grub pa brnyes: 'bangs nam mkha'i snying po nyi zer chibs: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: brag yangs rdzong shel gyi phug pa nas: lha bde gshegs sku yi grub pa brnyes: 'bangs sangs rgyas ye shes brag phur 'debs: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol:gnas mchims phu spre'u'i yang dben nas: lha bde gshegs gsung gi grub pa brnyes: 'bangs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad 'don: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol:gnas ne'u ring seng ge'i rdzong phug na: lha bde gshegs phrin las grub pa brnyes: ma ye shes mtsho rgyal mi ro slong: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gnas sham po gangs 441

dkar dben gnas su: yul bde stong dga' bzhi'i grub pa brnyes:'bangs dpal gyis ma mo bran tu bkol: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gnas yar lung shel gyi brag phug na: lha bde gshegs yon tan grub pa brnyes: 'bangs tsā na ku mar rdzu 'phrul che: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gnas mtsho chen sngags kyi sgrub phug nas: lha dregs pa dbang sdud grub pa brnyes: 'bangs dpal gyi seng ges lha srin 'dul: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gna' g.ya' ma lung gi dben gnas su:mthu mngon spyod las la grub pa thob: 'bangs bai ro tsa na ye shes mnga':dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: dpal rig stong skye med dgongs par 'phos: 'bangs g.yu sgra snying bo rtogs pa ldan: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: spyir 'khor 'das gnyis med klong la rdzogs: 'bangs sna nam dbang phyug bya ltar 'phur: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: lha zhi khro rgyal ba dgongs par chub: 'bangs lang gro dkon mchog thog mda' 'phen: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar 442

mdzad du gsol: rgyu zag med rdo rje brag la mdzad: 'bangs rma thang rin chen lha tshogs mjal: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: yul stong chen mkha' la bya ltar lding:'bangs 'brog yul stod kyi lo paṇa mchog: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: 'dre brag srin lcags phur dbal gyis sgrol: 'bangs shud pu dpal seng chu bo bsgyur:dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: yul gnyis 'dzin bdud dpung dbyings su gzhom: 'bangs rdo rje bdud 'joms thogs med rtsal: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: chos 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i ltad mor gzigs: 'bangs ska ba dpal brtsegs gzhan sems shes:dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: rtsal bzhi ldan dpa' bo ho ru ka: 'bangs sog po lha dpal stag la 'ju: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: don rig stong rtsal gyis bdag 'dzin sgrol:'bangs dran pa nam mkha'i snying po mchog: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: don mi brjed rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob: 'bangs ldan ma rtse mang dgyes pa'i sku: dus 443

de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: bcud nus pas ro lang gser la bsgyur: 'bangs rgyal ba'i blo gros che mchog rtsal: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: rten nam mkha' thog bcas 'gro 'dug mdzad: 'bangs rgyal ba byang chub rol ba'i sku: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gnas khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol: 'bangs klu yi mtshan can grags pa'i dpal: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: bdud lta log tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs: 'bangs lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje mchog: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: rtsal rang byung shes rab me chen 'bar:'bangs klu yi dbang po glegs bam 'chang: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: lus zag med 'ja' lus sku ru mnga': khong nying ban ting 'dzin bzang bo mchog: dus de ring g.yang sgo phye rogs mdzod: bod bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gzhan dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad dang: g.yang gter bdag lha klu gnyan dang bcas: thugs dgongs pa dbyings la mi g.yel bar: don gang brtsam 'phrin las mdzad du gsol: glu go na rna ba'i 444
bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: steng lha tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung nas lha bsang gis rting rag nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' dbang brnyes so:445

le'u bcu dgu ba/rin chen shel dkar nor bu'i gter//'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du spel//rten 'brel smon lam dkar po'i rgya//dbu nag bde dgas brgyan du gyur//der 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po dang: mi min tshe 'dzin lha mo: gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag: lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal: rgyal sras a stag rtse rgod: 'bru sras byang rong btsan po: a khu spyi dpon rgyal po: stag rong dpon po khro thung: 'dan ma g.yul rgyal thog rgod: seng stag dam pa rab rgyas sogs kyi mdzes pa'i chas dang bcas gter brag gi mdun nas yar byon par gter bdag rdo rje khu byug gi mgo can des gter sgrom dang gter shog phul ba las gter sgo 'byed tshul thams cad bstan nas mi snang bar gyur: 'dzam gling rgyal pos mu tig rang 'khrungs kyi rgyal mtshan las mchong gi sgrom bu phyag tu bzung nas 'o ma'i rigs dang dkar gsum mchod cing dam tshig bsgrags par mi min byang gi gter brag mchong ri gzi ldan gyi gter sgo phyes pas nang du 'ja' 'od dri bzang gi dbus na 446

mchong gi grub pa'i shākya thub pa: mu tig gi phyag na rdo rje: beeḍūrya'i sgrol ma: chu snying las grub pa'i bya khyung: bho ro'i ne tso: mu min gyi gsol kar sogs dang: tsu ta rdo yi snying po: si ra ka rma bya'i mgrin chung: chu chung ni la: padma rā ga: ind+ra ni la: chu shel nor bu chu 'byung kun phan: me shel nor bu 'od 'phro: gzi'i nor bu maddha we: byu ru'i nor bu me 'bar sogs dang: gzhan yang dngul gyi rigs zlum po: zla gam: gru bzhi: gru gsum:rin chen sa rdo'i dngul sogs drel khal stong la nye ba zhig blangs nas byang gling gnyis kyi las dmag 'khor dang bcas pa la dngul 'gyed btang: ge sar rin po ches gter shog gter yig rnams phyir sbas nas smon lam btab par gter sgo sngar ltar bsdams: der mi min bu mo tshe 'dzin lha mos 'byung 'gyur lung du ston pa dang: smon lam dkar po'i mtha' brgyan pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: po ṭa la yi zhing khams nas: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: smon lam yid bzhin 'grub par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: gter brag g.yang gi lte ba red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mi min tshe 'dzin lha mo yin: de ring bkra shis nyi ma shar: smon lam dkar po'i snang ba sharoḥ da lo byang gling g.yul 'khrugs skabs: 'das pa'i mi 447

rta chag grul gyi: sdig ltung mi dge kun dag nas: bde chen thar lam thob par shog: sangs rgyas byang sems byin rlabs dang: ge sar lha yi bden stobs kyis: rigs ldan lcags 'khor can gyi sar: tshom bu gcig la sangs rgyas shog: khyad par mi min dngul rdzong 'di: 'dzam gling yul gru kun la khyaboḥ ḍi ga rta rmig la sogs pa'i: dngul rigs nam pa sna tshogs kyis: 'gro ba'i 'dod don kun 'grub nas: rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog: rin chen dngul gyi byin mthu yis: bsod nams longs spyod 'phel bar shog: 'bad med g.yang du 'phyur bar shog: dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel bar shog: 'gro ba'i bla ma rin chen gyi: gdul bya dngul dkar nor bus spel: stag shar dgra bla'i rje bo des: dpa' rtags dngul dkar bzang pos ston: na chung mdzes ldan sgeg mo yis: bkrag mdangs dngul dkar dag pas bskyedoḥ zad med dngul gyi gter kha de: rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil bar shog: dngul la longs spyod 'dzoms nas byung: ri rgyal bzhin du mtho bar shog: dngul la dbang thang dar nas byung: nam mkha' bzhin du bskyed par shog: dngul la spes ka legs pa de: sprin bral nyi 'od bzhin du shog: dngul dkar g.yang gi 'dod 'byung gis:sems can re ba yongs bskang nas: phan bde spel la thogs med shog:'dzad med yon tan rang bzhin gyur: mdor na yangs ba'i rgyal khams 448

su:rtsod med dngos grub thob pa'i phyir: sa rdo ri brag shing dkar las:dngul gyi dwangs bcud 'byung bar shogoḥ bkra shis nam mkha' kun la khyab: smon lam sbrang char sha ra ra: sems can re smon padma'i tshal:mdzes sdug 'od dang 'grogs par shog: shākya'i bstan pa dar bar shog:sems can bde skyid ldan par shog: nad med tshe thag ring bar shog:dpal dang 'byor ba rgyas par shog: khams gsum dbang du bsdu bar shog: bdud bzhi srog dang bral bar shog: khyad par sku rje bla ma yi:mdzad pa mu tig dkar po'i phreng: 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i brgyan gyur nas: bstan 'gro'i bde legs bskyed du gsol: ma 'ong dus kyi bskal ba ru: gling dkar dpa' rtul thams cad kyi: sprul ba tha mi dad pa yis:'gro don dpag med 'byung bar shog: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: bden stobs smon lam bslu med pas:bstan 'gro'i rgud pa bsal du gsol: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: 'dir tshogs thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs ba dang zin tu bkra shis pa'i ltas dang rtags mtshan thams cad mngon du gyur bar gda': de nas gling rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa sgar du pheb nas dgyes tshogs la rol bas rjes su gur rnams bsdus: rin chen dngul sogs gter rdzas rnams rta drel la bkal 449

nas nyi 'od lam mer byang mi min g.yu thang la byon zhing g.yul las rgyal bas ngang la gling yul du pheb par brtsams nas byang rdzong gi mnga' bdag du byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub lo gcig la bzhugs su bcug pa dang:der stag zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi snga mor gling dmag 'tshub 'khyil ler lam la chas par byang byu ru'i chos 'grub dpon gyis phebs skyel mdzad kyang bkra shis smon lam gyis glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: dpal sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: lha bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum: mdo rgyud sde bzhi yi lha la 'dud: mchog byin rlabs dngos grub 'bad med stsol: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: byang mi min g.yul thang ra ba red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: byang byu ru'i rgyal khag bco brgyad nas: dpon stag rtse rgyal po'i sras po nga: byang byu ru'i bka' blon chos 'grub yin: ya de nas 'dra ma 'di ltar gda': rta 'do chen rkyang rgod 'phur shes steng:yul srog bdag mi dbang ge sar rgyal: mchog gang sku ri rab lhun po brtan: gsung snyan 'jebs phang 'gro'i gru char 'bebs: thugs kun mkhyen ye shes 'gro la snyoms: don yongs 'grub yon tan rgya mtsho 'khyil:mthu drag po'i 'phrin las me chen 'bar: steng 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin po che: dpa' g.yul rgyal mtshungs med mchog la bstod: phyogs gar byin 450

don 'grub mun sel zhing: skyid gzhi byes lhan tu 'dzoms par shog:g.yas khri gdugs nyi ma dgra lha dang: g.yon dung gi zla ba rtse rgod zung:dpal stobs bcu'i mnga' thang rgyas pa dang: gling chos srid dar ba'i srog shing shog: gong gser ba'i nyi 'bum nyi ma shar: sdug mun pa'i rmag rim sel bar shog: rong lha rgod stag mo 'dzum drug rgyas: dgra nag po'i dpung tshogs 'joms par shog: seng a dom sbom ra lha yi sras: dpal dgra bla'i dbu 'phang mtho bar shog: dpa' 'dan ma dgra yi tho ba gruboḥdapa' g.yul rgyal rting ma che bar shog: rje spyi dpon blo yi rdzi bo mchog:thabs bkod pa skar tshogs bkra bar shog: dpon stag rong rdzu 'phrul lha la 'gran: don gang brtsam bsam pa 'grub par shog: 'bru sga bde skyogs la rang dbang thob: sdang dgra bo'i btsan rdzong bcom par shog: dpa' 'bru sras byang rong btsan po gcig: bu seng stag dam pa rab rgyas gnyis:khong 'bru sras lha'u bsam 'grub gsum: blon 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me bzhi: gling rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra lnga: dpa' gser ba'i dung zla nyi shar drug: sde bal sras thog rgod ya med bdun: yul rol ba'i mtsho bdun chags pa bzhin: shar gling dkar stod kyi brgyan tu shog: hor sdig gcod shan pa me ru rtse: byang a stag 'khyil ba'i klu mo mtsho: dpa' 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur dpon: mon dung skyong stag lha 'phru dkar can: dpa' 451
