chen po'i ru 'dren sde bzhi de: stobs rgyal chen bzhi dang mnyam par shog:dpung 'bum dmag nam mkha'i skar tshogs bkrag: dgra gza' rgod g.yul las rgyal bar shog: steng mi la na tsha med par shog: lha tshe dpag med dang gnyis med shog: phyugs rkang bzhir god kha mi 'byung shog:g.yang dzam bha la dang 'bral med shog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: khyed gling dkar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces glu de ltar blangs ba dang: sku rje rin po ches chos 'grub la byin rlabs dang srung ba gnang: gzhan gling ba rnams kyis so so dbu thod gtugs nas 'bral mi phod pa'i ngang du shar gling dkar stod la chibs kha bsgyur bar gda': phyogs kyi dpa' rtul rnams kyang rang rang gi yul la phebs nas 'bral mi phod pa ltar byed do:der nyin mang po'i rjes su rma yul gling gi gnas la phebs pa dang:gling gzhis 'dug rnams kyis thos nas spro dga' dang bcas sne len chibs bsu rgya chen mdzad: khyad par du sga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo sogs ma sru rnams kyis ja chang gi phebs bsu byas te mjal dar gyi sprin chen zhig sa la chags par byas: der gling dkar stod kyi mdzes ma: thob chen gnam gyi rgyangs shing: skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mos bkra shis phebs bsu bzang po'i rten 'brel gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:452

glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la red: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang: phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshogs dang bcas:gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: bdag rgyud chos kyis phyug pa dang:gzhan don dpag med 'grub par shog: sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na: ja mkhar ring mo'i nye 'gram red: nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: mdzes sdug dbyar gyi me tog la: sku lus sgyug gsar ldem drug rgyas: skya lo ston pa'i sras mo nga: seng lcam 'brug mo kun la grags: de nas skyes mchog mi yi nor: dgra 'dul g.yul gyi rting ma bcas: rang yul phebs pa ngo mtshar che: lha chen tshangs pa dkar po dang: gnyan chen zur phud lnga ba 'dra:dbu 'phang dgung las mtho ba dang: bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par nges: gzhis kyi pha khu rgan rabs dang: ma sru mtsho la dar chags rnams:nad med tshe thag gnam las ring: dga' skyid nyi ma shar nas yod:gzhon chung byis pa'i rtsed ra skyid: lha dang bla mar byin rlabs 'bar:chos kyi phu thag chod nas gda': pha khu rgan rabs blo gros rgyas: gyod dang kha mchu nag po bsdums: 'byor phyugs g.yang gi rdang thag ring: god med 'phel kha rgyas nas byung: mi la na tsha bar chad med: phyugs la nad yams gyong gud med: jag rkun dgra yi tshur 'gebs med: chos nyid don la gol shor med: da rung de yi ga la tshad: dung mdog 'do ba'i yang steng 453

na: na chung mtsho kha'i me tog de: dkar dmar zhal gyi rang mdangs la:dgyes 'dzum padma'i gzi byin 'bar: lang tsho bcu drug sgeg nyams la:rmad byung sgyu ma'i ltad mo 'dzoms: ltas na mig gi bu lon 'phrog: bsam na sems kyi gong shing dga': tshe 'dzin lha mo ma yin nam: byang gling shar lho kha thag ring: lam gyi ngal ba o re brgyal: ja chang bdud rtsi'i thugs ngal gsos: de min mdo khams gling gi sde: tshur phebs o brgyal che drag pas: bdud rtsi chang dang 'o ma'i ja: bzhes la gsung gleng gtam gyi gzhung: sgra 'dzin snyan gyi dpal du phob: go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: ma go glu la yang len med: gling dkar thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung ba dang: der dgyes spros ngang la mi min sras mo dang seng lcam lha yi me tog gnyis kyi gtsos dwangs sman rnams kyis phan tshun la mjal dar phul res mdzad: khyad par du ldong spyi dpon rgyal po shin tu dgyes nas bkra shis rten 'brel bslu med kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so:glu a la la mo a la red: glu tha la la mo tha la redoḥ glu pha rgyud nam mkha' stong ba'i glu: yul stong ba'i glu zhig mi len rgyu: steng nam mkha' mtha' dbus gnyis dang bral: glu ma rgyud chu bo gzhung 'byams gluoḥ ngas 'byams pa'i glu zhig mi len rgyu: chu 'di la rgyun chad med do zer: glu rang rgyud rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor glu: yang 'phrul ba'i glu zhig mi len rgyu: rtsa 'di 454

la 'gags pa ye nas med: sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na: shar ja mkhar ring mo'i nye 'gram red: pho nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na: rma ri rgyud yag gi ri chen rnams: dbus lha sa'i mchod pa bshams pa 'dra: lho rdza dmar dbang gi la chen te: mtho nam mkha' yar la lang ba 'dra: gnas khra stod chags pa'i rten phur nga: ldong khu bo spyi dpon rgyal po yin: phyi 'byung bzhi 'khrug pa'i lus po rgas: nang sems nyid 'thib pa'i dbang po rgud: yul 'jig rten las kyi 'khrul ba la: mnyam brtag na byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra: sems yid chas khung thub zer ba zhig: 'khrul 'khor ba'i chos la med na yang:gling dkar pos bdud btul rdzong phab pa: ma 'gro ba'i don la smon lam thebs: yid dga' ba'i ltad mo ngo mtshar ldan: don ldan pa'i glu re len dgos yo da: mkhar seng phrug padma stag rtse 'di: steng mi min lha yi 'phrul mkhar red: 'di 'byung bzhi'i khams nas 'jigs las bral: shar rma g.yang chags pa'i brgyan du shog: mkhar nang bzhugs seng chen dbang gi rgyaloḥ lha sangs rgyas stong gi thugs sras red: mtho gser khri ser bo'i gong shing la: sku mi 'gyur chos bdun rdzogs par shog: sman rgyal yum seng lcam 'brug mo gtsos: phyogs rdzong khag dwangs sman me tog bgod:skyid bde dga' longs spyod 'bum dang bcas: rdzong bkra shis rten du bde legs shog: gling dpa' rtul grub chen thams cad kyis: dgra bdud bzhi 455

gces pa'i srog dang bral: chos rgyal bstan bshad sgrub kun la spel: don kun 'grub phyogs las rnam rgyal shog: yul gangs ri'i bskor ba'i 'jig rten gtsos: phyogs rgyal khams tha gru thams cad la: dpal ston pa mchog gi bkra shis shog: lam skyobs pa chos kyi bkra shis shog: yang 'dren pa dge 'dun bkra shis shog: lung sde snod gsum gyi bkra shis shog: gzhung bka' pod rnams kyi bkra shis shog: rje 'jam dpal sku yi bkra shis shog:lha spyan gzigs gsung gi bkra shis shog: mgon phyag rdor thugs kyi bkra shis shog: dpal rgyal kun 'phrin las bkra shis shog: glu bkra shis nam mkha' gang bar shog: don bde legs sa gzhi khyab par shog: sgos thub bstan yun ring 'dzin pa'i sde: mgon tshe mtha' yas dang gnyis med shog: glu go na rna ba'i bdud rtsi la: glu ma go ba la yang len med: shar gling ba'i thugs la de ltar zhog:ces gsung ba dang dpal rtul phu nu thams cad kyis bkra shis so zhes gting snon mdzad cing rten 'brel dgyes ston yid tshims pa gnang nas mthar so so rang mkhar du phebs: sku rje seng chen bla ma khong nyid byang gling gi g.yul 'khrug la shi bsad thebs pa'i mi rta rnams kyi ched du zab lam rdzogs pa chen po'i sgom rim la sku mtshams dam par byas skad:456

smras poḥde ltar byang gling g.yul du 'khrugs pa'i gtam:mi min dngul dkar gter rdzong phab pa yi:ngo mtshar rtogs brjod me rlung 'tshub ma'i byin:sa steng skye 'gro'i yid kyi gsos su smin:stod na rma chen gangs kyi ri bo bajid:smad na ra rgya'i a mye khyung mgon mtho:mtshams na dgu stod bkra shis ra ba yangs:gnas mchog phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di 'dzes:ming don mtshungs pa don kun 'grub pa yis:nor ba med pa dge ba'i bshes dang sprad:rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i brtag bya mtha' ru phyin:las smon dang po'i skya rengs shar nas bsus:skyid sdug bsgrags ma'i 'jig rten 'khor ba ru:rgyal pham bya ba sna tshogs res mos ngang:bzang ngan spel ma'i las la rab gzhom nas:dkar nag dge sdig 'go mnyam do mnyam byas:skabs rer mgo stong mi byed dgu byed kyis:457

smyos byed khu bas mun nag can du bsgyur:rmi lam tshong 'dus yul gyi mgron po rnams:re gsar re mi gsar ba'i zlos gar 'khrab:skabs rer sdug kyang sdug ngo ma zin nas:khrel med g.yo rgyu'i rang bzhin dpon ngan 'ga':khyi lud dar gyis btum pa ma shes nas:lus kyi bde sdug sna re zhu khul myong:kha las dge na nam mkha'i lha yang 'khor:rlung rta rgud na phu nu nye bas dor:'jig rten zin med sdug bsngal gting ring na:brtse ba'i phyi thag can zhig gang du mchis:mi che'i chu rgyun dal gyis snyeg na yang:dge ba'i bshes kyis yang dag lam bzang bstan:rang gis brtson pa cung zad byed khul gyis:sku rje bla ma'i rnam thar dpe ru bkod:'jig rten mi yi lta ba mthun min gyis:smra lce'i brjod pa gang dang ci bshad cing:dal cig mi lus thob pa'i legs rjes su:458

bsod nams rgya mtsho'i nas 'bru tsam 'di bskrun:dge ba bslab chen bslu med 'bras bu yis:srid par 'khyan pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa:sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams shambha lar:tshom bu gcig tu mngon sangs rgyas par shog:ces mi min dngul gyi rdzong chen phab pa me rlung 'tshub ma'i lang tsho zhes bya ba 'di yang mchog sprul 'jigs med phun tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro tā re lha mo: rig 'dzin rnam snang rdo rje sogs dang: gtan grogs tā re skyid bcas kyis bskul ngor 7 rab rgyan me yos lo'i sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang por 'go brtsams te zla ba lnga 'gor pa'i rjes kyi dmar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis par mdo smad sa yi thig le: bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang: gser gzhongs padma'i dga' tshal du yongs su 'grub par byed pa po ni sgrung gter gu ru rgyal mtshan no: 'dir mchog sprul o rgyan phun tshogs kyis sbyin bdag mdzad nas par du bskrun pa lags teoḥ 'dis kyang rgyal khams bde zhing phan bde gnyis kyi 'jig rten mdzes shing sku rje bla ma'i mdzad pa bskal ba rgya mtshor bstan gyur cig: dge'o: bkra shis:sarba maṅga lo:459

'dzam gling skyes mchog seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi rnam par thar ba mu tig phreng mdzes las/mi min dngul rjong /rtsom pa po/ gu ru rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ rta mgrin 'tsho/mdun shog marjes ris pa/ gu ru rgyal mtshan/dpe srun/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /'asprems spel/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing bkram/par 'debs/ zi ling mi rigs par khang /deb tshad/ ho smis850྾ho smis1168 1732dpar shog 14 875yig grangs/ khri26par thengs/ 2007lo'i zla12par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2007lo'i zla12par par thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 1rko1 000dpe rtags/sdubya2smo978—7—5421—1237—8rin rgong / sgor28 00par dbang 'di gar yod pas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)
